`src/Actions/Composite.ps1`:

```ps1
# Composite.ps1
# Typed actions that expand into plain 'registry' or 'service' parts and reuse their exact
# snapshot/restore code:
#   storageSense     documented Storage Sense policies (Policy CSP Storage)
#   wufbPolicy       Windows Update for Business deferral and target-release policies
#   deviceInterrupt  MSI mode, message limit and interrupt affinity policy of GPU, NIC and USB host controllers
#   serviceSet       several service startup types as one action
# The expansion comes from the catalog action (plus, for devices, the devices present now), never
# from a snapshot file, so a modified snapshot cannot redirect a restore.

$script:IgwtStorageSenseKey = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\StorageSense'
$script:IgwtStorageSenseSettings = [ordered]@{
    enabled        = @{ Name = 'AllowStorageSenseGlobal'; Allowed = @(0, 1) }
    cadence        = @{ Name = 'ConfigStorageSenseGlobalCadence'; Allowed = @(0, 1, 7, 30) }
    temporaryFiles = @{ Name = 'AllowStorageSenseTemporaryFilesCleanup'; Allowed = @(0, 1) }
    recycleBinDays = @{ Name = 'ConfigStorageSenseRecycleBinCleanupThreshold'; Min = 0; Max = 365 }
    downloadsDays  = @{ Name = 'ConfigStorageSenseDownloadsCleanupThreshold'; Min = 0; Max = 365 }
}
$script:IgwtWufbKey = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate'
$script:IgwtWufbSettings = @('featureDeferralDays', 'qualityDeferralDays', 'targetRelease')
$script:IgwtInterruptClasses = @('Display', 'Net', 'USB')
$script:IgwtInterruptFields = [ordered]@{
    msiSupported       = @{ Sub = 'MessageSignaledInterruptProperties'; Name = 'MSISupported'; Min = 0; Max = 1 }
    messageNumberLimit = @{ Sub = 'MessageSignaledInterruptProperties'; Name = 'MessageNumberLimit'; Min = 1; Max = 2048 }
    devicePolicy       = @{ Sub = 'Affinity Policy'; Name = 'DevicePolicy'; Min = 0; Max = 5 }
    devicePriority     = @{ Sub = 'Affinity Policy'; Name = 'DevicePriority'; Min = 0; Max = 3 }
}

function New-IgwtRegistryPart {
    [Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions', '', Justification = 'Builds an in-memory object only.')]
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([string]$Key, [string]$Path, [string]$Name, [string]$Kind = 'DWord', $On, $Default = '<absent>', [string]$Label = '')
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Key = $Key; Kind = 'registry'; Label = $Label; Reason = ''
        Action = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'registry'; path = $Path; name = $Name; valueType = $Kind; on = $On; default = $Default; absentValue = $null; equivalentOn = $null; bitClear = $null; onlyIfAbsent = $false }
    }
}

function Get-IgwtInterruptDevices {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Present PCI devices of a class (Display, Net, USB host controllers), read-only. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Class)
    $devices = @(Get-PnpDevice -Class $Class -PresentOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { [string]$_.InstanceId -like 'PCI\*' -and [string]$_.Status -eq 'OK' })
    if ($Class -eq 'USB') { $devices = @($devices | Where-Object { [string]$_.FriendlyName -match '(?i)host controller' }) }
    return $devices
}

function Get-IgwtCompositeParts {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        The concrete registry/service parts of a composite action. Parts that cannot be applied
        on this PC carry a Reason (shown as Not applicable).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    switch ([string]$Action.type) {
        'storageSense' {
            $def = $script:IgwtStorageSenseSettings[[string]$Action.setting]
            if (-not $def) { throw "Unknown Storage Sense setting '$($Action.setting)'." }
            return @(New-IgwtRegistryPart -Key ([string]$Action.setting) -Path $script:IgwtStorageSenseKey -Name $def.Name -On ([int]$Action.value))
        }
        'wufbPolicy' {
            $k = $script:IgwtWufbKey
            switch ([string]$Action.setting) {
                'featureDeferralDays' {
                    return @((New-IgwtRegistryPart -Key 'DeferFeatureUpdates' -Path $k -Name 'DeferFeatureUpdates' -On 1),
                        (New-IgwtRegistryPart -Key 'DeferFeatureUpdatesPeriodInDays' -Path $k -Name 'DeferFeatureUpdatesPeriodInDays' -On ([int]$Action.value)))
                }
                'qualityDeferralDays' {
                    return @((New-IgwtRegistryPart -Key 'DeferQualityUpdates' -Path $k -Name 'DeferQualityUpdates' -On 1),
                        (New-IgwtRegistryPart -Key 'DeferQualityUpdatesPeriodInDays' -Path $k -Name 'DeferQualityUpdatesPeriodInDays' -On ([int]$Action.value)))
                }
                'targetRelease' {
                    return @((New-IgwtRegistryPart -Key 'TargetReleaseVersion' -Path $k -Name 'TargetReleaseVersion' -On 1),
                        (New-IgwtRegistryPart -Key 'ProductVersion' -Path $k -Name 'ProductVersion' -Kind 'String' -On ([string]$Action.value.product)),
                        (New-IgwtRegistryPart -Key 'TargetReleaseVersionInfo' -Path $k -Name 'TargetReleaseVersionInfo' -Kind 'String' -On ([string]$Action.value.version)))
                }
                default { throw "Unknown Windows Update policy setting '$($Action.setting)'." }
            }
        }
        'serviceSet' {
            return @(foreach ($s in @($Action.services)) {
                    [pscustomobject]@{ Key = [string]$s.name; Kind = 'service'; Label = ''; Reason = ''
                        Action = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'service'; name = [string]$s.name; startupType = [string]$s.startupType; default = [string]$s.default; stop = [bool]$Action.stop } }
                })
        }
        'deviceInterrupt' {
            $class = [string]$Action.deviceClass
            if ($script:IgwtInterruptClasses -notcontains $class) { throw "Device class '$class' is not allowed (only Display, Net and USB host controllers)." }
            if ($class -eq 'USB' -and $Context -and $Context.HardwareProfile -and [string]$Context.HardwareProfile.Facts.systemDisk.bus -eq 'USB') {
                return @([pscustomobject]@{ Key = 'usb-boot'; Kind = 'none'; Label = 'USB host controllers'; Reason = 'Windows runs from a USB disk; its host controller is never changed.'; Action = $null })
            }
            $devices = @(Get-IgwtInterruptDevices -Class $class)
            if ($devices.Count -eq 0) { return @([pscustomobject]@{ Key = 'none'; Kind = 'none'; Label = "$class devices"; Reason = "No present PCI $class device."; Action = $null }) }
            $parts = foreach ($d in $devices) {
                $base = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\$($d.InstanceId)\Device Parameters\Interrupt Management"
                $msiKey = Test-IgwtRegistryKey -Path "$base\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties"
                foreach ($f in $script:IgwtInterruptFields.Keys) {
                    if ($null -eq $Action.PSObject.Properties[$f] -or $null -eq $Action.$f) { continue }
                    $spec = $script:IgwtInterruptFields[$f]
                    $p = New-IgwtRegistryPart -Key "$($d.InstanceId)|$($spec.Name)" -Path "$base\$($spec.Sub)" -Name $spec.Name -On ([int]$Action.$f) -Default $null -Label ([string]$d.FriendlyName)
                    if ($spec.Sub -eq 'MessageSignaledInterruptProperties' -and -not $msiKey) { $p.Reason = "$($d.FriendlyName) does not declare MSI support in its driver."; $p.Kind = 'none' }
                    $p
                }
            }
            return @($parts)
        }
        default { throw "'$($Action.type)' is not a composite action." }
    }
}

function Get-IgwtCompositeState {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    foreach ($p in @(Get-IgwtCompositeParts -Action $Action -Context $Context)) {
        if ($p.Kind -eq 'none') { [pscustomobject]@{ Target = [string]$p.Label; Current = 'not applicable'; Desired = ''; State = 'NotApplicable'; Note = [string]$p.Reason }; continue }
        $items = @()
        if ($p.Kind -eq 'service') { $items = @(Get-IgwtServiceState -Action $p.Action -Context $Context) } else { $items = @(Get-IgwtRegistryState -Action $p.Action -Context $Context) }
        foreach ($it in $items) {
            if ($p.Label) { $it.Target = "[$($p.Label)] $($it.Target)" }
            $it
        }
    }
}

function Get-IgwtCompositeSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $parts = foreach ($p in @(Get-IgwtCompositeParts -Action $Action -Context $Context)) {
        if ($p.Kind -eq 'none') { continue }
        $data = $null
        if ($p.Kind -eq 'service') { $data = Get-IgwtServiceSnapshot -Action $p.Action -Context $Context } else { $data = Get-IgwtRegistrySnapshot -Action $p.Action -Context $Context }
        [ordered]@{ key = [string]$p.Key; data = $data }
    }
    return @{ parts = @($parts) }
}

function Invoke-IgwtCompositeApply {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context, [ValidateSet('on', 'default')][string]$Mode = 'on')
    if ($Mode -eq 'default' -and [string]$Action.type -eq 'deviceInterrupt') { throw 'Device interrupt settings have no documented Windows default (the driver sets them); revert from the snapshot instead.' }
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess([string]$Action.type, "Apply ($Mode)")) { return }
    foreach ($p in @(Get-IgwtCompositeParts -Action $Action -Context $Context)) {
        if ($p.Kind -eq 'none') { continue }
        if ($p.Kind -eq 'service') { Invoke-IgwtServiceApply -Action $p.Action -Context $Context -Mode $Mode }
        else { Invoke-IgwtRegistryApply -Action $p.Action -Context $Context -Mode $Mode }
    }
}

function Restore-IgwtCompositeSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Snapshot, $Context)
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess([string]$Action.type, 'Restore snapshot')) { return }
    $current = @{}
    foreach ($p in @(Get-IgwtCompositeParts -Action $Action -Context $Context)) { $current[[string]$p.Key] = $p }
    $saved = @($Snapshot.parts | Where-Object { $_ })
    [array]::Reverse($saved)
    foreach ($s in $saved) {
        $p = $current[[string]$s.key]
        if (-not $p -or $p.Kind -eq 'none') { Write-IgwtLog -Level Warn -Message "$($Action.type): '$($s.key)' is no longer present; not restored."; continue }
        if ($p.Kind -eq 'service') { Restore-IgwtServiceSnapshot -Action $p.Action -Snapshot $s.data -Context $Context }
        else { Restore-IgwtRegistrySnapshot -Action $p.Action -Snapshot $s.data -Context $Context }
    }
}
```

`src/Actions/Custom.ps1`:

```ps1
# Custom.ps1
# 'custom' actions (named Detect / Snapshot / Apply / Restore handlers for settings that need
# more than one primitive), 'check' actions (read-only runtime conditions that contribute to a
# tweak's state, e.g. "memory integrity is actually running"), post-apply hooks, and the single
# P/Invoke used by iG Windows Tuner.

#region Native: the only Add-Type in iG Windows Tuner

$script:IgwtNativeSource = @'
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace iG Windows Tuner
{
    // SystemParametersInfo applies mouse, keyboard-repeat and accessibility-hotkey settings to
    // the running session and broadcasts WM_SETTINGCHANGE (SPIF_SENDCHANGE), so the user does
    // not have to sign out after iG Windows Tuner has written the documented registry values.
    public static class NativeMethods
    {
        [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
        public static extern bool SystemParametersInfo(uint uiAction, uint uiParam, int[] pvParam, uint fWinIni);
    }
}
'@

$script:SPI_GETMOUSE = 0x0003
$script:SPI_SETMOUSE = 0x0004
$script:SPI_SETKEYBOARDSPEED = 0x000B
$script:SPI_SETKEYBOARDDELAY = 0x0017
$script:SPI_GETFILTERKEYS = 0x0032
$script:SPI_SETFILTERKEYS = 0x0033
$script:SPI_GETTOGGLEKEYS = 0x0034
$script:SPI_SETTOGGLEKEYS = 0x0035
$script:SPI_GETSTICKYKEYS = 0x003A
$script:SPI_SETSTICKYKEYS = 0x003B
$script:SPIF_SENDCHANGE = 0x0002

function Initialize-IgwtNative {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    if (-not ('iGWindowsTuner.NativeMethods' -as [type])) {
        Add-Type -TypeDefinition $script:IgwtNativeSource -Language CSharp
    }
}

function Invoke-IgwtSystemParametersInfo {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([uint32]$Action, [uint32]$UiParam = 0, [int[]]$Buffer = $null)
    if ($script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) { return $true }
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("SystemParametersInfo 0x$('{0:X}' -f $Action)", 'Apply to current session')) { return $true }
    Initialize-IgwtNative
    return [iGWindowsTuner.NativeMethods]::SystemParametersInfo($Action, $UiParam, $Buffer, $script:SPIF_SENDCHANGE)
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtIntOrDefault {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param($Read, [int]$Default)
    if (-not $Read.Exists) { return $Default }
    $n = 0
    if ([int]::TryParse([string]$Read.Value, [ref]$n)) { return $n }
    return $Default
}

#endregion

#region Post-apply hooks (live refresh after registry changes)

function Invoke-IgwtPostApplyHook {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Applies just-written per-user settings to the running session. Never throws. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Hook)
    try {
        switch ($Hook) {
            'MouseParameters' {
                $m = 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse'
                $t1 = ConvertTo-IgwtIntOrDefault (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $m -Name 'MouseThreshold1') 6
                $t2 = ConvertTo-IgwtIntOrDefault (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $m -Name 'MouseThreshold2') 10
                $sp = ConvertTo-IgwtIntOrDefault (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $m -Name 'MouseSpeed') 1
                $null = Invoke-IgwtSystemParametersInfo -Action $script:SPI_SETMOUSE -Buffer @($t1, $t2, $sp)
            }
            'KeyboardRepeat' {
                $k = 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Keyboard'
                $delay = ConvertTo-IgwtIntOrDefault (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $k -Name 'KeyboardDelay') 1
                $speed = ConvertTo-IgwtIntOrDefault (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $k -Name 'KeyboardSpeed') 31
                $null = Invoke-IgwtSystemParametersInfo -Action $script:SPI_SETKEYBOARDDELAY -UiParam ([uint32]$delay)
                $null = Invoke-IgwtSystemParametersInfo -Action $script:SPI_SETKEYBOARDSPEED -UiParam ([uint32]$speed)
            }
            'AccessibilityFlags' {
                $a = 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility'
                $sticky = ConvertTo-IgwtIntOrDefault (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path "$a\StickyKeys" -Name 'Flags') 510
                $toggle = ConvertTo-IgwtIntOrDefault (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path "$a\ToggleKeys" -Name 'Flags') 62
                $filter = ConvertTo-IgwtIntOrDefault (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path "$a\Keyboard Response" -Name 'Flags') 126
                # STICKYKEYS / TOGGLEKEYS = { cbSize, dwFlags }; FILTERKEYS = 6 DWORDs (flags at index 1).
                $null = Invoke-IgwtSystemParametersInfo -Action $script:SPI_SETSTICKYKEYS -UiParam 8 -Buffer @(8, $sticky)
                $null = Invoke-IgwtSystemParametersInfo -Action $script:SPI_SETTOGGLEKEYS -UiParam 8 -Buffer @(8, $toggle)
                if (-not $script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) {
                    Initialize-IgwtNative
                    $fk = [int[]]@(24, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
                    if ([iGWindowsTuner.NativeMethods]::SystemParametersInfo($script:SPI_GETFILTERKEYS, 24, $fk, 0)) {
                        $fk[1] = $filter
                        $null = Invoke-IgwtSystemParametersInfo -Action $script:SPI_SETFILTERKEYS -UiParam 24 -Buffer $fk
                    }
                }
            }
            default { Write-IgwtLog -Level Warn -Message "Unknown post-apply hook '$Hook'." }
        }
    } catch {
        Write-IgwtLog -Level Warn -Message "Live refresh '$Hook' failed (a sign-out applies the change): $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }
}

#endregion

#region Check actions (read-only conditions)

function Get-IgwtCheckState {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $checker = [string]$Action.checker
    switch ($checker) {
        'HvciRunning' {
            $dg = Get-IgwtDeviceGuardInfo
            if (-not $dg.Available) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = 'Memory integrity running'; Current = 'unknown'; Desired = 'running'; State = 'Unknown'; Note = 'Win32_DeviceGuard not available.' } }
            return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = 'Memory integrity (HVCI) running'; Current = $(if ($dg.HvciRunning) { 'running' } else { 'not running' }); Desired = 'running';
                State = $(if ($dg.HvciRunning) { 'On' } else { 'Off' }); Note = 'Becomes active after a reboot.' }
        }
        'HvciNotRunning' {
            $dg = Get-IgwtDeviceGuardInfo
            if (-not $dg.Available) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = 'Memory integrity running'; Current = 'unknown'; Desired = 'not running'; State = 'Unknown'; Note = '' } }
            return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = 'Memory integrity (HVCI) running'; Current = $(if ($dg.HvciRunning) { 'running' } else { 'not running' }); Desired = 'not running';
                State = $(if (-not $dg.HvciRunning) { 'On' } else { 'Off' }); Note = 'Becomes inactive after a reboot.' }
        }
        'KernelShadowStacksRunning' {
            $dg = Get-IgwtDeviceGuardInfo
            if (-not $dg.Available) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = 'Kernel stack protection running'; Current = 'unknown'; Desired = 'running'; State = 'Unknown'; Note = '' } }
            return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = 'Kernel-mode hardware-enforced stack protection running'; Current = $(if ($dg.KernelShadowStacksRunning) { 'running' } else { 'not running' }); Desired = 'running';
                State = $(if ($dg.KernelShadowStacksRunning) { 'On' } else { 'Off' }); Note = 'Requires memory integrity and a CET-capable CPU; becomes active after a reboot.' }
        }
        'DefaultApp' {
            # Read-only: Windows protects per-user default apps with a hash, so they are changed in Settings.
            $what = $(if ($Action.extension) { [string]$Action.extension } else { [string]$Action.protocol })
            $path = $(if ($Action.extension) { "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\FileExts\$($Action.extension)\UserChoice" } else { "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Associations\UrlAssociations\$($Action.protocol)\UserChoice" })
            $v = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $path -Name 'ProgId'
            $cur = $(if ($v.Exists) { [string]$v.Value } else { '(Windows default)' })
            return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = "Default app for $what"; Current = $cur; Desired = [string]$Action.progId
                State = $(if ($v.Exists -and [string]$v.Value -eq [string]$Action.progId) { 'On' } else { 'Off' }); Note = 'Change it in Settings > Apps > Default apps; Windows does not allow programs to set it.' }
        }
        default { throw "Unknown checker '$checker'." }
    }
}

#endregion

#region Custom handlers

function Get-IgwtDiscoveredGameExes {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param($Context)
    $games = $null
    if ($Context -and $null -ne $Context.Games) { $games = @($Context.Games) } else { $games = @(Get-IgwtInstalledGames) }
    return @($games | ForEach-Object { $_.ExePath } | Where-Object { $_ } | Select-Object -Unique)
}

$script:IgwtGpuPrefKey = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences'

$script:IgwtCustomHandlers = @{

    # Ultimate Performance: duplicate the hidden e9a42b02 scheme once (or reuse an existing copy),
    # activate it, and on revert re-activate the previous scheme and delete only a copy we created.
    UltimatePlan = @{
        Detect = {
            param($Action, $Context)
            $active = Get-IgwtActivePowerScheme
            $schemes = @(Get-IgwtPowerSchemes)
            $cur = $schemes | Where-Object { $_.Guid -eq $active } | Select-Object -First 1
            $isUltimate = ($active -eq $script:IgwtSchemeUltimateBase) -or ($cur -and $cur.ResourceId -eq 19)
            $existing = $schemes | Where-Object { $_.ResourceId -eq 19 -or $_.Guid -eq $script:IgwtSchemeUltimateBase } | Select-Object -First 1
            [pscustomobject]@{
                Target  = 'Active power scheme'
                Current = "$($cur.Name) ($active)"
                Desired = $(if ($existing) { "Ultimate Performance ($($existing.Guid), existing copy reused)" } else { 'Ultimate Performance (new copy of e9a42b02-...)' })
                State   = $(if ($isUltimate) { 'On' } else { 'Off' })
                Note    = 'C-states and turbo stay under BIOS control; idle power use rises.'
            }
        }
        Snapshot = {
            param($Action, $Context)
            @{ previousActive = (Get-IgwtActivePowerScheme) }
        }
        Apply = {
            param($Action, $Context, $Mode)
            if ($Mode -eq 'default') {
                $null = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/setactive', $script:IgwtSchemeBalanced)
                return $null
            }
            $existing = @(Get-IgwtPowerSchemes) | Where-Object { $_.ResourceId -eq 19 } | Select-Object -First 1
            $created = $null
            $target = $null
            if ($existing) { $target = $existing.Guid }
            else {
                $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/duplicatescheme', $script:IgwtSchemeUltimateBase)
                $m = [regex]::Matches($r.Output, $script:IgwtGuidPattern) | Where-Object { $_.Value.ToLowerInvariant() -ne $script:IgwtSchemeUltimateBase } | Select-Object -First 1
                if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0 -or -not $m) { throw "powercfg /duplicatescheme failed: $($r.Output)" }
                $target = $m.Value.ToLowerInvariant()
                $created = $target
            }
            $r2 = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/setactive', $target)
            if ($r2.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "powercfg /setactive failed: $($r2.Output)" }
            return @{ activated = $target; createdGuid = $created }
        }
        Restore = {
            param($Action, $Snapshot, $Context)
            $prev = ([string]$Snapshot.previousActive).ToLowerInvariant()
            if ($prev -match "^$script:IgwtGuidPattern$" -and (Test-IgwtPowerSchemeExists -Guid $prev)) {
                $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/setactive', $prev)
                if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "powercfg /setactive failed: $($r.Output)" }
            }
            $created = [string]$Snapshot.applied.createdGuid
            if ($created -match "^$script:IgwtGuidPattern$" -and $created -ne $script:IgwtSchemeUltimateBase) {
                if ((Get-IgwtActivePowerScheme) -ne $created.ToLowerInvariant()) {
                    $null = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/delete', $created)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    # Hibernation: powercfg /hibernate off|on. Disabling hibernation also disables Fast Startup.
    Hibernate = @{
        Detect = {
            param($Action, $Context)
            $v = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power' -Name 'HibernateEnabled'
            $enabled = $v.Exists -and [int]$v.Value -ne 0
            [pscustomobject]@{ Target = 'Hibernation (hiberfil.sys)'; Current = $(if ($enabled) { 'enabled' } else { 'disabled' }); Desired = 'disabled';
                State = $(if ($enabled) { 'Off' } else { 'On' }); Note = 'Turning hibernation off also turns Fast Startup off and deletes hiberfil.sys.' }
        }
        Snapshot = {
            param($Action, $Context)
            $v = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power' -Name 'HibernateEnabled'
            @{ enabled = ($v.Exists -and [int]$v.Value -ne 0) }
        }
        Apply = {
            param($Action, $Context, $Mode)
            $arg = 'off'
            if ($Mode -eq 'default') { $arg = 'on' }
            $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/hibernate', $arg)
            if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "powercfg /hibernate $arg failed: $($r.Output)" }
            return $null
        }
        Restore = {
            param($Action, $Snapshot, $Context)
            if ($Snapshot.enabled) {
                $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/hibernate', 'on')
                if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "powercfg /hibernate on failed: $($r.Output)" }
            }
        }
    }

    # TCP receive window auto-tuning: repair to Normal if another tool disabled it.
    TcpAutoTuning = @{
        Detect = {
            param($Action, $Context)
            $s = Get-NetTCPSetting -SettingName Internet -ErrorAction Stop
            $state = 'Off'
            if ([string]$s.AutoTuningLevelLocal -eq 'Normal') { $state = 'On' }
            if ($s.AutoTuningLevelGroupPolicy -and [string]$s.AutoTuningLevelGroupPolicy -ne 'NotConfigured') { $state = 'ManagedByPolicy' }
            [pscustomobject]@{ Target = 'TCP auto-tuning (Internet template)'; Current = [string]$s.AutoTuningLevelLocal; Desired = 'Normal'; State = $state; Note = 'Normal is the Windows default.' }
        }
        Snapshot = {
            param($Action, $Context)
            @{ level = [string](Get-NetTCPSetting -SettingName Internet -ErrorAction Stop).AutoTuningLevelLocal }
        }
        Apply = {
            param($Action, $Context, $Mode)
            if ([string](Get-NetTCPSetting -SettingName Internet -ErrorAction Stop).AutoTuningLevelLocal -ne 'Normal') {
                Set-NetTCPSetting -SettingName Internet -AutoTuningLevelLocal Normal -ErrorAction Stop
            }
            return $null
        }
        Restore = {
            param($Action, $Snapshot, $Context)
            $allowed = @('Disabled', 'HighlyRestricted', 'Restricted', 'Normal', 'Experimental')
            $lvl = [string]$Snapshot.level
            if ($allowed -contains $lvl) { Set-NetTCPSetting -SettingName Internet -AutoTuningLevelLocal $lvl -ErrorAction Stop }
        }
    }

    # Windows Firewall: all profiles on with default inbound Block.
    FirewallProfiles = @{
        Detect = {
            param($Action, $Context)
            foreach ($p in @(Get-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain, Private, Public -ErrorAction Stop)) {
                $inboundOk = [string]$p.DefaultInboundAction -in 'Block', 'NotConfigured'
                [pscustomobject]@{ Target = "Firewall profile $($p.Name)"; Current = "enabled=$($p.Enabled) inbound=$($p.DefaultInboundAction)";
                    Desired = 'enabled=True inbound=Block'; State = $(if ([string]$p.Enabled -eq 'True' -and $inboundOk) { 'On' } else { 'Off' });
                    Note = 'NotConfigured inbound means Block (Windows default).' }
            }
        }
        Snapshot = {
            param($Action, $Context)
            $items = foreach ($p in @(Get-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain, Private, Public -ErrorAction Stop)) {
                [ordered]@{ name = [string]$p.Name; enabled = [string]$p.Enabled; inbound = [string]$p.DefaultInboundAction }
            }
            @{ profiles = @($items) }
        }
        Apply = {
            param($Action, $Context, $Mode)
            if ($Mode -eq 'default') { Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain, Private, Public -Enabled True -DefaultInboundAction NotConfigured -ErrorAction Stop }
            else { Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain, Private, Public -Enabled True -DefaultInboundAction Block -ErrorAction Stop }
            return $null
        }
        Restore = {
            param($Action, $Snapshot, $Context)
            foreach ($p in @($Snapshot.profiles)) {
                if ([string]$p.name -notin 'Domain', 'Private', 'Public') { continue }
                if ([string]$p.enabled -notin 'True', 'False', 'NotConfigured') { continue }
                if ([string]$p.inbound -notin 'Block', 'Allow', 'NotConfigured') { continue }
                Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile ([string]$p.name) -Enabled ([string]$p.enabled) -DefaultInboundAction ([string]$p.inbound) -ErrorAction Stop
            }
        }
    }

    # Unused Wi-Fi adapter: disable it (never when it carries the active connection).
    WifiAdapter = @{
        Detect = {
            param($Action, $Context)
            $wifi = @(Get-IgwtWifiAdapter)
            if ($wifi.Count -eq 0) {
                return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = 'Wi-Fi adapter'; Current = 'none present'; Desired = 'disabled'; State = 'NotApplicable'; Note = 'No Wi-Fi adapter is present (or it is disabled in firmware).' }
            }
            foreach ($w in $wifi) {
                $note = ''
                if ($w.Status -eq 'Up') { $note = 'This adapter is connected and in use; iG Windows Tuner will not disable it.' }
                [pscustomobject]@{ Target = "Wi-Fi adapter $($w.Name)"; Current = [string]$w.Status; Desired = 'Disabled';
                    State = $(if ($w.Status -eq 'Disabled') { 'On' } else { 'Off' }); Note = $note }
            }
        }
        Snapshot = {
            param($Action, $Context)
            $items = foreach ($w in @(Get-IgwtWifiAdapter)) { [ordered]@{ scope = [string]$w.InterfaceGuid; name = [string]$w.Name; status = [string]$w.Status } }
            @{ adapters = @($items) }
        }
        Apply = {
            param($Action, $Context, $Mode)
            foreach ($w in @(Get-IgwtWifiAdapter)) {
                if ($Mode -eq 'default') { if ($w.Status -eq 'Disabled') { Enable-NetAdapter -Name $w.Name -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction Stop }; continue }
                if ($w.Status -eq 'Up') { throw "Wi-Fi adapter $($w.Name) is connected; refusing to disable the network connection in use." }
                if ($w.Status -ne 'Disabled') { Disable-NetAdapter -Name $w.Name -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction Stop }
            }
            Clear-IgwtCache -Prefix 'net:' -WhatIf:$false
            return $null
        }
        Restore = {
            param($Action, $Snapshot, $Context)
            $now = @(Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
            foreach ($i in @($Snapshot.adapters)) {
                $a = $now | Where-Object { [string]$_.InterfaceGuid -eq [string]$i.scope } | Select-Object -First 1
                if (-not $a) { continue }
                if ([string]$i.status -ne 'Disabled' -and $a.Status -eq 'Disabled') { Enable-NetAdapter -Name $a.Name -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction Stop }
            }
        }
    }

    # Per-game GPU preference (High performance) for discovered game executables.
    GameGpuPreference = @{
        Detect = {
            param($Action, $Context)
            $exes = @(Get-IgwtDiscoveredGameExes -Context $Context)
            if ($exes.Count -eq 0) {
                return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = 'Per-game GPU preference'; Current = 'no supported games found'; Desired = 'GpuPreference=2'; State = 'NotApplicable'; Note = '' }
            }
            foreach ($exe in $exes) {
                $cur = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $script:IgwtGpuPrefKey -Name $exe
                $text = $null
                if ($cur.Exists) { $text = [string]$cur.Value }
                $val = Get-IgwtListItemValue -Text $text -Key 'GpuPreference'
                [pscustomobject]@{ Target = "$script:IgwtGpuPrefKey\$exe"; Current = $(if ($cur.Exists) { '"{0}"' -f $text } else { $script:IgwtAbsent });
                    Desired = 'GpuPreference=2 (High performance)'; State = $(if ([string]$val -eq '2') { 'On' } else { 'Off' }); Note = '' }
            }
        }
        Snapshot = {
            param($Action, $Context)
            $items = foreach ($exe in @(Get-IgwtDiscoveredGameExes -Context $Context)) {
                $cur = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $script:IgwtGpuPrefKey -Name $exe
                [ordered]@{ name = $exe; exists = [bool]$cur.Exists; kind = $cur.Kind; value = (ConvertTo-IgwtSerializableValue -Value $cur.Value -Kind $cur.Kind);
                    missingDepth = (Get-IgwtRegistryMissingDepth -Path $script:IgwtGpuPrefKey) }
            }
            @{ items = @($items) }
        }
        Apply = {
            param($Action, $Context, $Mode)
            foreach ($exe in @(Get-IgwtDiscoveredGameExes -Context $Context)) {
                $cur = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $script:IgwtGpuPrefKey -Name $exe
                $text = $null
                if ($cur.Exists) { $text = [string]$cur.Value }
                if ($Mode -eq 'default') { $new = Remove-IgwtListItem -Text $text -Key 'GpuPreference' -WhatIf:$false }
                else { $new = Set-IgwtListItem -Text $text -Key 'GpuPreference' -Value '2' -WhatIf:$false }
                if ($cur.Exists -and $new -eq $text) { continue }
                if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($new)) { if ($cur.Exists) { Remove-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $script:IgwtGpuPrefKey -Name $exe } }
                else { Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $script:IgwtGpuPrefKey -Name $exe -Kind String -Value $new }
            }
            return $null
        }
        Restore = {
            param($Action, $Snapshot, $Context)
            foreach ($i in @($Snapshot.items)) {
                $name = [string]$i.name
                if ($name -notmatch '^[A-Za-z]:\\.+\.exe$') { Write-IgwtLog -Level Warn -Message "Skipping unexpected GPU preference entry '$name'."; continue }
                Restore-IgwtRegistryItem -Path $script:IgwtGpuPrefKey -Name $name -Item $i
            }
        }
    }

    # Controlled Folder Access allow-list for discovered game executables (helper for Block mode).
    CfaAllowGames = @{
        Detect = {
            param($Action, $Context)
            $exes = @(Get-IgwtDiscoveredGameExes -Context $Context)
            if ($exes.Count -eq 0) {
                return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = 'Controlled Folder Access allowed apps'; Current = 'no supported games found'; Desired = ''; State = 'NotApplicable'; Note = '' }
            }
            $allowed = @((Get-IgwtCached -Key 'mp:pref' -ScriptBlock { Get-MpPreference -ErrorAction Stop }).ControlledFolderAccessAllowedApplications)
            foreach ($exe in $exes) {
                $present = @($allowed | Where-Object { [string]::Equals([string]$_, $exe, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) }).Count -gt 0
                [pscustomobject]@{ Target = "CFA allowed app $exe"; Current = $(if ($present) { 'allowed' } else { 'not listed' }); Desired = 'allowed';
                    State = $(if ($present) { 'On' } else { 'Off' }); Note = 'Allow-listing is not an antivirus exclusion; files are still scanned.' }
            }
        }
        Snapshot = {
            param($Action, $Context)
            $allowed = @((Get-IgwtCached -Key 'mp:pref' -ScriptBlock { Get-MpPreference -ErrorAction Stop }).ControlledFolderAccessAllowedApplications)
            $pre = foreach ($exe in @(Get-IgwtDiscoveredGameExes -Context $Context)) {
                if (@($allowed | Where-Object { [string]::Equals([string]$_, $exe, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) }).Count -gt 0) { $exe }
            }
            @{ alreadyAllowed = @($pre) }
        }
        Apply = {
            param($Action, $Context, $Mode)
            $allowed = @((Get-IgwtCached -Key 'mp:pref' -ScriptBlock { Get-MpPreference -ErrorAction Stop }).ControlledFolderAccessAllowedApplications)
            $added = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
            foreach ($exe in @(Get-IgwtDiscoveredGameExes -Context $Context)) {
                $present = @($allowed | Where-Object { [string]::Equals([string]$_, $exe, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) }).Count -gt 0
                if ($Mode -eq 'default') { if ($present) { Remove-MpPreference -ControlledFolderAccessAllowedApplications $exe -ErrorAction Stop }; continue }
                if (-not $present) { Add-MpPreference -ControlledFolderAccessAllowedApplications $exe -ErrorAction Stop; $added.Add($exe) }
            }
            Clear-IgwtCache -Prefix 'mp:' -WhatIf:$false
            return @{ added = @($added) }
        }
        Restore = {
            param($Action, $Snapshot, $Context)
            foreach ($exe in @($Snapshot.applied.added)) {
                if ([string]$exe -notmatch '^[A-Za-z]:\\.+\.exe$') { continue }
                Remove-MpPreference -ControlledFolderAccessAllowedApplications ([string]$exe) -ErrorAction Stop
            }
        }
    }
}

function Get-IgwtCustomHandler {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Name)
    $h = $script:IgwtCustomHandlers[$Name]
    if (-not $h) { throw "Unknown custom handler '$Name'." }
    return $h
}

#endregion
```

`src/Actions/Defender.ps1`:

```ps1
# Defender.ps1
# 'mpPreference' action: Microsoft Defender Antivirus preferences through Set-MpPreference.
# Only an explicit allow-list of settings can be changed, and none of them lowers protection.
# iG Windows Tuner never touches real-time protection, Tamper Protection, AMSI or exclusions.

$script:IgwtMpAllowed = @{
    PUAProtection                 = 'int'
    MAPSReporting                 = 'int'
    SubmitSamplesConsent          = 'int'
    EnableNetworkProtection       = 'int'
    EnableControlledFolderAccess  = 'int'
    ScanOnlyIfIdleEnabled         = 'bool'
    ScanAvgCPULoadFactor          = 'int'
}

function Test-IgwtDefenderActive {
    <# .SYNOPSIS True when Microsoft Defender Antivirus is the active antivirus (not passive or off). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param()
    try {
        $s = Get-IgwtCached -Key 'mp:status' -TtlSeconds 10 -ScriptBlock { Get-MpComputerStatus -ErrorAction Stop }
        return ([bool]$s.AMServiceEnabled -and ([string]$s.AMRunningMode -eq 'Normal' -or [string]::IsNullOrEmpty([string]$s.AMRunningMode)))
    } catch { return $false }
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtMpValue {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Setting, $Value)
    $t = $script:IgwtMpAllowed[$Setting]
    if (-not $t) { throw "Defender setting '$Setting' is not on iG Windows Tuner's allow-list." }
    if ($t -eq 'bool') {
        if ($Value -is [string]) { return [bool]::Parse($Value) }
        return [bool]$Value
    }
    return [int]$Value
}

function Get-IgwtMpPreferenceValue {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Setting)
    $null = ConvertTo-IgwtMpValue -Setting $Setting -Value 0
    $pref = Get-IgwtCached -Key 'mp:pref' -ScriptBlock { Get-MpPreference -ErrorAction Stop }
    $raw = $pref.$Setting
    if ($null -eq $raw) { return $null }
    if ($script:IgwtMpAllowed[$Setting] -eq 'bool') { return [bool]$raw }
    return [int]$raw
}

function Get-IgwtMpPreferenceState {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $setting = [string]$Action.setting
    if (-not (Test-IgwtDefenderActive)) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = "Defender $setting"; Current = 'Defender not active'; Desired = [string]$Action.on; State = 'NotApplicable'; Note = 'Microsoft Defender Antivirus is not the active antivirus.' }
    }
    try { $cur = Get-IgwtMpPreferenceValue -Setting $setting } catch {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = "Defender $setting"; Current = 'unreadable'; Desired = [string]$Action.on; State = 'Unknown'; Note = $_.Exception.Message }
    }
    $desired = ConvertTo-IgwtMpValue -Setting $setting -Value $Action.on
    $isOn = ($null -ne $cur -and $cur -eq $desired)
    if (-not $isOn -and $null -ne $cur -and $null -ne $Action.equivalentOn) {
        foreach ($eq in @($Action.equivalentOn)) { if ($cur -eq (ConvertTo-IgwtMpValue -Setting $setting -Value $eq)) { $isOn = $true } }
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Target  = "Defender preference $setting"
        Current = [string]$cur
        Desired = [string]$desired
        State   = $(if ($isOn) { 'On' } else { 'Off' })
        Note    = ''
    }
}

function Get-IgwtMpPreferenceSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    return @{ setting = [string]$Action.setting; value = (Get-IgwtMpPreferenceValue -Setting ([string]$Action.setting)) }
}

function Set-IgwtMpPreferenceValue {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Setting, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Value)
    $v = ConvertTo-IgwtMpValue -Setting $Setting -Value $Value
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("Defender $Setting", "Set to $v")) { return }
    $params = @{ ErrorAction = 'Stop' }
    $params[$Setting] = $v
    try { Set-MpPreference @params } finally { Clear-IgwtCache -Prefix 'mp:' -WhatIf:$false }
}

function Invoke-IgwtMpPreferenceApply {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context, [ValidateSet('on', 'default')][string]$Mode = 'on')
    $target = $Action.on
    if ($Mode -eq 'default') { $target = $Action.default }
    if ($null -eq $target) { throw "No default defined for Defender $($Action.setting)." }
    $cur = Get-IgwtMpPreferenceValue -Setting ([string]$Action.setting)
    if ($null -ne $cur -and $cur -eq (ConvertTo-IgwtMpValue -Setting ([string]$Action.setting) -Value $target)) { return }
    Set-IgwtMpPreferenceValue -Setting ([string]$Action.setting) -Value $target
}

function Restore-IgwtMpPreferenceSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Snapshot, $Context)
    if ($null -eq $Snapshot.value) { return }
    Set-IgwtMpPreferenceValue -Setting ([string]$Action.setting) -Value $Snapshot.value
}
```

`src/Actions/Dns.ps1`:

```ps1
# Dns.ps1
# 'dnsDoh' action: points the active wired adapter at a public resolver that is on Windows'
# built-in DNS-over-HTTPS list and turns on DoH auto-upgrade for those addresses with the
# supported DnsClient cmdlets. Revert restores the previous DHCP or static DNS servers and the
# previous DoH entry settings exactly.

$script:IgwtDohProviders = @{
    cloudflare = @{ Name = 'Cloudflare'; V4 = @('1.1.1.1', '1.0.0.1'); V6 = @('2606:4700:4700::1111', '2606:4700:4700::1001'); Template = 'https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query' }
    quad9      = @{ Name = 'Quad9'; V4 = @('9.9.9.9', '149.112.112.112'); V6 = @('2620:fe::fe', '2620:fe::9'); Template = 'https://dns.quad9.net/dns-query' }
}

function Get-IgwtDohProvider {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Provider)
    $p = $script:IgwtDohProviders[$Provider.ToLowerInvariant()]
    if (-not $p) { throw "Unknown DoH provider '$Provider'." }
    return $p
}

function Test-IgwtAdapterHasGlobalIPv6 {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][int]$InterfaceIndex)
    try {
        $v6 = @(Get-NetIPAddress -InterfaceIndex $InterfaceIndex -AddressFamily IPv6 -ErrorAction Stop |
            Where-Object { $_.PrefixOrigin -in 'RouterAdvertisement', 'Dhcp', 'Manual' -and $_.IPAddress -notlike 'fe80*' })
        return ($v6.Count -gt 0)
    } catch { return $false }
}

function Get-IgwtDnsInterfaceConfig {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Current DNS servers of one interface and whether they are static or from DHCP. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Adapter)
    $v4 = @(); $v6 = @()
    try { $v4 = @((Get-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceIndex $Adapter.ifIndex -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction Stop).ServerAddresses) } catch { $v4 = @() }
    try { $v6 = @((Get-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceIndex $Adapter.ifIndex -AddressFamily IPv6 -ErrorAction Stop).ServerAddresses) } catch { $v6 = @() }
    $static4 = $null
    $static6 = $null
    try { $static4 = (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces\$($Adapter.InterfaceGuid)" -Name 'NameServer').Value } catch { $static4 = $null }
    try { $static6 = (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip6\Parameters\Interfaces\$($Adapter.InterfaceGuid)" -Name 'NameServer').Value } catch { $static6 = $null }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        V4       = @($v4 | Where-Object { $_ })
        V6       = @($v6 | Where-Object { $_ })
        Static4  = -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$static4)
        Static6  = -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$static6)
    }
}

function Get-IgwtDohEntry {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Address)
    try { return (Get-DnsClientDohServerAddress -ServerAddress $Address -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1) } catch { return $null }
}

function Get-IgwtDnsDohState {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $prov = Get-IgwtDohProvider -Provider $Action.provider
    $adapters = @()
    if ($Context -and $null -ne $Context.WiredAdapters) { $adapters = @($Context.WiredAdapters) } else { $adapters = @(Get-IgwtActiveWiredAdapter) }
    if ($adapters.Count -eq 0) {
        return @([pscustomobject]@{ Target = 'DNS servers'; Current = 'no active wired adapter'; Desired = ''; State = 'NotApplicable'; Note = '' })
    }
    $fallback = [bool]$Action.allowFallbackToUdp
    foreach ($a in $adapters) {
        $cfg = Get-IgwtDnsInterfaceConfig -Adapter $a
        $serversOk = ((@($cfg.V4) -join ',') -eq (@($prov.V4) -join ','))
        $dohOk = $true
        foreach ($ip in $prov.V4) {
            $e = Get-IgwtDohEntry -Address $ip
            if (-not $e -or -not $e.AutoUpgrade -or ([bool]$e.AllowFallbackToUdp -ne $fallback)) { $dohOk = $false }
        }
        $note = ''
        $private = @($cfg.V4 | Where-Object { $_ -match '^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\.)' })
        if ($private.Count -gt 0) { $note = 'Your current DNS server is on your local network (router). DoH bypasses router DNS, local host names and router-side filtering.' }
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Target  = "[$($a.Name)] DNS servers + DoH"
            Current = "$(if ($cfg.Static4) { 'static' } else { 'DHCP' }): $(@($cfg.V4) -join ', ')"
            Desired = "$($prov.Name): $($prov.V4 -join ', ') (DoH auto-upgrade, fallback to plain DNS: $fallback)"
            State   = $(if ($serversOk -and $dohOk) { 'On' } else { 'Off' })
            Note    = $note
        }
    }
}

function Get-IgwtDnsDohSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $prov = Get-IgwtDohProvider -Provider $Action.provider
    $adapters = @()
    if ($Context -and $null -ne $Context.WiredAdapters) { $adapters = @($Context.WiredAdapters) } else { $adapters = @(Get-IgwtActiveWiredAdapter) }
    $ifaces = foreach ($a in $adapters) {
        $cfg = Get-IgwtDnsInterfaceConfig -Adapter $a
        [ordered]@{ scope = [string]$a.InterfaceGuid; adapter = [string]$a.Name; static4 = $cfg.Static4; v4 = @($cfg.V4); static6 = $cfg.Static6; v6 = @($cfg.V6) }
    }
    $doh = foreach ($ip in @($prov.V4 + $prov.V6)) {
        $e = Get-IgwtDohEntry -Address $ip
        if ($e) { [ordered]@{ address = $ip; exists = $true; template = [string]$e.DohTemplate; autoUpgrade = [bool]$e.AutoUpgrade; fallback = [bool]$e.AllowFallbackToUdp } }
        else { [ordered]@{ address = $ip; exists = $false } }
    }
    return @{ interfaces = @($ifaces); doh = @($doh) }
}

function Invoke-IgwtDnsDohApply {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context, [ValidateSet('on', 'default')][string]$Mode = 'on')
    $prov = Get-IgwtDohProvider -Provider $Action.provider
    $adapters = @()
    if ($Context -and $null -ne $Context.WiredAdapters) { $adapters = @($Context.WiredAdapters) } else { $adapters = @(Get-IgwtActiveWiredAdapter) }
    if ($Mode -eq 'default') {
        foreach ($a in $adapters) {
            if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($a.Name, 'Reset DNS servers to DHCP')) { Set-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceIndex $a.ifIndex -ResetServerAddresses -ErrorAction Stop }
        }
        return
    }
    $fallback = [bool]$Action.allowFallbackToUdp
    foreach ($ip in @($prov.V4 + $prov.V6)) {
        $e = Get-IgwtDohEntry -Address $ip
        if ($e) {
            if (-not $e.AutoUpgrade -or [bool]$e.AllowFallbackToUdp -ne $fallback) {
                if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($ip, 'Enable DoH auto-upgrade')) {
                    $null = Set-DnsClientDohServerAddress -ServerAddress $ip -DohTemplate $e.DohTemplate -AutoUpgrade $true -AllowFallbackToUdp $fallback -ErrorAction Stop
                }
            }
        } elseif ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($ip, 'Add DoH server entry')) {
            $null = Add-DnsClientDohServerAddress -ServerAddress $ip -DohTemplate $prov.Template -AutoUpgrade $true -AllowFallbackToUdp $fallback -ErrorAction Stop
        }
    }
    foreach ($a in $adapters) {
        $servers = @($prov.V4)
        if (Test-IgwtAdapterHasGlobalIPv6 -InterfaceIndex $a.ifIndex) { $servers += $prov.V6 }
        if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($a.Name, "Set DNS servers to $($servers -join ', ')")) {
            Set-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceIndex $a.ifIndex -ServerAddresses $servers -ErrorAction Stop
        }
    }
}

function Restore-IgwtDnsDohSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Snapshot, $Context)
    $prov = Get-IgwtDohProvider -Provider $Action.provider
    $known = @($prov.V4 + $prov.V6)
    $adapters = @()
    try { $adapters = @(Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction Stop) } catch { $adapters = @() }
    foreach ($i in @($Snapshot.interfaces)) {
        $a = $adapters | Where-Object { [string]$_.InterfaceGuid -eq [string]$i.scope } | Select-Object -First 1
        if (-not $a) { Write-IgwtLog -Level Warn -Message "Adapter $($i.adapter) is no longer present; DNS not restored."; continue }
        if (-not $i.static4 -and -not $i.static6) {
            if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($a.Name, 'Restore DNS servers from DHCP')) { Set-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceIndex $a.ifIndex -ResetServerAddresses -ErrorAction Stop }
        } else {
            $servers = @()
            if ($i.static4) { $servers += @($i.v4) }
            if ($i.static6) { $servers += @($i.v6) }
            if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($a.Name, "Restore static DNS servers $($servers -join ', ')")) {
                Set-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceIndex $a.ifIndex -ResetServerAddresses -ErrorAction Stop
                Set-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceIndex $a.ifIndex -ServerAddresses $servers -ErrorAction Stop
            }
        }
    }
    foreach ($d in @($Snapshot.doh)) {
        $ip = [string]$d.address
        if ($known -notcontains $ip) { continue }
        $e = Get-IgwtDohEntry -Address $ip
        if ($d.exists) {
            if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($ip, 'Restore DoH entry')) {
                if ($e) { $null = Set-DnsClientDohServerAddress -ServerAddress $ip -DohTemplate ([string]$d.template) -AutoUpgrade ([bool]$d.autoUpgrade) -AllowFallbackToUdp ([bool]$d.fallback) -ErrorAction Stop }
                else { $null = Add-DnsClientDohServerAddress -ServerAddress $ip -DohTemplate ([string]$d.template) -AutoUpgrade ([bool]$d.autoUpgrade) -AllowFallbackToUdp ([bool]$d.fallback) -ErrorAction Stop }
            }
        } elseif ($e -and $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($ip, 'Remove DoH entry added by iG Windows Tuner')) {
            Remove-DnsClientDohServerAddress -ServerAddress $ip -ErrorAction Stop
        }
    }
}
```

`src/Actions/Firewall.ps1`:

```ps1
# Firewall.ps1
# 'firewallRule' action, two forms (both only reduce network exposure):
#   - an iGWindowsTuner-owned BLOCK rule (rule name 'iGWindowsTuner-...'): created on apply, removed on revert
#     when it did not exist before
#   - an existing rule group (displayGroup, optional direction): its rules are disabled; revert
#     restores each rule's exact enabled state
# The Windows Firewall service and profiles are never touched here (see the FirewallProfiles handler).

function Test-IgwtOwnedFirewallAction {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action)
    return ($null -ne $Action.PSObject.Properties['rule'] -and [string]$Action.rule)
}

function Get-IgwtFirewallGroupRules {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action)
    $rules = @(Get-NetFirewallRule -DisplayGroup ([string]$Action.displayGroup) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    if ($Action.direction) { $rules = @($rules | Where-Object { [string]$_.Direction -eq [string]$Action.direction }) }
    return $rules
}

function Get-IgwtFirewallRuleState {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    if (Test-IgwtOwnedFirewallAction -Action $Action) {
        $r = Get-NetFirewallRule -Name ([string]$Action.rule) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
        $label = "Firewall rule $($Action.rule) ($($Action.direction) $($Action.action))"
        if (-not $r) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = $label; Current = 'not present'; Desired = 'present and enabled'; State = 'Off'; Note = '' } }
        $ok = ([string]$r.Enabled -eq 'True' -and [string]$r.Action -eq [string]$Action.action -and [string]$r.Direction -eq [string]$Action.direction)
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = $label; Current = "present, enabled $($r.Enabled), $($r.Direction) $($r.Action)"; Desired = 'present and enabled'; State = $(if ($ok) { 'On' } else { 'Off' }); Note = '' }
    }
    $rules = @(Get-IgwtFirewallGroupRules -Action $Action)
    $label = "Firewall rule group '$($Action.displayGroup)'$(if ($Action.direction) { " ($($Action.direction))" })"
    if ($rules.Count -eq 0) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = $label; Current = 'no rules'; Desired = 'disabled'; State = 'NotApplicable'; Note = 'This rule group does not exist on this PC.' } }
    $enabled = @($rules | Where-Object { [string]$_.Enabled -eq 'True' }).Count
    [pscustomobject]@{ Target = $label; Current = "$enabled of $($rules.Count) rule(s) enabled"; Desired = 'all disabled'; State = $(if ($enabled -eq 0) { 'On' } else { 'Off' }); Note = '' }
}

function Get-IgwtFirewallRuleSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    if (Test-IgwtOwnedFirewallAction -Action $Action) {
        $r = Get-NetFirewallRule -Name ([string]$Action.rule) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
        return @{ existed = [bool]$r; enabled = $(if ($r) { [string]$r.Enabled -eq 'True' } else { $false }) }
    }
    return @{ rules = @(Get-IgwtFirewallGroupRules -Action $Action | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ name = [string]$_.Name; enabled = ([string]$_.Enabled -eq 'True') } }) }
}

function Invoke-IgwtFirewallRuleApply {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context, [ValidateSet('on', 'default')][string]$Mode = 'on')
    if (Test-IgwtOwnedFirewallAction -Action $Action) {
        $name = [string]$Action.rule
        if (-not $name.StartsWith('iGWindowsTuner-')) { throw "iG Windows Tuner only manages its own firewall rules (names starting with 'iGWindowsTuner-')." }
        $r = Get-NetFirewallRule -Name $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($Mode -eq 'default') {
            if ($r -and $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($name, 'Remove iG Windows Tuner firewall rule')) { Remove-NetFirewallRule -Name $name -ErrorAction Stop }
            return
        }
        if ([string]$Action.action -ne 'Block') { throw 'iG Windows Tuner only creates Block rules.' }
        if ($r) {
            if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($name, 'Enable firewall rule')) { Set-NetFirewallRule -Name $name -Enabled True -Action Block -Direction ([string]$Action.direction) -ErrorAction Stop }
            return
        }
        if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($name, 'Create firewall block rule')) { return }
        $p = @{ Name = $name; DisplayName = [string]$Action.displayName; Group = 'iG Windows Tuner'; Direction = [string]$Action.direction; Action = 'Block'; Enabled = 'True'; ErrorAction = 'Stop' }
        $map = [ordered]@{ protocol = 'Protocol'; localPort = 'LocalPort'; remotePort = 'RemotePort'; program = 'Program'; profile = 'Profile' }
        foreach ($k in $map.Keys) {
            if ($null -ne $Action.PSObject.Properties[$k] -and $null -ne $Action.$k -and [string]$Action.$k) { $p[$map[$k]] = $Action.$k }
        }
        $null = New-NetFirewallRule @p
        return
    }
    $rules = @(Get-IgwtFirewallGroupRules -Action $Action)
    $target = [string]$Action.on
    if ($Mode -eq 'default') { $target = [string]$Action.default }
    $names = @($rules | Where-Object { ([string]$_.Enabled -eq 'True') -ne ($target -eq 'Enabled') } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Name })
    if ($names.Count -eq 0) { return }
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$($names.Count) rule(s) in '$($Action.displayGroup)'", "Set $target")) { return }
    if ($target -eq 'Enabled') { Enable-NetFirewallRule -Name $names -ErrorAction Stop } else { Disable-NetFirewallRule -Name $names -ErrorAction Stop }
}

function Restore-IgwtFirewallRuleSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Snapshot, $Context)
    if (Test-IgwtOwnedFirewallAction -Action $Action) {
        $name = [string]$Action.rule
        $r = Get-NetFirewallRule -Name $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
        if (-not $Snapshot.existed) {
            if ($r -and $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($name, 'Remove firewall rule created by iG Windows Tuner')) { Remove-NetFirewallRule -Name $name -ErrorAction Stop }
            return
        }
        if ($r -and $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($name, 'Restore enabled state')) { Set-NetFirewallRule -Name $name -Enabled $(if ($Snapshot.enabled) { 'True' } else { 'False' }) -ErrorAction Stop }
        return
    }
    $current = @{}
    foreach ($r in @(Get-IgwtFirewallGroupRules -Action $Action)) { $current[[string]$r.Name] = $r }
    $enable = @(); $disable = @()
    foreach ($s in @($Snapshot.rules | Where-Object { $_ })) {
        if (-not $current.ContainsKey([string]$s.name)) { continue }
        $isOn = ([string]$current[[string]$s.name].Enabled -eq 'True')
        if ([bool]$s.enabled -and -not $isOn) { $enable += [string]$s.name } elseif (-not [bool]$s.enabled -and $isOn) { $disable += [string]$s.name }
    }
    if ($enable.Count -and $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$($enable.Count) rule(s)", 'Re-enable')) { Enable-NetFirewallRule -Name $enable -ErrorAction Stop }
    if ($disable.Count -and $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$($disable.Count) rule(s)", 'Disable')) { Disable-NetFirewallRule -Name $disable -ErrorAction Stop }
}
```

`src/Actions/Mitigations.ps1`:

```ps1
# Mitigations.ps1
# Exploit protection actions (ProcessMitigations module):
#   processMitigation  one mitigation for one program (Set-ProcessMitigation -Name)
#   exploitSystem      one system-wide mitigation (Set-ProcessMitigation -System); catalog items may
#                      only turn system mitigations ON
# Each mitigation is captured as ON, OFF or NOTSET and restored exactly: NOTSET is restored with
# '-Remove -Disable <mitigation>', which Microsoft documents as returning it to the default.
# 'equivalentOn': ['NOTSET'] makes an item repair-only: "use default" counts as on (for mitigations
# that Windows enables by default), so only an explicit OFF is changed.

# Mitigation name (as used by -Enable/-Disable) -> property path in Get-ProcessMitigation output.
$script:IgwtMitigationMap = [ordered]@{
    DEP = 'DEP.Enable'; EmulateAtlThunks = 'DEP.EmulateAtlThunks'; SEHOP = 'SEHOP.Enable'
    ForceRelocateImages = 'ASLR.ForceRelocateImages'; RequireInfo = 'ASLR.RequireInfo'; BottomUp = 'ASLR.BottomUp'; HighEntropy = 'ASLR.HighEntropy'
    CFG = 'CFG.Enable'; SuppressExports = 'CFG.SuppressExports'; StrictCFG = 'CFG.StrictControlFlowGuard'
    StrictHandle = 'StrictHandle.Enable'; DisableExtensionPoints = 'ExtensionPoints.DisableExtensionPoints'
    BlockDynamicCode = 'DynamicCode.BlockDynamicCode'; DisableNonSystemFonts = 'FontDisable.DisableNonSystemFonts'
    BlockRemoteImageLoads = 'ImageLoad.BlockRemoteImageLoads'; BlockLowLabelImageLoads = 'ImageLoad.BlockLowLabelImageLoads'; PreferSystem32 = 'ImageLoad.PreferSystem32'
    DisallowChildProcessCreation = 'ChildProcess.DisallowChildProcessCreation'; MicrosoftSignedOnly = 'BinarySignature.MicrosoftSignedOnly'
    DisableWin32kSystemCalls = 'SystemCalls.DisableWin32kSystemCalls'
}

function Get-IgwtMitigationValue {
    <# .SYNOPSIS ON, OFF or NOTSET for one mitigation, system-wide (no -Process) or for one program. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Mitigation, [string]$Process)
    $path = $script:IgwtMitigationMap[$Mitigation]
    if (-not $path) { throw "Unsupported mitigation '$Mitigation'." }
    $obj = $null
    try {
        if ($Process) { $obj = Get-ProcessMitigation -Name $Process -ErrorAction Stop } else { $obj = Get-ProcessMitigation -System -ErrorAction Stop }
    } catch {
        if ($Process) { return 'NOTSET' }
        throw
    }
    $obj = @($obj) | Select-Object -First 1
    if (-not $obj) { return 'NOTSET' }
    $v = $obj
    foreach ($part in $path.Split('.')) {
        if ($null -eq $v) { break }
        $v = $v.$part
    }
    $s = ([string]$v).ToUpperInvariant()
    if ($s -in 'ON', 'OFF') { return $s }
    return 'NOTSET'
}

function Set-IgwtMitigationValue {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Mitigation, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateSet('ON', 'OFF', 'NOTSET')][string]$Value, [string]$Process)
    $target = $(if ($Process) { $Process } else { 'system' })
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($target, "Set exploit protection $Mitigation = $Value")) { return }
    $p = @{ ErrorAction = 'Stop' }
    if ($Process) { $p.Name = $Process } else { $p.System = $true }
    switch ($Value) {
        'ON' { $p.Enable = $Mitigation }
        'OFF' { $p.Disable = $Mitigation }
        'NOTSET' { $p.Remove = $true; $p.Disable = $Mitigation }
    }
    $null = Set-ProcessMitigation @p
}

function Get-IgwtMitigationTarget {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action)
    if ([string]$Action.type -eq 'processMitigation') { return [string]$Action.process }
    return ''
}

function Test-IgwtMitigationOn {
    <# .SYNOPSIS True when the value is the action's 'on' value or one of its equivalentOn values. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Value)
    if ($Value -eq [string]$Action.on) { return $true }
    return (@($Action.equivalentOn | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { ([string]$_).ToUpperInvariant() }) -contains $Value)
}

function Get-IgwtMitigationState {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $proc = Get-IgwtMitigationTarget -Action $Action
    $label = "Exploit protection $($Action.mitigation) ($(if ($proc) { $proc } else { 'system-wide' }))"
    try { $cur = Get-IgwtMitigationValue -Mitigation ([string]$Action.mitigation) -Process $proc } catch {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = $label; Current = 'unreadable'; Desired = [string]$Action.on; State = 'Unknown'; Note = $_.Exception.Message }
    }
    $note = $(if ($cur -eq 'NOTSET' -and (Test-IgwtMitigationOn -Action $Action -Value $cur)) { 'Use default (Windows turns it on).' } else { '' })
    [pscustomobject]@{ Target = $label; Current = $cur; Desired = [string]$Action.on; State = $(if (Test-IgwtMitigationOn -Action $Action -Value $cur) { 'On' } else { 'Off' }); Note = $note }
}

function Get-IgwtMitigationSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    return @{ value = (Get-IgwtMitigationValue -Mitigation ([string]$Action.mitigation) -Process (Get-IgwtMitigationTarget -Action $Action)) }
}

function Invoke-IgwtMitigationApply {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context, [ValidateSet('on', 'default')][string]$Mode = 'on')
    $proc = Get-IgwtMitigationTarget -Action $Action
    $target = [string]$Action.on
    if ($Mode -eq 'default') { $target = 'NOTSET' }
    if ([string]$Action.type -eq 'exploitSystem' -and $target -eq 'OFF') { throw 'iG Windows Tuner never turns system-wide exploit protection off.' }
    $cur = Get-IgwtMitigationValue -Mitigation ([string]$Action.mitigation) -Process $proc
    if ($Mode -eq 'on' -and (Test-IgwtMitigationOn -Action $Action -Value $cur)) { return }
    if ($cur -ne $target) { Set-IgwtMitigationValue -Mitigation ([string]$Action.mitigation) -Value $target -Process $proc }
}

function Restore-IgwtMitigationSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Snapshot, $Context)
    $prev = ([string]$Snapshot.value).ToUpperInvariant()
    if ($prev -notin 'ON', 'OFF', 'NOTSET') { throw "Snapshot value '$prev' is not ON, OFF or NOTSET." }
    $proc = Get-IgwtMitigationTarget -Action $Action
    $cur = Get-IgwtMitigationValue -Mitigation ([string]$Action.mitigation) -Process $proc
    if ($cur -ne $prev) { Set-IgwtMitigationValue -Mitigation ([string]$Action.mitigation) -Value $prev -Process $proc }
}
```

`src/Actions/NetAdapterAdvanced.ps1`:

```ps1
# NetAdapterAdvanced.ps1
# 'netAdapterAdvanced' action: driver advanced properties addressed by their standardized
# RegistryKeyword (*EEE, *InterruptModeration, *RSS, ...). Display names are localized and
# vendor-specific, so they are only used as a fallback when the keyword is not exposed.
# Changes are written with -NoRestart; the new value takes effect after the adapter restarts
# (or after a reboot), so an active connection or Remote Desktop session is never dropped.

function Get-IgwtAdapterAdvancedProperty {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Finds the advanced property on one adapter: by RegistryKeyword first, then by fallback
        display names. Returns $null when the adapter does not expose it.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Adapter, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action)
    $props = @()
    try { $props = @(Get-IgwtCached -Key "na:$($Adapter.Name)" -ScriptBlock { @(Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $Adapter.Name -AllProperties -ErrorAction Stop) }) } catch { return $null }
    $byKeyword = $props | Where-Object { $_.RegistryKeyword -eq [string]$Action.keyword } | Select-Object -First 1
    if ($byKeyword) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Property = $byKeyword; Mode = 'keyword'; OnValue = [string]$Action.on } }
    foreach ($fb in @($Action.fallback)) {
        if (-not $fb) { continue }
        $p = $props | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -eq [string]$fb.displayName } | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($p) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Property = $p; Mode = 'displayName'; OnValue = [string]$fb.displayValue } }
    }
    return $null
}

function Get-IgwtAdapterPropertyCurrent {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Found)
    if ($Found.Mode -eq 'keyword') { return [string](@($Found.Property.RegistryValue)[0]) }
    return [string]$Found.Property.DisplayValue
}

function Get-IgwtNetAdapterAdvancedState {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $adapters = @()
    if ($Context -and $null -ne $Context.WiredAdapters) { $adapters = @($Context.WiredAdapters) } else { $adapters = @(Get-IgwtActiveWiredAdapter) }
    if ($adapters.Count -eq 0) {
        return @([pscustomobject]@{ Target = "Adapter property $($Action.keyword)"; Current = 'no active wired adapter'; Desired = ''; State = 'NotApplicable'; Note = '' })
    }
    foreach ($a in $adapters) {
        $found = Get-IgwtAdapterAdvancedProperty -Adapter $a -Action $Action
        if (-not $found) {
            [pscustomobject]@{ Target = "[$($a.Name)] $($Action.keyword)"; Current = 'not exposed by driver'; Desired = [string]$Action.on; State = 'NotApplicable'; Note = 'The driver does not offer this property.' }
            continue
        }
        $cur = Get-IgwtAdapterPropertyCurrent -Found $found
        $label = $found.Property.RegistryKeyword
        if ($found.Mode -eq 'displayName') { $label = "$($found.Property.DisplayName) (vendor name)" }
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Target  = "[$($a.Name)] $label"
            Current = "$cur ($($found.Property.DisplayValue))"
            Desired = $found.OnValue
            State   = $(if ($cur -eq $found.OnValue) { 'On' } else { 'Off' })
            Note    = 'Takes effect after the adapter restarts or after a reboot.'
        }
    }
}

function Get-IgwtNetAdapterAdvancedSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $adapters = @()
    if ($Context -and $null -ne $Context.WiredAdapters) { $adapters = @($Context.WiredAdapters) } else { $adapters = @(Get-IgwtActiveWiredAdapter) }
    $items = foreach ($a in $adapters) {
        $found = Get-IgwtAdapterAdvancedProperty -Adapter $a -Action $Action
        if (-not $found) { continue }
        [ordered]@{
            scope       = [string]$a.InterfaceGuid
            adapter     = [string]$a.Name
            mode        = $found.Mode
            keyword     = [string]$found.Property.RegistryKeyword
            displayName = [string]$found.Property.DisplayName
            value       = (Get-IgwtAdapterPropertyCurrent -Found $found)
        }
    }
    return @{ items = @($items) }
}

function Set-IgwtAdapterPropertyValue {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$AdapterName, [string]$Keyword, [string]$DisplayName, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Mode, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Value)
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$AdapterName $Keyword$DisplayName", "Set advanced property to $Value (no adapter restart)")) { return }
    try {
        if ($Mode -eq 'keyword') {
            Set-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $AdapterName -RegistryKeyword $Keyword -RegistryValue $Value -NoRestart -ErrorAction Stop
        } else {
            Set-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $AdapterName -DisplayName $DisplayName -DisplayValue $Value -NoRestart -ErrorAction Stop
        }
    } finally { Clear-IgwtCache -Prefix 'na:' -WhatIf:$false }
}

function Invoke-IgwtNetAdapterAdvancedApply {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context, [ValidateSet('on', 'default')][string]$Mode = 'on')
    $adapters = @()
    if ($Context -and $null -ne $Context.WiredAdapters) { $adapters = @($Context.WiredAdapters) } else { $adapters = @(Get-IgwtActiveWiredAdapter) }
    foreach ($a in $adapters) {
        $found = Get-IgwtAdapterAdvancedProperty -Adapter $a -Action $Action
        if (-not $found) { continue }
        $target = $found.OnValue
        if ($Mode -eq 'default') {
            if ($found.Mode -ne 'keyword' -or $null -eq $Action.default) { continue }
            $target = [string]$Action.default
        }
        if ((Get-IgwtAdapterPropertyCurrent -Found $found) -eq $target) { continue }
        Set-IgwtAdapterPropertyValue -AdapterName $a.Name -Keyword $found.Property.RegistryKeyword -DisplayName $found.Property.DisplayName -Mode $found.Mode -Value $target
    }
}

function Restore-IgwtNetAdapterAdvancedSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Snapshot, $Context)
    $adapters = @()
    try { $adapters = @(Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction Stop) } catch { $adapters = @() }
    foreach ($item in @($Snapshot.items)) {
        $a = $adapters | Where-Object { [string]$_.InterfaceGuid -eq [string]$item.scope } | Select-Object -First 1
        if (-not $a) { Write-IgwtLog -Level Warn -Message "Adapter $($item.adapter) is no longer present; $($item.keyword) not restored."; continue }
        $keyword = [string]$item.keyword
        if ([string]$item.mode -ne 'keyword') { $keyword = '' }
        Set-IgwtAdapterPropertyValue -AdapterName $a.Name -Keyword $keyword -DisplayName ([string]$item.displayName) -Mode ([string]$item.mode) -Value ([string]$item.value)
    }
}
```

`src/Actions/NetAdapterPower.ps1`:

```ps1
# NetAdapterPower.ps1
# 'netAdapterPower' action: the Device Manager option "Allow the computer to turn off this
# device to save power" for the active wired adapter.
#
# Set-NetAdapterPowerManagement does not expose this option, so it is written as the
# documented PnPCapabilities value in the adapter's driver key (24 = do not allow, 0 = allow,
# the default). The action is implemented by the registry engine (see Get-IgwtRegistryTargets
# and Get-IgwtRegistryActionEffective in Registry.ps1) so it gets the same exact snapshot and
# revert behavior as every other registry value. A reboot is required for it to take effect.

function Get-IgwtAdapterPowerInfo {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Read-only: PnPCapabilities for each active wired adapter (used by the health report). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    foreach ($a in @(Get-IgwtActiveWiredAdapter)) {
        $classKey = Get-IgwtAdapterClassKey -InterfaceGuid $a.InterfaceGuid
        $value = $null
        if ($classKey) {
            try { $value = (Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $classKey -Name PnPCapabilities -ErrorAction Stop).PnPCapabilities } catch { $value = $null }
        }
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Adapter        = $a.Name
            PnPCapabilities = $value
            AllowTurnOff   = $(if ($null -eq $value) { 'Allowed (default)' } elseif (([int]$value -band 0x10) -ne 0 -or ([int]$value -band 0x08) -ne 0) { 'Not allowed' } else { 'Allowed' })
        }
    }
}
```

`src/Actions/NetCommon.ps1`:

```ps1
# NetCommon.ps1
# Adapter discovery shared by the network actions. Only the active physical wired adapter is
# ever targeted; virtual, VPN, tunnel and hypervisor adapters are skipped.

$script:IgwtVirtualAdapterPattern = 'VPN|Virtual|TAP-|TAP |Hyper-V|VMware|VirtualBox|WireGuard|Wintun|Npcap|Loopback|Bluetooth|Tailscale|ZeroTier|Kernel Debug|WAN Miniport|Teredo|IP-HTTPS|6to4'
$script:IgwtNetClassGuid = '{4d36e972-e325-11ce-bfc1-08002be10318}'

function Get-IgwtActiveWiredAdapter {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Physical Ethernet adapters that are Up, excluding virtual/VPN adapters. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $all = @()
    try { $all = @(Get-IgwtCached -Key 'net:physical' -ScriptBlock { @(Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction Stop) }) } catch { return @() }
    $result = foreach ($a in $all) {
        if ($a.Status -ne 'Up') { continue }
        if ($a.Virtual) { continue }
        if ($a.InterfaceDescription -match $script:IgwtVirtualAdapterPattern) { continue }
        $isEthernet = ([string]$a.PhysicalMediaType -eq '802.3') -or ([int]$a.NdisPhysicalMedium -eq 14)
        if (-not $isEthernet) { continue }
        $a
    }
    return @($result)
}

function Get-IgwtWifiAdapter {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Physical Wi-Fi adapters (any status except Not Present). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $all = @()
    try { $all = @(Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction Stop) } catch { return @() }
    $result = foreach ($a in $all) {
        $isWifi = ([string]$a.PhysicalMediaType -match '802\.11') -or ([int]$a.NdisPhysicalMedium -eq 9)
        if ($isWifi -and $a.Status -ne 'Not Present') { $a }
    }
    return @($result)
}

function Get-IgwtAdapterClassKey {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Registry path of the adapter's driver key under the network class
        (HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4d36e972-...}\NNNN), matched by NetCfgInstanceId.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$InterfaceGuid)
    $classPath = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\$script:IgwtNetClassGuid"
    $keys = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $classPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -match '^\d{4}$' }
    foreach ($k in $keys) {
        try {
            $id = $k.GetValue('NetCfgInstanceId')
            if ($id -and [string]::Equals([string]$id, $InterfaceGuid, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
                return "$classPath\$($k.PSChildName)"
            }
        } catch { Write-Verbose "Skipping unreadable class key $($k.PSChildName)." }
    }
    return $null
}

function Get-IgwtAdapterIdentity {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Short label for logs and diffs. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Adapter)
    return "$($Adapter.Name) ($($Adapter.InterfaceDescription))"
}
```
