`src/Actions/NetQos.ps1`:

```ps1
# NetQos.ps1
# 'netQosPolicy' action: policy-based QoS that marks a game's UDP traffic with a DSCP value
# (46 = Expedited Forwarding). It only helps when the router honors DSCP. Policies are named
# "iGWindowsTuner-<game>" so they are easy to find in Get-NetQosPolicy and are never confused with
# policies created by other tools. Policies created before the rename from AegisTune are named
# "AegisTune-<game>"; they are detected, updated and removed under that name.

function Get-IgwtQosTargets {
    <# .SYNOPSIS One policy per game executable flagged "qos": true in data\games.json. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action)
    $prefix = 'iGWindowsTuner-'
    if ($Action.namePrefix) { $prefix = [string]$Action.namePrefix }
    $legacyPrefix = 'AegisTune-'
    $games = @((Get-IgwtGameDefinitions) | Where-Object { $_.qos })
    foreach ($g in $games) {
        $i = 0
        foreach ($exe in @($g.exe)) {
            $suffix = ''
            if ($i -gt 0) { $suffix = "-$i" }
            [pscustomobject]@{ Name = "$prefix$($g.id)$suffix"; LegacyName = $(if ($prefix -ne $legacyPrefix) { "$legacyPrefix$($g.id)$suffix" } else { '' }); Exe = [string]$exe; Game = [string]$g.name }
            $i++
        }
    }
}

function Get-IgwtQosPolicyByName {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Name)
    try { return (Get-NetQosPolicy -Name $Name -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1) } catch { return $null }
}

function Get-IgwtQosTargetPolicy {
    <# .SYNOPSIS The policy for a target under its current name, else under its pre-rename (AegisTune) name. Returns Name and Policy. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Target)
    $p = Get-IgwtQosPolicyByName -Name $Target.Name
    if (-not $p -and $Target.LegacyName) {
        $old = Get-IgwtQosPolicyByName -Name $Target.LegacyName
        if ($old) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Name = [string]$Target.LegacyName; Policy = $old } }
    }
    return [pscustomobject]@{ Name = [string]$Target.Name; Policy = $p }
}

function Get-IgwtNetQosState {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $dscp = [int]$Action.dscp
    $proto = [string]$Action.protocol
    foreach ($t in @(Get-IgwtQosTargets -Action $Action)) {
        $found = Get-IgwtQosTargetPolicy -Target $t
        $p = $found.Policy
        $isOn = $false
        $cur = 'not present'
        if ($p) {
            $cur = "app=$($p.AppPathName) proto=$($p.IPProtocol) dscp=$($p.DSCPValue)"
            $isOn = ([string]$p.AppPathName -eq $t.Exe -and [int]$p.DSCPValue -eq $dscp -and [string]$p.IPProtocol -eq $proto)
        }
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Target  = "QoS policy $($found.Name) ($($t.Game))"
            Current = $cur
            Desired = "app=$($t.Exe) proto=$proto dscp=$dscp"
            State   = $(if ($isOn) { 'On' } else { 'Off' })
            Note    = 'Only effective if your router honors DSCP markings.'
        }
    }
}

function Get-IgwtNetQosSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $items = foreach ($t in @(Get-IgwtQosTargets -Action $Action)) {
        $found = Get-IgwtQosTargetPolicy -Target $t
        $p = $found.Policy
        if ($p) {
            [ordered]@{ name = $found.Name; exists = $true; appPathName = [string]$p.AppPathName; ipProtocol = [string]$p.IPProtocol;
                dscp = [int]$p.DSCPValue; networkProfile = [string]$p.NetworkProfile }
        } else {
            [ordered]@{ name = $t.Name; exists = $false }
        }
    }
    return @{ items = @($items) }
}

function Invoke-IgwtNetQosApply {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context, [ValidateSet('on', 'default')][string]$Mode = 'on')
    $dscp = [sbyte]$Action.dscp
    $proto = [string]$Action.protocol
    foreach ($t in @(Get-IgwtQosTargets -Action $Action)) {
        if ($Mode -eq 'default') {
            foreach ($n in @($t.Name, $t.LegacyName) | Where-Object { $_ }) {
                if ((Get-IgwtQosPolicyByName -Name $n) -and $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($n, 'Remove QoS policy')) { Remove-NetQosPolicy -Name $n -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction Stop }
            }
            continue
        }
        $found = Get-IgwtQosTargetPolicy -Target $t
        $p = $found.Policy
        if (-not $p) {
            if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($t.Name, "Create QoS policy ($($t.Exe), $proto, DSCP $dscp)")) {
                $null = New-NetQosPolicy -Name $t.Name -AppPathNameMatchCondition $t.Exe -IPProtocolMatchCondition $proto -DSCPAction $dscp -NetworkProfile All -ErrorAction Stop
            }
        } elseif ([string]$p.AppPathName -ne $t.Exe -or [int]$p.DSCPValue -ne [int]$dscp -or [string]$p.IPProtocol -ne $proto) {
            if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($found.Name, 'Update QoS policy')) {
                Set-NetQosPolicy -Name $found.Name -AppPathNameMatchCondition $t.Exe -IPProtocolMatchCondition $proto -DSCPAction $dscp -ErrorAction Stop
            }
        }
    }
}

function Restore-IgwtNetQosSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Snapshot, $Context)
    $allowed = @(Get-IgwtQosTargets -Action $Action | ForEach-Object { $_.Name; $_.LegacyName } | Where-Object { $_ })
    foreach ($item in @($Snapshot.items)) {
        $name = [string]$item.name
        if ($allowed -notcontains $name) { Write-IgwtLog -Level Warn -Message "Snapshot names unknown QoS policy '$name'; skipped."; continue }
        $p = Get-IgwtQosPolicyByName -Name $name
        if (-not $item.exists) {
            if ($p -and $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($name, 'Remove QoS policy (did not exist before)')) { Remove-NetQosPolicy -Name $name -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction Stop }
        } else {
            if ($p) {
                if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($name, 'Restore QoS policy')) {
                    Set-NetQosPolicy -Name $name -AppPathNameMatchCondition ([string]$item.appPathName) -IPProtocolMatchCondition ([string]$item.ipProtocol) -DSCPAction ([sbyte]$item.dscp) -ErrorAction Stop
                }
            } elseif ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($name, 'Recreate QoS policy')) {
                $null = New-NetQosPolicy -Name $name -AppPathNameMatchCondition ([string]$item.appPathName) -IPProtocolMatchCondition ([string]$item.ipProtocol) -DSCPAction ([sbyte]$item.dscp) -NetworkProfile ([string]$item.networkProfile) -ErrorAction Stop
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```ps1
# OptionalFeature.ps1
# 'optionalFeature' action: enable/disable a Windows optional feature (for example SMB1Protocol).
# Features are only disabled or re-enabled, never removed from the image (no DISM payload removal).

function Get-IgwtOptionalFeatureStateValue {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Feature)
    $f = Get-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName $Feature -ErrorAction Stop
    if (-not $f) { return $null }
    return [string]$f.State
}

function Get-IgwtOptionalFeatureState {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $feature = [string]$Action.feature
    $isAdmin = $true
    if ($Context -and $null -ne $Context.IsAdmin) { $isAdmin = [bool]$Context.IsAdmin }
    if (-not $isAdmin) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = "Optional feature $feature"; Current = 'requires administrator to read'; Desired = [string]$Action.on; State = 'Unknown'; Note = '' }
    }
    try { $state = Get-IgwtOptionalFeatureStateValue -Feature $feature } catch {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = "Optional feature $feature"; Current = 'unreadable'; Desired = [string]$Action.on; State = 'Unknown'; Note = $_.Exception.Message }
    }
    if (-not $state) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = "Optional feature $feature"; Current = 'not present'; Desired = [string]$Action.on; State = 'NotApplicable'; Note = '' }
    }
    $isOn = $state -like "$($Action.on)*"
    [pscustomobject]@{ Target = "Optional feature $feature"; Current = $state; Desired = [string]$Action.on; State = $(if ($isOn) { 'On' } else { 'Off' }); Note = '' }
}

function Get-IgwtOptionalFeatureSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    return @{ feature = [string]$Action.feature; state = (Get-IgwtOptionalFeatureStateValue -Feature ([string]$Action.feature)) }
}

function Set-IgwtOptionalFeature {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Feature, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateSet('Enabled', 'Disabled')][string]$State)
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Feature, "Set optional feature $State (no restart)")) { return }
    if ($State -eq 'Disabled') { $null = Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName $Feature -NoRestart -ErrorAction Stop }
    else { $null = Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName $Feature -NoRestart -ErrorAction Stop }
}

function Invoke-IgwtOptionalFeatureApply {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context, [ValidateSet('on', 'default')][string]$Mode = 'on')
    $target = [string]$Action.on
    if ($Mode -eq 'default') { $target = [string]$Action.default }
    $cur = Get-IgwtOptionalFeatureStateValue -Feature ([string]$Action.feature)
    if (-not $cur -or $cur -like "$target*") { return }
    Set-IgwtOptionalFeature -Feature ([string]$Action.feature) -State $target
}

function Restore-IgwtOptionalFeatureSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Snapshot, $Context)
    $prev = [string]$Snapshot.state
    if (-not $prev) { return }
    $target = 'Disabled'
    if ($prev -like 'Enable*') { $target = 'Enabled' }
    $cur = Get-IgwtOptionalFeatureStateValue -Feature ([string]$Action.feature)
    if ($cur -like "$target*") { return }
    Set-IgwtOptionalFeature -Feature ([string]$Action.feature) -State $target
}
```

`src/Actions/PowerAttribute.ps1`:

```ps1
# PowerAttribute.ps1
# 'powercfgAttribute' action: shows or hides a power setting in Power Options with
# 'powercfg -attributes <subgroup> <setting> -ATTRIB_HIDE / +ATTRIB_HIDE'. Visibility is read from
# the setting's Attributes value (bit 1 = hidden); revert writes that exact value back.

function Get-IgwtPowerAttributePath {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action)
    return "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\PowerSettings\$($Action.subgroup)\$($Action.setting)"
}

function Get-IgwtPowerAttributeVisible {
    <# .SYNOPSIS $true visible, $false hidden, $null when the setting does not exist on this PC. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action)
    $path = Get-IgwtPowerAttributePath -Action $Action
    if (-not (Test-IgwtRegistryKey -Path $path)) { return $null }
    $v = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $path -Name 'Attributes'
    if (-not $v.Exists) { return $true }
    return ((([long]$v.Value) -band 1) -eq 0)
}

function Get-IgwtPowerAttributeState {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $label = "Power setting visibility: $($Action.label)"
    $vis = Get-IgwtPowerAttributeVisible -Action $Action
    if ($null -eq $vis) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = $label; Current = 'not present'; Desired = ''; State = 'NotApplicable'; Note = 'This power setting does not exist on this PC.' } }
    $want = [bool]$Action.visible
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Target  = $label
        Current = $(if ($vis) { 'shown in Power Options' } else { 'hidden' })
        Desired = $(if ($want) { 'shown in Power Options' } else { 'hidden' })
        State   = $(if ($vis -eq $want) { 'On' } else { 'Off' })
        Note    = ''
    }
}

function Get-IgwtPowerAttributeSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $path = Get-IgwtPowerAttributePath -Action $Action
    $cur = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $path -Name 'Attributes'
    return @{ item = [ordered]@{ exists = [bool]$cur.Exists; kind = $cur.Kind; value = (ConvertTo-IgwtSerializableValue -Value $cur.Value -Kind $cur.Kind); missingDepth = 0 } }
}

function Set-IgwtPowerAttributeVisible {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][bool]$Visible)
    $flag = '+ATTRIB_HIDE'
    if ($Visible) { $flag = '-ATTRIB_HIDE' }
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$($Action.subgroup) $($Action.setting)", "powercfg -attributes $flag")) { return }
    $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('-attributes', [string]$Action.subgroup, [string]$Action.setting, $flag)
    if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "powercfg -attributes failed: $($r.Output)" }
}

function Invoke-IgwtPowerAttributeApply {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context, [ValidateSet('on', 'default')][string]$Mode = 'on')
    $vis = Get-IgwtPowerAttributeVisible -Action $Action
    if ($null -eq $vis) { return }
    $want = [bool]$Action.visible
    if ($Mode -eq 'default') { $want = ([string]$Action.default -eq 'visible') }
    if ($vis -ne $want) { Set-IgwtPowerAttributeVisible -Action $Action -Visible $want }
}

function Restore-IgwtPowerAttributeSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Snapshot, $Context)
    if (-not (Test-IgwtRegistryKey -Path (Get-IgwtPowerAttributePath -Action $Action))) { return }
    if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Action.label, 'Restore power setting visibility')) {
        Restore-IgwtRegistryItem -Path (Get-IgwtPowerAttributePath -Action $Action) -Name 'Attributes' -Item $Snapshot.item
    }
}
```

`src/Actions/PowerCfg.ps1`:

```ps1
# PowerCfg.ps1
# 'powercfgScheme' and 'powercfgSetting' actions through the inbox powercfg.exe.
# Output is parsed only for GUIDs and 0x values, which are not localized.

$script:IgwtSchemeBalanced = '381b4222-f694-41f0-9685-ff5bb260df2e'
$script:IgwtSchemeHighPerformance = '8c5e7fda-e8bf-4a96-9a85-a6e23a8c635c'
$script:IgwtSchemeUltimateBase = 'e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61'
$script:IgwtGuidPattern = '[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}'

function Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Runs %SystemRoot%\System32\powercfg.exe with the given arguments and returns exit code and output.
        Refuses to run in TestMode (tests must mock this function).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string[]]$Arguments)
    if ($script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) { throw 'TestMode safety: powercfg.exe must be mocked in tests.' }
    $readOnly = @('/getactivescheme', '/list', '/query', '/q', '/qh', '/l', '/availablesleepstates', '/a')
    $isRead = $readOnly -contains $Arguments[0].ToLowerInvariant()
    if (-not $isRead -and -not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("powercfg.exe $($Arguments -join ' ')", 'Run')) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = '' }
    }
    $exe = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\powercfg.exe'
    if ($isRead) {
        return (Get-IgwtCached -Key ("pc:" + ($Arguments -join ' ')) -ScriptBlock {
                $o = & $exe @Arguments 2>&1 | Out-String
                [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE; Output = $o }
            })
    }
    $output = & $exe @Arguments 2>&1 | Out-String
    $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    Clear-IgwtCache -Prefix 'pc:' -WhatIf:$false
    return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = $code; Output = $output }
}

function Get-IgwtActivePowerScheme {
    <# .SYNOPSIS GUID (lower case) of the active power scheme. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param()
    $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/getactivescheme')
    $m = [regex]::Match($r.Output, $script:IgwtGuidPattern)
    if (-not $m.Success) { throw "Could not read the active power scheme: $($r.Output)" }
    return $m.Value.ToLowerInvariant()
}

function Get-IgwtPowerSchemes {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Installed power schemes from the registry, with the powrprof resource id of their name. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $root = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\User\PowerSchemes'
    $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/list')
    $listed = @([regex]::Matches($r.Output, $script:IgwtGuidPattern) | ForEach-Object { $_.Value.ToLowerInvariant() } | Select-Object -Unique)
    foreach ($g in $listed) {
        $fn = $null
        try { $fn = [string](Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path "$root\$g" -Name 'FriendlyName').Value } catch { $fn = $null }
        $resId = $null
        if ($fn -match 'powrprof\.dll,-(\d+)') { $resId = [int]$Matches[1] }
        $display = $fn
        if ($fn -and $fn.Contains(',')) { $display = $fn.Substring($fn.LastIndexOf(',') + 1) }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Guid = $g; FriendlyName = $fn; Name = $display; ResourceId = $resId }
    }
}

function Test-IgwtPowerSchemeExists {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Guid)
    return (@(Get-IgwtPowerSchemes | Where-Object { $_.Guid -eq $Guid.ToLowerInvariant() }).Count -gt 0)
}

function Get-IgwtPowerSettingValue {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Current AC/DC index of a setting in a scheme (last two 0x values of powercfg /query). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Scheme, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Subgroup, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Setting)
    $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/query', $Scheme, $Subgroup, $Setting)
    $hex = @([regex]::Matches($r.Output, '0x([0-9a-fA-F]{8})') | ForEach-Object { [Convert]::ToUInt32($_.Groups[1].Value, 16) })
    if ($hex.Count -lt 2) { return $null }
    return [pscustomobject]@{ AC = [int]$hex[$hex.Count - 2]; DC = [int]$hex[$hex.Count - 1] }
}

function Get-IgwtPowerSettingDefault {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Windows default AC/DC index for a setting in a scheme, from
        HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\PowerSettings\<sub>\<setting>\DefaultPowerSchemeValues\<scheme>.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Scheme, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Subgroup, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Setting)
    $p = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\PowerSettings\$Subgroup\$Setting\DefaultPowerSchemeValues\$Scheme"
    try {
        $ac = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $p -Name 'ACSettingIndex'
        $dc = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $p -Name 'DCSettingIndex'
        if ($ac.Exists) { return [pscustomobject]@{ AC = [int]$ac.Value; DC = $(if ($dc.Exists) { [int]$dc.Value } else { $null }) } }
    } catch { Write-Verbose "No default power values for $Scheme." }
    return $null
}

#region powercfgScheme

function Get-IgwtPowerCfgSchemeState {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $target = ([string]$Action.scheme).ToLowerInvariant()
    $active = Get-IgwtActivePowerScheme
    $schemes = @(Get-IgwtPowerSchemes)
    $activeName = ($schemes | Where-Object { $_.Guid -eq $active } | Select-Object -First 1).Name
    $targetScheme = $schemes | Where-Object { $_.Guid -eq $target } | Select-Object -First 1
    if (-not $targetScheme) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = 'Active power scheme'; Current = "$activeName ($active)"; Desired = $target; State = 'NotApplicable'; Note = 'This power scheme is not installed on this PC.' }
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Target  = 'Active power scheme'
        Current = "$activeName ($active)"
        Desired = "$($targetScheme.Name) ($target)"
        State   = $(if ($active -eq $target) { 'On' } else { 'Off' })
        Note    = ''
    }
}

function Get-IgwtPowerCfgSchemeSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    return @{ previousActive = (Get-IgwtActivePowerScheme) }
}

function Invoke-IgwtPowerCfgSchemeApply {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context, [ValidateSet('on', 'default')][string]$Mode = 'on')
    $target = ([string]$Action.scheme).ToLowerInvariant()
    if ($Mode -eq 'default') { $target = $script:IgwtSchemeBalanced }
    if ((Get-IgwtActivePowerScheme) -eq $target) { return }
    if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($target, 'Activate power scheme')) {
        $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/setactive', $target)
        if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "powercfg /setactive failed: $($r.Output)" }
    }
}

function Restore-IgwtPowerCfgSchemeSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Snapshot, $Context)
    $prev = ([string]$Snapshot.previousActive).ToLowerInvariant()
    if ($prev -notmatch "^$script:IgwtGuidPattern$") { throw 'Snapshot does not contain a valid scheme GUID.' }
    if (-not (Test-IgwtPowerSchemeExists -Guid $prev)) { Write-IgwtLog -Level Warn -Message "Previous power scheme $prev no longer exists; leaving the current scheme active."; return }
    if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($prev, 'Re-activate previous power scheme')) {
        $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/setactive', $prev)
        if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "powercfg /setactive failed: $($r.Output)" }
    }
}

#endregion

#region powercfgSetting

function Get-IgwtPowerCfgSettingState {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $scheme = Get-IgwtActivePowerScheme
    $v = Get-IgwtPowerSettingValue -Scheme $scheme -Subgroup $Action.subgroup -Setting $Action.setting
    if (-not $v) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = "Power setting $($Action.label)"; Current = 'not available'; Desired = ''; State = 'NotApplicable'; Note = 'Setting not exposed by this power scheme or hardware.' }
    }
    $isOn = ($v.AC -eq [int]$Action.ac)
    if ($null -ne $Action.dc) { $isOn = $isOn -and ($v.DC -eq [int]$Action.dc) }
    $desired = "AC=$($Action.ac)"
    if ($null -ne $Action.dc) { $desired += " DC=$($Action.dc)" }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Target  = "Power setting $($Action.label) (active plan $scheme)"
        Current = "AC=$($v.AC) DC=$($v.DC)"
        Desired = $desired
        State   = $(if ($isOn) { 'On' } else { 'Off' })
        Note    = 'Applies to the plan that is active at apply time.'
    }
}

function Get-IgwtPowerCfgSettingSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $scheme = Get-IgwtActivePowerScheme
    $v = Get-IgwtPowerSettingValue -Scheme $scheme -Subgroup $Action.subgroup -Setting $Action.setting
    $ac = $null; $dc = $null
    if ($v) { $ac = $v.AC; $dc = $v.DC }
    return @{ scheme = $scheme; ac = $ac; dc = $dc }
}

function Set-IgwtPowerSettingIndex {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Scheme, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Subgroup, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Setting, $AC, $DC)
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$Scheme $Subgroup $Setting", "Set AC=$AC DC=$DC")) { return }
    if ($null -ne $AC) {
        $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/setacvalueindex', $Scheme, $Subgroup, $Setting, ([string][int]$AC))
        if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "powercfg /setacvalueindex failed: $($r.Output)" }
    }
    if ($null -ne $DC) {
        $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/setdcvalueindex', $Scheme, $Subgroup, $Setting, ([string][int]$DC))
        if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "powercfg /setdcvalueindex failed: $($r.Output)" }
    }
    if ((Get-IgwtActivePowerScheme) -eq $Scheme) {
        # Re-activating the scheme makes the new index effective immediately.
        $null = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/setactive', $Scheme)
    }
}

function Invoke-IgwtPowerCfgSettingApply {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context, [ValidateSet('on', 'default')][string]$Mode = 'on')
    $scheme = Get-IgwtActivePowerScheme
    if ($Mode -eq 'default') {
        $def = Get-IgwtPowerSettingDefault -Scheme $scheme -Subgroup $Action.subgroup -Setting $Action.setting
        if (-not $def -and $Action.defaultFromScheme) {
            $def = Get-IgwtPowerSettingDefault -Scheme ([string]$Action.defaultFromScheme) -Subgroup $Action.subgroup -Setting $Action.setting
        }
        if (-not $def) { $def = [pscustomobject]@{ AC = $Action.defaultAc; DC = $Action.defaultDc } }
        if ($null -eq $def.AC) { throw "No documented default for power setting $($Action.label)." }
        Set-IgwtPowerSettingIndex -Scheme $scheme -Subgroup $Action.subgroup -Setting $Action.setting -AC $def.AC -DC $def.DC
        return
    }
    $dc = $null
    if ($null -ne $Action.dc) { $dc = $Action.dc }
    Set-IgwtPowerSettingIndex -Scheme $scheme -Subgroup $Action.subgroup -Setting $Action.setting -AC $Action.ac -DC $dc
}

function Restore-IgwtPowerCfgSettingSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Snapshot, $Context)
    $scheme = ([string]$Snapshot.scheme).ToLowerInvariant()
    if ($scheme -notmatch "^$script:IgwtGuidPattern$") { throw 'Snapshot does not contain a valid scheme GUID.' }
    if ($null -eq $Snapshot.ac) { return }
    if (-not (Test-IgwtPowerSchemeExists -Guid $scheme)) { Write-IgwtLog -Level Warn -Message "Power scheme $scheme no longer exists; $($Action.label) not restored."; return }
    Set-IgwtPowerSettingIndex -Scheme $scheme -Subgroup $Action.subgroup -Setting $Action.setting -AC $Snapshot.ac -DC $Snapshot.dc
}
```

`src/Actions/Registry.ps1`:

```ps1
# Registry.ps1
# Type-exact registry primitives (.NET Microsoft.Win32 API, no reg.exe) and the 'registry' action.
#
# Snapshot fidelity: every captured value records whether it existed, its exact REG type and
# data, whether its key existed and how many parent keys were missing, so a revert can put
# back "value did not exist" and remove keys that iG Windows Tuner created.

$script:IgwtAbsent = '<absent>'

#region Path resolution

function Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Applies the interactive-user hive mapping and the test redirection to a registry path.
        In TestMode every path must end up inside the Pester TestRegistry: drive.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)
    $p = $Path
    if ($script:IgwtSettings.UserHiveSid -and $p -match '^(HKCU:|HKEY_CURRENT_USER)(\\|$)') {
        $rest = $p -replace '^(HKCU:|HKEY_CURRENT_USER)\\?', ''
        $p = "Registry::HKEY_USERS\$($script:IgwtSettings.UserHiveSid)\$rest"
    }
    $redirect = $script:IgwtSettings.RegistryRedirect
    if ($redirect) {
        foreach ($prefix in $redirect.Keys) {
            if ($p.StartsWith([string]$prefix, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
                $p = [string]$redirect[$prefix] + $p.Substring(([string]$prefix).Length)
                break
            }
        }
    }
    if ($script:IgwtSettings.TestMode -and -not $p.StartsWith('TestRegistry:', [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        throw "TestMode safety: registry path '$Path' does not resolve into TestRegistry:."
    }
    return $p
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtRegistryLocation {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Converts a resolved PowerShell registry path into hive + subkey for the .NET API. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ResolvedPath)
    $native = $null
    if ($ResolvedPath -match '^Registry::(.+)$') {
        $native = $Matches[1]
    } elseif ($ResolvedPath -match '^(HKEY_[A-Z_]+)(\\.*)?$') {
        $native = $ResolvedPath
    } elseif ($ResolvedPath -match '^([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*):\\?(.*)$') {
        $driveName = $Matches[1]
        $rest = $Matches[2]
        $drive = Get-PSDrive -Name $driveName -PSProvider Registry -ErrorAction Stop
        $root = $drive.Root.TrimEnd('\')
        if ($rest) { $native = "$root\$rest" } else { $native = $root }
    } else {
        throw "Unsupported registry path '$ResolvedPath'."
    }
    $native = $native.TrimEnd('\')
    $parts = $native.Split([char[]]@('\'), 2)
    switch ($parts[0].ToUpperInvariant()) {
        'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE' { $hive = [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryHive]::LocalMachine }
        'HKEY_CURRENT_USER'  { $hive = [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryHive]::CurrentUser }
        'HKEY_USERS'         { $hive = [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryHive]::Users }
        'HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT'  { $hive = [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryHive]::ClassesRoot }
        default { throw "Unsupported registry hive '$($parts[0])'." }
    }
    $sub = ''
    if ($parts.Count -gt 1) { $sub = $parts[1] }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Hive = $hive; SubKey = $sub; Native = $native }
}

function Open-IgwtRegistryBaseKey {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][Microsoft.Win32.RegistryHive]$Hive)
    return [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryKey]::OpenBaseKey($Hive, [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryView]::Registry64)
}

#endregion

#region Value conversion

function ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Converts JSON numbers, hex strings ("0xFFFFFFFF") and negative Int32 values to UInt64. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([uint64])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Value)
    if ($Value -is [string]) {
        $s = $Value.Trim()
        if ($s -match '^0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)$') { return [Convert]::ToUInt64($Matches[1], 16) }
        if ($s -match '^-\d+$') { $Value = [int64]$s }
        else { return [uint64]::Parse($s, [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) }
    }
    if ($Value -is [uint64] -or $Value -is [uint32]) { return [uint64]$Value }
    if ($Value -is [double] -or $Value -is [decimal] -or $Value -is [single]) { return [uint64]$Value }
    $i = [int64]$Value
    if ($i -lt 0) {
        if ($i -ge [int32]::MinValue) { return [uint64][BitConverter]::ToUInt32([BitConverter]::GetBytes([int32]$i), 0) }
        return [BitConverter]::ToUInt64([BitConverter]::GetBytes($i), 0)
    }
    return [uint64]$i
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtByteArray {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Bytes from a byte array, an integer list or a hex string ("0A1BFF", spaces allowed). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param($Value)
    if ($null -eq $Value) { return , ([byte[]]@()) }
    if ($Value -is [byte[]]) { return , $Value }
    if ($Value -is [string]) {
        $hex = ($Value -replace '\s', '')
        if ($hex.Length % 2 -ne 0 -or $hex -notmatch '^[0-9a-fA-F]*$') { throw "Invalid hex data '$Value'." }
        $bytes = New-Object byte[] ($hex.Length / 2)
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $bytes.Length; $i++) { $bytes[$i] = [Convert]::ToByte($hex.Substring($i * 2, 2), 16) }
        return , $bytes
    }
    return , ([byte[]]@($Value | ForEach-Object { [byte]$_ }))
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtHexString {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Hex text for binary registry data in snapshots (readable, no encoding of code). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param($Value)
    return ((ConvertTo-IgwtByteArray $Value) | ForEach-Object { '{0:X2}' -f $_ }) -join ''
}

function ConvertFrom-IgwtRawRegistryValue {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Normalizes a raw .NET registry value (DWORD -> UInt32, QWORD -> UInt64). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param($Raw, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Kind)
    switch ($Kind) {
        'DWord'       { return [BitConverter]::ToUInt32([BitConverter]::GetBytes([int32]$Raw), 0) }
        'QWord'       { return [BitConverter]::ToUInt64([BitConverter]::GetBytes([int64]$Raw), 0) }
        'MultiString' { return , ([string[]]@($Raw)) }
        'Binary'      { return , (ConvertTo-IgwtByteArray $Raw) }
        'None'        { return , (ConvertTo-IgwtByteArray $Raw) }
        'Unknown'     { return , (ConvertTo-IgwtByteArray $Raw) }
        default       { return [string]$Raw }
    }
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtRawRegistryValue {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Converts a normalized or JSON value into what RegistryKey.SetValue expects for the kind. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param($Value, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Kind)
    switch ($Kind) {
        'DWord' {
            $u = ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 $Value
            if ($u -gt [uint32]::MaxValue) { throw "Value $u does not fit in a DWORD." }
            return [BitConverter]::ToInt32([BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]$u), 0)
        }
        'QWord' {
            $u = ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 $Value
            return [BitConverter]::ToInt64([BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$u), 0)
        }
        'MultiString' { return , ([string[]]@($Value | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })) }
        'Binary'      { return , (ConvertTo-IgwtByteArray $Value) }
        'None'        { return , (ConvertTo-IgwtByteArray $Value) }
        'String'      { return [string]$Value }
        'ExpandString' { return [string]$Value }
        default { throw "Unsupported registry value kind '$Kind'." }
    }
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtSerializableValue {
    <# .SYNOPSIS JSON-safe form: QWORD as decimal string, binary as hex text. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param($Value, [string]$Kind)
    if ($null -eq $Value) { return $null }
    switch ($Kind) {
        'DWord'       { return [int64](ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 $Value) }
        'QWord'       { return ([uint64](ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 $Value)).ToString([System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) }
        'Binary'      { return (ConvertTo-IgwtHexString $Value) }
        'None'        { return (ConvertTo-IgwtHexString $Value) }
        'Unknown'     { return (ConvertTo-IgwtHexString $Value) }
        'MultiString' { return , ([string[]]@($Value)) }
        default       { return [string]$Value }
    }
}

function ConvertFrom-IgwtSerializableValue {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param($Data, [string]$Kind)
    if ($null -eq $Data) { return $null }
    switch ($Kind) {
        'DWord'       { return [uint32](ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 $Data) }
        'QWord'       { return [uint64](ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 ([string]$Data)) }
        'Binary'      { return , (ConvertTo-IgwtByteArray ([string]$Data)) }
        'None'        { return , (ConvertTo-IgwtByteArray ([string]$Data)) }
        'Unknown'     { return , (ConvertTo-IgwtByteArray ([string]$Data)) }
        'MultiString' { return , ([string[]]@($Data)) }
        default       { return [string]$Data }
    }
}

function Test-IgwtRegistryValueEqual {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Compares two values of the same kind (numbers numerically, strings case-insensitively). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param($Left, $Right, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Kind)
    if ($null -eq $Left -or $null -eq $Right) { return ($null -eq $Left -and $null -eq $Right) }
    switch ($Kind) {
        { $_ -in 'DWord', 'QWord' } {
            try { return ((ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 $Left) -eq (ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 $Right)) } catch { return $false }
        }
        'MultiString' {
            $l = @($Left); $r = @($Right)
            if ($l.Count -ne $r.Count) { return $false }
            for ($i = 0; $i -lt $l.Count; $i++) { if ([string]$l[$i] -ne [string]$r[$i]) { return $false } }
            return $true
        }
        { $_ -in 'Binary', 'None', 'Unknown' } {
            return ((ConvertTo-IgwtHexString $Left) -eq (ConvertTo-IgwtHexString $Right))
        }
        default { return ([string]$Left -eq [string]$Right) }
    }
}

function Format-IgwtRegistryValue {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Short display form, e.g. 0 (DWORD), "Warn" (REG_SZ), <absent>. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([bool]$Exists = $true, $Value, [string]$Kind)
    if (-not $Exists) { return $script:IgwtAbsent }
    switch ($Kind) {
        'DWord' {
            $u = ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 $Value
            if ($u -gt 9) { return ('{0} (0x{0:X}) DWORD' -f $u) }
            return "$u DWORD"
        }
        'QWord' { return "$(ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 $Value) QWORD" }
        'String' { return ('"{0}" SZ' -f $Value) }
        'ExpandString' { return ('"{0}" EXPAND_SZ' -f $Value) }
        'MultiString' { return ('[{0}] MULTI_SZ' -f (@($Value) -join ', ')) }
        default {
            $bytes = ConvertTo-IgwtByteArray $Value
            $hex = ($bytes | Select-Object -First 12 | ForEach-Object { '{0:X2}' -f $_ }) -join ' '
            if ($bytes.Count -gt 12) { $hex += ' ...' }
            return "$hex $($Kind.ToUpperInvariant())"
        }
    }
}

#endregion

#region Primitive operations

function Test-IgwtRegistryKey {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)
    $loc = ConvertTo-IgwtRegistryLocation (Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath $Path)
    $base = Open-IgwtRegistryBaseKey $loc.Hive
    try {
        $key = $base.OpenSubKey($loc.SubKey, $false)
        if ($key) { $key.Dispose(); return $true }
        return $false
    } finally { $base.Dispose() }
}

function Get-IgwtRegistryValue {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Reads one value. Returns Exists, KeyExists, Kind and the normalized Value.
        Environment variables in REG_EXPAND_SZ are not expanded (exact data is preserved).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][AllowEmptyString()][string]$Name
    )
    $loc = ConvertTo-IgwtRegistryLocation (Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath $Path)
    $base = Open-IgwtRegistryBaseKey $loc.Hive
    try {
        $key = $base.OpenSubKey($loc.SubKey, $false)
        if (-not $key) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Exists = $false; KeyExists = $false; Kind = $null; Value = $null } }
        try {
            $names = $key.GetValueNames()
            $found = $false
            foreach ($n in $names) { if ([string]::Equals($n, $Name, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { $found = $true; break } }
            if (-not $found) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Exists = $false; KeyExists = $true; Kind = $null; Value = $null } }
            $kind = $key.GetValueKind($Name).ToString()
            $raw = $key.GetValue($Name, $null, [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueOptions]::DoNotExpandEnvironmentNames)
            $value = ConvertFrom-IgwtRawRegistryValue -Raw $raw -Kind $kind
            return [pscustomobject]@{ Exists = $true; KeyExists = $true; Kind = $kind; Value = $value }
        } finally { $key.Dispose() }
    } finally { $base.Dispose() }
}

function Set-IgwtRegistryValue {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Creates the key if needed and writes the value with the exact kind. #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][AllowEmptyString()][string]$Name,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Kind,
        [AllowNull()]$Value
    )
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$Path\$Name", "Set $Kind")) { return }
    $loc = ConvertTo-IgwtRegistryLocation (Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath $Path)
    $raw = ConvertTo-IgwtRawRegistryValue -Value $Value -Kind $Kind
    $base = Open-IgwtRegistryBaseKey $loc.Hive
    try {
        $key = $base.CreateSubKey($loc.SubKey, [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryKeyPermissionCheck]::ReadWriteSubTree)
        if (-not $key) { throw "Could not open or create registry key '$Path'." }
        try { $key.SetValue($Name, $raw, [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]$Kind) } finally { $key.Dispose() }
    } finally { $base.Dispose() }
}

function Remove-IgwtRegistryValue {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Deletes a value if present (missing key or value is not an error). #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][AllowEmptyString()][string]$Name
    )
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$Path\$Name", 'Delete value')) { return }
    $loc = ConvertTo-IgwtRegistryLocation (Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath $Path)
    $base = Open-IgwtRegistryBaseKey $loc.Hive
    try {
        $key = $base.OpenSubKey($loc.SubKey, $true)
        if ($key) { try { $key.DeleteValue($Name, $false) } finally { $key.Dispose() } }
    } finally { $base.Dispose() }
}

function Get-IgwtRegistryMissingDepth {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Number of trailing key segments of Path that do not exist yet (0 = key exists).
        Recorded in snapshots so a revert can remove keys created by iG Windows Tuner.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([int])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)
    $loc = ConvertTo-IgwtRegistryLocation (Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath $Path)
    $segments = @($loc.SubKey.Split([char[]]@('\'), [System.StringSplitOptions]::RemoveEmptyEntries))
    $base = Open-IgwtRegistryBaseKey $loc.Hive
    try {
        for ($i = $segments.Count; $i -ge 1; $i--) {
            $sub = ($segments[0..($i - 1)] -join '\')
            $key = $base.OpenSubKey($sub, $false)
            if ($key) { $key.Dispose(); return ($segments.Count - $i) }
        }
        return $segments.Count
    } finally { $base.Dispose() }
}

function Test-IgwtRegistryTreeEmpty {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][Microsoft.Win32.RegistryKey]$Key)
    if ($Key.ValueCount -gt 0) { return $false }
    foreach ($name in $Key.GetSubKeyNames()) {
        $child = $Key.OpenSubKey($name, $false)
        if ($child) {
            try { if (-not (Test-IgwtRegistryTreeEmpty -Key $child)) { return $false } } finally { $child.Dispose() }
        }
    }
    return $true
}

function Remove-IgwtCreatedRegistryKey {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Removes the top-most key that iG Windows Tuner created for Path (MissingDepth segments up),
        but only when that whole tree holds no values. Pre-existing keys are never removed.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][int]$MissingDepth
    )
    if ($MissingDepth -le 0) { return }
    $loc = ConvertTo-IgwtRegistryLocation (Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath $Path)
    $segments = @($loc.SubKey.Split([char[]]@('\'), [System.StringSplitOptions]::RemoveEmptyEntries))
    if ($MissingDepth -ge $segments.Count) { return }   # never delete a hive-level key
    $createdTop = ($segments[0..($segments.Count - $MissingDepth)] -join '\')
    $parent = ''
    if ($segments.Count - $MissingDepth - 1 -ge 0) { $parent = ($segments[0..($segments.Count - $MissingDepth - 1)] -join '\') }
    $leafName = $segments[$segments.Count - $MissingDepth]
    $base = Open-IgwtRegistryBaseKey $loc.Hive
    try {
        $top = $base.OpenSubKey($createdTop, $false)
        if (-not $top) { return }
        $empty = $false
        try { $empty = Test-IgwtRegistryTreeEmpty -Key $top } finally { $top.Dispose() }
        if (-not $empty) { return }
        if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($createdTop, 'Delete empty key created by iG Windows Tuner')) { return }
        if ($parent) {
            $pk = $base.OpenSubKey($parent, $true)
            if ($pk) { try { $pk.DeleteSubKeyTree($leafName, $false) } finally { $pk.Dispose() } }
        } else {
            $base.DeleteSubKeyTree($leafName, $false)
        }
    } finally { $base.Dispose() }
}

#endregion

#region 'registry' action

function Get-IgwtRegistryDesired {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Computes the target value for a registry action given the current value.
        Supports "<absent>" targets and "bitClear" (clear flag bits in a numeric string or DWORD).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Current, [string]$Mode = 'on')
    $target = $Action.on
    if ($Mode -eq 'default') { $target = $Action.default }
    if ([string]$target -eq $script:IgwtAbsent) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Absent = $true; Kind = $null; Value = $null }
    }
    $kind = [string]$Action.valueType
    if ($Mode -eq 'on' -and $null -ne $Action.bitClear) {
        $base = $null
        if ($Current.Exists) { $base = $Current.Value }
        elseif ($null -ne $Action.default -and [string]$Action.default -ne $script:IgwtAbsent) { $base = $Action.default }
        else { $base = 0 }
        $num = ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 ([string]$base)
        $mask = ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 $Action.bitClear
        $newNum = $num -band (-bnot $mask)
        if ($kind -eq 'String') { $target = [string]$newNum } else { $target = $newNum }
    }
    return [pscustomobject]@{ Absent = $false; Kind = $kind; Value = (ConvertFrom-IgwtSerializableValue -Data $target -Kind $kind) }
}

function Test-IgwtRegistryOn {
    <# .SYNOPSIS True when the current value satisfies the action's target. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Current)
    if ($Action.onlyIfAbsent -and $Current.Exists) { return $true }
    if ($null -ne $Action.bitClear -and $Current.Exists) {
        try {
            $num = ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 ([string]$Current.Value)
            return (($num -band (ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 $Action.bitClear)) -eq 0)
        } catch { return $false }
    }
    $desired = Get-IgwtRegistryDesired -Action $Action -Current $Current
    if ($desired.Absent) {
        if (-not $Current.Exists) { return $true }
    } elseif ($Current.Exists) {
        if ($Current.Kind -eq $desired.Kind -and (Test-IgwtRegistryValueEqual -Left $Current.Value -Right $desired.Value -Kind $desired.Kind)) { return $true }
    } elseif ($null -ne $Action.absentValue) {
        # Windows treats a missing value as absentValue.
        if ($null -ne $Action.bitClear) {
            return (((ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 ([string]$Action.absentValue)) -band (ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 $Action.bitClear)) -eq 0)
        }
        if (Test-IgwtRegistryValueEqual -Left (ConvertFrom-IgwtSerializableValue -Data $Action.absentValue -Kind $desired.Kind) -Right $desired.Value -Kind $desired.Kind) { return $true }
    }
    if ($Current.Exists -and $null -ne $Action.equivalentOn) {
        foreach ($eq in @($Action.equivalentOn)) {
            if (Test-IgwtRegistryValueEqual -Left $Current.Value -Right (ConvertFrom-IgwtSerializableValue -Data $eq -Kind $Current.Kind) -Kind $Current.Kind) { return $true }
        }
    }
    return $false
}

function Get-IgwtRegistryTargets {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Concrete (path, name) targets of a registry-like action. Plain registry actions have one;
        adapter-scoped actions get one per active wired adapter with {InterfaceGuid} and
        {AdapterClassKey} tokens expanded.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    if ($Action.type -in 'adapterRegistry', 'netAdapterPower') {
        $path = [string]$Action.path
        $name = [string]$Action.name
        if ($Action.type -eq 'netAdapterPower') { $path = '{AdapterClassKey}'; $name = 'PnPCapabilities' }
        $adapters = @()
        if ($Context -and $null -ne $Context.WiredAdapters) { $adapters = @($Context.WiredAdapters) } else { $adapters = @(Get-IgwtActiveWiredAdapter) }
        $targets = foreach ($a in $adapters) {
            $p = $path.Replace('{InterfaceGuid}', [string]$a.InterfaceGuid)
            if ($p.Contains('{AdapterClassKey}')) {
                $classKey = Get-IgwtAdapterClassKey -InterfaceGuid $a.InterfaceGuid
                if (-not $classKey) { continue }
                $p = $p.Replace('{AdapterClassKey}', $classKey)
            }
            [pscustomobject]@{ Path = $p; Name = $name; Scope = [string]$a.InterfaceGuid; Label = [string]$a.Name }
        }
        return @($targets)
    }
    return @([pscustomobject]@{ Path = [string]$Action.path; Name = [string]$Action.name; Scope = ''; Label = '' })
}

function Get-IgwtRegistryActionEffective {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Returns the action with netAdapterPower translated to its registry form. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action)
    if ($Action.type -ne 'netAdapterPower') { return $Action }
    # PnPCapabilities 24 (0x18) clears "Allow the computer to turn off this device to save power";
    # 0 restores the default (documented by Microsoft, see catalog sources).
    $on = 24
    if ($Action.allowTurnOff) { $on = 0 }
    return [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'netAdapterPower'; valueType = 'DWord'; on = $on; default = 0; absentValue = 0;
        bitClear = $null; onlyIfAbsent = $false; equivalentOn = $null }
}

function Get-IgwtRegistryState {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $eff = Get-IgwtRegistryActionEffective $Action
    $targets = @(Get-IgwtRegistryTargets -Action $Action -Context $Context)
    if ($targets.Count -eq 0) {
        return @([pscustomobject]@{ Target = 'Active wired network adapter'; Current = 'none found'; Desired = ''; State = 'NotApplicable'; Note = 'No active physical wired adapter.' })
    }
    foreach ($t in $targets) {
        $cur = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $t.Path -Name $t.Name
        $desired = Get-IgwtRegistryDesired -Action $eff -Current $cur
        $isOn = Test-IgwtRegistryOn -Action $eff -Current $cur
        $note = ''
        if ($cur.Exists -and -not $desired.Absent -and $cur.Kind -ne $desired.Kind -and -not $isOn) {
            $note = "Current type is $($cur.Kind); Windows expects $($desired.Kind). It will be rewritten with the correct type."
        }
        if (-not $cur.Exists -and $null -ne $eff.absentValue) { $note = "Not set; Windows uses $($eff.absentValue) when absent." }
        $label = "$($t.Path)\$($t.Name)"
        if ($t.Label) { $label = "[$($t.Label)] $label" }
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Target  = $label
            Current = (Format-IgwtRegistryValue -Exists $cur.Exists -Value $cur.Value -Kind $cur.Kind)
            Desired = $(if ($desired.Absent) { $script:IgwtAbsent } else { Format-IgwtRegistryValue -Exists $true -Value $desired.Value -Kind $desired.Kind })
            State   = $(if ($isOn) { 'On' } else { 'Off' })
            Note    = $note
        }
    }
}

function Get-IgwtRegistrySnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $targets = @(Get-IgwtRegistryTargets -Action $Action -Context $Context)
    $items = foreach ($t in $targets) {
        $cur = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $t.Path -Name $t.Name
        [ordered]@{
            scope        = $t.Scope
            path         = $t.Path
            name         = $t.Name
            exists       = [bool]$cur.Exists
            kind         = $cur.Kind
            value        = (ConvertTo-IgwtSerializableValue -Value $cur.Value -Kind $cur.Kind)
            missingDepth = (Get-IgwtRegistryMissingDepth -Path $t.Path)
        }
    }
    return @{ items = @($items) }
}

function Invoke-IgwtRegistryApply {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context, [ValidateSet('on', 'default')][string]$Mode = 'on')
    $eff = Get-IgwtRegistryActionEffective $Action
    if ($Mode -eq 'default' -and $null -eq $eff.default) { throw "No documented Windows default for $($Action.path)\$($Action.name)." }
    foreach ($t in @(Get-IgwtRegistryTargets -Action $Action -Context $Context)) {
        $cur = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $t.Path -Name $t.Name
        if ($Mode -eq 'on' -and (Test-IgwtRegistryOn -Action $eff -Current $cur)) { continue }
        $desired = Get-IgwtRegistryDesired -Action $eff -Current $cur -Mode $Mode
        if ($desired.Absent) {
            if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$($t.Path)\$($t.Name)", 'Delete value')) { Remove-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $t.Path -Name $t.Name }
        } else {
            if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$($t.Path)\$($t.Name)", "Set $($desired.Kind)")) {
                Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $t.Path -Name $t.Name -Kind $desired.Kind -Value $desired.Value
            }
        }
    }
}

function Restore-IgwtRegistryItem {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Restores one captured value exactly, including "did not exist" and created keys. #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Name, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Item)
    if ($Item.exists) {
        $value = ConvertFrom-IgwtSerializableValue -Data $Item.value -Kind ([string]$Item.kind)
        if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$Path\$Name", "Restore $($Item.kind)")) {
            Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $Path -Name $Name -Kind ([string]$Item.kind) -Value $value
        }
    } else {
        if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$Path\$Name", 'Restore (delete value that did not exist)')) {
            Remove-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $Path -Name $Name
            if ($null -ne $Item.missingDepth -and [int]$Item.missingDepth -gt 0) {
                Remove-IgwtCreatedRegistryKey -Path $Path -MissingDepth ([int]$Item.missingDepth)
            }
        }
    }
}

function Restore-IgwtRegistrySnapshot {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Restores captured values. Paths come from the catalog action (expanded per adapter scope),
        never from the snapshot file, so a modified snapshot cannot redirect writes elsewhere.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Snapshot, $Context)
    $targets = @(Get-IgwtRegistryTargets -Action $Action -Context $Context)
    foreach ($item in @($Snapshot.items)) {
        $target = $targets | Where-Object { $_.Scope -eq [string]$item.scope } | Select-Object -First 1
        if (-not $target) {
            if ($Action.type -in 'adapterRegistry', 'netAdapterPower') {
                Write-IgwtLog -Level Warn -Message "Adapter $($item.scope) is no longer present; its value was not restored."
                continue
            }
            $target = $targets[0]
        }
        if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$($target.Path)\$($target.Name)", 'Restore')) {
            Restore-IgwtRegistryItem -Path $target.Path -Name $target.Name -Item $item
        }
    }
}

#endregion
```

`src/Actions/RegistryListMerge.ps1`:

```ps1
# RegistryListMerge.ps1
# 'registryListMerge' action: edits one key=value item inside a semicolon-separated REG_SZ
# (for example DirectXUserGlobalSettings = "SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1;VRROptimizeEnable=1;").
# Unrelated items are always preserved; the value is never overwritten wholesale.

$script:IgwtRemoveItem = '<remove>'

function ConvertFrom-IgwtListString {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Parses "A=1;B=2;" into ordered items (Key, Value, Raw). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([AllowNull()][AllowEmptyString()][string]$Text)
    $list = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Text)) { return , $list }
    foreach ($part in $Text.Split([char[]]@(';'))) {
        if ($part.Trim().Length -eq 0) { continue }
        $idx = $part.IndexOf('=')
        if ($idx -gt 0) {
            $list.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Key = $part.Substring(0, $idx).Trim(); Value = $part.Substring($idx + 1); Raw = $part })
        } else {
            $list.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Key = $null; Value = $null; Raw = $part })
        }
    }
    return , $list
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtListString {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Serializes items back to "A=1;B=2;" (Windows writes a trailing semicolon). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][AllowEmptyCollection()]$Items)
    $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
    foreach ($i in $Items) {
        if ($null -ne $i.Key) { $null = $sb.Append("$($i.Key)=$($i.Value);") } else { $null = $sb.Append("$($i.Raw);") }
    }
    return $sb.ToString()
}

function Get-IgwtListItemValue {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([AllowNull()][AllowEmptyString()][string]$Text, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Key)
    foreach ($i in (ConvertFrom-IgwtListString $Text)) {
        if ($null -ne $i.Key -and [string]::Equals($i.Key, $Key, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return $i.Value }
    }
    return $null
}

function Set-IgwtListItem {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Returns Text with Key set to Value (replaced in place or appended). #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([AllowNull()][AllowEmptyString()][string]$Text, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Key, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Value)
    $items = ConvertFrom-IgwtListString $Text
    $found = $false
    foreach ($i in $items) {
        if ($null -ne $i.Key -and [string]::Equals($i.Key, $Key, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
            if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Key, "Set list item to $Value")) { $i.Value = $Value }
            $found = $true
        }
    }
    if (-not $found) { $items.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Key = $Key; Value = $Value; Raw = "$Key=$Value" }) }
    return (ConvertTo-IgwtListString $items)
}

function Remove-IgwtListItem {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Returns Text without Key. Other items are untouched. #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([AllowNull()][AllowEmptyString()][string]$Text, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Key)
    $items = ConvertFrom-IgwtListString $Text
    $kept = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    foreach ($i in $items) {
        if ($null -ne $i.Key -and [string]::Equals($i.Key, $Key, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
            if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Key, 'Remove list item')) { $kept.Add($i) }
            continue
        }
        $kept.Add($i)
    }
    return (ConvertTo-IgwtListString $kept)
}

function Get-IgwtListMergeState {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $cur = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $Action.path -Name $Action.name
    $text = $null
    if ($cur.Exists) { $text = [string]$cur.Value }
    $itemValue = Get-IgwtListItemValue -Text $text -Key $Action.item
    $isOn = ($null -ne $itemValue -and [string]$itemValue -eq [string]$Action.on)
    $desiredText = Set-IgwtListItem -Text $text -Key $Action.item -Value ([string]$Action.on) -WhatIf:$false
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Target  = "$($Action.path)\$($Action.name) [$($Action.item)]"
        Current = $(if ($cur.Exists) { '"{0}"' -f $text } else { $script:IgwtAbsent })
        Desired = ('"{0}"' -f $desiredText)
        State   = $(if ($isOn) { 'On' } else { 'Off' })
        Note    = 'Only this item is changed; other items in the string are preserved.'
    }
}

function Invoke-IgwtListMergeApply {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context, [ValidateSet('on', 'off', 'default')][string]$Mode = 'on')
    $cur = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $Action.path -Name $Action.name
    $text = $null
    $kind = 'String'
    if ($cur.Exists) {
        $text = [string]$cur.Value
        if ($cur.Kind -eq 'ExpandString') { $kind = 'ExpandString' }
    }
    $target = $Action.on
    if ($Mode -eq 'off') { $target = $Action.off }
    if ($Mode -eq 'default') { $target = $Action.default }
    if ($null -eq $target) { $target = $script:IgwtRemoveItem }
    if ([string]$target -eq $script:IgwtRemoveItem) {
        $new = Remove-IgwtListItem -Text $text -Key $Action.item -WhatIf:$false
    } else {
        $new = Set-IgwtListItem -Text $text -Key $Action.item -Value ([string]$target) -WhatIf:$false
    }
    if ($cur.Exists -and $new -eq $text) { return }
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($new)) {
        if ($cur.Exists -and $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$($Action.path)\$($Action.name)", 'Delete empty list value')) {
            Remove-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $Action.path -Name $Action.name
        }
        return
    }
    if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$($Action.path)\$($Action.name)", "Set list item $($Action.item)")) {
        Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $Action.path -Name $Action.name -Kind $kind -Value $new
    }
}
```

`src/Actions/ScheduledTask.ps1`:

```ps1
# ScheduledTask.ps1
# 'scheduledTask' action: enables or disables an EXISTING scheduled task. iG Windows Tuner never creates,
# imports or deletes tasks (no persistence), and security, update and recovery tasks are refused.

$script:IgwtProtectedTaskPaths = @(
    '\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Defender\', '\Microsoft\Windows\UpdateOrchestrator\', '\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\',
    '\Microsoft\Windows\WaaSMedic\', '\Microsoft\Windows\TPM\', '\Microsoft\Windows\BitLocker\', '\Microsoft\Windows\SystemRestore\',
    '\Microsoft\Windows\Time Synchronization\', '\Microsoft\Windows\AppID\', '\Microsoft\Windows\ExploitGuard\', '\Microsoft\Windows\Plug and Play\'
)

function Assert-IgwtTaskAllowed {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)
    foreach ($p in $script:IgwtProtectedTaskPaths) {
        if ($Path.StartsWith($p, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw "Scheduled tasks under '$p' are protected (security, update or recovery) and are never disabled by iG Windows Tuner." }
    }
}

function Get-IgwtTaskEnabled {
    <# .SYNOPSIS $true enabled, $false disabled, $null when the task does not exist. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action)
    $t = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskPath ([string]$Action.path) -TaskName ([string]$Action.name) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
    if (-not $t) { return $null }
    return ([string]$t.State -ne 'Disabled')
}

function Get-IgwtScheduledTaskState {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $label = "Scheduled task $($Action.path)$($Action.name)"
    $en = Get-IgwtTaskEnabled -Action $Action
    if ($null -eq $en) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = $label; Current = 'not present'; Desired = [string]$Action.on; State = 'NotApplicable'; Note = 'This task does not exist on this PC.' } }
    $cur = $(if ($en) { 'Enabled' } else { 'Disabled' })
    [pscustomobject]@{ Target = $label; Current = $cur; Desired = [string]$Action.on; State = $(if ($cur -eq [string]$Action.on) { 'On' } else { 'Off' }); Note = '' }
}

function Get-IgwtScheduledTaskSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $en = Get-IgwtTaskEnabled -Action $Action
    return @{ exists = ($null -ne $en); enabled = [bool]$en }
}

function Set-IgwtTaskEnabled {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][bool]$Enabled)
    if (-not $Enabled) { Assert-IgwtTaskAllowed -Path ([string]$Action.path) }
    $what = $(if ($Enabled) { 'Enable' } else { 'Disable' })
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$($Action.path)$($Action.name)", "$what scheduled task")) { return }
    if ($Enabled) { $null = Enable-ScheduledTask -TaskPath ([string]$Action.path) -TaskName ([string]$Action.name) -ErrorAction Stop }
    else { $null = Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskPath ([string]$Action.path) -TaskName ([string]$Action.name) -ErrorAction Stop }
}

function Invoke-IgwtScheduledTaskApply {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context, [ValidateSet('on', 'default')][string]$Mode = 'on')
    $en = Get-IgwtTaskEnabled -Action $Action
    if ($null -eq $en) { return }
    $target = [string]$Action.on
    if ($Mode -eq 'default') { $target = [string]$Action.default }
    $want = ($target -eq 'Enabled')
    if ($en -ne $want) { Set-IgwtTaskEnabled -Action $Action -Enabled $want }
}

function Restore-IgwtScheduledTaskSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Snapshot, $Context)
    if (-not $Snapshot.exists) { return }
    $en = Get-IgwtTaskEnabled -Action $Action
    if ($null -eq $en) { Write-IgwtLog -Level Warn -Message "Scheduled task $($Action.path)$($Action.name) no longer exists; not restored."; return }
    if ($en -ne [bool]$Snapshot.enabled) { Set-IgwtTaskEnabled -Action $Action -Enabled ([bool]$Snapshot.enabled) }
}
```

`src/Actions/Service.ps1`:

```ps1
# Service.ps1
# 'service' action: startup type of one Windows service. Uses Set-Service (so the Service
# Control Manager picks the change up immediately) and records the exact registry Start and
# DelayedAutostart values for a faithful revert. Anti-cheat services are refused outright.

$script:IgwtProtectedServices = @('vgc', 'vgk', 'FACEIT', 'FACEITService', 'EasyAntiCheat', 'EasyAntiCheat_EOS', 'BEService', 'BEDaisy',
    'atvi-randgrid_sr', 'Javelin', 'mpssvc', 'WinDefend', 'WdNisSvc', 'SecurityHealthService', 'wscsvc', 'BFE', 'EventLog', 'wuauserv')

function Get-IgwtServiceStartup {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Reads Start/DelayedAutostart from the service key (works without elevation). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Name)
    $path = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\$Name"
    $start = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $path -Name 'Start'
    if (-not $start.KeyExists) { return $null }
    $delayed = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $path -Name 'DelayedAutostart'
    $type = 'Unknown'
    switch ([int]$start.Value) {
        0 { $type = 'Boot' }
        1 { $type = 'System' }
        2 { if ($delayed.Exists -and [int]$delayed.Value -eq 1) { $type = 'AutomaticDelayed' } else { $type = 'Automatic' } }
        3 { $type = 'Manual' }
        4 { $type = 'Disabled' }
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{ StartupType = $type; Start = $start; Delayed = $delayed }
}

function Assert-IgwtServiceAllowed {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Name)
    if ($script:IgwtProtectedServices -contains $Name) { throw "Service '$Name' is protected (anti-cheat or core security) and is never modified by iG Windows Tuner." }
}

function Get-IgwtServiceState {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $name = [string]$Action.name
    $s = Get-IgwtServiceStartup -Name $name
    if (-not $s) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Target = "Service $name"; Current = 'not installed'; Desired = [string]$Action.startupType; State = 'NotApplicable'; Note = '' }
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Target  = "Service $name startup type"
        Current = $s.StartupType
        Desired = [string]$Action.startupType
        State   = $(if ($s.StartupType -eq [string]$Action.startupType) { 'On' } else { 'Off' })
        Note    = ''
    }
}

function Get-IgwtServiceSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context)
    $name = [string]$Action.name
    $s = Get-IgwtServiceStartup -Name $name
    if (-not $s) { return @{ exists = $false } }
    $running = $false
    try { $running = ((Get-Service -Name $name -ErrorAction Stop).Status -eq 'Running') } catch { $running = $false }
    return @{
        exists         = $true
        start          = [int]$s.Start.Value
        delayedExists  = [bool]$s.Delayed.Exists
        delayed        = $(if ($s.Delayed.Exists) { [int]$s.Delayed.Value } else { $null })
        wasRunning     = $running
    }
}

function Set-IgwtServiceStartupType {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Name, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$StartupType)
    Assert-IgwtServiceAllowed -Name $Name
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Name, "Set startup type $StartupType")) { return }
    $path = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\$Name"
    switch ($StartupType) {
        'AutomaticDelayed' {
            Set-Service -Name $Name -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction Stop
            Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $path -Name 'DelayedAutostart' -Kind DWord -Value 1
        }
        'Automatic' {
            Set-Service -Name $Name -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction Stop
            $d = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $path -Name 'DelayedAutostart'
            if ($d.Exists -and [int]$d.Value -ne 0) { Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $path -Name 'DelayedAutostart' -Kind DWord -Value 0 }
        }
        'Manual' { Set-Service -Name $Name -StartupType Manual -ErrorAction Stop }
        'Disabled' { Set-Service -Name $Name -StartupType Disabled -ErrorAction Stop }
        default { throw "Unsupported startup type '$StartupType'." }
    }
}

function Invoke-IgwtServiceApply {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, $Context, [ValidateSet('on', 'default')][string]$Mode = 'on')
    $name = [string]$Action.name
    $s = Get-IgwtServiceStartup -Name $name
    if (-not $s) { return }
    $target = [string]$Action.startupType
    if ($Mode -eq 'default') { $target = [string]$Action.default }
    if ($s.StartupType -ne $target) { Set-IgwtServiceStartupType -Name $name -StartupType $target }
    if ($Mode -eq 'on' -and $target -eq 'Disabled' -and $Action.stop) {
        $svc = Get-Service -Name $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if ($svc -and $svc.Status -eq 'Running' -and $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($name, 'Stop service')) { Stop-Service -Name $name -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
    }
}

function Restore-IgwtServiceSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Snapshot, $Context)
    $name = [string]$Action.name
    if (-not $Snapshot.exists) { return }
    $type = 'Manual'
    switch ([int]$Snapshot.start) {
        2 { $type = 'Automatic' }
        3 { $type = 'Manual' }
        4 { $type = 'Disabled' }
        default { throw "Snapshot start value $($Snapshot.start) for $name is not restorable through the SCM." }
    }
    Set-IgwtServiceStartupType -Name $name -StartupType $type
    $path = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\$name"
    if ($Snapshot.delayedExists) {
        Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $path -Name 'DelayedAutostart' -Kind DWord -Value ([int]$Snapshot.delayed)
    } else {
        Remove-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $path -Name 'DelayedAutostart'
    }
    if ($Snapshot.wasRunning) {
        $svc = Get-Service -Name $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if ($svc -and $svc.Status -ne 'Running' -and $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($name, 'Start service')) { Start-Service -Name $name -ErrorAction Stop }
    }
}
```
