`src/Cleaner/CleanerEngine.ps1`:

```ps1
# CleanerEngine.ps1
# Two-phase cleaner: Invoke-IgwtCleanerScan enumerates and sizes (deletes nothing);
# Invoke-IgwtCleanerClean deletes only the files in a scan result, re-validating each one through
# Remove-IgwtCleanerFile. Processes are never killed; services are stopped only for the rules that
# declare them and always restored in a finally block. Work runs at below-normal thread priority and
# can be cancelled between files.

$script:IgwtCleanerMaxItemsPerRule = 250000
$script:IgwtLastCleanerScan = $null

#region Enumeration

function Get-IgwtCleanerRunningBlockers {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Names of required-closed processes that are running (the rule is skipped while they run). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Rule)
    $running = @()
    foreach ($n in @($Rule.requiresClosed)) {
        if (-not $n) { continue }
        if (@(Get-Process -Name ([string]$n) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count -gt 0) { $running += [string]$n }
    }
    return $running
}

function Test-IgwtNameMatch {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Name, [string[]]$Patterns)
    foreach ($p in @($Patterns)) { if ($p -and $Name -like $p) { return $true } }
    return $false
}

function Add-IgwtCleanerSkip {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Result, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Reason, [string]$Path)
    if (-not $Result.Skipped.ContainsKey($Reason)) { $Result.Skipped[$Reason] = 0; $Result.SkippedSamples[$Reason] = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string] }
    $Result.Skipped[$Reason]++
    if ($Path -and $Result.SkippedSamples[$Reason].Count -lt 5) { $Result.SkippedSamples[$Reason].Add($Path) }
}

function Get-IgwtCleanerFolderItems {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Enumerates one validated root without following reparse points. Adds file entries to
        $Result.Items and directories to $Result.Directories; records skip reasons.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Rule, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Root, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Result, $CancelToken)
    $stack = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.Stack[System.IO.DirectoryInfo]
    $stack.Push((New-Object System.IO.DirectoryInfo($Root)))
    $first = $true
    while ($stack.Count -gt 0) {
        if ($CancelToken -and $CancelToken.IsCancellationRequested) { $Result.Cancelled = $true; return }
        $dir = $stack.Pop()
        if (-not $first) { $Result.Directories.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Path = $dir.FullName; Root = $Root }) }
        $first = $false
        $entries = @()
        try { $entries = @($dir.EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) } catch { Add-IgwtCleanerSkip -Result $Result -Reason 'folder not readable (access denied)' -Path $dir.FullName; continue }
        foreach ($e in $entries) {
            $attr = [long]$e.Attributes
            if (($attr -band $script:IgwtAttrReparse) -ne 0) { Add-IgwtCleanerSkip -Result $Result -Reason 'reparse point (not followed)' -Path $e.FullName; continue }
            if ($e -is [System.IO.DirectoryInfo]) {
                if (Test-IgwtNameMatch -Name $e.Name -Patterns @($Rule.exclude)) { Add-IgwtCleanerSkip -Result $Result -Reason 'excluded by rule' -Path $e.FullName; continue }
                if ($Rule.recurse) { $stack.Push($e) }
                continue
            }
            if (-not (Test-IgwtNameMatch -Name $e.Name -Patterns @($Rule.include))) { continue }
            if (Test-IgwtNameMatch -Name $e.Name -Patterns @($Rule.exclude)) { Add-IgwtCleanerSkip -Result $Result -Reason 'excluded by rule' -Path $e.FullName; continue }
            $skip = Test-IgwtCleanerAttributesSkippable -Attributes $attr -AllowSystemFiles:([bool]$Rule.allowSystemFiles)
            if ($skip) { Add-IgwtCleanerSkip -Result $Result -Reason $skip -Path $e.FullName; continue }
            if ((Get-IgwtCleanerFileAge -Item $e) -lt [double]$Rule.minAgeHours) { Add-IgwtCleanerSkip -Result $Result -Reason "younger than $($Rule.minAgeHours) h" -Path $e.FullName; continue }
            $prot = Test-IgwtCleanerPathProtected -Path $e.FullName -AllowDownloads:([bool]$Rule.allowDownloads)
            if ($prot) { Add-IgwtCleanerSkip -Result $Result -Reason "protected: $prot" -Path $e.FullName; continue }
            if ($Result.Items.Count -ge $script:IgwtCleanerMaxItemsPerRule) { $Result.Truncated = $true; Add-IgwtCleanerSkip -Result $Result -Reason 'item limit reached (scan again after cleaning)' -Path $e.FullName; continue }
            $Result.Items.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Path = $e.FullName; Size = [long]$e.Length; LastWriteTicks = $e.LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks; Root = $Root })
        }
    }
}

#endregion

#region Special methods (sizes and actions)

function Get-IgwtRecycleBinUsage {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Size of the current user's Recycle Bin per fixed drive (read from X:\$Recycle.Bin\<SID>). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $sid = [System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().User.Value
    foreach ($d in [System.IO.DriveInfo]::GetDrives()) {
        if ($d.DriveType -ne 'Fixed' -or -not $d.IsReady) { continue }
        $bin = Join-Path $d.RootDirectory.FullName "`$Recycle.Bin\$sid"
        $bytes = 0L; $count = 0
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bin) {
            try {
                foreach ($f in (New-Object System.IO.DirectoryInfo($bin)).EnumerateFiles('*', [System.IO.SearchOption]::AllDirectories)) {
                    if ($f.Name -like '$R*' -or $f.DirectoryName -ne $bin) { $bytes += $f.Length; if ($f.DirectoryName -eq $bin) { $count++ } }
                }
            } catch { Write-Verbose "Recycle Bin on $($d.Name) not readable." }
        }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Drive = $d.Name.TrimEnd('\').TrimEnd(':'); Bytes = $bytes; Items = $count }
    }
}

function Get-IgwtDeliveryOptimizationCacheSize {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    try { return [long](Get-DeliveryOptimizationPerfSnap -ErrorAction Stop -WarningAction SilentlyContinue).CacheSizeBytes } catch { return $null }
}

function ConvertFrom-IgwtSizeText {
    <# .SYNOPSIS "1.23 GB" -> bytes (used for DISM output). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([long])]
    param([string]$Text)
    if ($Text -match '([\d\.,]+)\s*(KB|MB|GB|TB|bytes)') {
        $n = [double]::Parse(($Matches[1] -replace ',', '.'), [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
        switch ($Matches[2]) { 'KB' { return [long]($n * 1KB) } 'MB' { return [long]($n * 1MB) } 'GB' { return [long]($n * 1GB) } 'TB' { return [long]($n * 1TB) } default { return [long]$n } }
    }
    return 0
}

function ConvertFrom-IgwtComponentStoreReport {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Parses 'dism /AnalyzeComponentStore /English' output (reclaimable bytes, recommendation, packages). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([AllowEmptyString()][string]$Text)
    $reclaim = 0L
    if ($Text -match 'Backups and Disabled Features\s*:\s*([^\r\n]+)') { $reclaim += ConvertFrom-IgwtSizeText $Matches[1] }
    $recommended = ($Text -match 'Component Store Cleanup Recommended\s*:\s*Yes')
    $packages = 0
    if ($Text -match 'Number of Reclaimable Packages\s*:\s*(\d+)') { $packages = [int]$Matches[1] }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = $reclaim; Recommended = [bool]$recommended; Packages = $packages }
}

function Get-IgwtComponentStoreAnalysis {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Read-only DISM component store analysis (needs elevation). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    if ($script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) { throw 'TestMode safety: dism.exe must be mocked in tests.' }
    $exe = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\dism.exe'
    $out = & $exe /Online /Cleanup-Image /AnalyzeComponentStore /English 2>&1 | Out-String
    $r = ConvertFrom-IgwtComponentStoreReport -Text $out
    $r | Add-Member -NotePropertyName ExitCode -NotePropertyValue $LASTEXITCODE
    return $r
}

function Get-IgwtDriverStoreCandidates {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Older third-party driver packages that have a newer version of the same package installed and
        are not bound to any present device. Read-only (needs elevation).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $drivers = @(Get-WindowsDriver -Online -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { -not $_.Inbox -and $_.Driver -like 'oem*.inf' })
    $inUse = @{}
    foreach ($p in @(Get-PnpDevice -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        try {
            $inf = (Get-PnpDeviceProperty -InstanceId $p.InstanceId -KeyName 'DEVPKEY_Device_DriverInfPath' -ErrorAction Stop).Data
            if ($inf) { $inUse[([string]$inf).ToLowerInvariant()] = $true }
        } catch { Write-Verbose "No driver inf for $($p.InstanceId)." }
    }
    $groups = $drivers | Group-Object { "$((Split-Path ([string]$_.OriginalFileName) -Leaf).ToLowerInvariant())|$($_.ProviderName)|$($_.ClassName)" }
    foreach ($g in $groups) {
        if ($g.Count -lt 2) { continue }
        $sorted = @($g.Group | Sort-Object @{ Expression = { $v = $null; if ([version]::TryParse([string]$_.Version, [ref]$v)) { $v } else { [version]'0.0' } } }, Date -Descending)
        foreach ($old in ($sorted | Select-Object -Skip 1)) {
            $name = ([string]$old.Driver).ToLowerInvariant()
            if ($inUse.ContainsKey($name)) { continue }
            $folder = Split-Path -Parent ([string]$old.OriginalFileName)
            $bytes = 0L
            try { $bytes = (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $folder -Recurse -File -ErrorAction Stop | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum } catch { $bytes = 0 }
            [pscustomobject]@{ Inf = $name; Provider = $old.ProviderName; Class = $old.ClassName; Version = [string]$old.Version; Date = $old.Date; Bytes = [long]$bytes; Newer = [string]$sorted[0].Version }
        }
    }
}

#endregion

#region Services

function Stop-IgwtCleanerService {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Stops the rule's services and returns their original states (restored by Restore-IgwtCleanerService). #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([string[]]$Name)
    $states = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    foreach ($n in @($Name)) {
        if (-not $n) { continue }
        $svc = Get-Service -Name $n -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if (-not $svc) { continue }
        $states.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Name = $n; WasRunning = ([string]$svc.Status -eq 'Running') })
        if ([string]$svc.Status -eq 'Running' -and $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($n, 'Stop service temporarily')) {
            Stop-Service -Name $n -Force -ErrorAction Stop
        }
    }
    return $states.ToArray()
}

function Restore-IgwtCleanerService {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Starts every service that was running before the clean. Never throws. #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param($States)
    foreach ($s in @($States)) {
        if (-not $s -or -not $s.WasRunning) { continue }
        try { if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($s.Name, 'Restart service')) { Start-Service -Name $s.Name -ErrorAction Stop } }
        catch { Write-IgwtLog -Level Warn -Message "Cleaner could not restart service $($s.Name): $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    }
}

#endregion

#region Scan

function New-IgwtCleanerRuleResult {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions', '', Justification = 'Creates an in-memory result object only.')]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Rule)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        RuleId = [string]$Rule.id; Name = [string]$Rule.name; Category = [string]$Rule.category; Level = [string]$Rule.level; Method = [string]$Rule.method
        Default = [bool]$Rule.default; Hint = [string]$Rule.hint; SideEffects = [string]$Rule.sideEffects
        Status = 'Ready'; Reason = ''; Bytes = 0L; Count = 0; Roots = @(); Items = (New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object])
        Directories = (New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]); Skipped = @{}; SkippedSamples = @{}; Samples = @(); Truncated = $false; Cancelled = $false
        Extra = $null; Blockers = @(); ResolvedRoots = @()
    }
}

function Invoke-IgwtCleanerRuleScan {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Scans one rule. Never deletes anything. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Rule, [switch]$AllUsers, $CancelToken)
    $res = New-IgwtCleanerRuleResult -Rule $Rule
    $isAdmin = Test-IgwtIsAdmin
    try {
        $res.Blockers = @(Get-IgwtCleanerRunningBlockers -Rule $Rule)
        switch ([string]$Rule.method) {
            { $_ -in 'files', 'browserCache', 'guidance' } {
                $roots = @(Resolve-IgwtCleanerRoots -Rule $Rule -AllUsers:$AllUsers)
                $res.Roots = $roots
                $res.ResolvedRoots = @($roots | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Ok' } | ForEach-Object { $_.Path })
                foreach ($r in ($roots | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Refused' })) { Add-IgwtCleanerSkip -Result $res -Reason "root refused: $($r.Reason)" -Path $r.Path }
                foreach ($root in $res.ResolvedRoots) { Get-IgwtCleanerFolderItems -Rule $Rule -Root $root -Result $res -CancelToken $CancelToken }
                if ([int]$Rule.keepNewest -gt 0 -and $res.Items.Count -gt 0) {
                    $keep = @($res.Items | Sort-Object LastWriteTicks -Descending | Select-Object -First ([int]$Rule.keepNewest))
                    foreach ($k in $keep) { [void]$res.Items.Remove($k); Add-IgwtCleanerSkip -Result $res -Reason "kept the newest $($Rule.keepNewest)" -Path $k.Path }
                }
                $res.Bytes = [long](($res.Items | Measure-Object Size -Sum).Sum)
                $res.Count = $res.Items.Count
                if ($Rule.method -eq 'guidance') { $res.Status = 'GuidanceOnly'; $res.Reason = [string]$Rule.notes }
                elseif ($res.ResolvedRoots.Count -eq 0 -and @($roots | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Refused' }).Count -gt 0) { $res.Status = 'Refused'; $res.Reason = 'Every folder of this rule resolves to a protected location on this PC, so it is never cleaned.' }
                elseif ($res.ResolvedRoots.Count -eq 0) { $res.Status = 'NotPresent'; $res.Reason = 'Nothing to clean: the folders do not exist on this PC.' }
            }
            'recycleBin' {
                $usage = @(Get-IgwtRecycleBinUsage)
                $res.Extra = $usage
                $res.Bytes = [long](($usage | Measure-Object Bytes -Sum).Sum)
                $res.Count = [int](($usage | Measure-Object Items -Sum).Sum)
            }
            'deliveryOptimization' {
                $b = Get-IgwtDeliveryOptimizationCacheSize
                if ($null -eq $b) { $res.Status = 'Unknown'; $res.Reason = 'Delivery Optimization status is not available.' } else { $res.Bytes = $b; $res.Count = $(if ($b -gt 0) { 1 } else { 0 }) }
            }
            'dism' {
                if (-not $isAdmin) { $res.Status = 'RequiresAdmin'; $res.Reason = 'Component store analysis needs administrator rights.' }
                else {
                    $a = Get-IgwtComponentStoreAnalysis
                    $res.Extra = $a; $res.Bytes = $a.Bytes; $res.Count = $a.Packages
                    if (-not $a.Recommended -and -not $Rule.resetBase) { $res.Reason = 'DISM reports that component store cleanup is not recommended right now.' }
                }
            }
            'driverStore' {
                if (-not $isAdmin) { $res.Status = 'RequiresAdmin'; $res.Reason = 'Driver store analysis needs administrator rights.' }
                else {
                    $c = @(Get-IgwtDriverStoreCandidates)
                    $res.Extra = $c; $res.Bytes = [long](($c | Measure-Object Bytes -Sum).Sum); $res.Count = $c.Count
                }
            }
        }
        if ($res.Status -eq 'Ready' -and $Rule.requiresAdmin -and -not $isAdmin) { $res.Status = 'RequiresAdmin'; $res.Reason = 'Cleaning this needs administrator rights (sizes may be incomplete).' }
        if ($res.Status -eq 'Ready' -and $res.Blockers.Count -gt 0) { $res.Status = 'RequiresClose'; $res.Reason = "Close $($res.Blockers -join ', ') first; iG Windows Tuner never closes apps for you." }
        if ($res.Status -eq 'Ready' -and $res.Bytes -eq 0 -and $res.Count -eq 0) { $res.Status = 'Empty' }
        if ($res.Cancelled) { $res.Status = 'Cancelled' }
        $res.Samples = @($res.Items | Sort-Object Size -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { $_.Path })
    } catch {
        $res.Status = 'Error'; $res.Reason = $_.Exception.Message
    }
    return $res
}

function Invoke-IgwtCleanerScan {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Phase 1: enumerates and sizes the selected rules. Deletes nothing.
    .PARAMETER RuleId
        Rules to scan (default: every rule up to -Level; default-off rules only with -IncludeOptIn).
    .PARAMETER Level
        Highest rule level to include (Standard, Advanced, Expert).
    .PARAMETER IncludeOptIn
        Include rules that are off by default.
    .PARAMETER AllUsers
        Expand allUsers rules to every local profile (requires admin).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([string[]]$RuleId, [ValidateSet('Standard', 'Advanced', 'Expert')][string]$Level = 'Standard', [switch]$IncludeOptIn, [switch]$AllUsers, $CancelToken)
    if ($AllUsers -and -not (Test-IgwtIsAdmin) -and -not $script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) { throw 'All-user-profiles mode requires administrator rights.' }
    $rules = @()
    if ($RuleId) { $rules = @(Get-IgwtCleanerRule -Id $RuleId) }
    else {
        $max = [array]::IndexOf($script:IgwtLevels, $Level)
        $rules = @(Get-IgwtCleanerRules | Where-Object { [array]::IndexOf($script:IgwtLevels, [string]$_.level) -le $max -and ($_.default -or $IncludeOptIn) })
    }
    $oldPriority = [System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.Priority
    [System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.Priority = [System.Threading.ThreadPriority]::BelowNormal
    $script:IgwtCleanerProtection = $null
    try {
        $results = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
        $n = 0
        foreach ($r in $rules) {
            $n++
            Send-IgwtProgress -Text "Scanning: $($r.name)" -Percent ([int](100 * ($n - 1) / [Math]::Max(1, $rules.Count)))
            $results.Add((Invoke-IgwtCleanerRuleScan -Rule $r -AllUsers:$AllUsers -CancelToken $CancelToken))
            if ($CancelToken -and $CancelToken.IsCancellationRequested) { break }
        }
        Send-IgwtProgress -Text 'Scan finished' -Percent 100
        $scan = [pscustomobject]@{
            Id = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString(); Created = (Get-Date).ToString('o'); AllUsers = [bool]$AllUsers
            Rules = $results.ToArray(); TotalBytes = [long](($results | Measure-Object Bytes -Sum).Sum); TotalCount = [int](($results | Measure-Object Count -Sum).Sum)
        }
        $script:IgwtLastCleanerScan = $scan
        Write-IgwtLog -Message ("Cleaner scan: {0} rule(s), {1:N1} MB in {2} item(s). Nothing was deleted." -f $results.Count, ($scan.TotalBytes / 1MB), $scan.TotalCount)
        return $scan
    } finally {
        [System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.Priority = $oldPriority
    }
}

#endregion

#region Clean

function Write-IgwtCleanerDeletionLog {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Writer, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$RuleId, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Outcome)
    $line = ConvertTo-Json -Compress -InputObject ([ordered]@{ time = (Get-Date).ToString('o'); rule = $RuleId; path = $Outcome.Path; bytes = $Outcome.Bytes })
    $Writer.WriteLine($line)
}

function Invoke-IgwtCleanerLogRotation {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Keeps the 10 newest cleaner deletion logs; older ones are compressed into one archive and removed. #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Folder)
    $logs = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Folder -Filter 'Cleaner-*.jsonl' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name -Descending)
    if ($logs.Count -le 10) { return }
    $old = $logs | Select-Object -Skip 10
    $zip = Join-Path $Folder ("Cleaner-archive-{0}.zip" -f (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'))
    if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($zip, 'Compress old cleaner logs')) {
        Compress-Archive -LiteralPath @($old.FullName) -DestinationPath $zip -CompressionLevel Optimal
        foreach ($o in $old) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $o.FullName -Force }
    }
}

function Invoke-IgwtCleanerRuleClean {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Cleans one rule from a scan. The rule's roots are resolved again and intersected with the
        scan's roots, so a stale or modified scan object cannot widen what may be deleted.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Rule, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$RuleScan, $Writer, $CancelToken, [switch]$AllUsers)
    $sum = [pscustomobject]@{ RuleId = $Rule.id; Name = $Rule.name; Status = 'Cleaned'; Reason = ''; DeletedBytes = 0L; DeletedCount = 0; Skipped = @{}; SkippedSamples = @{} }
    $isAdmin = (Test-IgwtIsAdmin) -or $script:IgwtSettings.TestMode
    if ($RuleScan.Status -in 'Error', 'NotPresent', 'Refused', 'GuidanceOnly', 'Empty', 'Cancelled', 'Unknown') { $sum.Status = 'Skipped'; $sum.Reason = "Scan status: $($RuleScan.Status)"; return $sum }
    if ($Rule.requiresAdmin -and -not $isAdmin) { $sum.Status = 'Skipped'; $sum.Reason = 'Requires administrator rights.'; return $sum }
    $blockers = @(Get-IgwtCleanerRunningBlockers -Rule $Rule)
    if ($blockers.Count -gt 0) { $sum.Status = 'Skipped'; $sum.Reason = "Close $($blockers -join ', ') first (iG Windows Tuner never closes apps)."; return $sum }
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Rule.id, 'Clean')) { $sum.Status = 'Skipped'; $sum.Reason = 'WhatIf'; return $sum }

    $roots = @()
    if ($Rule.method -in 'files', 'browserCache') {
        $fresh = @(Resolve-IgwtCleanerRoots -Rule $Rule -AllUsers:$AllUsers | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Ok' } | ForEach-Object { $_.Path })
        $roots = @($RuleScan.ResolvedRoots | Where-Object { $scanRoot = [string]$_; @($fresh | Where-Object { [string]::Equals($_, $scanRoot, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) }).Count -gt 0 })
    }
    $ruleForDelete = $Rule.PSObject.Copy()
    $ruleForDelete | Add-Member -NotePropertyName ResolvedRoots -NotePropertyValue $roots -Force
    $services = @()
    try {
        if (@($Rule.services).Count -gt 0) { $services = @(Stop-IgwtCleanerService -Name @($Rule.services)) }
        switch ([string]$Rule.method) {
            { $_ -in 'files', 'browserCache' } {
                foreach ($item in $RuleScan.Items) {
                    if ($CancelToken -and $CancelToken.IsCancellationRequested) { $sum.Status = 'Cancelled'; break }
                    $o = Remove-IgwtCleanerFile -Entry $item -Rule $ruleForDelete
                    if ($o.Result -eq 'Deleted') {
                        $sum.DeletedBytes += $o.Bytes; $sum.DeletedCount++
                        if ($Writer) { Write-IgwtCleanerDeletionLog -Writer $Writer -RuleId $Rule.id -Outcome $o }
                    } else { Add-IgwtCleanerSkip -Result $sum -Reason $o.Reason -Path $o.Path }
                }
                if ($Rule.removeEmptyDirs) {
                    foreach ($d in @($RuleScan.Directories | Sort-Object { $_.Path.Length } -Descending)) {
                        $null = Remove-IgwtCleanerEmptyDirectory -Path $d.Path -Root $d.Root -Rule $ruleForDelete
                    }
                }
            }
            'recycleBin' {
                foreach ($u in @($RuleScan.Extra | Where-Object { $_.Bytes -gt 0 })) {
                    Clear-RecycleBin -DriveLetter $u.Drive -Force -ErrorAction Stop
                    $sum.DeletedBytes += $u.Bytes; $sum.DeletedCount += $u.Items
                }
            }
            'deliveryOptimization' {
                Delete-DeliveryOptimizationCache -Force -ErrorAction Stop
                $sum.DeletedBytes = [long]$RuleScan.Bytes
            }
            'dism' {
                if ($Rule.resetBase) { $null = Repair-WindowsImage -Online -StartComponentCleanup -ResetBase -NoRestart -ErrorAction Stop }
                else { $null = Repair-WindowsImage -Online -StartComponentCleanup -NoRestart -ErrorAction Stop }
                $sum.DeletedBytes = [long]$RuleScan.Bytes
            }
            'driverStore' {
                $current = @(Get-IgwtDriverStoreCandidates | ForEach-Object { $_.Inf })
                foreach ($c in @($RuleScan.Extra)) {
                    if ($current -notcontains $c.Inf) { Add-IgwtCleanerSkip -Result $sum -Reason 'no longer a safe candidate (in use or newest)' -Path $c.Inf; continue }
                    $r = Invoke-IgwtPnpUtilDelete -Inf $c.Inf
                    if ($r -eq 0) { $sum.DeletedBytes += $c.Bytes; $sum.DeletedCount++ } else { Add-IgwtCleanerSkip -Result $sum -Reason "pnputil refused (exit $r)" -Path $c.Inf }
                }
            }
        }
    } catch {
        $sum.Status = 'Error'; $sum.Reason = $_.Exception.Message
    } finally {
        Restore-IgwtCleanerService -States $services
    }
    return $sum
}

function Invoke-IgwtPnpUtilDelete {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Deletes one third-party driver package WITHOUT /force (pnputil refuses packages that are in use). #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Inf)
    if ($Inf -notmatch '^oem\d+\.inf$') { throw "Refusing unexpected driver package name '$Inf'." }
    if ($script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) { throw 'TestMode safety: pnputil.exe must be mocked in tests.' }
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Inf, 'pnputil /delete-driver (no /force)')) { return -1 }
    $exe = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\pnputil.exe'
    $null = & $exe /delete-driver $Inf 2>&1
    return $LASTEXITCODE
}

function Invoke-IgwtCleanerClean {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Phase 2: deletes ONLY the items found by a scan (Invoke-IgwtCleanerScan), re-validating each
        file right before deletion. Writes a per-rule summary to the log and every deleted path to
        Logs\Cleaner-<time>.jsonl.
    .PARAMETER Scan
        The scan result (default: the last scan of this session).
    .PARAMETER RuleId
        Clean only these rules from the scan.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param($Scan, [string[]]$RuleId, $CancelToken)
    if (-not $Scan) { $Scan = $script:IgwtLastCleanerScan }
    if (-not $Scan) { throw 'Run a scan first (Invoke-IgwtCleanerScan); the cleaner only deletes what a scan found.' }
    if (-not $script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) { Initialize-IgwtDataRoot }
    $logDir = Get-IgwtDataPath -Kind Logs
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $logDir)) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $logDir -Force -WhatIf:$false }
    $logFile = Join-Path $logDir ("Cleaner-{0}.jsonl" -f (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmmss-fff'))
    $writer = New-Object System.IO.StreamWriter($logFile, $false, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    $oldPriority = [System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.Priority
    [System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.Priority = [System.Threading.ThreadPriority]::BelowNormal
    $script:IgwtCleanerProtection = $null
    $results = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    try {
        $todo = @($Scan.Rules | Where-Object { -not $RuleId -or $RuleId -contains $_.RuleId })
        $n = 0
        foreach ($rs in $todo) {
            $n++
            if ($CancelToken -and $CancelToken.IsCancellationRequested) { break }
            $rule = Get-IgwtCleanerRule -Id $rs.RuleId
            Send-IgwtProgress -Text "Cleaning: $($rule.name)" -Percent ([int](100 * ($n - 1) / [Math]::Max(1, $todo.Count)))
            $r = Invoke-IgwtCleanerRuleClean -Rule $rule -RuleScan $rs -Writer $writer -CancelToken $CancelToken -AllUsers:([bool]$Scan.AllUsers)
            $results.Add($r)
            $skippedTotal = [int](($r.Skipped.Values | Measure-Object -Sum).Sum)
            Write-IgwtLog -Message ("Cleaner {0}: {1} - {2:N1} MB in {3} file(s), {4} skipped. {5}" -f $r.RuleId, $r.Status, ($r.DeletedBytes / 1MB), $r.DeletedCount, $skippedTotal, $r.Reason)
        }
    } finally {
        $writer.Dispose()
        [System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.Priority = $oldPriority
        try { Invoke-IgwtCleanerLogRotation -Folder $logDir } catch { Write-Verbose 'Log rotation failed.' }
    }
    Send-IgwtProgress -Text 'Clean finished' -Percent 100
    $total = [long](($results | Measure-Object DeletedBytes -Sum).Sum)
    Write-IgwtLog -Message ("Cleaner finished: {0:N1} MB freed. Deleted-path log: {1}" -f ($total / 1MB), $logFile)
    return [pscustomobject]@{ ScanId = $Scan.Id; Rules = $results.ToArray(); FreedBytes = $total; LogFile = $logFile }
}

#endregion
```

`src/Cleaner/CleanerRules.ps1`:

```ps1
# CleanerRules.ps1
# Loads and validates the cleaner rules (data\cleaner\*.json) and expands their roots:
# environment variables, the {SteamLibrary} token, Chromium/Firefox profile discovery and
# (opt-in, admin) all user profiles. Every resolved root is canonicalized and checked against the
# denylist before it is used.

$script:IgwtCleanerRuleCache = $null
$script:IgwtCleanerCategories = @('System', 'Gaming', 'Browsers', 'Apps', 'Developer', 'Downloads')
$script:IgwtCleanerMethods = @('files', 'browserCache', 'recycleBin', 'deliveryOptimization', 'dism', 'driverStore', 'guidance')
$script:IgwtLevels = @('Standard', 'Advanced', 'Expert')

function ConvertTo-IgwtNormalizedCleanerRule {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Upgrades pre-v2 rules in memory (tier, antiCheat, reversible, source, hardware) and fills defaults. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Rule, [string]$SourceFile, [int]$SourceSchema = 2)
    $missing = @('tier', 'antiCheat', 'reversible', 'source', 'hardware') | Where-Object { $null -eq $Rule.PSObject.Properties[$_] }
    if ($missing) { $Rule = ConvertTo-IgwtPSObject -InputObject (ConvertTo-IgwtV2CleanerRule -Rule $Rule) }
    $defaults = [ordered]@{
        level = 'Standard'; sideEffects = ''; include = @('*'); exclude = @(); recurse = $true; minAgeHours = 0; requiresClosed = @()
        services = @(); allUsers = $false; recycle = $false; default = $false; requiresAdmin = $false; allowSystemFiles = $false; allowDownloads = $false
        removeEmptyDirs = $true; keepNewest = 0; roots = @(); browser = ''; userDataRoots = @(); profileCacheDirs = @(); rootCacheDirs = @()
        sources = @(); notes = ''; resetBase = $false; source = 'igwt'
    }
    foreach ($k in $defaults.Keys) {
        if ($null -eq $Rule.PSObject.Properties[$k]) { $Rule | Add-Member -NotePropertyName $k -NotePropertyValue $defaults[$k] }
    }
    $Rule | Add-Member -NotePropertyName sourceFile -NotePropertyValue $SourceFile -Force
    $Rule | Add-Member -NotePropertyName sourceSchema -NotePropertyValue $SourceSchema -Force
    return $Rule
}

function Get-IgwtCleanerRules {
    <# .SYNOPSIS All cleaner rules from data\cleaner\*.json (normalized). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([switch]$Force)
    if ($script:IgwtCleanerRuleCache -and -not $Force) { return $script:IgwtCleanerRuleCache }
    $folder = Join-Path (Get-IgwtDataFolder) 'cleaner'
    $all = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    foreach ($file in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $folder -Filter '*.json' | Sort-Object Name)) {
        $doc = Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $file.FullName
        $schema = Get-IgwtFileSchemaVersion -Document $doc
        foreach ($r in @($doc.rules)) { if ($r) { $all.Add((ConvertTo-IgwtNormalizedCleanerRule -Rule $r -SourceFile $file.Name -SourceSchema $schema)) } }
    }
    $script:IgwtCleanerRuleCache = @($all | Sort-Object @{ Expression = { [array]::IndexOf($script:IgwtCleanerCategories, $_.category) } }, id)
    return $script:IgwtCleanerRuleCache
}

function Get-IgwtCleanerRule {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string[]]$Id)
    $rules = Get-IgwtCleanerRules
    foreach ($i in $Id) {
        $r = $rules | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $i } | Select-Object -First 1
        if (-not $r) { throw "Unknown cleaner rule '$i'." }
        $r
    }
}

function Get-IgwtUserProfileFolders {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Local user profiles from HKLM\...\ProfileList (real user SIDs only; no Default/Public/system profiles).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $list = Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList'
    foreach ($k in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $list -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        if ($k.PSChildName -notmatch '^S-1-5-21-') { continue }
        $p = [string]$k.GetValue('ProfileImagePath')
        if (-not $p) { continue }
        $p = [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($p)
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { [pscustomobject]@{ Sid = $k.PSChildName; Path = $p } }
    }
}

function Expand-IgwtCleanerRootTemplate {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Expands one root template for one user profile (or the current user) into concrete paths.
        Unresolved environment variables make the root invalid (it is skipped, never guessed).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Template, [string]$ProfilePath)
    $t = $Template
    if ($ProfilePath) {
        $t = $t.Replace('%LOCALAPPDATA%', (Join-Path $ProfilePath 'AppData\Local')).Replace('%APPDATA%', (Join-Path $ProfilePath 'AppData\Roaming'))
        $t = $t.Replace('%TEMP%', (Join-Path $ProfilePath 'AppData\Local\Temp')).Replace('%TMP%', (Join-Path $ProfilePath 'AppData\Local\Temp')).Replace('%USERPROFILE%', $ProfilePath)
    }
    if ($t.Contains('{SteamLibrary}')) {
        $libs = @()
        try { $libs = @(Get-IgwtSteamLibraryPaths) } catch { $libs = @() }
        return @($libs | ForEach-Object { [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($t.Replace('{SteamLibrary}', $_)) })
    }
    $e = [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($t)
    if ($e -match '%[^%]+%') { return @() }
    return @($e)
}

function Get-IgwtBrowserCacheRoots {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Cache folders of every Chromium profile (Default, Profile N, Guest Profile) or Firefox profile
        under the rule's user-data roots. Only folder names listed in the rule are returned.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Rule)
    $roots = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    foreach ($tpl in @($Rule.userDataRoots)) {
        foreach ($udr in @(Expand-IgwtCleanerRootTemplate -Template ([string]$tpl))) {
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $udr -PathType Container)) { continue }
            foreach ($rc in @($Rule.rootCacheDirs)) { $roots.Add((Join-Path $udr $rc)) }
            $profiles = @()
            if ($Rule.browser -eq 'firefox') {
                $profiles = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $udr -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
            } else {
                $profiles = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $udr -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'Default' -or $_.Name -like 'Profile *' -or $_.Name -eq 'Guest Profile' })
            }
            foreach ($p in $profiles) {
                if ((([long]$p.Attributes) -band 0x400) -ne 0) { continue }
                foreach ($pc in @($Rule.profileCacheDirs)) { $roots.Add((Join-Path $p.FullName $pc)) }
            }
        }
    }
    return @($roots)
}

function Resolve-IgwtCleanerRoots {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Concrete, validated roots of a rule. Returns objects with Path, Status (Ok, Missing, Refused)
        and Reason. Only Ok roots are ever enumerated or used by the deletion primitive.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Rule, [switch]$AllUsers)
    $candidates = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    if ($Rule.method -eq 'browserCache') {
        foreach ($r in (Get-IgwtBrowserCacheRoots -Rule $Rule)) { $candidates.Add($r) }
    } else {
        $profiles = @($null)
        if ($AllUsers -and $Rule.allUsers) { $profiles = @(Get-IgwtUserProfileFolders | ForEach-Object { $_.Path }) }
        foreach ($tpl in @($Rule.roots)) {
            foreach ($prof in $profiles) {
                foreach ($x in @(Expand-IgwtCleanerRootTemplate -Template ([string]$tpl) -ProfilePath $prof)) { $candidates.Add($x) }
            }
        }
    }
    $seen = @{}
    foreach ($c in $candidates) {
        $canon = $null
        try { $canon = ConvertTo-IgwtCanonicalPath -Path $c } catch {
            [pscustomobject]@{ Path = $c; Status = 'Refused'; Reason = $_.Exception.Message }
            continue
        }
        if ($seen.ContainsKey($canon.ToLowerInvariant())) { continue }
        $seen[$canon.ToLowerInvariant()] = $true
        $reason = Test-IgwtCleanerRootAllowed -Root $canon -AllowDownloads:([bool]$Rule.allowDownloads)
        if ($reason) { [pscustomobject]@{ Path = $canon; Status = 'Refused'; Reason = $reason }; continue }
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $canon)) { [pscustomobject]@{ Path = $canon; Status = 'Missing'; Reason = 'not present' }; continue }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Path = $canon; Status = 'Ok'; Reason = '' }
    }
}

function Test-IgwtCleanerCatalog {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Validates data\cleaner\*.json. Returns error strings (none = valid). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $errors = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $rules = @(Get-IgwtCleanerRules -Force)
    $ids = @{}
    $files = @{}
    foreach ($r in $rules) {
        $rid = [string]$r.id
        foreach ($f in 'id', 'name', 'category', 'level', 'method') { if (-not [string]$r.$f) { $errors.Add("${rid}: missing '$f'.") } }
        if ($rid -notmatch '^clean\.[a-z0-9\.\-]+$') { $errors.Add("${rid}: id must start with 'clean.' (lower case).") }
        if ($ids.ContainsKey($rid)) { $errors.Add("${rid}: duplicate id.") } else { $ids[$rid] = $true }
        Test-IgwtItemText -Item $r -Label $rid -Errors $errors
        Test-IgwtItemMetadata -Item $r -Label $rid -Errors $errors
        if ([int]$r.sourceSchema -lt $script:IgwtSchemaVersion -and -not $files.ContainsKey([string]$r.sourceFile)) {
            $files[[string]$r.sourceFile] = $true
            $errors.Add("cleaner\$($r.sourceFile): schemaVersion $($r.sourceSchema); run tools\Convert-IgwtV1Data.ps1 to migrate it.")
        }
        if ([string]$r.method -in 'files', 'browserCache', 'recycleBin', 'deliveryOptimization', 'dism', 'driverStore' -and -not $r.recycle -and [string]$r.reversible -eq 'full') { $errors.Add("${rid}: rules that delete files cannot be reversible 'full'.") }
        if (-not (ConvertTo-IgwtAntiCheatInfo -Value $r.antiCheat).Safe) { $errors.Add("${rid}: cleaner rules must be anti-cheat safe.") }
        if ($script:IgwtCleanerCategories -notcontains [string]$r.category) { $errors.Add("${rid}: unknown category '$($r.category)'.") }
        if ($script:IgwtLevels -notcontains [string]$r.level) { $errors.Add("${rid}: level must be Standard, Advanced or Expert.") }
        if ($script:IgwtCleanerMethods -notcontains [string]$r.method) { $errors.Add("${rid}: unknown method '$($r.method)'.") }
        if ($r.method -in 'files', 'guidance' -and @($r.roots).Count -eq 0) { $errors.Add("${rid}: '$($r.method)' rules need roots.") }
        if ($r.method -eq 'browserCache' -and (@($r.userDataRoots).Count -eq 0 -or (@($r.profileCacheDirs).Count + @($r.rootCacheDirs).Count) -eq 0)) { $errors.Add("${rid}: browserCache rules need userDataRoots and cache folders.") }
        foreach ($d in @($r.profileCacheDirs) + @($r.rootCacheDirs)) { if ($script:IgwtBrowserCacheNames -notcontains [string]$d) { $errors.Add("${rid}: '$d' is not an allowed browser cache folder name.") } }
        if ($r.default -and $r.level -ne 'Standard') { $errors.Add("${rid}: only Standard rules may be on by default.") }
        if ($r.allowDownloads -and -not $r.recycle) { $errors.Add("${rid}: rules that clean Downloads must send files to the Recycle Bin.") }
        if ($r.allowDownloads -and $r.default) { $errors.Add("${rid}: the Downloads rule must be opt-in (default false).") }
        if ($r.category -eq 'Browsers' -and @($r.requiresClosed).Count -eq 0) { $errors.Add("${rid}: browser rules must list the browser process in requiresClosed.") }
        foreach ($s in @($r.sources)) { if ([string]$s -notmatch '^https://') { $errors.Add("${rid}: source '$s' must be https.") } }
        foreach ($tpl in @($r.roots)) {
            foreach ($x in @(Expand-IgwtCleanerRootTemplate -Template ([string]$tpl))) {
                try {
                    $c = ConvertTo-IgwtCanonicalPath -Path $x
                    $why = Test-IgwtCleanerRootAllowed -Root $c -AllowDownloads:([bool]$r.allowDownloads)
                    if ($why -and $why -notlike 'root is*') { $errors.Add("${rid}: root '$tpl' resolves to a protected location ($why).") }
                } catch { $errors.Add("${rid}: root '$tpl' is invalid ($($_.Exception.Message)).") }
            }
        }
    }
    return $errors.ToArray()
}
```

`src/Cleaner/CleanerSafety.ps1`:

```ps1
# CleanerSafety.ps1
# Safety core of the cleaning engine. Every deletion goes through Remove-IgwtCleanerFile, and
# the protections live HERE, in the primitive, not only in the rule files:
#   - allow-list only: a path is deleted only if it resolves under one of the rule's roots
#   - canonical paths: GetFullPath + 8.3 short-name expansion; device, UNC and relative paths refused
#   - hard denylist (system, program, profile and user-document locations, OneDrive, Defender, ...)
#   - reparse points (junctions, symlinks, mount points) are never followed and never deleted
#   - cloud placeholders / offline files are skipped so cleaning never triggers downloads
#   - files are re-validated right before deletion (unchanged since the scan, still old enough)
#   - only single files and EMPTY directories are deleted; there is no recursive delete anywhere

$script:IgwtCleanerTestRoot = $null   # TestMode: deletions are refused outside this folder

# File attribute bits used by the safety checks.
$script:IgwtAttrReparse = 0x400          # FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT
$script:IgwtAttrOffline = 0x1000         # FILE_ATTRIBUTE_OFFLINE
$script:IgwtAttrRecallOnOpen = 0x40000   # FILE_ATTRIBUTE_RECALL_ON_OPEN
$script:IgwtAttrRecallOnData = 0x400000  # FILE_ATTRIBUTE_RECALL_ON_DATA_ACCESS
$script:IgwtAttrSystem = 0x4
$script:IgwtAttrReadOnly = 0x1

# Cache folder names that may be deleted inside browser profile data.
$script:IgwtBrowserCacheNames = @('Cache', 'Code Cache', 'GPUCache', 'ShaderCache', 'GrShaderCache', 'GraphiteDawnCache', 'DawnCache', 'DawnGraphiteCache', 'DawnWebGPUCache', 'cache2', 'startupCache', 'jumpListCache', 'thumbnails')

function Set-IgwtCleanerTestRoot {
    <# .SYNOPSIS TestMode only: deletions outside this folder are refused (second safety net for the test suite). #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([string]$Path)
    if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess('cleaner test root', 'Set')) {
        if ($Path) { $script:IgwtCleanerTestRoot = (ConvertTo-IgwtCanonicalPath -Path $Path) } else { $script:IgwtCleanerTestRoot = $null }
    }
}

function Resolve-IgwtLongPathName {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Expands 8.3 short-name components (for example PROGRA~1) to their long names by asking the
        file system for the matching directory entry. Components that do not exist are kept as-is.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)
    if ($Path -notmatch '~') { return $Path }
    $root = [System.IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($Path)
    $parts = $Path.Substring($root.Length).Split([char[]]@('\'), [System.StringSplitOptions]::RemoveEmptyEntries)
    $current = $root
    foreach ($p in $parts) {
        $next = Join-Path $current $p
        if ($p -match '~') {
            try {
                $match = @((New-Object System.IO.DirectoryInfo($current)).GetFileSystemInfos($p))
                if ($match.Count -eq 1) { $next = Join-Path $current $match[0].Name }
            } catch { Write-Verbose "Cannot expand short name '$p' under $current." }
        }
        $current = $next
    }
    return $current
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtCanonicalPath {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Canonical, absolute, local path without trailing separator. Refuses empty, relative, UNC,
        device (\\?\, \\.\) and invalid paths. Resolves "." and ".." and 8.3 short names.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][AllowEmptyString()][string]$Path)
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Path)) { throw 'Empty path.' }
    if ($Path.IndexOfAny([System.IO.Path]::GetInvalidPathChars()) -ge 0) { throw "Invalid characters in path '$Path'." }
    if ($Path.StartsWith('\\')) { throw "UNC and device paths are not allowed: '$Path'." }
    if ($Path -notmatch '^[A-Za-z]:\\') { throw "Only absolute local paths are allowed: '$Path'." }
    $full = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
    $full = Resolve-IgwtLongPathName -Path $full
    if ($full.Length -gt 3) { $full = $full.TrimEnd('\') }
    return $full
}

function Test-IgwtPathUnder {
    <# .SYNOPSIS True when Path equals Parent or lies inside it (case-insensitive, separator-aware). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Parent, [switch]$Strict)
    $p = $Path.TrimEnd('\'); $q = $Parent.TrimEnd('\')
    if ([string]::Equals($p, $q, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return (-not $Strict) }
    return $p.StartsWith($q + '\', [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
}

function Get-IgwtKnownFolderPath {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Current user's shell folder from the registry (Shell Folders, expanded), or $null. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Name)
    try {
        $key = Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Shell Folders'
        $v = (Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $key -Name $Name -ErrorAction Stop).$Name
        if ($v) { return [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables([string]$v) }
    } catch { Write-Verbose "Shell folder $Name not found." }
    return $null
}

function Get-IgwtCleanerProtection {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Builds the protection lists (canonical paths) used by the deletion primitive:
        ExactDeny (these exact paths are never deleted), PrefixDeny (never delete at or below),
        SystemAllow (the only %SystemRoot% subfolders that may be cleaned), ProfileAllow (the only
        user-profile subfolders that may be cleaned), Exceptions (code-level allowed subfolders inside
        protected program folders, e.g. the Steam shader cache).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $sys = $env:SystemRoot
    $pf = $env:ProgramFiles; $pf86 = ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}; $pfw = $env:ProgramW6432
    $pd = $env:ProgramData
    $profilesRoot = Split-Path -Parent $env:USERPROFILE
    $canon = { param($x) if ($x) { try { ConvertTo-IgwtCanonicalPath -Path ([string]$x) } catch { $null } } }

    $exact = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    foreach ($d in [System.IO.DriveInfo]::GetDrives()) { $exact.Add($d.RootDirectory.FullName) }
    foreach ($x in @($sys, $pd, $profilesRoot, $env:USERPROFILE, $env:LOCALAPPDATA, $env:APPDATA, (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'AppData'), (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'AppData\LocalLow'), $env:PUBLIC)) {
        $c = & $canon $x; if ($c) { $exact.Add($c) }
    }

    $prefix = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    foreach ($x in @((Join-Path $sys 'System32'), (Join-Path $sys 'SysWOW64'), (Join-Path $sys 'WinSxS'), (Join-Path $sys 'Installer'),
            (Join-Path $sys 'servicing'), (Join-Path $sys 'assembly'), (Join-Path $sys 'Prefetch'), (Join-Path $sys 'Boot'), (Join-Path $sys 'Fonts'),
            $pf, $pf86, $pfw, (Join-Path $pd 'Microsoft\Windows Defender'), (Join-Path $pd 'Microsoft\Windows Defender Advanced Threat Protection'),
            (Join-Path $pd 'Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu'), (Join-Path $pd 'Packages'))) {
        $c = & $canon $x; if ($c) { $prefix.Add($c) }
    }
    # User document folders (current user; resolved from Shell Folders so redirected folders count too)
    foreach ($n in 'Desktop', 'Personal', 'My Pictures', 'My Music', 'My Video', '{4C5C32FF-BB9D-43B0-B5B4-2D72E54EAAA4}', 'Favorites', 'Start Menu', 'Startup') {
        $c = & $canon (Get-IgwtKnownFolderPath -Name $n); if ($c) { $prefix.Add($c) }
    }
    foreach ($x in @($env:OneDrive, $env:OneDriveConsumer, $env:OneDriveCommercial)) { $c = & $canon $x; if ($c) { $prefix.Add($c) } }
    foreach ($n in 'Desktop', 'Documents', 'Pictures', 'Music', 'Videos', 'Saved Games', 'Favorites', 'Contacts', 'Links', 'Searches', 'OneDrive') {
        $c = & $canon (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE $n); if ($c) { $prefix.Add($c) }
    }
    # Roaming browser profile data (cookies, history, passwords) and Defender per-user data
    foreach ($x in @((Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles'), (Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Opera Software'))) { $c = & $canon $x; if ($c) { $prefix.Add($c) } }

    $downloads = & $canon (Get-IgwtKnownFolderPath -Name '{374DE290-123F-4565-9164-39C4925E467B}')
    if (-not $downloads) { $downloads = & $canon (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads') }

    $systemAllow = @()
    foreach ($x in @('Temp', 'SoftwareDistribution\Download', 'Logs\CBS', 'Logs\DISM', 'Minidump', 'LiveKernelReports')) { $c = & $canon (Join-Path $sys $x); if ($c) { $systemAllow += $c } }
    $memoryDmp = & $canon (Join-Path $sys 'MEMORY.DMP')

    $exceptions = @()
    foreach ($base in @($pf86, $pf)) {
        if (-not $base) { continue }
        foreach ($x in @('Steam\logs', 'Steam\steamapps\shadercache', 'Steam\appcache\httpcache', 'Steam\dumps')) { $c = & $canon (Join-Path $base $x); if ($c) { $exceptions += $c } }
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExactDeny    = @($exact | Select-Object -Unique)
        PrefixDeny   = @($prefix | Select-Object -Unique)
        SystemRoot   = (& $canon $sys)
        SystemAllow  = $systemAllow
        MemoryDmp    = $memoryDmp
        ProfilesRoot = (& $canon $profilesRoot)
        Downloads    = $downloads
        Exceptions   = $exceptions
    }
}

function Get-IgwtCleanerProtectionCached {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    if (-not $script:IgwtCleanerProtection) { $script:IgwtCleanerProtection = Get-IgwtCleanerProtection }
    return $script:IgwtCleanerProtection
}

function Test-IgwtCleanerPathProtected {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Returns a refusal reason when a canonical path must never be deleted (or used as a root),
        otherwise $null. Enforced for every root and every single deletion.
    .PARAMETER AllowDownloads
        Only the explicit opt-in Downloads rule may target the Downloads folder.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path, [switch]$AllowDownloads)
    $prot = Get-IgwtCleanerProtectionCached
    foreach ($e in $prot.ExactDeny) { if ([string]::Equals($Path.TrimEnd('\'), $e.TrimEnd('\'), [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return "protected location ($e)" } }

    $isException = $false
    foreach ($x in $prot.Exceptions) { if (Test-IgwtPathUnder -Path $Path -Parent $x) { $isException = $true } }
    if (-not $isException) {
        foreach ($d in $prot.PrefixDeny) { if (Test-IgwtPathUnder -Path $Path -Parent $d) { return "protected folder ($d)" } }
    }

    # Under %SystemRoot%: only the declared subfolders (and MEMORY.DMP) may be cleaned.
    if ($prot.SystemRoot -and (Test-IgwtPathUnder -Path $Path -Parent $prot.SystemRoot)) {
        $ok = $false
        foreach ($a in $prot.SystemAllow) { if (Test-IgwtPathUnder -Path $Path -Parent $a) { $ok = $true } }
        if ($prot.MemoryDmp -and [string]::Equals($Path, $prot.MemoryDmp, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { $ok = $true }
        if (-not $ok) { return 'Windows folder outside the allowed cleanup subfolders' }
    }

    # Under a user profile: only AppData, the Gradle/Maven caches and (opt-in) Downloads.
    if ($prot.ProfilesRoot -and (Test-IgwtPathUnder -Path $Path -Parent $prot.ProfilesRoot -Strict)) {
        $rel = $Path.Substring($prot.ProfilesRoot.Length).TrimStart('\')
        $segs = $rel.Split([char[]]@('\'), [System.StringSplitOptions]::RemoveEmptyEntries)
        if ($segs.Count -lt 2) { return 'user profile root' }
        $second = $segs[1]
        $allowed = $false
        if ($second -eq 'AppData' -and $segs.Count -ge 4) { $allowed = $true }
        elseif ($second -eq '.gradle' -and $segs.Count -ge 3 -and $segs[2] -eq 'caches') { $allowed = $true }
        elseif ($second -eq '.m2' -and $segs.Count -ge 3 -and $segs[2] -eq 'repository') { $allowed = $true }
        elseif ($second -eq 'Downloads' -and $AllowDownloads) { $allowed = $true }
        if (-not $allowed) { return 'user profile folder outside AppData and the declared developer caches' }
    }
    if ($prot.Downloads -and -not $AllowDownloads -and (Test-IgwtPathUnder -Path $Path -Parent $prot.Downloads)) { return 'Downloads folder (only the opt-in Downloads rule may clean it)' }

    # Never touch the Recycle Bin or System Volume Information through the file method.
    if ($Path -match '\\\$Recycle\.Bin(\\|$)' -or $Path -match '\\System Volume Information(\\|$)') { return 'Recycle Bin / System Volume Information' }

    # Browser profile data: only cache folders below a Chromium "User Data" or Firefox profile root.
    if ($Path -match '\\User Data\\' -or $Path -match '\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles\\') {
        $segs = $Path.Split([char[]]@('\'))
        $hasCache = @($segs | Where-Object { $script:IgwtBrowserCacheNames -contains $_ }).Count -gt 0
        if (-not $hasCache) { return 'browser profile data (only cache folders may be cleaned)' }
    }
    return $null
}

function Test-IgwtCleanerRootAllowed {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Refusal reason for a rule root, or $null. A root may be a temp folder (only its contents are
        ever deleted), but never a drive root, the Windows/ProgramData/profile roots, or anything the
        denylist protects. Roots that are reparse points are refused as well.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Root, [switch]$AllowDownloads)
    if ($Root -match '^[A-Za-z]:\\?$') { return 'drive root' }
    $reason = Test-IgwtCleanerPathProtected -Path $Root -AllowDownloads:$AllowDownloads
    if ($reason) { return $reason }
    try {
        $di = New-Object System.IO.DirectoryInfo($Root)
        if ($di.Exists -and ((([long]$di.Attributes) -band $script:IgwtAttrReparse) -ne 0)) { return 'root is a reparse point (not followed)' }
    } catch { return 'root is not accessible' }
    return $null
}

function Test-IgwtCleanerAttributesSkippable {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Skip reason for a file's attributes: reparse point, cloud placeholder / offline file,
        or System+ReadOnly (unless the rule allows system files). $null when the file may be deleted.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][long]$Attributes, [switch]$AllowSystemFiles)
    if (($Attributes -band $script:IgwtAttrReparse) -ne 0) { return 'reparse point (not followed)' }
    if (($Attributes -band ($script:IgwtAttrOffline -bor $script:IgwtAttrRecallOnOpen -bor $script:IgwtAttrRecallOnData)) -ne 0) { return 'cloud placeholder or offline file (would trigger a download)' }
    if (-not $AllowSystemFiles -and ($Attributes -band $script:IgwtAttrSystem) -ne 0 -and ($Attributes -band $script:IgwtAttrReadOnly) -ne 0) { return 'system + read-only file' }
    return $null
}

function Test-IgwtCleanerAncestry {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        True when no directory between Root (exclusive) and the file is a reparse point. Run right
        before each deletion so a junction swapped in after the scan cannot redirect the delete.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Root)
    try {
        $rootInfo = New-Object System.IO.DirectoryInfo($Root)
        if (-not $rootInfo.Exists -or (([long]$rootInfo.Attributes) -band $script:IgwtAttrReparse) -ne 0) { return $false }
        $dir = [System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($Path)
        while ($dir -and (Test-IgwtPathUnder -Path $dir -Parent $Root -Strict)) {
            $di = New-Object System.IO.DirectoryInfo($dir)
            if (-not $di.Exists) { return $false }
            if ((([long]$di.Attributes) -band $script:IgwtAttrReparse) -ne 0) { return $false }
            $dir = [System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($dir)
        }
        return $true
    } catch { return $false }
}

function Get-IgwtCleanerFileAge {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Age in hours from the NEWER of creation and last-write time (extracted files keep old write times). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([double])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][System.IO.FileSystemInfo]$Item)
    $newest = $Item.LastWriteTimeUtc
    if ($Item.CreationTimeUtc -gt $newest) { $newest = $Item.CreationTimeUtc }
    return ([DateTime]::UtcNow - $newest).TotalHours
}

function Send-IgwtToRecycleBin {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Moves one file to the Recycle Bin (used by the opt-in Downloads rule). #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Path, 'Move to Recycle Bin')) { return }
    Add-Type -AssemblyName Microsoft.VisualBasic
    [Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.FileSystem]::DeleteFile($Path, [Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.UIOption]::OnlyErrorDialogs, [Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.RecycleOption]::SendToRecycleBin)
}

function Remove-IgwtCleanerFile {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        THE deletion primitive. Deletes one scanned file only after every safety check passes again.
        Returns an object with Result (Deleted / Skipped / Refused) and Reason.
    .PARAMETER Entry
        The scan entry (Path, Size, LastWriteUtc, Root) captured during the scan.
    .PARAMETER Rule
        The cleaner rule (minAgeHours, recycle, allowSystemFiles, allowDownloads).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Entry, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Rule)
    $out = { param($r, $why) [pscustomobject]@{ Path = [string]$Entry.Path; Bytes = [long]$Entry.Size; Result = $r; Reason = $why } }
    try { $path = ConvertTo-IgwtCanonicalPath -Path ([string]$Entry.Path) } catch { return (& $out 'Refused' $_.Exception.Message) }
    if (-not [string]::Equals($path, [string]$Entry.Path, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return (& $out 'Refused' 'path changed after canonicalization') }
    if ($script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) {
        if (-not $script:IgwtCleanerTestRoot -or -not (Test-IgwtPathUnder -Path $path -Parent $script:IgwtCleanerTestRoot -Strict)) { return (& $out 'Refused' 'TestMode: outside the test root') }
    }
    $root = [string]$Entry.Root
    try { $root = ConvertTo-IgwtCanonicalPath -Path $root } catch { return (& $out 'Refused' 'invalid root') }
    if (-not (Test-IgwtPathUnder -Path $path -Parent $root -Strict)) { return (& $out 'Refused' 'outside the rule root') }
    $declared = @($Rule.ResolvedRoots | Where-Object { [string]::Equals([string]$_, $root, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) })
    if ($declared.Count -eq 0) { return (& $out 'Refused' 'root is not one of the rule roots') }
    $prot = Test-IgwtCleanerPathProtected -Path $path -AllowDownloads:([bool]$Rule.allowDownloads)
    if ($prot) { return (& $out 'Refused' $prot) }
    if (-not (Test-IgwtCleanerAncestry -Path $path -Root $root)) { return (& $out 'Skipped' 'a parent folder is (or became) a reparse point') }
    $fi = New-Object System.IO.FileInfo($path)
    if (-not $fi.Exists) { return (& $out 'Skipped' 'no longer exists') }
    $attrSkip = Test-IgwtCleanerAttributesSkippable -Attributes ([long]$fi.Attributes) -AllowSystemFiles:([bool]$Rule.allowSystemFiles)
    if ($attrSkip) { return (& $out 'Skipped' $attrSkip) }
    if ($fi.Length -ne [long]$Entry.Size -or $fi.LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks -ne [long]$Entry.LastWriteTicks) { return (& $out 'Skipped' 'changed since the scan') }
    if ((Get-IgwtCleanerFileAge -Item $fi) -lt [double]$Rule.minAgeHours) { return (& $out 'Skipped' 'younger than the minimum age') }
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($path, 'Delete file')) { return (& $out 'Skipped' 'WhatIf') }
    try {
        if ($Rule.recycle) {
            Send-IgwtToRecycleBin -Path $path
        } else {
            if (($fi.Attributes -band [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReadOnly) -ne 0) {
                if (-not $Rule.allowSystemFiles) { return (& $out 'Skipped' 'read-only file') }
                $fi.Attributes = ($fi.Attributes -band (-bnot [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReadOnly))
            }
            [System.IO.File]::Delete($path)
        }
        return (& $out 'Deleted' '')
    } catch [System.UnauthorizedAccessException] {
        return (& $out 'Skipped' 'access denied')
    } catch [System.IO.IOException] {
        return (& $out 'Skipped' 'in use')
    } catch {
        return (& $out 'Skipped' $_.Exception.Message)
    }
}

function Remove-IgwtCleanerEmptyDirectory {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Deletes one directory only if it is empty, not a reparse point, inside the root and not protected. Never recursive. #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Root, $Rule)
    try { $p = ConvertTo-IgwtCanonicalPath -Path $Path; $r = ConvertTo-IgwtCanonicalPath -Path $Root } catch { return $false }
    if (-not (Test-IgwtPathUnder -Path $p -Parent $r -Strict)) { return $false }
    if ($script:IgwtSettings.TestMode -and (-not $script:IgwtCleanerTestRoot -or -not (Test-IgwtPathUnder -Path $p -Parent $script:IgwtCleanerTestRoot -Strict))) { return $false }
    if (Test-IgwtCleanerPathProtected -Path $p -AllowDownloads:([bool]$Rule.allowDownloads)) { return $false }
    $di = New-Object System.IO.DirectoryInfo($p)
    if (-not $di.Exists -or ((([long]$di.Attributes) -band $script:IgwtAttrReparse) -ne 0)) { return $false }
    if (-not (Test-IgwtCleanerAncestry -Path (Join-Path $p 'x') -Root $r)) { return $false }
    try {
        if (@($di.EnumerateFileSystemInfos()).Count -gt 0) { return $false }
        if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($p, 'Delete empty folder')) { return $false }
        [System.IO.Directory]::Delete($p, $false)
        return $true
    } catch { return $false }
}
```

`src/Cleaner/DiskAnalyzer.ps1`:

```ps1
# DiskAnalyzer.ps1
# Read-only disk usage analyzer: largest folders and largest files under a path. Reparse points are
# never followed (so OneDrive placeholders, junctions and mount points are not double-counted or
# hydrated). Nothing is modified.

function Get-IgwtDiskUsage {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Largest folders (up to -FolderDepth below Path) and largest files under Path. Read-only.
    .PARAMETER Path
        Folder or drive to analyze (default: the system drive).
    .PARAMETER Top
        Number of folders and files to return.
    .PARAMETER FolderDepth
        Folders deeper than this (relative to Path) are aggregated into their ancestors.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([string]$Path = "$env:SystemDrive\", [int]$Top = 25, [int]$FolderDepth = 3, $CancelToken)
    $root = ConvertTo-IgwtCanonicalPath -Path $Path
    if ($root.Length -eq 2) { $root += '\' }
    $rootInfo = New-Object System.IO.DirectoryInfo($root)
    if (-not $rootInfo.Exists) { throw "Folder not found: $root" }
    $rootDepth = @($rootInfo.FullName.TrimEnd('\').Split([char[]]@('\'), [System.StringSplitOptions]::RemoveEmptyEntries)).Count
    $folderBytes = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary[string,long]' ([System.StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    $folderFiles = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary[string,long]' ([System.StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    $topFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $minTop = 0L
    $files = 0L; $total = 0L; $denied = 0; $reparse = 0; $dirs = 0
    $oldPriority = [System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.Priority
    [System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.Priority = [System.Threading.ThreadPriority]::BelowNormal
    try {
        $stack = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.Stack[System.IO.DirectoryInfo]
        $stack.Push($rootInfo)
        while ($stack.Count -gt 0) {
            if ($CancelToken -and $CancelToken.IsCancellationRequested) { break }
            $dir = $stack.Pop()
            $dirs++
            if ($dirs % 500 -eq 0) { Send-IgwtProgress -Text ("Analyzing {0}: {1:N0} file(s), {2} so far (read-only)..." -f $root, $files, (Format-IgwtBytes $total)) -Percent -1 }
            $entries = @()
            try { $entries = @($dir.EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) } catch { $denied++; continue }
            # The folder this directory's sizes are credited to (capped at FolderDepth below the root).
            $segs = @($dir.FullName.TrimEnd('\').Split([char[]]@('\'), [System.StringSplitOptions]::RemoveEmptyEntries))
            $keep = [Math]::Min($segs.Count, $rootDepth + $FolderDepth)
            foreach ($e in $entries) {
                if ((([long]$e.Attributes) -band 0x400) -ne 0) { $reparse++; continue }
                if ($e -is [System.IO.DirectoryInfo]) { $stack.Push($e); continue }
                $len = [long]$e.Length
                $files++; $total += $len
                # Credit every ancestor from the root down to the capped depth.
                for ($d = $rootDepth + 1; $d -le $keep; $d++) {
                    $key = ($segs[0..($d - 1)] -join '\')
                    if ($key.Length -eq 2) { $key += '\' }
                    if ($folderBytes.ContainsKey($key)) { $folderBytes[$key] += $len; $folderFiles[$key]++ } else { $folderBytes[$key] = $len; $folderFiles[$key] = 1 }
                }
                if ($topFiles.Count -lt $Top -or $len -gt $minTop) {
                    $topFiles.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Path = $e.FullName; Bytes = $len; LastWrite = $e.LastWriteTime })
                    if ($topFiles.Count -gt $Top * 4) {
                        $trim = @($topFiles | Sort-Object Bytes -Descending | Select-Object -First $Top)
                        $topFiles.Clear(); foreach ($t in $trim) { $topFiles.Add($t) }
                        $minTop = $trim[-1].Bytes
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    } finally {
        [System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.Priority = $oldPriority
    }
    $folders = foreach ($k in $folderBytes.Keys) {
        $depth = @($k.TrimEnd('\').Split([char[]]@('\'), [System.StringSplitOptions]::RemoveEmptyEntries)).Count - $rootDepth
        [pscustomobject]@{ Path = $k; Bytes = $folderBytes[$k]; Files = $folderFiles[$k]; Depth = $depth }
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Root            = $root
        TotalBytes      = $total
        Files           = $files
        Folders         = @($folders | Sort-Object Bytes -Descending | Select-Object -First $Top)
        LargestFiles    = @($topFiles | Sort-Object Bytes -Descending | Select-Object -First $Top)
        AccessDenied    = $denied
        ReparseSkipped  = $reparse
        Cancelled       = [bool]($CancelToken -and $CancelToken.IsCancellationRequested)
    }
}

function Format-IgwtBytes {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Human-readable size (B, KB, MB, GB, TB). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([double]$Bytes)
    if ($Bytes -ge 1TB) { return ('{0:N2} TB' -f ($Bytes / 1TB)) }
    if ($Bytes -ge 1GB) { return ('{0:N2} GB' -f ($Bytes / 1GB)) }
    if ($Bytes -ge 1MB) { return ('{0:N1} MB' -f ($Bytes / 1MB)) }
    if ($Bytes -ge 1KB) { return ('{0:N0} KB' -f ($Bytes / 1KB)) }
    return ('{0:N0} B' -f $Bytes)
}
```

`src/Core/Cache.ps1`:

```ps1
# Cache.ps1
# Short-lived read cache for slow, read-only queries (Get-MpPreference, powercfg /list, adapter
# properties) so one state scan does not repeat them dozens of times. Every write path clears
# the related entries, and the cache is disabled in TestMode so mocks are always honored.

$script:IgwtCache = @{}

function Get-IgwtCached {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Returns a cached value or runs the scriptblock and caches its result for TtlSeconds. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Key, [int]$TtlSeconds = 5, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][scriptblock]$ScriptBlock)
    if ($script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) { return (& $ScriptBlock) }
    $hit = $script:IgwtCache[$Key]
    if ($hit -and $hit.Expires -gt [DateTime]::UtcNow) { return $hit.Value }
    $value = & $ScriptBlock
    $script:IgwtCache[$Key] = @{ Value = $value; Expires = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds($TtlSeconds) }
    return $value
}

function Clear-IgwtCache {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Drops cached entries whose key starts with Prefix (all entries without Prefix). #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([string]$Prefix)
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess('read cache', 'Clear')) { return }
    if (-not $Prefix) { $script:IgwtCache.Clear(); return }
    foreach ($k in @($script:IgwtCache.Keys)) { if ($k.StartsWith($Prefix)) { $script:IgwtCache.Remove($k) } }
}
```
