```ps1
# Environment.ps1
# Module-wide settings: data folders, registry redirection (used only by the test suite)
# and the interactive-user hive mapping used when elevation happens under a different account.

$script:IgwtVersion = '1.0.0'

$script:IgwtSettings = @{
    DataRoot         = (Join-Path $env:ProgramData 'iGWindowsTuner')
    UserLogRoot      = (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'iGWindowsTuner')
    LegacyDataRoot   = (Join-Path $env:ProgramData 'AegisTune')   # data root before the rename; its backups stay readable
    RegistryRedirect = $null      # ordered map of path prefix -> replacement prefix (tests only)
    TestMode         = $false     # when true, every registry path must resolve into TestRegistry:
    UserHiveSid      = $null      # when set, HKCU:\ resolves to HKEY_USERS\<sid>\
    DataFolder       = $null      # catalog data folder override (tests and the migration tool); default <project>\data
}

function Set-IgwtEnvironment {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Overrides module settings. Used by the test suite and by the elevation logic.
    .PARAMETER DataRoot
        Folder for backups, logs and state (default %ProgramData%\iGWindowsTuner).
    .PARAMETER LegacyDataRoot
        With -DataRoot: data root of the tool before it was renamed from AegisTune (default
        %ProgramData%\AegisTune; empty when -DataRoot is given without it). Its backups stay
        listed and revertable; nothing is written there.
    .PARAMETER RegistryRedirect
        Ordered hashtable of path prefix to replacement prefix, e.g. @{ 'HKLM:\' = 'TestRegistry:\HKLM\' }.
    .PARAMETER TestMode
        Refuse any registry path that does not resolve into the Pester TestRegistry: drive and
        refuse to run external executables that have not been mocked.
    .PARAMETER UserHiveSid
        Resolve HKCU:\ to HKEY_USERS\<sid>\ (interactive user while running elevated as another admin).
    .PARAMETER DataFolder
        Read the catalog (tweaks, presets, cleaner rules, hardware tags) from this folder instead of
        the project's data folder. An empty string restores the default.
    .PARAMETER Reset
        Restore all defaults.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param(
        [string]$DataRoot,
        [string]$LegacyDataRoot,
        [System.Collections.IDictionary]$RegistryRedirect,
        [switch]$TestMode,
        [string]$UserHiveSid,
        [AllowEmptyString()][string]$DataFolder,
        [switch]$Reset
    )
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess('iG Windows Tuner module settings', 'Update')) { return }
    if ($Reset) {
        $script:IgwtSettings.DataRoot = (Join-Path $env:ProgramData 'iGWindowsTuner')
        $script:IgwtSettings.UserLogRoot = (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'iGWindowsTuner')
        $script:IgwtSettings.LegacyDataRoot = (Join-Path $env:ProgramData 'AegisTune')
        $script:IgwtSettings.RegistryRedirect = $null
        $script:IgwtSettings.TestMode = $false
        $script:IgwtSettings.UserHiveSid = $null
        $script:IgwtSettings.DataFolder = $null
        Clear-IgwtCatalogCaches
        return
    }
    if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('DataFolder')) {
        if ($DataFolder) { $script:IgwtSettings.DataFolder = $DataFolder } else { $script:IgwtSettings.DataFolder = $null }
        Clear-IgwtCatalogCaches
    }
    if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('DataRoot')) {
        $script:IgwtSettings.DataRoot = $DataRoot
        $script:IgwtSettings.UserLogRoot = $DataRoot
        $script:IgwtSettings.LegacyDataRoot = $LegacyDataRoot
    }
    if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('RegistryRedirect')) { $script:IgwtSettings.RegistryRedirect = $RegistryRedirect }
    if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('TestMode')) { $script:IgwtSettings.TestMode = [bool]$TestMode }
    if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('UserHiveSid')) { $script:IgwtSettings.UserHiveSid = $UserHiveSid }
}

function Clear-IgwtCatalogCaches {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Drops the cached catalog, cleaner rules and hardware tags (reloaded on next use). #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param()
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess('catalog caches', 'Clear')) { return }
    $script:IgwtCatalogCache = $null
    $script:IgwtCleanerRuleCache = $null
    $script:IgwtHardwareTagCache = $null
    $script:IgwtDetectionCache = $null
    $script:IgwtOverlayCache = $null
    $script:IgwtAsrCatalogCache = $null
    $script:IgwtPowerSettingCache = $null
    $script:IgwtKernelInspectorCache = $null
    $script:IgwtServiceRuleCache = $null
    $script:IgwtNicKeywordCache = $null
}

function Get-IgwtEnvironment {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Returns a copy of the current module settings. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Version          = $script:IgwtVersion
        DataRoot         = $script:IgwtSettings.DataRoot
        UserLogRoot      = $script:IgwtSettings.UserLogRoot
        TestMode         = $script:IgwtSettings.TestMode
        UserHiveSid      = $script:IgwtSettings.UserHiveSid
        RegistryRedirect = $script:IgwtSettings.RegistryRedirect
        ProjectRoot      = $script:IgwtProjectRoot
    }
}

function Get-IgwtDataPath {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Returns a data folder path. Backups and state always live under the admin-only data root.
        Logs fall back to %LOCALAPPDATA%\iGWindowsTuner\Logs when not elevated (read-only runs).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [ValidateSet('Root', 'Backups', 'Logs', 'State', 'Reports', 'LegacyBackups', 'LegacyState')]
        [string]$Kind = 'Root'
    )
    $root = $script:IgwtSettings.DataRoot
    $legacy = [string]$script:IgwtSettings.LegacyDataRoot
    switch ($Kind) {
        'LegacyBackups' { if ($legacy) { return (Join-Path $legacy 'Backups') }; return $null }
        'LegacyState' { if ($legacy) { return (Join-Path $legacy 'State') }; return $null }
        'Root'    { return $root }
        'Backups' { return (Join-Path $root 'Backups') }
        'State'   { return (Join-Path $root 'State') }
        'Logs' {
            if ((Test-IgwtIsAdmin) -or $script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) { return (Join-Path $root 'Logs') }
            return (Join-Path $script:IgwtSettings.UserLogRoot 'Logs')
        }
        'Reports' {
            if ((Test-IgwtIsAdmin) -or $script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) { return (Join-Path $root 'Reports') }
            return (Join-Path $script:IgwtSettings.UserLogRoot 'Reports')
        }
    }
}

function Initialize-IgwtDataRoot {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Creates the data folders. When elevated, the root gets a protected ACL
        (SYSTEM and Administrators: full control, Users: read) so that a standard user
        cannot plant or edit snapshot files that an elevated revert would later trust.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param()
    $isAdmin = Test-IgwtIsAdmin
    $root = $script:IgwtSettings.DataRoot
    if ($isAdmin -or $script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) {
        foreach ($kind in 'Root', 'Backups', 'Logs', 'State', 'Reports') {
            $p = Get-IgwtDataPath -Kind $kind
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) {
                if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($p, 'Create folder')) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $p -Force }
            }
        }
        if ($isAdmin -and -not $script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) { Protect-IgwtDataRoot -Path $root }
    } else {
        foreach ($kind in 'Logs', 'Reports') {
            $p = Get-IgwtDataPath -Kind $kind
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) {
                if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($p, 'Create folder')) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $p -Force }
            }
        }
    }
}

function Protect-IgwtDataRoot {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Applies the protected ACL to the iG Windows Tuner data root (elevated only). #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Path, 'Set protected ACL (SYSTEM/Administrators full, Users read)')) { return }
    try {
        $inherit = [System.Security.AccessControl.InheritanceFlags]'ContainerInherit, ObjectInherit'
        $prop = [System.Security.AccessControl.PropagationFlags]::None
        $allow = [System.Security.AccessControl.AccessControlType]::Allow
        $acl = New-Object System.Security.AccessControl.DirectorySecurity
        $acl.SetAccessRuleProtection($true, $false)
        $system = New-Object System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier('S-1-5-18')
        $admins = New-Object System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier('S-1-5-32-544')
        $users = New-Object System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier('S-1-5-32-545')
        $acl.AddAccessRule((New-Object System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemAccessRule($system, 'FullControl', $inherit, $prop, $allow)))
        $acl.AddAccessRule((New-Object System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemAccessRule($admins, 'FullControl', $inherit, $prop, $allow)))
        $acl.AddAccessRule((New-Object System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemAccessRule($users, 'ReadAndExecute', $inherit, $prop, $allow)))
        try { $acl.SetOwner($admins) } catch { Write-Verbose "Could not set owner on ${Path}: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
        Set-Acl -LiteralPath $Path -AclObject $acl -ErrorAction Stop
    } catch {
        Write-Warning "Could not protect ${Path}: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }
}

function Test-IgwtTrustedFile {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Returns $true when a file is owned by SYSTEM, Administrators, TrustedInstaller or the
        current (elevated) user and grants no write access to low-privilege groups.
        Snapshots that fail this check are not restored.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)
    if ($script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) { return $true }
    try {
        $acl = Get-Acl -LiteralPath $Path -ErrorAction Stop
        $ownerSid = (New-Object System.Security.Principal.NTAccount($acl.Owner)).Translate([System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier]).Value
        $trustedOwners = @('S-1-5-18', 'S-1-5-32-544', 'S-1-5-80-956008885-3418522649-1831038044-1853292631-2271478464',
            [System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().User.Value)
        if ($trustedOwners -notcontains $ownerSid) { return $false }
        $lowPriv = @('S-1-1-0', 'S-1-5-11', 'S-1-5-32-545', 'S-1-5-4', 'S-1-5-32-546')
        $writeRights = [System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]'Write, Modify, FullControl, TakeOwnership, ChangePermissions'
        foreach ($rule in $acl.Access) {
            if ($rule.AccessControlType -ne 'Allow') { continue }
            $sid = $null
            try { $sid = $rule.IdentityReference.Translate([System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier]).Value } catch { continue }
            if (($lowPriv -contains $sid) -and (($rule.FileSystemRights -band $writeRights) -ne 0)) { return $false }
        }
        return $true
    } catch {
        return $false
    }
}

function Get-IgwtInteractiveUserSid {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Returns the SID of the user who owns explorer.exe in the current session, or $null.
        Used to detect over-the-shoulder elevation (UAC credentials of a different admin),
        in which case HKCU tweaks are redirected to the interactive user's hive.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    try {
        $sessionId = (Get-Process -Id $PID).SessionId
        $explorer = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Process -Filter "Name='explorer.exe'" -ErrorAction Stop |
            Where-Object { $_.SessionId -eq $sessionId } | Select-Object -First 1
        if (-not $explorer) { return $null }
        $owner = Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $explorer -MethodName GetOwnerSid -ErrorAction Stop
        return $owner.Sid
    } catch {
        return $null
    }
}

function Initialize-IgwtUserHive {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        When elevated as a different account than the signed-in user, map HKCU:\ to the
        signed-in user's hive so per-user tweaks land where the gamer actually logs on.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    if ($script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) { return }
    $current = [System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().User.Value
    $interactive = Get-IgwtInteractiveUserSid
    if ($interactive -and ($interactive -ne $current)) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath "Registry::HKEY_USERS\$interactive") {
            $script:IgwtSettings.UserHiveSid = $interactive
            Write-IgwtLog -Level Warn -Message "Elevated as a different account; per-user (HKCU) settings will target the signed-in user $interactive."
        }
    }
}
```

```ps1
# Games.ps1
# Read-only game discovery from data\games.json: Steam libraries (libraryfolders.vdf),
# Riot install manifest, and known install paths. Nothing is ever written to game folders.

function Get-IgwtSteamLibraryPaths {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Steam library roots from the Steam install path and steamapps\libraryfolders.vdf. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $roots = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $steam = $null
    try { $steam = (Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath (Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Valve\Steam') -Name SteamPath -ErrorAction Stop).SteamPath } catch { $steam = $null }
    if (-not $steam) {
        try { $steam = (Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath (Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Valve\Steam') -Name InstallPath -ErrorAction Stop).InstallPath } catch { $steam = $null }
    }
    if (-not $steam) { return @() }
    $steam = $steam -replace '/', '\'
    $roots.Add($steam)
    $vdf = Join-Path $steam 'steamapps\libraryfolders.vdf'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $vdf) {
        foreach ($p in (ConvertFrom-IgwtSteamLibraryVdf -Text ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($vdf)))) { if ($roots -notcontains $p) { $roots.Add($p) } }
    }
    return @($roots | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ })
}

function ConvertFrom-IgwtSteamLibraryVdf {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Extracts "path" values from libraryfolders.vdf text. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([AllowEmptyString()][string]$Text)
    $result = foreach ($m in [regex]::Matches($Text, '"path"\s+"([^"]+)"')) {
        ($m.Groups[1].Value -replace '\\\\', '\') -replace '/', '\'
    }
    return @($result)
}

function Get-IgwtRiotInstallPaths {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Product install folders from %ProgramData%\Riot Games\RiotClientInstalls.json (if present). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $file = Join-Path $env:ProgramData 'Riot Games\RiotClientInstalls.json'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file)) { return @() }
    try {
        $doc = Get-Content -LiteralPath $file -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        $paths = foreach ($p in $doc.PSObject.Properties) {
            if ($p.Value -is [string] -and $p.Value -match '\.exe$') { Split-Path -Parent ($p.Value -replace '/', '\') }
            elseif ($p.Value -is [psobject]) { foreach ($q in $p.Value.PSObject.Properties) { if ($q.Value -is [string] -and $q.Value -match '\.exe$') { Split-Path -Parent ($q.Value -replace '/', '\') } } }
        }
        return @($paths | Select-Object -Unique)
    } catch { return @() }
}

function Get-IgwtInstalledGames {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Detects installed games listed in data\games.json. Returns Id, Name, ExePath, AntiCheat.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $defs = Get-IgwtGameDefinitions
    $steamLibs = @(Get-IgwtSteamLibraryPaths)
    $found = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    foreach ($g in $defs) {
        $candidates = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
        if ($g.steamDir -and $g.relativeExe) {
            foreach ($lib in $steamLibs) { $candidates.Add((Join-Path $lib "steamapps\common\$($g.steamDir)\$($g.relativeExe)")) }
        }
        foreach ($kp in @($g.knownPaths)) {
            if ($kp) { $candidates.Add([Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables([string]$kp)) }
        }
        foreach ($c in $candidates) {
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c -PathType Leaf) {
                $found.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Id = $g.id; Name = $g.name; ExePath = $c; AntiCheat = $g.antiCheat })
                break
            }
        }
    }
    return $found.ToArray()
}
```

`src/Core/Logging.ps1`:

```ps1
# Logging.ps1
# Human-readable log plus JSON-lines log. Both are plain text files; nothing is hidden.

$script:IgwtLogBuffer = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
$script:IgwtLogSink = $null       # optional scriptblock called with each entry (same runspace)
$script:IgwtLogQueue = $null      # optional ConcurrentQueue; the GUI's background worker uses it
$script:IgwtSessionId = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8)

function Write-IgwtLog {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Writes a log entry to %ProgramData%\iGWindowsTuner\Logs (or %LOCALAPPDATA% when not elevated).
    .PARAMETER Level
        Debug, Info, Warn or Error.
    .PARAMETER Message
        Human-readable message.
    .PARAMETER TweakId
        Optional tweak id the entry belongs to.
    .PARAMETER Data
        Optional structured data written to the JSON-lines log.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [ValidateSet('Debug', 'Info', 'Warn', 'Error')]
        [string]$Level = 'Info',
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [AllowEmptyString()]
        [string]$Message,
        [string]$TweakId,
        [System.Collections.IDictionary]$Data
    )
    $now = Get-Date
    $entry = [ordered]@{
        time    = $now.ToString('o')
        session = $script:IgwtSessionId
        level   = $Level
        message = $Message
    }
    if ($TweakId) { $entry.tweak = $TweakId }
    if ($Data) { $entry.data = $Data }

    $script:IgwtLogBuffer.Add([pscustomobject]$entry)
    if ($script:IgwtLogBuffer.Count -gt 2000) { $script:IgwtLogBuffer.RemoveRange(0, 500) }

    Write-Verbose ("[{0}] {1}{2}" -f $Level.ToUpperInvariant(), $(if ($TweakId) { "$TweakId - " } else { '' }), $Message)

    if ($script:IgwtLogSink) {
        try { & $script:IgwtLogSink ([pscustomobject]$entry) } catch { Write-Verbose "Log sink failed: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    }
    if ($script:IgwtLogQueue) { $script:IgwtLogQueue.Enqueue([pscustomobject]@{ Kind = 'log'; Entry = [pscustomobject]$entry }) }

    try {
        $dir = Get-IgwtDataPath -Kind Logs
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force }
        $stamp = $now.ToString('yyyyMMdd')
        $text = "{0} [{1}] [{2}] {3}{4}" -f $now.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), $script:IgwtSessionId, $Level.ToUpperInvariant(),
            $(if ($TweakId) { "$TweakId - " } else { '' }), $Message
        Add-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir "iGWindowsTuner-$stamp.log") -Value $text -Encoding UTF8
        Add-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir "iGWindowsTuner-$stamp.jsonl") -Value (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $entry -Compress -Depth 8) -Encoding UTF8
    } catch {
        Write-Verbose "Could not write log file: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }
}

function Get-IgwtLogBuffer {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Returns the in-memory log entries of this session. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([int]$Last = 0)
    if ($Last -gt 0 -and $script:IgwtLogBuffer.Count -gt $Last) {
        return $script:IgwtLogBuffer.GetRange($script:IgwtLogBuffer.Count - $Last, $Last).ToArray()
    }
    return $script:IgwtLogBuffer.ToArray()
}

function Set-IgwtLogSink {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Registers a receiver for log and progress entries: a scriptblock (same runspace) or a
        ConcurrentQueue (the GUI's background runspace hands entries to the UI thread this way).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([scriptblock]$Sink, [System.Collections.Concurrent.ConcurrentQueue[object]]$Queue)
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess('log sink', 'Set')) { return }
    if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Sink')) { $script:IgwtLogSink = $Sink }
    if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Queue')) { $script:IgwtLogQueue = $Queue }
}

function Send-IgwtProgress {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Reports progress to the GUI queue (if any) and to an optional callback. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([string]$Text, [int]$Percent, [scriptblock]$Callback)
    if ($script:IgwtLogQueue) { $script:IgwtLogQueue.Enqueue([pscustomobject]@{ Kind = 'progress'; Text = $Text; Percent = $Percent }) }
    if ($Callback) { & $Callback $Text $Percent }
}
```

`src/Core/Migration.ps1`:

```ps1
# Migration.ps1
# v1 -> v2 data migration. The converters are pure (objects in, ordered dictionaries out) and are
# used in two places: the loaders upgrade v1 entries in memory, so old files and snapshots keep
# working, and tools\Convert-IgwtV1Data.ps1 rewrites v1 data files on disk. Action definitions are
# never changed, so snapshot fingerprints (and therefore every v1 snapshot) stay valid.

$script:IgwtTweakKeyOrder = @('id', 'name', 'category', 'group', 'order', 'level', 'hint', 'description', 'warning', 'evidence', 'impact', 'risk',
    'antiCheat', 'reversible', 'sideEffects', 'requires', 'appliesTo', 'hardware', 'source', 'attribution', 'conflictsWith', 'status', 'statusReason',
    'policyKeys', 'postApply', 'revertNote')
$script:IgwtCleanerKeyOrder = @('id', 'name', 'category', 'level', 'tier', 'method', 'default', 'hint', 'description', 'sideEffects', 'antiCheat',
    'reversible', 'source', 'attribution', 'hardware', 'requiresAdmin')
$script:IgwtPresetKeyOrder = @('id', 'name', 'order', 'tagline', 'hint', 'description', 'gaming', 'levelCeiling', 'antiCheatPolicy', 'include', 'exclude')
$script:IgwtV1ConditionMap = [ordered]@{ wiredAdapter = 'wiredAdapter'; multipleGpus = 'multipleGpus'; nvidiaGpu = 'nvidiaGpu'; defender = 'defenderActive'; notRdp = 'notRdp' }

#region Helpers

function Test-IgwtHasProperty {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([AllowNull()]$Object, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Name)
    if ($null -eq $Object) { return $false }
    if ($Object -is [System.Collections.IDictionary]) { return $Object.Contains($Name) }
    return ($null -ne $Object.PSObject.Properties[$Name])
}

function Get-IgwtPropertyNames {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string[]])]
    param([AllowNull()]$Object)
    if ($null -eq $Object) { return @() }
    if ($Object -is [System.Collections.IDictionary]) { return @($Object.Keys | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }) }
    return @($Object.PSObject.Properties | Where-Object { $_.MemberType -eq 'NoteProperty' } | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtOrderedCopy {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Shallow copy with the given keys first (when present), then the rest in their original order, Last keys at the end. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Object, [string[]]$Order = @(), [string[]]$Last = @(), [string[]]$Drop = @())
    $names = @(Get-IgwtPropertyNames -Object $Object)
    $out = [ordered]@{}
    foreach ($k in $Order) { if ($names -contains $k -and $Drop -notcontains $k) { $out[$k] = $Object.$k } }
    foreach ($k in $names) { if (-not $out.Contains($k) -and $Last -notcontains $k -and $Drop -notcontains $k) { $out[$k] = $Object.$k } }
    foreach ($k in $Last) { if ($names -contains $k -and -not $out.Contains($k) -and $Drop -notcontains $k) { $out[$k] = $Object.$k } }
    return $out
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtPSObject {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Deep copy that turns dictionaries into PSCustomObjects (the shape ConvertFrom-Json produces). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([AllowNull()]$InputObject)
    if ($null -eq $InputObject -or $InputObject -is [string] -or $InputObject -is [System.ValueType]) { return $InputObject }
    if ($InputObject -is [System.Collections.IDictionary] -or $InputObject -is [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject]) {
        $o = [ordered]@{}
        foreach ($k in @(Get-IgwtPropertyNames -Object $InputObject)) { $o[$k] = ConvertTo-IgwtPSObject -InputObject $InputObject.$k }
        return [pscustomobject]$o
    }
    if ($InputObject -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable]) {
        $list = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
        foreach ($x in $InputObject) { $list.Add((ConvertTo-IgwtPSObject -InputObject $x)) }
        return , $list.ToArray()
    }
    return $InputObject
}

function Get-IgwtIdMap {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Renamed item ids (old -> new) from data\migration\id-map.json, applied to v1 snapshots and presets. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([string]$DataFolder)
    if (-not $DataFolder) { $DataFolder = Get-IgwtDataFolder }
    $map = @{}
    $file = Join-Path $DataFolder 'migration\id-map.json'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file) {
        $doc = Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $file
        foreach ($n in @(Get-IgwtPropertyNames -Object $doc.renamed)) { $map[$n] = [string]$doc.renamed.$n }
    }
    return $map
}

function Resolve-IgwtMappedId {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([AllowEmptyString()][string]$Id, [hashtable]$IdMap = @{})
    if ($Id -and $IdMap.ContainsKey($Id)) { return [string]$IdMap[$Id] }
    return $Id
}

#endregion

#region Item converters

function Get-IgwtV1TweakLevel {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Level for a v1 tweak: expert + not anti-cheat safe = Lab, other expert toggles = Expert,
        Tier B or medium/high risk = Advanced, everything else = Standard.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Tweak)
    $expert = [bool]$Tweak.expert
    $safe = $true
    if (Test-IgwtHasProperty -Object $Tweak -Name 'antiCheatSafe') { $safe = [bool]$Tweak.antiCheatSafe }
    if (-not $safe) { return 'Lab' }
    if ($expert) { return 'Expert' }
    if ([string]$Tweak.evidence.tier -eq 'B' -or [string]$Tweak.risk -in 'medium', 'high') { return 'Advanced' }
    return 'Standard'
}

function ConvertFrom-IgwtV1AntiCheat {
    <# .SYNOPSIS v1 antiCheatSafe (+ warning text) -> v2 antiCheat ("safe", "unknown" or { breaks }). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Tweak)
    if (-not (Test-IgwtHasProperty -Object $Tweak -Name 'antiCheatSafe') -or [bool]$Tweak.antiCheatSafe) { return 'safe' }
    $text = "$($Tweak.warning) $($Tweak.description)"
    $names = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    foreach ($k in $script:IgwtAntiCheatNames.Keys) {
        if ($text -match [regex]::Escape($k) -and -not $names.Contains($script:IgwtAntiCheatNames[$k])) { $names.Add($script:IgwtAntiCheatNames[$k]) }
    }
    if ($names.Count -eq 0) { return 'unknown' }
    return [ordered]@{ breaks = $names.ToArray() }
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtV2Tweak {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        v1 tweak -> v2 tweak (ordered). Adds level, antiCheat, reversible, sideEffects, source and
        hardware; moves appliesTo.hardware conditions to appliesTo.conditions; drops antiCheatSafe
        and expert. Actions are copied unchanged. Already-v2 entries are only re-ordered.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Tweak)
    $o = ConvertTo-IgwtOrderedCopy -Object $Tweak -Order $script:IgwtTweakKeyOrder -Last @('actions') -Drop @('antiCheatSafe', 'expert', 'sourceFile', 'sourceSchema', 'legacyFields', 'antiCheatText', 'tier')
    if (-not $o.Contains('level')) { $o['level'] = Get-IgwtV1TweakLevel -Tweak $Tweak }
    if (-not $o.Contains('antiCheat')) { $o['antiCheat'] = ConvertFrom-IgwtV1AntiCheat -Tweak $Tweak }
    if (-not $o.Contains('reversible')) { $o['reversible'] = 'full' }
    if (-not $o.Contains('sideEffects')) { $o['sideEffects'] = '' }
    if (-not $o.Contains('source')) { $o['source'] = 'igwt' }
    if (-not $o.Contains('hardware')) { $o['hardware'] = [ordered]@{ tags = @(); excludeTags = @() } }

    # appliesTo: build/edition limits plus runtime conditions (v1 kept them in appliesTo.hardware).
    $a = $null
    if ($o.Contains('appliesTo')) { $a = $o['appliesTo'] }
    $applies = [ordered]@{ minBuild = 26100 }
    if ($a) {
        foreach ($k in @(Get-IgwtPropertyNames -Object $a)) {
            if ($k -eq 'hardware') { continue }
            $applies[$k] = $a.$k
        }
        if ((Test-IgwtHasProperty -Object $a -Name 'hardware') -and $a.hardware) {
            $conds = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
            foreach ($c in @(if ($applies.Contains('conditions')) { $applies['conditions'] })) { if ($c -and -not $conds.Contains([string]$c)) { $conds.Add([string]$c) } }
            foreach ($k in @(Get-IgwtPropertyNames -Object $a.hardware)) {
                if (-not $a.hardware.$k) { continue }
                $name = $k
                if ($script:IgwtV1ConditionMap.Contains($k)) { $name = $script:IgwtV1ConditionMap[$k] }
                if (-not $conds.Contains($name)) { $conds.Add($name) }
            }
            if ($conds.Count -gt 0) { $applies['conditions'] = $conds.ToArray() }
        }
    }
    $o['appliesTo'] = $applies
    return (ConvertTo-IgwtOrderedCopy -Object $o -Order $script:IgwtTweakKeyOrder -Last @('actions'))
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtV2CleanerRule {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Pre-v2 cleaner rule -> v2 rule (ordered): adds tier (A when the rule cites a source),
        antiCheat "safe", reversible (none, partial for Recycle Bin rules, full for guidance),
        source "igwt" and hardware. Existing values are kept.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Rule)
    $o = ConvertTo-IgwtOrderedCopy -Object $Rule -Order $script:IgwtCleanerKeyOrder -Last @('notes', 'sources') -Drop @('sourceFile', 'sourceSchema')
    if (-not $o.Contains('level')) { $o['level'] = 'Standard' }
    if (-not $o.Contains('tier')) { $o['tier'] = $(if (@($Rule.sources | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -gt 0) { 'A' } else { 'B' }) }
    if (-not $o.Contains('sideEffects')) { $o['sideEffects'] = '' }
    if (-not $o.Contains('antiCheat')) { $o['antiCheat'] = 'safe' }
    if (-not $o.Contains('reversible')) {
        $rev = 'none'
        if ([string]$Rule.method -eq 'guidance') { $rev = 'full' } elseif ([bool]$Rule.recycle) { $rev = 'partial' }
        $o['reversible'] = $rev
    }
    if (-not $o.Contains('source')) { $o['source'] = 'igwt' }
    if (-not $o.Contains('hardware')) { $o['hardware'] = [ordered]@{ tags = @(); excludeTags = @() } }
    return (ConvertTo-IgwtOrderedCopy -Object $o -Order $script:IgwtCleanerKeyOrder -Last @('notes', 'sources'))
}

function Get-IgwtDefaultPresetHint {
    <# .SYNOPSIS A preset hint (max 140 characters) from its tagline and the first sentence of its description. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([string]$Tagline, [string]$Description)
    $first = ''
    if ($Description -match '^(.+?[.!?])(\s|$)') { $first = $Matches[1] }
    $hint = ([string]$Tagline).Trim().TrimEnd('.')
    if ($hint -and $first -and ($hint.Length + 2 + $first.Length) -le 140) { return "${hint}: $first" }
    if ($hint) { if ($hint.Length -gt 140) { return $hint.Substring(0, 139).TrimEnd() + '.' } else { return "$hint." } }
    if ($first.Length -le 140) { return $first }
    return $first.Substring(0, 139).TrimEnd() + '.'
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtV2Preset {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        v1 preset ({ tweaks }) -> v2 intent preset: include, exclude, levelCeiling, antiCheatPolicy,
        gaming and a hint. Renamed ids are mapped. Already-v2 presets are only re-ordered.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Preset, [hashtable]$IdMap = @{})
    $o = ConvertTo-IgwtOrderedCopy -Object $Preset -Order $script:IgwtPresetKeyOrder -Drop @('tweaks', 'sourceSchema', 'sourceFile')
    if (-not $o.Contains('include')) { $o['include'] = @(@($Preset.tweaks) | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { Resolve-IgwtMappedId -Id ([string]$_) -IdMap $IdMap }) }
    if (-not $o.Contains('exclude')) { $o['exclude'] = @() }
    if (-not $o.Contains('levelCeiling')) { $o['levelCeiling'] = 'Advanced' }
    if (-not $o.Contains('antiCheatPolicy')) { $o['antiCheatPolicy'] = 'safeOnly' }
    if (-not $o.Contains('gaming')) { $o['gaming'] = $true }
    if (-not $o.Contains('hint')) { $o['hint'] = Get-IgwtDefaultPresetHint -Tagline ([string]$Preset.tagline) -Description ([string]$Preset.description) }
    return (ConvertTo-IgwtOrderedCopy -Object $o -Order $script:IgwtPresetKeyOrder)
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtV2Snapshot {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Upgrades a snapshot document to schema 2 (in memory): maps renamed ids, records the item
        level of each entry when the catalog knows it, and adds catalogSchema/hardwareTags.
        Captured action data and fingerprints are not touched, so the restore logic is unchanged.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Document, [object[]]$Catalog = @(), [hashtable]$IdMap = @{})
    $o = ConvertTo-IgwtOrderedCopy -Object $Document -Order @('schema', 'tool', 'version', 'id', 'created', 'operation', 'detail') -Last @('entries')
    $from = [int]$o['schema']
    if ($from -lt 2) { $o['migratedFrom'] = $from }
    $o['schema'] = 2
    if (-not $o.Contains('catalogSchema')) { $o['catalogSchema'] = $(if ($from -lt 2) { 1 } else { 2 }) }
    if (-not $o.Contains('hardwareTags')) { $o['hardwareTags'] = @() }
    $levels = @{}
    foreach ($t in @($Catalog)) { if ($t) { $levels[[string]$t.id] = [string]$t.level } }
    $entries = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    foreach ($e in @($Document.entries | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })) {
        $ne = ConvertTo-IgwtOrderedCopy -Object $e -Order @('tweakId', 'level', 'result', 'message', 'time') -Last @('actions')
        $mapped = Resolve-IgwtMappedId -Id ([string]$ne['tweakId']) -IdMap $IdMap
        if ($mapped -ne [string]$ne['tweakId']) { $ne['originalTweakId'] = [string]$ne['tweakId']; $ne['tweakId'] = $mapped }
        if (-not $ne.Contains('level') -and $levels.ContainsKey($mapped)) { $ne['level'] = $levels[$mapped] }
        $entries.Add([pscustomobject](ConvertTo-IgwtOrderedCopy -Object $ne -Order @('tweakId', 'originalTweakId', 'level', 'result', 'message', 'time') -Last @('actions')))
    }
    $o['entries'] = $entries.ToArray()
    return [pscustomobject]$o
}

#endregion

#region JSON writer

function ConvertTo-IgwtJsonString {
    <# .SYNOPSIS JSON string literal; non-ASCII and control characters are \u-escaped so data files stay ASCII. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([AllowEmptyString()][string]$Text)
    $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder ($Text.Length + 2)
    $null = $sb.Append('"')
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) {
        $code = [int]$ch
        if ($code -eq 34) { $null = $sb.Append('\"') }
        elseif ($code -eq 92) { $null = $sb.Append('\\') }
        elseif ($code -eq 10) { $null = $sb.Append('\n') }
        elseif ($code -eq 13) { $null = $sb.Append('\r') }
        elseif ($code -eq 9) { $null = $sb.Append('\t') }
        elseif ($code -lt 32 -or $code -gt 126) { $null = $sb.Append(('\u{0:x4}' -f $code)) }
        else { $null = $sb.Append($ch) }
    }
    $null = $sb.Append('"')
    return $sb.ToString()
}

function Test-IgwtJsonScalar {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([AllowNull()]$Value)
    return ($null -eq $Value -or $Value -is [string] -or $Value -is [bool] -or $Value -is [char] -or $Value -is [datetime] -or $Value -is [enum] -or
        $Value -is [int] -or $Value -is [long] -or $Value -is [double] -or $Value -is [decimal] -or $Value -is [single] -or
        $Value -is [int16] -or $Value -is [byte] -or $Value -is [uint32] -or $Value -is [uint64] -or $Value -is [sbyte] -or $Value -is [uint16])
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtJsonScalar {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([AllowNull()]$Value)
    $inv = [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture
    if ($null -eq $Value) { return 'null' }
    if ($Value -is [bool]) { if ($Value) { return 'true' } else { return 'false' } }
    if ($Value -is [string] -or $Value -is [char] -or $Value -is [enum]) { return (ConvertTo-IgwtJsonString -Text ([string]$Value)) }
    if ($Value -is [datetime]) { return (ConvertTo-IgwtJsonString -Text $Value.ToString('o', $inv)) }
    if ($Value -is [double] -or $Value -is [single]) { return ([double]$Value).ToString('R', $inv) }
    return ([System.IFormattable]$Value).ToString($null, $inv)
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtJsonText {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Recursive part of ConvertTo-IgwtJson. Inline when it fits in Width; otherwise one member per line. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([AllowNull()]$Value, [int]$Indent, [int]$Width, [string]$NewLine)
    if (Test-IgwtJsonScalar -Value $Value) { return (ConvertTo-IgwtJsonScalar -Value $Value) }
    $pad = ' ' * $Indent
    $inner = ' ' * ($Indent + 2)
    $isMap = ($Value -is [System.Collections.IDictionary] -or $Value -is [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject])
    if ($isMap) {
        $keys = @(Get-IgwtPropertyNames -Object $Value)
        if ($keys.Count -eq 0) { return '{}' }
        $parts = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
        $simple = $true
        foreach ($k in $keys) {
            $v = $Value.$k
            if (-not (Test-IgwtJsonScalar -Value $v)) {
                if ($v -is [System.Collections.IDictionary] -or $v -is [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject]) { $simple = $false }
                else { foreach ($x in @($v)) { if (-not (Test-IgwtJsonScalar -Value $x)) { $simple = $false } } }
            }
            $parts.Add((ConvertTo-IgwtJsonString -Text $k) + ': ' + (ConvertTo-IgwtJsonText -Value $v -Indent ($Indent + 2) -Width $Width -NewLine $NewLine))
        }
        $line = '{ ' + ($parts -join ', ') + ' }'
        if ($simple -and ($Indent + $line.Length) -le $Width -and $line -notmatch "`n") { return $line }
        return '{' + $NewLine + (($parts | ForEach-Object { $inner + $_ }) -join (',' + $NewLine)) + $NewLine + $pad + '}'
    }
    # Any other enumerable is a JSON array.
    $items = @($Value)
    if ($items.Count -eq 0) { return '[]' }
    $rendered = @($items | ForEach-Object { ConvertTo-IgwtJsonText -Value $_ -Indent ($Indent + 2) -Width $Width -NewLine $NewLine })
    $allScalar = (@($items | Where-Object { -not (Test-IgwtJsonScalar -Value $_) }).Count -eq 0)
    $line = '[ ' + ($rendered -join ', ') + ' ]'
    if ($allScalar -and ($Indent + $line.Length) -le $Width) { return $line }
    return '[' + $NewLine + (($rendered | ForEach-Object { $inner + $_ }) -join (',' + $NewLine)) + $NewLine + $pad + ']'
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtJson {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Readable, ASCII-only JSON for data files (2-space indent; short objects and scalar arrays on
        one line). Unlike ConvertTo-Json in Windows PowerShell 5.1 it does not escape <, > or ' and
        has no depth limit.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][AllowNull()]$InputObject, [int]$Width = 160)
    $nl = "`r`n"
    return (ConvertTo-IgwtJsonText -Value $InputObject -Indent 0 -Width $Width -NewLine $nl) + $nl
}

#endregion

#region File and folder conversion

function Get-IgwtDataFileKind {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Document)
    # v1 presets also have a 'tweaks' member, but it lists id strings instead of tweak objects.
    $firstTweak = $null
    if (Test-IgwtHasProperty -Object $Document -Name 'tweaks') { $firstTweak = @($Document.tweaks | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ }) | Select-Object -First 1 }
    if ((Test-IgwtHasProperty -Object $Document -Name 'include') -or (Test-IgwtHasProperty -Object $Document -Name 'tagline') -or $firstTweak -is [string]) { return 'preset' }
    if (Test-IgwtHasProperty -Object $Document -Name 'tweaks') { return 'tweaks' }
    if (Test-IgwtHasProperty -Object $Document -Name 'rules') { return 'cleaner' }
    return ''
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtV2DataDocument {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Converts one parsed data file (tweaks, cleaner rules or a preset) to its v2 document. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Document, [hashtable]$IdMap = @{})
    switch (Get-IgwtDataFileKind -Document $Document) {
        'tweaks' {
            $o = ConvertTo-IgwtOrderedCopy -Object $Document -Order @('schemaVersion', 'category') -Last @('tweaks')
            $o['schemaVersion'] = $script:IgwtSchemaVersion
            $o['tweaks'] = @(@($Document.tweaks) | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { ConvertTo-IgwtV2Tweak -Tweak $_ })
            return (ConvertTo-IgwtOrderedCopy -Object $o -Order @('schemaVersion', 'category') -Last @('tweaks'))
        }
        'cleaner' {
            $o = ConvertTo-IgwtOrderedCopy -Object $Document -Order @('schemaVersion', 'category') -Last @('rules')
            $o['schemaVersion'] = $script:IgwtSchemaVersion
            $o['rules'] = @(@($Document.rules) | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { ConvertTo-IgwtV2CleanerRule -Rule $_ })
            return (ConvertTo-IgwtOrderedCopy -Object $o -Order @('schemaVersion', 'category') -Last @('rules'))
        }
        'preset' {
            $p = ConvertTo-IgwtV2Preset -Preset $Document -IdMap $IdMap
            $o = [ordered]@{ schemaVersion = $script:IgwtSchemaVersion }
            foreach ($k in $p.Keys) { if ($k -ne 'schemaVersion') { $o[$k] = $p[$k] } }
            return $o
        }
        default { throw 'Not an iG Windows Tuner tweak, cleaner or preset document.' }
    }
}

function Convert-IgwtDataToV2 {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Converts the v1 data files under a data folder (tweaks\*.json, presets\*.json, cleaner\*.json)
        to schema v2 in place. Files that are already v2 and unchanged are left alone.
    .PARAMETER DataFolder
        The data folder to convert (default: this installation's data folder).
    .OUTPUTS
        One object per file: File, Kind, Items, FromSchema, Changed.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([string]$DataFolder)
    if (-not $DataFolder) { $DataFolder = Get-IgwtDataFolder }
    $idMap = Get-IgwtIdMap -DataFolder $DataFolder
    foreach ($sub in 'tweaks', 'presets', 'cleaner') {
        $dir = Join-Path $DataFolder $sub
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { continue }
        foreach ($f in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Filter '*.json' -File | Sort-Object Name)) {
            $raw = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f.FullName, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
            $doc = Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $f.FullName
            $from = 1
            if (Test-IgwtHasProperty -Object $doc -Name 'schemaVersion') { $from = [int]$doc.schemaVersion }
            if ($from -gt $script:IgwtSchemaVersion) { throw "$($f.Name): schemaVersion $from is newer than this version of iG Windows Tuner supports." }
            $v2 = ConvertTo-IgwtV2DataDocument -Document $doc -IdMap $idMap
            $text = ConvertTo-IgwtJson -InputObject $v2
            $changed = ($text -ne $raw)
            $count = 1
            if ($v2.Contains('tweaks')) { $count = @($v2['tweaks']).Count } elseif ($v2.Contains('rules')) { $count = @($v2['rules']).Count }
            if ($changed -and $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($f.FullName, "Write schema v$($script:IgwtSchemaVersion)")) {
                [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($f.FullName, $text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
            }
            [pscustomobject]@{ File = "$sub\$($f.Name)"; Kind = (Get-IgwtDataFileKind -Document $doc); Items = $count; FromSchema = $from; Changed = $changed }
        }
    }
    $script:IgwtCatalogCache = $null
    $script:IgwtCleanerRuleCache = $null
}

function Convert-IgwtSnapshotToV2 {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Writes a schema 2 copy of a snapshot file to another folder (archival). The original is never
        modified: iG Windows Tuner also reads v1 snapshots directly and upgrades them in memory.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Destination)
    $src = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Path).ProviderPath
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Destination)) { if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Destination, 'Create folder')) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Destination -Force } }
    $dest = Join-Path (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Destination).ProviderPath (Split-Path $src -Leaf)
    if ([string]::Equals($dest, $src, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Refusing to overwrite the original snapshot; choose another destination folder.' }
    $doc = Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $src
    if ($script:IgwtSnapshotToolNames -notcontains [string]$doc.tool) { throw "$src is not an iG Windows Tuner snapshot." }
    $v2 = ConvertTo-IgwtV2Snapshot -Document $doc -Catalog @(Get-IgwtCatalog) -IdMap (Get-IgwtIdMap)
    if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($dest, 'Write schema 2 snapshot copy')) {
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($dest, (ConvertTo-IgwtJson -InputObject $v2), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    }
    return $dest
}

#endregion
```

```ps1
# Preflight.ps1
# Checks that run before any change: admin, edition, build, pending reboot, laptop/battery, RDP.

$script:IgwtMinimumBuild = 26100

function Get-IgwtOsInfo {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Windows edition, version, build and UBR from the registry (read-only). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $cv = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $build = 0
    if ($cv -and $cv.CurrentBuildNumber) { $build = [int]$cv.CurrentBuildNumber }
    elseif ($cv -and $cv.CurrentBuild) { $build = [int]$cv.CurrentBuild }
    $ubr = 0
    if ($cv -and $null -ne $cv.UBR) { $ubr = [int]$cv.UBR }
    $caption = $null
    $lastBoot = $null
    try {
        $os = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_OperatingSystem -ErrorAction Stop
        $caption = $os.Caption
        $lastBoot = $os.LastBootUpTime
    } catch { Write-Verbose "Win32_OperatingSystem unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Caption        = $(if ($caption) { $caption } else { $cv.ProductName })
        EditionId      = $cv.EditionID
        DisplayVersion = $cv.DisplayVersion
        Build          = $build
        Ubr            = $ubr
        FullBuild      = "$build.$ubr"
        LastBootUpTime = $lastBoot
        Uptime         = $(if ($lastBoot) { (Get-Date) - $lastBoot } else { $null })
    }
}

function Get-IgwtPendingReboot {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Returns the reasons a reboot is pending (Windows servicing and iG Windows Tuner itself). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $reasons = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Component Based Servicing\RebootPending') { $reasons.Add('Component Based Servicing') }
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WindowsUpdate\Auto Update\RebootRequired') { $reasons.Add('Windows Update') }
    try {
        $sm = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager' -Name PendingFileRenameOperations -ErrorAction Stop
        if ($sm.PendingFileRenameOperations) { $reasons.Add('Pending file rename operations') }
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'No pending file rename operations.' }
    $own = Get-IgwtPendingRestartState
    if ($own -and $own.Requires -ne 'none') { $reasons.Add("iG Windows Tuner changes ($($own.Requires))") }
    return , $reasons.ToArray()
}

function Test-IgwtRdpSession {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Returns $true when the current session is a Remote Desktop session. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param()
    # SESSIONNAME is "Console" locally and "RDP-Tcp#N" in a Remote Desktop session.
    if ($env:SESSIONNAME -and $env:SESSIONNAME -like 'RDP-*') { return $true }
    try {
        $null = [System.Reflection.Assembly]::Load('System.Windows.Forms, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089')
        if ([System.Windows.Forms.SystemInformation]::TerminalServerSession) { return $true }
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'System.Windows.Forms not available for RDP detection.' }
    return $false
}

function Get-IgwtPowerSource {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Laptop/battery detection (desktop PCs report no battery). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $isPortable = $false
    $hasBattery = $false
    $onBattery = $false
    try {
        $enclosure = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_SystemEnclosure -ErrorAction Stop
        $portable = @(8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 18, 21, 30, 31, 32)
        foreach ($t in @($enclosure.ChassisTypes)) { if ($portable -contains [int]$t) { $isPortable = $true } }
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'Win32_SystemEnclosure unavailable.' }
    try {
        $battery = @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Battery -ErrorAction Stop)
        if ($battery.Count -gt 0) {
            $hasBattery = $true
            # BatteryStatus 1 = discharging (on battery)
            if (@($battery | Where-Object { $_.BatteryStatus -eq 1 }).Count -gt 0) { $onBattery = $true }
        }
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'Win32_Battery unavailable.' }
    [pscustomobject]@{ IsPortable = $isPortable; HasBattery = $hasBattery; OnBattery = $onBattery }
}

function Get-IgwtPreflight {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Collects preflight facts and returns warnings/errors. Read-only.
    .PARAMETER ForApply
        Evaluate as if changes are about to be made (admin becomes an error, not a warning).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([switch]$ForApply)
    $os = Get-IgwtOsInfo
    $isAdmin = Test-IgwtIsAdmin
    $pending = Get-IgwtPendingReboot
    $power = Get-IgwtPowerSource
    $rdp = Test-IgwtRdpSession
    $warnings = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $errors = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    if ($os.Build -lt $script:IgwtMinimumBuild) {
        $errors.Add("Windows build $($os.Build) is older than $script:IgwtMinimumBuild (Windows 11 24H2). iG Windows Tuner refuses to change older builds.")
    }
    if ($os.EditionId -ne 'Professional') {
        $warnings.Add("Edition is '$($os.EditionId)'. iG Windows Tuner is designed and tested for Windows 11 Pro; some policies may behave differently.")
    }
    if (-not $isAdmin) {
        if ($ForApply) { $errors.Add('Administrator rights are required to apply or revert changes.') }
        else { $warnings.Add('Not elevated: some health checks (TPM, Secure Boot databases, BitLocker, disk counters) are limited.') }
    }
    if ($pending.Count -gt 0) { $warnings.Add("A reboot is already pending: $($pending -join ', ').") }
    if ($power.IsPortable -or $power.HasBattery) {
        $warnings.Add('Portable device or battery detected. Performance power settings raise power use and heat.')
    }
    if ($power.OnBattery) { $warnings.Add('Running on battery.') }
    if ($rdp) { $warnings.Add('This is a Remote Desktop session. Tweaks that could interrupt networking or Remote Desktop are blocked.') }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        IsAdmin       = $isAdmin
        Os            = $os
        Build         = $os.Build
        EditionId     = $os.EditionId
        IsPro         = ($os.EditionId -eq 'Professional')
        SupportedBuild = ($os.Build -ge $script:IgwtMinimumBuild)
        PendingReboot = $pending
        Power         = $power
        IsRdpSession  = $rdp
        Warnings      = $warnings.ToArray()
        Errors        = $errors.ToArray()
        CanApply      = ($errors.Count -eq 0)
    }
}

function Get-IgwtPendingRestartState {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Returns iG Windows Tuner's own logoff/reboot requirement that has not been satisfied yet. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $file = Join-Path (Get-IgwtDataPath -Kind State) 'pending-restart.json'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file)) {
        # A requirement recorded before the rename from AegisTune.
        $legacy = Get-IgwtDataPath -Kind LegacyState
        if ($legacy) { $file = Join-Path $legacy 'pending-restart.json' }
        if (-not $legacy -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file)) { return $null }
    }
    try {
        $state = Get-Content -LiteralPath $file -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
    } catch { return $null }
    $os = $null
    try { $os = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_OperatingSystem -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Verbose 'OS query failed.' }
    if ($os -and $state.bootTime) {
        $recordedBoot = [datetime]::Parse($state.bootTime, [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture, [System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles]::RoundtripKind)
        if ([math]::Abs(($os.LastBootUpTime - $recordedBoot).TotalSeconds) -gt 120) { return $null }   # rebooted since
    }
    $requires = [string]$state.requires
    if ($requires -eq 'logoff' -and $state.recordedAt) {
        $explorer = Get-Process -Name explorer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object StartTime | Select-Object -First 1
        $recordedAt = [datetime]::Parse($state.recordedAt, [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture, [System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles]::RoundtripKind)
        if ($explorer -and $explorer.StartTime -gt $recordedAt) { return $null }  # signed out and back in since
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Requires = $requires; Tweaks = @($state.tweaks); RecordedAt = $state.recordedAt }
}

function Set-IgwtPendingRestartState {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Records that applied tweaks need a logoff or reboot (persistent banner). #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param(
        [ValidateSet('logoff', 'reboot')][string]$Requires,
        [string[]]$TweakId
    )
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess('pending-restart.json', 'Record restart requirement')) { return }
    $dir = Get-IgwtDataPath -Kind State
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force }
    $file = Join-Path $dir 'pending-restart.json'
    $existing = Get-IgwtPendingRestartState
    $all = @($TweakId)
    if ($existing) {
        $all = @($existing.Tweaks) + @($TweakId) | Select-Object -Unique
        if ($existing.Requires -eq 'reboot') { $Requires = 'reboot' }
    }
    $boot = $null
    try { $boot = (Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_OperatingSystem -ErrorAction Stop).LastBootUpTime.ToString('o') } catch { Write-Verbose 'OS query failed.' }
    $obj = [ordered]@{ requires = $Requires; tweaks = @($all); bootTime = $boot; recordedAt = (Get-Date).ToString('o') }
    Set-Content -LiteralPath $file -Value (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $obj -Depth 4) -Encoding UTF8
}
```

```ps1
# RestorePoint.ps1
# System Restore point before every apply (in addition to the JSON snapshot).
# Uses the documented WMI class root\default:SystemRestore so it works in Windows PowerShell 5.1
# and PowerShell 7. The 24-hour creation limit is lifted only for the duration of the call by
# setting SystemRestorePointCreationFrequency to 0, then the exact previous value is restored.

$script:IgwtSystemRestoreKey = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\SystemRestore'

function Test-IgwtSystemProtectionEnabled {
    <# .SYNOPSIS True when System Protection is on for the system drive. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param()
    try {
        $v = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\SPP\Clients' -Name '{09F7EDC5-294E-4180-AF6A-FB0E6A0E9513}'
        if (-not $v.Exists) { return $false }
        $drive = ($env:SystemDrive).TrimEnd(':')
        foreach ($line in @($v.Value)) { if ([string]$line -match "\($drive%3A\)") { return $true } }
        return $false
    } catch { return $false }
}

function Enable-IgwtSystemProtection {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Turns on System Protection for the system drive (only called after explicit consent). #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param()
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$env:SystemDrive\", 'Enable System Protection')) { return $false }
    $r = Invoke-CimMethod -Namespace 'root/default' -ClassName SystemRestore -MethodName Enable -Arguments @{ Drive = "$env:SystemDrive\" } -ErrorAction Stop
    if ([int]$r.ReturnValue -ne 0) { throw "Enabling System Protection failed (code $($r.ReturnValue))." }
    Write-IgwtLog -Message "System Protection enabled on $env:SystemDrive (user consent)."
    return $true
}

function New-IgwtRestorePoint {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Creates a restore point. Returns an object with Created (bool) and Reason.
    .PARAMETER Description
        Restore point description.
    .PARAMETER EnableSystemProtection
        Consent to turn on System Protection for the system drive if it is off.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([string]$Description = 'iG Windows Tuner: before applying changes', [switch]$EnableSystemProtection)
    if (-not (Test-IgwtSystemProtectionEnabled)) {
        if (-not $EnableSystemProtection) {
            return [pscustomobject]@{ Created = $false; Reason = 'SystemProtectionDisabled' }
        }
        try { $null = Enable-IgwtSystemProtection } catch { return [pscustomobject]@{ Created = $false; Reason = "EnableFailed: $($_.Exception.Message)" } }
    }
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Description, 'Create System Restore point')) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Created = $false; Reason = 'WhatIf' } }

    $before = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $script:IgwtSystemRestoreKey -Name 'SystemRestorePointCreationFrequency'
    $missing = Get-IgwtRegistryMissingDepth -Path $script:IgwtSystemRestoreKey
    $item = @{ exists = $before.Exists; kind = $before.Kind; value = (ConvertTo-IgwtSerializableValue -Value $before.Value -Kind $before.Kind); missingDepth = $missing }
    try {
        Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $script:IgwtSystemRestoreKey -Name 'SystemRestorePointCreationFrequency' -Kind DWord -Value 0
        # RestorePointType 12 = MODIFY_SETTINGS, EventType 100 = BEGIN_SYSTEM_CHANGE
        $r = Invoke-CimMethod -Namespace 'root/default' -ClassName SystemRestore -MethodName CreateRestorePoint -Arguments @{
            Description = $Description; RestorePointType = [uint32]12; EventType = [uint32]100 } -ErrorAction Stop
        if ([int]$r.ReturnValue -ne 0) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Created = $false; Reason = "CreateRestorePoint returned $($r.ReturnValue)" } }
        Write-IgwtLog -Message "System Restore point created: $Description"
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Created = $true; Reason = '' }
    } catch {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Created = $false; Reason = $_.Exception.Message }
    } finally {
        try { Restore-IgwtRegistryItem -Path $script:IgwtSystemRestoreKey -Name 'SystemRestorePointCreationFrequency' -Item $item }
        catch { Write-IgwtLog -Level Warn -Message "Could not restore SystemRestorePointCreationFrequency: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    }
}
```

```ps1
# Schema.ps1
# Schema v2 vocabulary and the field checks shared by every catalog item kind (tweaks, cleaner
# rules, presets, hardware tags). Data files declare "schemaVersion": 2. Entries without the v2
# fields (v1 data) are upgraded in memory when they are loaded (see Migration.ps1), and
# tools\Convert-IgwtV1Data.ps1 rewrites v1 files on disk.

$script:IgwtSchemaVersion = 2
$script:IgwtItemLevels = @('Standard', 'Advanced', 'Expert', 'Lab')
$script:IgwtTiers = @('A', 'B')
$script:IgwtReversibleValues = @('full', 'partial', 'none')
$script:IgwtItemSources = @('igwt', 'winutil', 'microsoft')
$script:IgwtAntiCheatPolicies = @('safeOnly', 'any')
# Runtime applicability checks (appliesTo.conditions); evaluated against the engine context.
$script:IgwtConditions = @('wiredAdapter', 'multipleGpus', 'nvidiaGpu', 'defenderActive', 'notRdp')
# Anti-cheat names recognised when v1 warnings are migrated (text -> canonical name).
$script:IgwtAntiCheatNames = [ordered]@{
    'FACEIT' = 'FACEIT'; 'Vanguard' = 'Riot Vanguard'; 'Easy Anti-Cheat' = 'Easy Anti-Cheat'; 'EasyAntiCheat' = 'Easy Anti-Cheat'
    'BattlEye' = 'BattlEye'; 'RICOCHET' = 'RICOCHET'; 'Javelin' = 'Javelin'
}
$script:IgwtHardwareTagCache = $null

function Get-IgwtHardwareTagDefinitions {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Hardware tag vocabulary from data\hardware\tags.json (id, name, group, hint, description). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([switch]$Force)
    if ($script:IgwtHardwareTagCache -and -not $Force) { return $script:IgwtHardwareTagCache }
    $file = Join-Path (Get-IgwtDataFolder) 'hardware\tags.json'
    $tags = @()
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file) { $tags = @((Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $file).tags | Where-Object { $_ }) }
    $script:IgwtHardwareTagCache = $tags
    return $tags
}

function Get-IgwtLevelRank {
    <# .SYNOPSIS 0 = Standard ... 3 = Lab; -1 for an unknown level. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([int])]
    param([AllowEmptyString()][string]$Level)
    return [array]::IndexOf($script:IgwtItemLevels, $Level)
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtAntiCheatInfo {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Interprets an antiCheat field: "safe", "unknown" or { "breaks": [names] }. Returns Valid,
        Safe, Unknown, Breaks and a short Text for badges.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([AllowNull()]$Value)
    $info = [pscustomobject]@{ Valid = $false; Safe = $false; Unknown = $false; Breaks = @(); Text = 'Anti-cheat: invalid' }
    if ($Value -is [string]) {
        if ($Value -eq 'safe') { $info.Valid = $true; $info.Safe = $true; $info.Text = 'Anti-cheat safe' }
        elseif ($Value -eq 'unknown') { $info.Valid = $true; $info.Unknown = $true; $info.Text = 'Anti-cheat: unknown' }
        return $info
    }
    if ($null -ne $Value -and ($Value -is [System.Collections.IDictionary] -or $Value -is [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject])) {
        $breaks = $null
        if ($Value -is [System.Collections.IDictionary]) { $breaks = $Value['breaks'] } else { $breaks = $Value.breaks }
        $names = @($breaks | Where-Object { $_ -is [string] -and $_.Trim() })
        if ($names.Count -gt 0 -and $names.Count -eq @($breaks).Count) {
            $info.Valid = $true; $info.Breaks = $names; $info.Text = "Breaks $($names -join ', ')"
        }
    }
    return $info
}

function Get-IgwtItemTier {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Evidence tier of an item: evidence.tier for tweaks, the top-level tier otherwise. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Item)
    if ($null -ne $Item.PSObject.Properties['evidence'] -and $Item.evidence -and $null -ne $Item.evidence.PSObject.Properties['tier']) { return [string]$Item.evidence.tier }
    if ($null -ne $Item.PSObject.Properties['tier']) { return [string]$Item.tier }
    return ''
}

function Test-IgwtItemText {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Every user-facing item: a hint of 140 characters or fewer and a real description. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Item, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Label, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][AllowEmptyCollection()][System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]$Errors)
    $hint = [string]$Item.hint
    $desc = [string]$Item.description
    if (-not $hint.Trim()) { $Errors.Add("${Label}: missing 'hint'.") }
    elseif ($hint.Length -gt 140) { $Errors.Add("${Label}: hint is $($hint.Length) characters (max 140).") }
    if (-not $desc.Trim()) { $Errors.Add("${Label}: missing 'description'.") }
    elseif ($desc.Length -lt 40) { $Errors.Add("${Label}: description is too short (at least 40 characters).") }
}

function Test-IgwtItemMetadata {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Schema v2 metadata shared by tweaks and cleaner rules: level, tier, antiCheat, reversible,
        sideEffects, source (+ attribution for WinUtil items) and hardware tags.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Item, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Label, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][AllowEmptyCollection()][System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]$Errors)
    if ($script:IgwtItemLevels -notcontains [string]$Item.level) { $Errors.Add("${Label}: level must be Standard, Advanced, Expert or Lab (got '$($Item.level)').") }
    if ($script:IgwtTiers -notcontains (Get-IgwtItemTier -Item $Item)) { $Errors.Add("${Label}: tier must be A or B (rejected items belong in rejected.json).") }
    if (-not (ConvertTo-IgwtAntiCheatInfo -Value $Item.antiCheat).Valid) { $Errors.Add("${Label}: antiCheat must be ""safe"", ""unknown"" or { ""breaks"": [names] }.") }
    if ($script:IgwtReversibleValues -notcontains [string]$Item.reversible) { $Errors.Add("${Label}: reversible must be full, partial or none.") }
    if ($null -eq $Item.PSObject.Properties['sideEffects'] -or ($null -ne $Item.sideEffects -and $Item.sideEffects -isnot [string])) { $Errors.Add("${Label}: 'sideEffects' must be a string (empty when there are none).") }
    if ($script:IgwtItemSources -notcontains [string]$Item.source) { $Errors.Add("${Label}: source must be igwt, winutil or microsoft.") }
    if ([string]$Item.source -eq 'winutil' -and -not ([string]$Item.attribution).Trim()) { $Errors.Add("${Label}: WinUtil-derived items need an 'attribution'.") }
    $hw = $Item.hardware
    if ($null -eq $hw) { $Errors.Add("${Label}: missing 'hardware' ({ tags, excludeTags }).") }
    else {
        $known = @(Get-IgwtHardwareTagDefinitions | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.id })
        $tags = @($hw.tags | Where-Object { $_ }); $ex = @($hw.excludeTags | Where-Object { $_ })
        foreach ($t in $tags + $ex) { if ($known -notcontains [string]$t) { $Errors.Add("${Label}: unknown hardware tag '$t'.") } }
        foreach ($t in $tags) { if ($ex -contains $t) { $Errors.Add("${Label}: hardware tag '$t' is both required and excluded.") } }
    }
}
```

`src/Core/Snapshot.ps1`:

```ps1
# Snapshot.ps1
# JSON snapshots of every value about to change, written to %ProgramData%\iGWindowsTuner\Backups
# before anything is modified and updated after each tweak, so an interrupted run can still be
# reverted. Snapshot files are plain JSON and can be inspected with any text editor.

$script:IgwtSnapshotSchema = 2
$script:IgwtSupportedSnapshotSchemas = @(1, 2)   # schema 1 (iG Windows Tuner 1.x) is upgraded in memory when read
# Snapshots record the tool name; files written before the rename say 'AegisTune'.
$script:IgwtSnapshotToolNames = @('iG Windows Tuner', 'AegisTune')
$script:IgwtApplyOperations =@('Apply', 'Preset', 'ResetDefault', 'Startup')

function Get-IgwtActionFingerprint {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Identifies an action so a snapshot is only restored onto the same catalog action. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action)
    $parts = @([string]$Action.type)
    # 1.0 keys first (unchanged, so 1.0 snapshots keep matching); 2.0 keys only exist on 2.0 action types.
    foreach ($p in 'path', 'name', 'item', 'subgroup', 'setting', 'scheme', 'keyword', 'setting', 'id', 'feature', 'handler', 'checker', 'provider',
        'deviceClass', 'package', 'process', 'mitigation', 'rule', 'displayGroup', 'direction', 'extension', 'protocol') {
        if ($null -ne $Action.PSObject.Properties[$p] -and $null -ne $Action.$p) { $parts += "$p=$($Action.$p)" }
    }
    if ($null -ne $Action.PSObject.Properties['services'] -and $null -ne $Action.services) { $parts += 'services=' + (@($Action.services | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.name }) -join ',') }
    return ($parts -join '|')
}

function New-IgwtSnapshot {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Creates a new snapshot document (in memory) and its file path. #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Operation, [string]$Detail = '')
    $dir = Get-IgwtDataPath -Kind Backups
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) {
        if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($dir, 'Create backups folder')) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force }
    }
    $stamp = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmmss-fff')
    $safeOp = ($Operation -replace '[^A-Za-z0-9\-]', '')
    $path = Join-Path $dir ("snapshot-{0}-{1}-{2}.json" -f $stamp, $safeOp, [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 6))
    $os = Get-IgwtOsInfo
    $doc = [ordered]@{
        schema        = $script:IgwtSnapshotSchema
        catalogSchema = $script:IgwtSchemaVersion
        tool          = 'iG Windows Tuner'
        version       = $script:IgwtVersion
        hardwareTags  = @()
        id          = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString()
        created     = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
        operation   = $Operation
        detail      = $Detail
        computer    = $env:COMPUTERNAME
        build       = $os.FullBuild
        userSid     = [System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().User.Value
        userHiveSid = $script:IgwtSettings.UserHiveSid
        entries     = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    }
    return [pscustomobject]@{ Path = $path; Document = $doc }
}

function Save-IgwtSnapshot {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Snapshot)
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Snapshot.Path, 'Write snapshot')) { return }
    $json = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $Snapshot.Document -Depth 25
    $tmp = "$($Snapshot.Path).tmp"
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($tmp, $json, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    Move-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Destination $Snapshot.Path -Force
}

function Add-IgwtSnapshotEntry {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Adds (or replaces) the entry for one tweak and writes the file immediately. #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Snapshot,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$TweakId,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][AllowEmptyCollection()]$Actions,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Result,
        [string]$Message = '',
        [string]$Level
    )
    $entries = $Snapshot.Document.entries
    for ($i = $entries.Count - 1; $i -ge 0; $i--) { if ($entries[$i].tweakId -eq $TweakId) { $entries.RemoveAt($i) } }
    $entry = [ordered]@{ tweakId = $TweakId }
    if ($Level) { $entry['level'] = $Level }
    $entry['result'] = $Result; $entry['message'] = $Message; $entry['time'] = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'); $entry['actions'] = @($Actions)
    $entries.Add($entry)
    if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Snapshot.Path, "Record $TweakId ($Result)")) { Save-IgwtSnapshot -Snapshot $Snapshot }
}

function Get-IgwtSnapshotList {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Snapshot files, newest first, with their operation and entries. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    # Backups written before the rename from AegisTune stay in the legacy data root and are listed too.
    $dirs = @(Get-IgwtDataPath -Kind Backups; Get-IgwtDataPath -Kind LegacyBackups) | Where-Object { $_ -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $_) }
    if ($dirs.Count -eq 0) { return @() }
    $files = @($dirs | ForEach-Object { Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $_ -Filter 'snapshot-*.json' -File }) | Sort-Object Name -Descending
    $catalog = @()
    $idMap = @{}
    try { $catalog = @(Get-IgwtCatalog); $idMap = Get-IgwtIdMap } catch { Write-Verbose "Catalog unavailable for snapshot upgrade: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    foreach ($f in $files) {
        try {
            $doc = Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $f.FullName
            if ([int]$doc.schema -lt $script:IgwtSnapshotSchema) { $doc = ConvertTo-IgwtV2Snapshot -Document $doc -Catalog $catalog -IdMap $idMap }
            [pscustomobject]@{
                Path      = $f.FullName
                File      = $f.Name
                Created   = $doc.created
                Operation = [string]$doc.operation
                Detail    = [string]$doc.detail
                Entries   = @($doc.entries | Where-Object { $_ })
                Applied   = @($doc.entries | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.result -eq 'Applied' } | ForEach-Object { $_.tweakId })
                Document  = $doc
            }
        } catch {
            Write-IgwtLog -Level Warn -Message "Unreadable snapshot $($f.Name): $($_.Exception.Message)"
        }
    }
}

function Read-IgwtSnapshot {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Loads a snapshot for restore. Refuses files that are not owned by an administrator or that
        low-privilege users could have modified, and files with an unknown schema. Schema 1 files
        (iG Windows Tuner 1.x) are upgraded to schema 2 in memory; the file itself is not changed.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { throw "Snapshot not found: $Path" }
    if (-not (Test-IgwtTrustedFile -Path $Path)) {
        throw "Snapshot '$Path' is not trusted (it must be owned by Administrators/SYSTEM and not writable by standard users). Refusing to restore from it."
    }
    $doc = Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $Path
    if ($script:IgwtSupportedSnapshotSchemas -notcontains [int]$doc.schema -or $script:IgwtSnapshotToolNames -notcontains [string]$doc.tool) { throw "Snapshot '$Path' has an unsupported format." }
    if ([int]$doc.schema -lt $script:IgwtSnapshotSchema) { $doc = ConvertTo-IgwtV2Snapshot -Document $doc -Catalog @(Get-IgwtCatalog) -IdMap (Get-IgwtIdMap) }
    return $doc
}

function Find-IgwtLatestSnapshotEntry {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Newest applied entry for a tweak that has not been reverted since. Returns
        (Path, Document, Entry) or $null.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$TweakId)
    foreach ($s in @(Get-IgwtSnapshotList)) {
        $entry = @($s.Entries | Where-Object { $_.tweakId -eq $TweakId -and $_.result -in 'Applied', 'Reverted' }) | Select-Object -First 1
        if (-not $entry) { continue }
        if ($s.Operation -eq 'Revert') { return $null }   # most recent event for this tweak was a revert
        if ($script:IgwtApplyOperations -contains (($s.Operation -split ':')[0])) {
            return [pscustomobject]@{ Path = $s.Path; Document = $s.Document; Entry = $entry }
        }
    }
    return $null
}
```
