```ps1
function New-IgwtGuiKernelRow {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Bindable row for one registry value of the kernel and memory inspector. #>
    [Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions', '', Justification = 'Builds or refreshes in-memory objects only; changes no system state.')]
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Value, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Key)
    $brush = switch ([string]$Value.Status) { 'Changed' { $script:IgwtColor.Warn } 'Default' { $script:IgwtColor.Pass } 'Absent' { $script:IgwtColor.Muted } default { $script:IgwtColor.Muted } }
    $link = ''
    if ($Value.Item) { $link = "Change through catalog item $($Value.Item)" } elseif ($Value.Rejected) { $link = "Explained in $($Value.Rejected) (not changed by iG Windows Tuner)" }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Name = [string]$Value.Name; Key = $Key; Meaning = [string]$Value.Meaning; Link = $link; Current = [string]$Value.Current
        DefaultText = $(if ($Value.Default) { "Windows default: $($Value.Default)" } else { '' }); Status = [string]$Value.Status; StatusBrush = $brush

function New-IgwtGuiDiskRow {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Bindable row for one folder or file of a disk analysis. #>
    [Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions', '', Justification = 'Builds or refreshes in-memory objects only; changes no system state.')]
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path, [long]$Bytes, [long]$Largest, [string]$Extra, [switch]$IsFolder)
    $leaf = Split-Path -Path $Path -Leaf
    if (-not $leaf) { $leaf = $Path }
    $parent = Split-Path -Path $Path -Parent
    $detail = $parent
    if ($Extra) { $detail = "$Extra  |  $parent" }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Path     = $Path
        Name     = $leaf
        Detail   = $detail
        Bytes    = $Bytes
        SizeText = (Format-IgwtBytes $Bytes)
        Share    = $(if ($Largest -gt 0) { [Math]::Round(100.0 * $Bytes / $Largest, 1) } else { 0 })
        IsFolder = [bool]$IsFolder
    }
}

    [OutputType([string])]
    param()
    return (@(

            'How it works: every change is declared in data\tweaks\*.json with a source, a Windows default and a revert path. The toggles always show the real current state. Applying creates a System Restore point and a JSON snapshot of every value first; each tweak is applied atomically and rolled back on error.',
            '',

            'Evidence tiers: Tier A = documented by Microsoft or the vendor; Tier B = real but situational (measure before and after). Popular tweaks that are placebo, obsolete or security-reducing are listed on the Rejected Tweaks page with the reason.',
            '',
            'Files: backups in %ProgramData%\iGWindowsTuner\Backups, logs in %ProgramData%\iGWindowsTuner\Logs. See docs\README.md, docs\SECURITY.md and docs\TESTING.md.'
        ) -join [Environment]::NewLine)
}
```

`src/Hardware/HardwareProfile.ps1`:

```ps1
# HardwareProfile.ps1
# Read-only hardware profile: collects facts (CPU, GPUs, NICs, memory, form factor, system disk,
# virtual machine) and turns them into hardware tags with the data-driven detection rules in
# data\hardware\detection.json. Tags drive the overlays in Overlays.ps1. Nothing is changed.

$script:IgwtHardwareProfileCache = $null
$script:IgwtDetectionCache = $null
$script:IgwtVmPattern = '(?i)(Virtual Machine|VMware|VirtualBox|KVM|QEMU|Xen|Parallels|HVM domU|Bochs|innotek)'
$script:IgwtDetectionKeys = @('cpuVendor', 'cpuName', 'cpuNameNot', 'cpuFamily', 'cpuModels', 'hybrid', 'gpuName', 'gpuPnp', 'nicName', 'nicPnp',
    'laptop', 'vm', 'modernStandby', 'systemDiskBus', 'systemDiskMedia', 'memoryGBMin', 'memoryGBBelow')

#region Facts

function ConvertTo-IgwtPciId {
    <# .SYNOPSIS 'PCI\VEN_10DE&DEV_2216&SUBSYS_...' -> 'VEN_10DE&DEV_2216' (no serial or instance data). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([AllowEmptyString()][string]$PnpDeviceId)
    if ($PnpDeviceId -match '(VEN_[0-9A-F]{4}&DEV_[0-9A-F]{4})') { return $Matches[1].ToUpperInvariant() }
    return ''
}

function Test-IgwtModernStandby {
    <# .SYNOPSIS True when 'powercfg /a' lists Standby (S0 Low Power Idle) as available. Read-only. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param()
    try {
        $text = [string](Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/a')).Output
        $available = ($text -split '(?im)^.*not available.*$')[0]
        return ($available -match 'S0 Low Power Idle')
    } catch { return $false }
}

function Get-IgwtHardwareFacts {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Raw hardware facts for the profile (read-only, no serial numbers): CPU, active GPUs, network
        controllers, installed memory, battery/chassis, Modern Standby, system disk, VM indicators.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $cpu = Get-IgwtCpuInfo
    $facts = [ordered]@{
        schemaVersion = 2
        name          = ''
        cpu           = [ordered]@{ name = [string]$cpu.Name; vendor = [string]$cpu.Vendor; family = $cpu.Family; model = $cpu.Model; cores = $cpu.Cores; threads = $cpu.Threads }
        gpus          = @()
        nics          = @()
        memoryGB      = 0
        battery       = $false
        portableChassis = $false
        modernStandby = $false
        systemDisk    = [ordered]@{ model = ''; bus = ''; media = '' }
        system        = [ordered]@{ manufacturer = ''; model = '' }
        os            = [ordered]@{ build = 0 }
    }
    try {
        $facts.gpus = @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_VideoController -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.PNPDeviceID -like 'PCI\*' } | ForEach-Object {
                [ordered]@{ name = [string]$_.Name; vendor = [string]$_.AdapterCompatibility; pnp = (ConvertTo-IgwtPciId $_.PNPDeviceID); enabled = ([int]$_.ConfigManagerErrorCode -eq 0) }
            })
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'GPU facts unavailable.' }
    try {
        $facts.nics = @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PnPEntity -Filter "PNPClass='Net'" -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.PNPDeviceID -like 'PCI\*' } | ForEach-Object {
                [ordered]@{ name = [string]$_.Name; pnp = (ConvertTo-IgwtPciId $_.PNPDeviceID); enabled = ([int]$_.ConfigManagerErrorCode -eq 0) }
            })
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'NIC facts unavailable.' }
    $mem = Get-IgwtMemoryInfo
    $facts.memoryGB = [int]$mem.TotalGB
    try {
        $cs = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ComputerSystem -ErrorAction Stop
        $facts.system = [ordered]@{ manufacturer = [string]$cs.Manufacturer; model = [string]$cs.Model }
        if (-not $facts.memoryGB -and $cs.TotalPhysicalMemory) { $facts.memoryGB = [int][math]::Ceiling([double]$cs.TotalPhysicalMemory / 1GB) }
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'Win32_ComputerSystem unavailable.' }
    $power = Get-IgwtPowerSource
    $facts.battery = [bool]$power.HasBattery
    $facts.portableChassis = [bool]$power.IsPortable
    $facts.modernStandby = Test-IgwtModernStandby
    try {
        $num = (Get-Partition -DriveLetter ($env:SystemDrive.TrimEnd(':')) -ErrorAction Stop | Get-Disk -ErrorAction Stop).Number
        $pd = @(Get-PhysicalDisk -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { [string]$_.DeviceId -eq [string]$num }) | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($pd) { $facts.systemDisk = [ordered]@{ model = [string]$pd.FriendlyName; bus = [string]$pd.BusType; media = [string]$pd.MediaType } }
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'System disk facts unavailable.' }
    $facts.os = [ordered]@{ build = [int](Get-IgwtOsInfo).Build }
    return [pscustomobject]$facts
}

function Get-IgwtDerivedFacts {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Values computed from raw facts: hybrid CPU, virtual machine, laptop. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Facts)
    $cores = [int]$Facts.cpu.cores; $threads = [int]$Facts.cpu.threads
    $vm = ("$($Facts.system.manufacturer) $($Facts.system.model)" -match $script:IgwtVmPattern)
    # In a VM, virtual processors usually appear as cores without Hyper-Threading, so the hybrid test is skipped.
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Hybrid = (-not $vm) -and ([string]$Facts.cpu.vendor -match 'Intel' -and $cores -gt 0 -and $threads -gt 0 -and $threads -lt (2 * $cores))
        Vm     = [bool]$vm
        Laptop = (-not $vm) -and ([bool]$Facts.battery -or [bool]$Facts.portableChassis)
    }
}

#endregion

#region Detection

function Get-IgwtDetectionRules {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Tag detection rules from data\hardware\detection.json. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([switch]$Force)
    if ($script:IgwtDetectionCache -and -not $Force) { return $script:IgwtDetectionCache }
    $file = Join-Path (Get-IgwtDataFolder) 'hardware\detection.json'
    $rules = @()
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file) { $rules = @((Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $file).rules | Where-Object { $_ }) }
    $script:IgwtDetectionCache = $rules
    return $rules
}

function Test-IgwtDetectionCondition {
    <# .SYNOPSIS True when every key of one condition object holds for the facts (keys are ANDed). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Facts, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Derived, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$When)
    $gpus = @($Facts.gpus | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.enabled })
    $nics = @($Facts.nics | Where-Object { $_ })
    foreach ($p in $When.PSObject.Properties) {
        $v = $p.Value
        $ok = switch ($p.Name) {
            'cpuVendor' { [string]$Facts.cpu.vendor -match [string]$v }
            'cpuName' { [string]$Facts.cpu.name -match [string]$v }
            'cpuNameNot' { [string]$Facts.cpu.name -notmatch [string]$v }
            'cpuFamily' { [int]$Facts.cpu.family -eq [int]$v }
            'cpuModels' { @($v | ForEach-Object { [int]$_ }) -contains [int]$Facts.cpu.model }
            'hybrid' { [bool]$Derived.Hybrid -eq [bool]$v }
            'gpuName' { @($gpus | Where-Object { [string]$_.name -match [string]$v }).Count -gt 0 }
            'gpuPnp' { @($gpus | Where-Object { [string]$_.pnp -match [string]$v }).Count -gt 0 }
            'nicName' { @($nics | Where-Object { [string]$_.name -match [string]$v }).Count -gt 0 }
            'nicPnp' { @($nics | Where-Object { [string]$_.pnp -match [string]$v }).Count -gt 0 }
            'laptop' { [bool]$Derived.Laptop -eq [bool]$v }
            'vm' { [bool]$Derived.Vm -eq [bool]$v }
            'modernStandby' { [bool]$Facts.modernStandby -eq [bool]$v }
            'systemDiskBus' { [string]$Facts.systemDisk.bus -match [string]$v }
            'systemDiskMedia' { [string]$Facts.systemDisk.media -match [string]$v }
            'memoryGBMin' { [double]$Facts.memoryGB -ge [double]$v }
            'memoryGBBelow' { [double]$Facts.memoryGB -gt 0 -and [double]$Facts.memoryGB -lt [double]$v }
            default { $false }
        }
        if (-not $ok) { return $false }
    }
    return $true
}

function Get-IgwtHardwareProfile {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Hardware tags for this PC (or for -Facts, used by the test fixtures), with the detection
        rule that produced each tag. Cached for the session; -Force re-detects. Read-only.
    .OUTPUTS
        Facts, Derived, Tags (sorted ids) and TagDetails (Id, Name, Group, Hint, Basis).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param($Facts, [switch]$Force)
    $useCache = ($null -eq $Facts)
    if ($useCache -and $script:IgwtHardwareProfileCache -and -not $Force) { return $script:IgwtHardwareProfileCache }
    if ($null -eq $Facts) { $Facts = Get-IgwtHardwareFacts }
    if ($Facts -is [System.Collections.IDictionary]) { $Facts = ConvertTo-IgwtPSObject -InputObject $Facts }
    $derived = Get-IgwtDerivedFacts -Facts $Facts
    $defs = @{}
    foreach ($t in @(Get-IgwtHardwareTagDefinitions)) { $defs[[string]$t.id] = $t }
    $found = [ordered]@{}
    foreach ($r in @(Get-IgwtDetectionRules)) {
        $tag = [string]$r.tag
        if ($found.Contains($tag)) { continue }
        $conds = @()
        if ($null -ne $r.PSObject.Properties['anyOf']) { $conds = @($r.anyOf) } else { $conds = @($r.when) }
        foreach ($c in $conds) {
            if ($c -and (Test-IgwtDetectionCondition -Facts $Facts -Derived $derived -When $c)) { $found[$tag] = [string]$r.basis; break }
        }
    }
    $details = @(foreach ($k in $found.Keys) {
            $d = $defs[$k]
            [pscustomobject]@{ Id = $k; Name = $(if ($d) { [string]$d.name } else { $k }); Group = $(if ($d) { [string]$d.group } else { '' }); Hint = $(if ($d) { [string]$d.hint } else { '' }); Basis = $found[$k] }
        })
    $profileObj = [pscustomobject]@{
        Facts      = $Facts
        Derived    = $derived
        Tags       = @($found.Keys | Sort-Object)
        TagDetails = @($details | Sort-Object Group, Id)
    }
    if ($useCache) { $script:IgwtHardwareProfileCache = $profileObj }
    return $profileObj
}

#endregion
```

`src/Hardware/Overlays.ps1`:

```ps1
# Overlays.ps1
# Hardware overlays (data\hardware\overlays.json) and preset resolution.
# Final plan = intent preset -> hardware overlays -> user add-ons. Blocks are enforced in state
# detection (blocked items are Not applicable, so neither presets nor -Apply can turn them on),
# adds put items into presets when the preset's level ceiling and anti-cheat policy allow it.

$script:IgwtOverlayCache = $null
$script:IgwtOverlayMatchKeys = @('type', 'handler', 'name', 'setting', 'subgroup', 'scheme', 'keyword', 'feature', 'id', 'fieldPresent')

function Get-IgwtHardwareOverlays {
    <# .SYNOPSIS All overlay definitions from data\hardware\overlays.json. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([switch]$Force)
    if ($script:IgwtOverlayCache -and -not $Force) { return $script:IgwtOverlayCache }
    $file = Join-Path (Get-IgwtDataFolder) 'hardware\overlays.json'
    $list = @()
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file) { $list = @((Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $file).overlays | Where-Object { $_ }) }
    $script:IgwtOverlayCache = $list
    return $list
}

function Get-IgwtActiveOverlays {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Overlays that apply to the given hardware tags (an overlay is active when any of its tags is present). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([AllowEmptyCollection()][string[]]$Tags = @())
    foreach ($o in @(Get-IgwtHardwareOverlays)) {
        $hit = @(@($o.tags) | Where-Object { $Tags -contains [string]$_ })
        if ($hit.Count -gt 0) {
            $copy = $o.PSObject.Copy()
            $copy | Add-Member -NotePropertyName MatchedTags -NotePropertyValue $hit -Force -PassThru
        }
    }
}

function Test-IgwtOverlayActionMatch {
    <# .SYNOPSIS True when one action matches an overlay matcher (every listed field equals one of its values, case-insensitive). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Matcher)
    foreach ($p in $Matcher.PSObject.Properties) {
        $allowed = @($p.Value | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
        if ($p.Name -eq 'fieldPresent') {
            foreach ($f in $allowed) { if ($null -eq $Action.PSObject.Properties[$f] -or $null -eq $Action.$f) { return $false } }
            continue
        }
        if ($null -eq $Action.PSObject.Properties[$p.Name]) { return $false }
        $actual = [string]$Action.($p.Name)
        if (@($allowed | Where-Object { [string]::Equals($_, $actual, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) }).Count -eq 0) { return $false }
    }
    return $true
}

function Get-IgwtHardwareBlock {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Why an item cannot be applied on this hardware, or $null: missing required hardware tags,
        an excluded tag, or an active overlay that blocks it (by id or by action match).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Tweak, [AllowEmptyCollection()][string[]]$Tags = @())
    $need = @($Tweak.hardware.tags | Where-Object { $_ })
    $missing = @($need | Where-Object { $Tags -notcontains [string]$_ })
    if ($missing.Count -gt 0) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Kind = 'tags'; OverlayId = ''; Reason = "Needs hardware tag(s) $($missing -join ', ') that this PC does not have." } }
    $excluded = @(@($Tweak.hardware.excludeTags | Where-Object { $_ }) | Where-Object { $Tags -contains [string]$_ })
    if ($excluded.Count -gt 0) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Kind = 'tags'; OverlayId = ''; Reason = "Not used on this hardware ($($excluded -join ', '))." } }
    foreach ($o in @(Get-IgwtActiveOverlays -Tags $Tags)) {
        $hit = (@($o.block) -contains [string]$Tweak.id)
        if (-not $hit) {
            foreach ($m in @($o.blockMatching | Where-Object { $_ })) {
                foreach ($a in @($Tweak.actions)) { if (Test-IgwtOverlayActionMatch -Action $a -Matcher $m) { $hit = $true; break } }
                if ($hit) { break }
            }
        }
        if ($hit) {
            return [pscustomobject]@{ Kind = 'overlay'; OverlayId = [string]$o.id; Reason = "Blocked on this hardware by '$($o.name)' ($(@($o.MatchedTags) -join ', ')): $($o.hint)" }
        }
    }
    return $null
}

function Resolve-IgwtPresetSelection {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Resolves a preset for the given hardware tags: intent preset -> hardware overlays -> user
        add-ons/removals. Returns the final ids plus every item's origin and the reasons.
    .PARAMETER Preset
        Preset name/id or preset object.
    .PARAMETER Tags
        Hardware tags (default: this PC's profile).
    .PARAMETER AddIds
        Your add-ons (still subject to hardware blocks).
    .PARAMETER RemoveIds
        Items you want left out.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Preset, [string[]]$Tags, [string[]]$AddIds = @(), [string[]]$RemoveIds = @())
    if ($Preset -is [string]) { $Preset = Get-IgwtPreset -Name $Preset }
    if ($null -eq $Tags) { $Tags = @((Get-IgwtHardwareProfile).Tags) }
    $catalog = @{}
    foreach ($t in @(Get-IgwtCatalog)) { $catalog[[string]$t.id] = $t }
    $active = @(Get-IgwtActiveOverlays -Tags $Tags)
    $excluded = @($Preset.exclude | Where-Object { $_ })
    $ceiling = Get-IgwtLevelRank -Level ([string]$Preset.levelCeiling)
    $items = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $index = @{}
    $addItem = {
        param([string]$Id, [string]$Origin, [bool]$Included, [string]$Note)
        if ($index.ContainsKey($Id)) {
            $it = $index[$Id]
            if ($Note) { $it.Notes.Add($Note) }
            return
        }
        $it = [pscustomobject]@{ Id = $Id; Origin = $Origin; Included = $Included; Blocked = $false; Notes = (New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]) }
        if ($Note) { $it.Notes.Add($Note) }
        $items.Add($it); $index[$Id] = $it
    }
    $checkBlock = {
        param($It)
        $t = $catalog[$It.Id]
        if (-not $t) { $It.Included = $false; $It.Notes.Add('Unknown item.'); return }
        $b = Get-IgwtHardwareBlock -Tweak $t -Tags $Tags
        if ($b) { $It.Included = $false; $It.Blocked = $true; $It.Notes.Add($b.Reason) }
    }

    # 1. Intent preset
    foreach ($id in @($Preset.include | Where-Object { $_ -and $excluded -notcontains $_ })) { & $addItem ([string]$id) 'preset' $true '' }
    foreach ($it in $items.ToArray()) { & $checkBlock $it }

    # 2. Hardware overlays (adds)
    foreach ($o in $active) {
        foreach ($id in @($o.add | Where-Object { $_ })) {
            $label = "'$($o.name)' ($(@($o.MatchedTags) -join ', '))"
            if ($index.ContainsKey([string]$id)) { if ($index[[string]$id].Included) { $index[[string]$id].Notes.Add("Also required by $label.") }; continue }
            $t = $catalog[[string]$id]
            if ($excluded -contains $id) { & $addItem ([string]$id) 'overlay' $false "Suggested by $label but excluded by the preset."; continue }
            if (-not $t) { continue }
            $rank = Get-IgwtLevelRank -Level ([string]$t.level)
            if ([string]$t.level -eq 'Lab' -or ($ceiling -ge 0 -and $rank -gt $ceiling)) { & $addItem ([string]$id) 'overlay' $false "Suggested by $label but above the preset's level ceiling ($($Preset.levelCeiling))."; continue }
            if ([string]$Preset.antiCheatPolicy -eq 'safeOnly' -and -not $t.antiCheatSafe) { & $addItem ([string]$id) 'overlay' $false "Suggested by $label but not anti-cheat safe."; continue }
            & $addItem ([string]$id) 'overlay' $true "Added by ${label}: $($o.hint)"
            & $checkBlock $index[[string]$id]
        }
    }

    # 3. User add-ons and removals
    foreach ($id in @($AddIds | Where-Object { $_ })) {
        if ($index.ContainsKey([string]$id)) {
            $it = $index[[string]$id]
            if (-not $it.Included -and -not $it.Blocked) { $it.Included = $true; $it.Origin = 'user'; $it.Notes.Add('Added by you.') }
            continue
        }
        & $addItem ([string]$id) 'user' $true 'Added by you.'
        & $checkBlock $index[[string]$id]
    }
    foreach ($id in @($RemoveIds | Where-Object { $_ })) {
        if ($index.ContainsKey([string]$id)) { $index[[string]$id].Included = $false; $index[[string]$id].Notes.Add('Removed by you.') }
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Preset   = [string]$Preset.id
        Name     = [string]$Preset.name
        Tags     = @($Tags)
        Overlays = @($active | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Id = [string]$_.id; Name = [string]$_.name; Tags = @($_.MatchedTags); Hint = [string]$_.hint; Guidance = @($_.guidance | Where-Object { $_ }) } })
        Items    = $items.ToArray()
        Ids      = @($items | Where-Object { $_.Included } | ForEach-Object { $_.Id })
        Blocked  = @($items | Where-Object { $_.Blocked } | ForEach-Object { $_.Id })
        Guidance = @($active | ForEach-Object { @($_.guidance | Where-Object { $_ }) })
    }
}

function Test-IgwtHardwareCatalog {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Validates data\hardware (tags, detection rules, overlays). Returns error strings. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $errors = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $tagIds = @(Get-IgwtHardwareTagDefinitions -Force | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.id })
    $catalogIds = @(Get-IgwtCatalog | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.id })
    $detected = @{}
    foreach ($r in @(Get-IgwtDetectionRules -Force)) {
        $label = "detection rule for '$($r.tag)'"
        if ($tagIds -notcontains [string]$r.tag) { $errors.Add("${label}: unknown tag.") }
        $detected[[string]$r.tag] = $true
        if (-not $r.basis) { $errors.Add("${label}: missing 'basis'.") }
        if ($r.source -and [string]$r.source -notmatch '^https://') { $errors.Add("${label}: source must be https.") }
        $conds = @()
        if ($null -ne $r.PSObject.Properties['anyOf']) { $conds = @($r.anyOf) } elseif ($null -ne $r.PSObject.Properties['when']) { $conds = @($r.when) }
        if ($conds.Count -eq 0) { $errors.Add("${label}: needs 'when' or 'anyOf'.") }
        foreach ($c in $conds) {
            foreach ($p in $c.PSObject.Properties) {
                if ($script:IgwtDetectionKeys -notcontains $p.Name) { $errors.Add("${label}: unknown condition '$($p.Name)'.") ; continue }
                if ($p.Name -in 'cpuVendor', 'cpuName', 'cpuNameNot', 'gpuName', 'gpuPnp', 'nicName', 'nicPnp', 'systemDiskBus', 'systemDiskMedia') {
                    try { $null = [regex]::new([string]$p.Value) } catch { $errors.Add("${label}: invalid regex in '$($p.Name)'.") }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    foreach ($t in $tagIds) { if (-not $detected.ContainsKey($t)) { $errors.Add("hardware tag '$t': no detection rule.") } }
    $ids = @{}
    foreach ($o in @(Get-IgwtHardwareOverlays -Force)) {
        $oid = [string]$o.id
        $label = "overlay '$oid'"
        if ($oid -notmatch '^overlay\.[a-z0-9\-]+$') { $errors.Add("${label}: id must look like 'overlay.name'.") }
        if ($ids.ContainsKey($oid)) { $errors.Add("${label}: duplicate id.") } else { $ids[$oid] = $true }
        if (-not $o.name) { $errors.Add("${label}: missing 'name'.") }
        Test-IgwtItemText -Item $o -Label $label -Errors $errors
        if (@($o.tags).Count -eq 0) { $errors.Add("${label}: needs at least one tag.") }
        foreach ($t in @($o.tags)) { if ($tagIds -notcontains [string]$t) { $errors.Add("${label}: unknown tag '$t'.") } }
        if ([string]$o.basis -notin 'vendor', 'reviewer', 'igwt') { $errors.Add("${label}: basis must be vendor, reviewer or igwt.") }
        $sources = @($o.sources | Where-Object { $_ })
        if ($sources.Count -eq 0) { $errors.Add("${label}: needs at least one source.") }
        foreach ($s in $sources) { if ([string]$s -notmatch '^https://') { $errors.Add("${label}: source '$s' must be https.") } }
        $block = @($o.block | Where-Object { $_ }); $add = @($o.add | Where-Object { $_ }); $guide = @($o.guidance | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })
        $effects = $block.Count + @($o.blockMatching | Where-Object { $_ }).Count + $add.Count + $guide.Count
        if ($effects -eq 0) { $errors.Add("${label}: needs block, blockMatching, add or guidance.") }
        foreach ($id in $block + $add) { if ($catalogIds -notcontains [string]$id) { $errors.Add("${label}: unknown item '$id'.") } }
        foreach ($id in $add) { if ($block -contains $id) { $errors.Add("${label}: '$id' is both added and blocked.") } }
        foreach ($m in @($o.blockMatching | Where-Object { $_ })) {
            if ($null -eq $m.PSObject.Properties['type']) { $errors.Add("${label}: every blockMatching entry needs 'type'.") }
            foreach ($p in $m.PSObject.Properties) { if ($script:IgwtOverlayMatchKeys -notcontains $p.Name) { $errors.Add("${label}: unknown blockMatching field '$($p.Name)'.") } }
        }
        foreach ($g in $guide) { if (-not ([string]$g).Trim()) { $errors.Add("${label}: empty guidance text.") } }
    }
    return $errors.ToArray()
}
```

`src/Health/AntiCheat.ps1`:

```ps1
# AntiCheat.ps1
# Anti-cheat readiness: which platform requirements pass, per anti-cheat. Read-only.
# Requirements are documented in docs\ANTICHEAT.md with sources.

$script:IgwtAntiCheatProfiles = @(
    [pscustomobject]@{ Id = 'faceit'; Name = 'FACEIT Anti-Cheat (CS2)'; Requires = @('tpm', 'secureBoot', 'vbs', 'iommu', 'win11', 'noTestSign')
        Note = 'TPM 2.0 + Secure Boot mandatory since 25 Nov 2025; VBS + IOMMU enforced in waves; Windows 10 unsupported from 14 Oct 2026.' }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Id = 'vanguard'; Name = 'Riot Vanguard (VALORANT, LoL)'; Requires = @('tpm', 'secureBoot', 'noTestSign')
        Note = 'On Windows 11, Vanguard requires TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot.' }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Id = 'vanguardOnDemand'; Name = 'Riot Vanguard On-Demand mode'; Requires = @('win1125h2', 'secureBoot', 'tpm', 'vbs', 'hvci', 'iommu', 'noTestSign')
        Note = 'Optional mode: Windows 11 25H2+, Secure Boot, TPM 2.0, VBS, HVCI and IOMMU.' }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Id = 'ricochet'; Name = 'Call of Duty (RICOCHET)'; Requires = @('tpm', 'secureBoot', 'noTestSign')
        Note = 'TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot required from Black Ops 7.' }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Id = 'javelin'; Name = 'Battlefield 6 (Javelin)'; Requires = @('secureBoot', 'tpm', 'noTestSign')
        Note = 'Secure Boot required; TPM 2.0 required.' }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Id = 'eacbe'; Name = 'Easy Anti-Cheat / BattlEye'; Requires = @('noTestSign')
        Note = 'No platform-wide requirement; individual games may require Secure Boot. Test signing and kernel debugging are refused.' }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Id = 'vac'; Name = 'Valve Anti-Cheat (Dota 2, CS2)'; Requires = @()
        Note = 'User-mode anti-cheat with no platform requirements.' }
)

function Get-IgwtAntiCheatRequirements {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Evaluates each platform requirement once (Pass/Fail/Unknown with detail). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $os = Get-IgwtOsInfo
    $tpm = Get-IgwtTpmInfo
    $sb = Get-IgwtSecureBootInfo
    $dg = Get-IgwtDeviceGuardInfo
    $boot = Get-IgwtBootFlags
    $r = [ordered]@{}
    $r.tpm = [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'TPM 2.0 ready'; Pass = ($tpm.Present -and $tpm.Ready -and $tpm.Version20); Unknown = $false; Detail = $tpm.Detail }
    $r.secureBoot = [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'Secure Boot on'; Pass = ($sb.Enabled -eq $true); Unknown = ($null -eq $sb.Enabled); Detail = '' }
    $r.secureBoot2023 = [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'Secure Boot 2023 certificates'; Pass = ($sb.CA2023Status -eq 'Updated' -or ($sb.DbHas2023 -and $sb.KekHas2023)); Unknown = (-not $sb.CA2023Status -and -not $sb.DatabaseChecked); Detail = $sb.CA2023Status }
    $r.vbs = [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'VBS running'; Pass = ($dg.Available -and $dg.VbsStatus -eq 2); Unknown = (-not $dg.Available); Detail = '' }
    $r.hvci = [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'Memory integrity (HVCI) running'; Pass = ($dg.Available -and $dg.HvciRunning); Unknown = (-not $dg.Available); Detail = '' }
    $r.iommu = [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'IOMMU / Kernel DMA protection'; Pass = ($dg.Available -and $dg.DmaProtectionAvailable); Unknown = (-not $dg.Available); Detail = 'Win32_DeviceGuard reports DMA protection available' }
    $r.win11 = [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'Windows 11'; Pass = ($os.Build -ge 22000); Unknown = $false; Detail = "build $($os.FullBuild)" }
    $r.win1125h2 = [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'Windows 11 25H2 or newer'; Pass = ($os.Build -ge 26200); Unknown = $false; Detail = "$($os.DisplayVersion), build $($os.FullBuild)" }
    $flags = @()
    if ($boot.TestSigning) { $flags += 'test signing' }
    if ($boot.KernelDebug) { $flags += 'kernel debugging' }
    if ($boot.NoIntegrityCheck) { $flags += 'integrity checks disabled' }
    $r.noTestSign = [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'No test signing / kernel debugging'; Pass = ($flags.Count -eq 0); Unknown = $false; Detail = $(if ($flags.Count) { "Active: $($flags -join ', ')" } else { 'Boot options clean' }) }
    return [pscustomobject]$r
}

function Get-IgwtAntiCheatReadiness {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Requirement results plus a per-anti-cheat matrix and an overall color:
        Green = everything including Vanguard On-Demand passes; Amber = kernel anti-cheats work but
        an optional mode or the 2023 certificates are missing; Red = a hard requirement fails.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param($Requirements)
    if (-not $Requirements) { $Requirements = Get-IgwtAntiCheatRequirements }
    $matrix = foreach ($p in $script:IgwtAntiCheatProfiles) {
        $missing = @(); $unknown = @()
        foreach ($req in $p.Requires) {
            $r = $Requirements.$req
            if ($r.Unknown) { $unknown += $r.Name } elseif (-not $r.Pass) { $missing += $r.Name }
        }
        $status = $(if ($missing.Count) { 'Fail' } elseif ($unknown.Count) { 'Unknown' } else { 'Pass' })
        [pscustomobject]@{ Id = $p.Id; Name = $p.Name; Status = $status; Missing = $missing; Unknown = $unknown; Note = $p.Note }
    }
    $hardFail = @($matrix | Where-Object { $_.Id -in 'faceit', 'vanguard', 'ricochet', 'javelin', 'eacbe' -and $_.Status -eq 'Fail' }).Count -gt 0
    $optionalMiss = @($matrix | Where-Object { $_.Status -ne 'Pass' -and $_.Id -notin 'vac' }).Count -gt 0 -or -not $Requirements.secureBoot2023.Pass
    $overall = $(if ($hardFail) { 'Red' } elseif ($optionalMiss) { 'Amber' } else { 'Green' })
    return [pscustomobject]@{ Overall = $overall; Requirements = $Requirements; Matrix = @($matrix) }
}

function Get-IgwtSecurityPostureChecks {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Defender, firewall, UAC, LSA protection, SmartScreen and BitLocker (read-only). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $checks = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    try {
        $mp = Get-MpComputerStatus -ErrorAction Stop
        $ok = $mp.AMServiceEnabled -and $mp.RealTimeProtectionEnabled
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Defender'; Id = 'defender'; Name = 'Microsoft Defender Antivirus'; Status = $(if ($ok) { 'Pass' } else { 'Fail' })
                Value = "Real-time protection $(if ($mp.RealTimeProtectionEnabled) { 'on' } else { 'off' }), mode $($mp.AMRunningMode)"; Detail = "Engine $($mp.AMEngineVersion)"; Advice = ''; Source = '' })
        $age = [int]$mp.AntivirusSignatureAge
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Defender'; Id = 'signatures'; Name = 'Security intelligence age'; Status = $(if ($age -le 3) { 'Pass' } else { 'Warn' }); Value = "$age day(s)"; Detail = "Version $($mp.AntivirusSignatureVersion)"; Advice = ''; Source = '' })
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Defender'; Id = 'tamper'; Name = 'Tamper Protection'; Status = $(if ($mp.IsTamperProtected) { 'Pass' } else { 'Warn' }); Value = $(if ($mp.IsTamperProtected) { 'On' } else { 'Off' })
                Detail = 'Read-only. iG Windows Tuner never changes Tamper Protection.'; Advice = $(if (-not $mp.IsTamperProtected) { 'Turn it on in Windows Security > Virus & threat protection settings.' } else { '' }); Source = 'https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/prevent-changes-to-security-settings-with-tamper-protection' })
    } catch {
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Defender'; Id = 'defender'; Name = 'Microsoft Defender Antivirus'; Status = 'Unknown'; Value = 'Status unavailable'; Detail = $_.Exception.Message; Advice = ''; Source = '' })
    }
    try {
        $profiles = @(Get-NetFirewallProfile -ErrorAction Stop)
        $off = @($profiles | Where-Object { [string]$_.Enabled -ne 'True' } | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Defender'; Id = 'firewall'; Name = 'Windows Firewall'; Status = $(if ($off.Count -eq 0) { 'Pass' } else { 'Fail' })
                Value = $(if ($off.Count -eq 0) { 'All profiles on' } else { "Off: $($off -join ', ')" }); Detail = (@($profiles | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Name): inbound $($_.DefaultInboundAction)" }) -join '; '); Advice = ''; Source = '' })
        $rules = @(Get-NetFirewallRule -Direction Inbound -Enabled True -Action Allow -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { -not $_.Group -or ([string]$_.Group) -notlike '@*' })
        $names = @($rules | Select-Object -ExpandProperty DisplayName -Unique)
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Defender'; Id = 'fwrules'; Name = 'App-created inbound allow rules'; Status = 'Info'; Value = "$($names.Count) rule(s)"
                Detail = (($names | Select-Object -First 15) -join '; ') + $(if ($names.Count -gt 15) { '; ...' } else { '' }); Advice = 'Review these in Windows Defender Firewall > Inbound Rules and remove rules for apps you no longer use.'; Source = '' })
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'Firewall query failed.' }
    $uac = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($uac) {
        $level = switch ([int]$uac.ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin) { 2 { 'Always notify' } 5 { 'Default (notify for apps)' } 0 { 'Never notify' } default { "ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin=$($uac.ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin)" } }
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Defender'; Id = 'uac'; Name = 'User Account Control'; Status = $(if ([int]$uac.EnableLUA -eq 1 -and [int]$uac.ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin -ne 0) { 'Pass' } else { 'Fail' })
                Value = "$(if ([int]$uac.EnableLUA -eq 1) { 'On' } else { 'OFF' }), $level"; Detail = ''; Advice = ''; Source = '' })
    }
    $lsa = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa' -Name RunAsPPL -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Defender'; Id = 'lsa'; Name = 'LSA protection'; Status = $(if ($lsa -and [int]$lsa.RunAsPPL -in 1, 2) { 'Pass' } else { 'Warn' })
            Value = $(if ($lsa) { "RunAsPPL=$($lsa.RunAsPPL)" } else { 'Not configured' }); Detail = '1 = with UEFI lock, 2 = without UEFI lock.'; Advice = ''; Source = 'https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/security/credentials-protection-and-management/configuring-additional-lsa-protection' })
    $bl = Get-IgwtBitLockerStatus
    $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Defender'; Id = 'bitlocker'; Name = "BitLocker ($env:SystemDrive)"; Status = $(if ($bl.On) { 'Pass' } else { 'Info' }); Value = $bl.Text
            Detail = 'Report only; iG Windows Tuner never enables or suspends BitLocker.'
            Advice = $(if ($bl.On) { 'Make sure the recovery key is backed up (Microsoft account or printed). BIOS updates may ask for it.' } else { 'Optional: turn on BitLocker (Settings > Privacy & security > Device encryption / BitLocker) and back up the recovery key first.' })
            Source = 'https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/back-up-your-bitlocker-recovery-key-e63607b4-77fb-4ad3-8022-d6dc428fbd0d' })
    return $checks.ToArray()
}

function Get-IgwtBitLockerStatus {
    <# .SYNOPSIS BitLocker state of the system drive (Get-BitLockerVolume when elevated, Shell property otherwise). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    if (Test-IgwtIsAdmin) {
        try {
            $v = Get-BitLockerVolume -MountPoint $env:SystemDrive -ErrorAction Stop
            return [pscustomobject]@{ On = ([string]$v.ProtectionStatus -eq 'On'); Text = "Protection $($v.ProtectionStatus), $($v.VolumeStatus), $($v.EncryptionPercentage)%" }
        } catch { Write-Verbose 'Get-BitLockerVolume failed.' }
    }
    try {
        $shell = New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application
        $p = $shell.NameSpace("$env:SystemDrive\").Self.ExtendedProperty('System.Volume.BitLockerProtection')
        $text = switch ([int]$p) { 1 { 'On' } 2 { 'Off' } 3 { 'Encrypting' } 4 { 'Decrypting' } 5 { 'Suspended' } 6 { 'On (locked)' } default { "Unknown ($p)" } }
        return [pscustomobject]@{ On = ([int]$p -in 1, 3, 6); Text = "$text (non-elevated reading)" }
    } catch { return [pscustomobject]@{ On = $false; Text = 'Unknown' } }
}
```

```ps1
# Firmware.ps1
# BIOS/board information and TPM status. Read-only; iG Windows Tuner never touches firmware settings.

function Get-IgwtFirmwareInfo {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $bios = $null; $board = $null
    try { $bios = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_BIOS -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Verbose 'Win32_BIOS unavailable.' }
    try { $board = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_BaseBoard -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Verbose 'Win32_BaseBoard unavailable.' }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        BiosVendor    = $(if ($bios) { $bios.Manufacturer } else { '' })
        BiosVersion   = $(if ($bios) { $bios.SMBIOSBIOSVersion } else { '' })
        BiosDate      = $(if ($bios) { $bios.ReleaseDate } else { $null })
        BoardVendor   = $(if ($board) { $board.Manufacturer } else { '' })
        BoardProduct  = $(if ($board) { $board.Product } else { '' })
    }
}

function Get-IgwtTpmInfo {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        TPM status. Elevated: Get-Tpm (present/ready) plus the spec version from Win32_Tpm.
        Not elevated: presence of the "Trusted Platform Module 2.0" device only.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    if (Test-IgwtIsAdmin) {
        try {
            $t = Get-Tpm -ErrorAction Stop
            $spec = $null
            try { $spec = (Get-CimInstance -Namespace 'root\cimv2\Security\MicrosoftTpm' -ClassName Win32_Tpm -ErrorAction Stop).SpecVersion } catch { $spec = $null }
            $is20 = $false
            if ($spec) { $is20 = ([string]$spec).Split(',')[0].Trim() -like '2.*' }
            return [pscustomobject]@{ Present = [bool]$t.TpmPresent; Ready = [bool]$t.TpmReady; Version20 = $is20; Verified = $true; Detail = "Spec $spec" }
        } catch { Write-Verbose "Get-Tpm failed: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    }
    try {
        $dev = @(Get-PnpDevice -Class SecurityDevices -PresentOnly -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.FriendlyName -like 'Trusted Platform Module*' })
        if ($dev.Count -gt 0) {
            $d = $dev[0]
            return [pscustomobject]@{ Present = $true; Ready = ($d.Status -eq 'OK'); Version20 = ($d.FriendlyName -match '2\.0'); Verified = $false
                Detail = "$($d.FriendlyName), device status $($d.Status) (run elevated for full readiness)" }
        }
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'PnP TPM query failed.' }
    return [pscustomobject]@{ Present = $false; Ready = $false; Version20 = $false; Verified = $false; Detail = 'No TPM device found.' }
}

function Get-IgwtFirmwareChecks {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $fw = Get-IgwtFirmwareInfo
    $tpm = Get-IgwtTpmInfo
    $date = ''
    if ($fw.BiosDate) { $date = $fw.BiosDate.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd') }
    $ageWarn = $fw.BiosDate -and (((Get-Date) - $fw.BiosDate).TotalDays -gt 540)
    @(
        [pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Firmware'; Id = 'bios'; Name = 'BIOS / motherboard'; Status = $(if ($ageWarn) { 'Warn' } else { 'Info' })
            Value = "$($fw.BoardVendor) $($fw.BoardProduct), BIOS $($fw.BiosVersion) ($date)"; Detail = $fw.BiosVendor
            Advice = $(if ($ageWarn) { 'BIOS is older than 18 months; check the board vendor for updates (microcode, Secure Boot keys, stability).' } else { '' }); Source = '' }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Security'; Id = 'tpm'; Name = 'TPM 2.0'; Status = $(if ($tpm.Present -and $tpm.Ready -and $tpm.Version20) { 'Pass' } elseif ($tpm.Present) { 'Warn' } else { 'Fail' })
            Value = $(if ($tpm.Present) { $(if ($tpm.Ready) { 'Present and ready' } else { 'Present, not ready' }) } else { 'Not found' }); Detail = $tpm.Detail
            Advice = $(if (-not $tpm.Present) { 'Enable Intel PTT (Platform Trust Technology) in BIOS.' } else { '' }); Source = 'https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/security/hardware-security/tpm/trusted-platform-module-overview' }
    )
}
```

```ps1
# Gpu.ps1
# GPU driver, Resizable BAR (nvidia-smi BAR1 size, read-only), HAGS state and refresh rate.
# iG Windows Tuner never writes NVIDIA driver profiles.

function Invoke-IgwtNvidiaSmi {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Runs nvidia-smi.exe read-only queries. Returns $null when it is not installed. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string[]]$Arguments)
    if ($script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) { throw 'TestMode safety: nvidia-smi.exe must be mocked in tests.' }
    # Only the read-only query modes (-q and --query-gpu) are permitted.
    if (@($Arguments | Where-Object { $_ -like '--query-gpu*' -or $_ -eq '-q' }).Count -eq 0) { throw 'Only read-only nvidia-smi queries are allowed.' }
    $exe = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\nvidia-smi.exe'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) {
        $alt = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles} 'NVIDIA Corporation\NVSMI\nvidia-smi.exe'
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $alt) { $exe = $alt } else { return $null }
    }
    try { return (& $exe @Arguments 2>$null | Out-String) } catch { return $null }
}

function ConvertFrom-IgwtNvidiaBar1 {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Parses "BAR1 Memory Usage ... Total : 16384 MiB" from nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([AllowEmptyString()][string]$Text)
    $m = [regex]::Match($Text, 'BAR1 Memory Usage\s*[\r\n]+\s*Total\s*:\s*(\d+)\s*MiB')
    if ($m.Success) { return [int]$m.Groups[1].Value }
    return $null
}

function Test-IgwtRefreshRateOk {
    <# .SYNOPSIS True when the current refresh rate is within 2 Hz of the maximum (239.76 Hz reports as 239). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([int]$Current, [int]$Maximum)
    if ($Current -le 0 -or $Maximum -le 0) { return $true }
    return ($Current -ge ($Maximum - 2))
}

function Get-IgwtGpuChecks {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $checks = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $gpus = @()
    try { $gpus = @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_VideoController -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.PNPDeviceID -like 'PCI\*' }) } catch { $gpus = @() }
    foreach ($g in $gpus) {
        $date = ''
        if ($g.DriverDate) { $date = $g.DriverDate.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd') }
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'GPU'; Id = "gpu-$($g.DeviceID)"; Name = 'Graphics adapter'; Status = 'Info'; Value = $g.Name
                Detail = "Driver $($g.DriverVersion) ($date)"; Advice = ''; Source = '' })
        if ($g.CurrentRefreshRate -and $g.MaxRefreshRate) {
            $ok = Test-IgwtRefreshRateOk -Current ([int]$g.CurrentRefreshRate) -Maximum ([int]$g.MaxRefreshRate)
            $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'GPU'; Id = "refresh-$($g.DeviceID)"; Name = 'Refresh rate'; Status = $(if ($ok) { 'Pass' } else { 'Warn' })
                    Value = "$($g.CurrentRefreshRate) Hz (max $($g.MaxRefreshRate) Hz)"; Detail = $g.VideoModeDescription
                    Advice = $(if (-not $ok) { 'Your display runs below its maximum refresh rate. Settings > System > Display > Advanced display > Choose a refresh rate.' } else { '' })
                    Source = 'https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/change-the-refresh-rate-on-your-monitor-in-windows-c8ea729e-0678-015c-c415-f806f04aae5a' })
        }
    }
    $nv = @($gpus | Where-Object { $_.PNPDeviceID -like 'PCI\VEN_10DE*' })
    if ($nv.Count -gt 0) {
        $q = Invoke-IgwtNvidiaSmi -Arguments @('--query-gpu=name,driver_version,pcie.link.gen.max,pcie.link.width.max', '--format=csv,noheader')
        if ($q) {
            $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'GPU'; Id = 'nvsmi'; Name = 'NVIDIA driver (nvidia-smi)'; Status = 'Info'; Value = $q.Trim(); Detail = 'name, driver, max PCIe gen, max PCIe width'; Advice = ''; Source = '' })
        }
        $mem = Invoke-IgwtNvidiaSmi -Arguments @('-q', '-d', 'MEMORY')
        $bar1 = $null
        if ($mem) { $bar1 = ConvertFrom-IgwtNvidiaBar1 -Text $mem }
        if ($null -ne $bar1) {
            $on = $bar1 -gt 256
            $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'GPU'; Id = 'rebar'; Name = 'Resizable BAR'; Status = $(if ($on) { 'Pass' } else { 'Info' }); Value = $(if ($on) { "Enabled (BAR1 $bar1 MiB)" } else { "Disabled (BAR1 $bar1 MiB)" })
                    Detail = 'BAR1 of about the VRAM size means Resizable BAR is active; 256 MiB means it is off.'
                    Advice = $(if (-not $on) { 'Optional: enable "Above 4G Decoding" and "Re-Size BAR Support" in BIOS (Gigabyte: Settings > IO Ports). Gains are game-dependent.' } else { '' })
                    Source = 'https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/news/geforce-rtx-30-series-resizable-bar-support/' })
        }
    }
    $hags = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' -Name HwSchMode -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $hagsText = 'Driver default (not set)'
    if ($hags) { $hagsText = $(switch ([int]$hags.HwSchMode) { 2 { 'On (HwSchMode=2)' } 1 { 'Off (HwSchMode=1)' } default { "HwSchMode=$($hags.HwSchMode)" } }) }
    $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'GPU'; Id = 'hags'; Name = 'Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling'; Status = 'Info'; Value = $hagsText
            Detail = 'Benefit varies by game and GPU; measure frametimes before and after changing it.'; Advice = ''; Source = 'https://devblogs.microsoft.com/directx/hardware-accelerated-gpu-scheduling/' })
    return $checks.ToArray()
}

function Get-IgwtNvidiaGuidance {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Read-only NVIDIA Control Panel / in-game checklist (iG Windows Tuner never writes driver profiles). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    @(
        [pscustomobject]@{ Item = 'NVIDIA Reflex'; Advice = 'Turn on Reflex (On + Boost optional) in each game that supports it. Dota 2, CS2 and VALORANT support Reflex.' }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Item = 'Low Latency Mode'; Advice = 'Use Low Latency Mode On (or Ultra) only for games without Reflex; Reflex overrides it where available.' }

    )
}
```

```ps1
# Hardware.ps1
# OS, CPU (including the 13th/14th-gen Vmin Shift microcode check) and memory. Read-only.

$script:IgwtMicrocodeMinimum = 0x12F
$script:IgwtVminModels = @(183, 191)   # Raptor Lake-S (0xB7) and Raptor Lake-S Refresh (0xBF), family 6

function ConvertFrom-IgwtMicrocodeRevision {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Parses the "Update Revision" REG_BINARY. Older builds store 8 bytes with the revision in the
        high DWORD (bytes 4-7); current builds store 4 bytes (little-endian DWORD).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([long])]
    param([byte[]]$Bytes)
    if (-not $Bytes -or $Bytes.Length -lt 4) { return -1 }
    if ($Bytes.Length -ge 8) {
        $high = [BitConverter]::ToUInt32($Bytes, 4)
        if ($high -ne 0) { return [long]$high }
    }
    return [long][BitConverter]::ToUInt32($Bytes, 0)
}

function Get-IgwtCpuInfo {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $cpu = $null
    try { $cpu = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Processor -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1 } catch { Write-Verbose 'Win32_Processor unavailable.' }
    $reg = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\HARDWARE\DESCRIPTION\System\CentralProcessor\0' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $rev = -1
    if ($reg -and $reg.'Update Revision') { $rev = ConvertFrom-IgwtMicrocodeRevision -Bytes ([byte[]]$reg.'Update Revision') }
    $family = $null; $model = $null; $stepping = $null
    if ($reg -and $reg.Identifier -match 'Family (\d+) Model (\d+) Stepping (\d+)') { $family = [int]$Matches[1]; $model = [int]$Matches[2]; $stepping = [int]$Matches[3] }
    $name = $(if ($cpu) { ($cpu.Name -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim() } elseif ($reg) { $reg.ProcessorNameString } else { 'Unknown CPU' })
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Name              = $name
        Cores             = $(if ($cpu) { [int]$cpu.NumberOfCores } else { $null })
        Threads           = $(if ($cpu) { [int]$cpu.NumberOfLogicalProcessors } else { $null })
        Vendor            = $(if ($reg) { $reg.VendorIdentifier } else { '' })
        Family            = $family
        Model             = $model
        Stepping          = $stepping
        MicrocodeRevision = $rev
        IsVminAffected    = ($family -eq 6 -and $script:IgwtVminModels -contains $model -and $name -match '1[34]th Gen Intel')
        IsHybrid          = ($cpu -and [int]$cpu.NumberOfLogicalProcessors -lt (2 * [int]$cpu.NumberOfCores))
    }
}

function Get-IgwtMemoryInfo {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $modules = @()
    try { $modules = @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PhysicalMemory -ErrorAction Stop) } catch { $modules = @() }
    $total = ($modules | Measure-Object -Property Capacity -Sum).Sum
    $type = 'Unknown'
    $types = @($modules | ForEach-Object { [int]$_.SMBIOSMemoryType } | Select-Object -Unique)
    if ($types -contains 34) { $type = 'DDR5' } elseif ($types -contains 26) { $type = 'DDR4' }
    $configured = @($modules | ForEach-Object { [int]$_.ConfiguredClockSpeed } | Where-Object { $_ -gt 0 } | Sort-Object -Unique)
    $rated = @($modules | ForEach-Object { [int]$_.Speed } | Where-Object { $_ -gt 0 } | Sort-Object -Unique)
    $partRated = $null
    $part = (@($modules | ForEach-Object { ([string]$_.PartNumber).Trim() } | Select-Object -Unique) -join ', ')
    if ($part -match '(?<![0-9])([2-8][0-9])00(?![0-9])') { $partRated = [int]"$($Matches[1])00" }
    elseif ($part -match 'KF[45](\d{2})') { $partRated = [int]"$($Matches[1])00" }   # Kingston FURY: KF556C40 = 5600 MT/s
    [pscustomobject]@{
        TotalGB        = $(if ($total) { [math]::Round($total / 1GB) } else { 0 })
        Modules        = $modules.Count
        Type           = $type
        ConfiguredMTs  = $(if ($configured) { $configured[0] } else { $null })
        ReportedMaxMTs = $(if ($rated) { $rated[-1] } else { $null })
        PartRatedMTs   = $partRated
        PartNumbers    = $part
    }
}

function Get-IgwtHardwareChecks {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $checks = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $os = Get-IgwtOsInfo
    $pending = Get-IgwtPendingReboot
    $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'System'; Id = 'os'; Name = 'Windows'; Status = $(if ($os.Build -ge 26100) { 'Pass' } else { 'Fail' })
            Value = "$($os.Caption) $($os.DisplayVersion) (build $($os.FullBuild))"; Detail = "Edition: $($os.EditionId)"; Advice = $(if ($os.Build -lt 26100) { 'iG Windows Tuner supports Windows 11 24H2 (26100) and newer.' } else { '' }); Source = '' })
    if ($os.Uptime) {
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'System'; Id = 'uptime'; Name = 'Uptime'; Status = 'Info'; Value = ('{0}d {1}h {2}m' -f $os.Uptime.Days, $os.Uptime.Hours, $os.Uptime.Minutes); Detail = "Last boot $($os.LastBootUpTime)"; Advice = ''; Source = '' })
    }
    $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'System'; Id = 'pendingReboot'; Name = 'Pending reboot'; Status = $(if ($pending.Count -gt 0) { 'Warn' } else { 'Pass' })
            Value = $(if ($pending.Count -gt 0) { $pending -join ', ' } else { 'None' }); Detail = ''; Advice = $(if ($pending.Count -gt 0) { 'Reboot before measuring performance or applying changes.' } else { '' }); Source = '' })

    $cpu = Get-IgwtCpuInfo
    $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'CPU'; Id = 'cpu'; Name = 'Processor'; Status = 'Info'; Value = $cpu.Name
            Detail = "$($cpu.Cores) cores / $($cpu.Threads) threads$(if ($cpu.IsHybrid) { ', hybrid (P-cores + E-cores): Thread Director and the Windows scheduler stay in charge' })"; Advice = ''; Source = '' })
    $mcText = $(if ($cpu.MicrocodeRevision -ge 0) { '0x{0:X}' -f $cpu.MicrocodeRevision } else { 'unknown' })
    if ($cpu.IsVminAffected) {
        $ok = $cpu.MicrocodeRevision -ge $script:IgwtMicrocodeMinimum
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'CPU'; Id = 'microcode'; Name = 'CPU microcode (Vmin Shift fix)'; Status = $(if ($ok) { 'Pass' } else { 'Fail' }); Value = $mcText
                Detail = '13th/14th-gen desktop CPUs need microcode 0x12F or newer to prevent Vmin Shift instability (permanent degradation).'
                Advice = $(if ($ok) { 'Keep the BIOS current and use the "Intel Default Settings" profile.' } else { 'Update the motherboard BIOS (Gigabyte: download the latest BIOS for your board) and load the "Intel Default Settings" BIOS profile. iG Windows Tuner never changes firmware, voltages or power limits.' })
                Source = 'https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/articles/000102331/processors.html' })
    } else {
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'CPU'; Id = 'microcode'; Name = 'CPU microcode'; Status = 'Info'; Value = $mcText; Detail = 'Not a 13th/14th-gen desktop CPU affected by Vmin Shift.'; Advice = ''; Source = '' })
    }

    $mem = Get-IgwtMemoryInfo
    $memStatus = 'Pass'
    $memAdvice = ''
    $rated = $mem.PartRatedMTs
    if (-not $rated) { $rated = $mem.ReportedMaxMTs }
    if ($mem.ConfiguredMTs -and $rated -and $mem.ConfiguredMTs -lt ($rated - 100)) {
        $memStatus = 'Warn'
        $memAdvice = "Memory runs at $($mem.ConfiguredMTs) MT/s but the kit is rated $rated MT/s. Enable XMP in BIOS if you want rated speed (validate stability). iG Windows Tuner never changes memory settings."
    }
    $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Memory'; Id = 'memory'; Name = 'Memory'; Status = $memStatus
            Value = "$($mem.TotalGB) GB $($mem.Type), $($mem.Modules) module(s), configured $($mem.ConfiguredMTs) MT/s"
            Detail = "Reported max $($mem.ReportedMaxMTs) MT/s; part number(s) $($mem.PartNumbers)"; Advice = $memAdvice; Source = '' })
    return $checks.ToArray()
}
```

```ps1
# Network.ps1
# Active wired adapter, link speed, EEE/interrupt moderation/RSS state, DNS and DoH. Read-only.

function Get-IgwtNetworkChecks {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $checks = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $wired = @(Get-IgwtActiveWiredAdapter)
    if ($wired.Count -eq 0) {
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Network'; Id = 'nic'; Name = 'Wired adapter'; Status = 'Warn'; Value = 'No active wired adapter'; Detail = 'Competitive play is best on a wired connection.'; Advice = 'Use Ethernet (Cat5e or better).'; Source = '' })
    }
    foreach ($a in $wired) {
        $bps = [double]$a.ReceiveLinkSpeed
        $speedText = [string]$a.LinkSpeed
        $status = 'Pass'
        $advice = ''
        if ($bps -gt 0 -and $bps -le 100000000) {
            $status = 'Warn'
            $advice = 'Link negotiated at 100 Mbps or less: usually a damaged cable, a 2-pair cable, or a bad port. Try another Cat5e/Cat6 cable and router port.'
        }
        $drvDate = ''
        if ($a.DriverDate) { $drvDate = ([datetime]$a.DriverDate).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd') }
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Network'; Id = "nic-$($a.ifIndex)"; Name = 'Wired adapter'; Status = $status; Value = "$($a.InterfaceDescription) at $speedText"
                Detail = "Name '$($a.Name)', driver $($a.DriverVersionString) ($drvDate)"; Advice = $advice; Source = '' })
        $props = @()
        try { $props = @(Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $a.Name -AllProperties -ErrorAction Stop) } catch { $props = @() }
        foreach ($kw in @(@{ K = '*EEE'; N = 'Energy Efficient Ethernet'; Want = '0' }, @{ K = '*InterruptModeration'; N = 'Interrupt moderation'; Want = $null }, @{ K = '*RSS'; N = 'Receive Side Scaling'; Want = '1' })) {
            $p = $props | Where-Object { $_.RegistryKeyword -eq $kw.K } | Select-Object -First 1
            if (-not $p) { continue }
            $val = [string](@($p.RegistryValue)[0])
            $st = 'Info'
            if ($kw.Want) { $st = $(if ($val -eq $kw.Want) { 'Pass' } else { 'Warn' }) }
            $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Network'; Id = "nic-$($a.ifIndex)-$($kw.K)"; Name = $kw.N; Status = $st; Value = "$($p.DisplayValue) ($($kw.K)=$val)"; Detail = $a.Name; Advice = ''; Source = '' })
        }
        $cfg = Get-IgwtDnsInterfaceConfig -Adapter $a
        $private = @($cfg.V4 | Where-Object { $_ -match '^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\.)' })
        $dnsDetail = $(if ($cfg.Static4) { 'Static' } else { 'From DHCP' })
        if ($private.Count -gt 0) { $dnsDetail += '; the resolver is your router (local DNS). Encrypted DNS would bypass router-side filtering and local host names.' }
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Network'; Id = "dns-$($a.ifIndex)"; Name = 'DNS servers'; Status = 'Info'; Value = (@($cfg.V4 + $cfg.V6) -join ', '); Detail = $dnsDetail; Advice = ''; Source = '' })
    }
    try {
        $tcp = Get-NetTCPSetting -SettingName Internet -ErrorAction Stop
        $ok = [string]$tcp.AutoTuningLevelLocal -eq 'Normal'
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Network'; Id = 'autotuning'; Name = 'TCP receive window auto-tuning'; Status = $(if ($ok) { 'Pass' } else { 'Warn' }); Value = [string]$tcp.AutoTuningLevelLocal
                Detail = 'Normal is the Windows default; "Disabled" (an old tweak) caps download throughput.'; Advice = $(if (-not $ok) { 'Apply "TCP auto-tuning normal" in iG Windows Tuner (Network).' } else { '' }); Source = 'https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/nettcpip/set-nettcpsetting' })
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'Get-NetTCPSetting failed.' }
    $wifi = @(Get-IgwtWifiAdapter)
    foreach ($w in $wifi) {
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Network'; Id = "wifi-$($w.ifIndex)"; Name = 'Wi-Fi adapter'; Status = 'Info'; Value = "$($w.InterfaceDescription): $($w.Status)"; Detail = 'Unused radios can be disabled (Network > Disable unused Wi-Fi adapter).'; Advice = ''; Source = '' })
    }
    return $checks.ToArray()
}
```

```ps1
# Report.ps1
# Aggregates every read-only health check into one report; console, HTML and JSON output.

function Get-IgwtHardwareSummary {
    <# .SYNOPSIS One-line hardware summary for the GUI header and the report title. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $cpu = Get-IgwtCpuInfo
    $mem = Get-IgwtMemoryInfo
    $os = Get-IgwtOsInfo
    $gpu = ''
    try { $gpu = (@(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_VideoController -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.PNPDeviceID -like 'PCI\*' } | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }) -join ' + ') } catch { $gpu = '' }
    $cpuShort = ($cpu.Name -replace '\(R\)|\(TM\)|CPU|Processor|\d+th Gen ', '' -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Cpu   = $cpuShort
        Gpu   = $gpu
        Memory = "$($mem.TotalGB) GB $($mem.Type)-$($mem.ConfiguredMTs)"
        Os    = "$($os.Caption -replace 'Microsoft ', '') $($os.DisplayVersion) ($($os.FullBuild))"
        Text  = "$cpuShort | $gpu | $($mem.TotalGB) GB $($mem.Type)-$($mem.ConfiguredMTs) | $($os.Caption -replace 'Microsoft ', '') $($os.DisplayVersion) ($($os.FullBuild))"
    }
}

function Get-IgwtRecommendations {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    @(
        [pscustomobject]@{ Title = 'Test bufferbloat on your router'; Text = 'Run a bufferbloat test (for example the Waveform bufferbloat test) while the line is loaded. If latency rises a lot under load, enable SQM / Smart Queue (CAKE or fq_codel) on the router. This usually matters more for online play than any Windows setting.'; Source = 'https://www.waveform.com/tools/bufferbloat' }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Title = 'Keep the BIOS current'; Text = 'BIOS updates carry CPU microcode (13th/14th-gen Vmin Shift fix 0x12F+), Secure Boot key updates and memory compatibility fixes.'; Source = '' }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Title = 'Use the Intel Default Settings profile'; Text = 'On 13th/14th-gen Intel CPUs, load the "Intel Default Settings" profile in BIOS for safe power limits and current limits.'; Source = 'https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/articles/000102331/processors.html' }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Title = 'Turn on NVIDIA Reflex in game'; Text = 'Reflex lowers render latency more than any OS tweak. Dota 2, CS2 and VALORANT support it.'; Source = 'https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/technologies/reflex/' }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Title = 'Measure, do not guess'; Text = 'Capture frametimes (PresentMon or CapFrameX), DPC latency (LatencyMon) and ping/jitter before and after changes. See docs\TESTING.md.'; Source = 'https://github.com/GameTechDev/PresentMon' }
    )
}

function Get-IgwtHealthReport {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Runs every read-only health check. Never changes anything.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $checks = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $sections = @(
        @{ Name = 'Hardware'; Block = { Get-IgwtHardwareChecks } }
        @{ Name = 'Firmware'; Block = { Get-IgwtFirmwareChecks } }
        @{ Name = 'SecureBoot'; Block = { Get-IgwtSecureBootChecks } }
        @{ Name = 'Vbs'; Block = { Get-IgwtVbsChecks } }
        @{ Name = 'Gpu'; Block = { Get-IgwtGpuChecks } }
        @{ Name = 'Network'; Block = { Get-IgwtNetworkChecks } }
        @{ Name = 'Storage'; Block = { Get-IgwtStorageChecks } }
        @{ Name = 'Security'; Block = { Get-IgwtSecurityPostureChecks } }
    )
    foreach ($s in $sections) {
        try { foreach ($c in @(& $s.Block)) { if ($c) { $checks.Add($c) } } }
        catch { $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = $s.Name; Id = "error-$($s.Name)"; Name = "$($s.Name) checks"; Status = 'Unknown'; Value = 'Error'; Detail = $_.Exception.Message; Advice = ''; Source = '' }) }
    }
    $ac = Get-IgwtAntiCheatReadiness
    $games = @()
    try { $games = @(Get-IgwtInstalledGames) } catch { $games = @() }
    $hardware = $null
    try {
        $hp = Get-IgwtHardwareProfile
        $hardware = [pscustomobject]@{
            Tags     = @($hp.TagDetails)
            Overlays = @(Get-IgwtActiveOverlays -Tags @($hp.Tags) | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Id = [string]$_.id; Name = [string]$_.name; Tags = @($_.MatchedTags); Hint = [string]$_.hint; Guidance = @($_.guidance | Where-Object { $_ }); Sources = @($_.sources) } })
        }
    } catch { Write-Verbose "Hardware profile unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    $security = $null
    try { $security = Get-IgwtSecurityScore } catch { Write-Verbose "Security score unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Generated       = (Get-Date).ToString('o')
        Tool            = "iG Windows Tuner $script:IgwtVersion"
        Computer        = $env:COMPUTERNAME
        Elevated        = (Test-IgwtIsAdmin)
        Summary         = (Get-IgwtHardwareSummary)
        Hardware        = $hardware
        Checks          = $checks.ToArray()
        AntiCheat       = $ac
        Security        = $security
        Games           = $games
        NvidiaGuidance  = @(Get-IgwtNvidiaGuidance)
        Recommendations = @(Get-IgwtRecommendations)
    }
}

function Format-IgwtHealthReport {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Plain-text rendering of the health report for the console. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Report)
    $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
    $line = '-' * 78
    $null = $sb.AppendLine("iG Windows Tuner health report  ($($Report.Tool), $($Report.Generated))")
    $null = $sb.AppendLine($Report.Summary.Text)
    if (-not $Report.Elevated) { $null = $sb.AppendLine('Note: not elevated - TPM readiness, Secure Boot databases, disk counters and BitLocker details are limited.') }
    $null = $sb.AppendLine($line)
    if ($Report.Hardware) {
        $null = $sb.AppendLine('[Hardware profile]')
        $null = $sb.AppendLine('  Tags: ' + (@($Report.Hardware.Tags | ForEach-Object { $_.Id }) -join ', '))
        foreach ($t in $Report.Hardware.Tags) { $null = $sb.AppendLine(('    {0,-26} {1}' -f $t.Id, $t.Name)) }
        if (@($Report.Hardware.Overlays).Count) { $null = $sb.AppendLine('  Hardware overlays (adjust presets on this PC):') }
        foreach ($o in $Report.Hardware.Overlays) {
            $null = $sb.AppendLine("    - $($o.Name): $($o.Hint)")
            foreach ($g in $o.Guidance) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("        -> $g") }
        }
        $null = $sb.AppendLine($line)
    }
    foreach ($group in ($Report.Checks | Group-Object Section)) {
        $null = $sb.AppendLine("[$($group.Name)]")
        foreach ($c in $group.Group) {
            $null = $sb.AppendLine(('  {0,-8} {1}: {2}' -f "[$($c.Status.ToUpperInvariant())]", $c.Name, $c.Value))
            if ($c.Detail) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("           $($c.Detail)") }
            if ($c.Advice) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("           -> $($c.Advice)") }
        }
    }
    $null = $sb.AppendLine($line)
    $null = $sb.AppendLine("Anti-cheat readiness: $($Report.AntiCheat.Overall.ToUpperInvariant())")
    foreach ($k in $Report.AntiCheat.Requirements.PSObject.Properties) {
        $r = $k.Value
        $st = $(if ($r.Unknown) { 'UNKNOWN' } elseif ($r.Pass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' })
        $null = $sb.AppendLine(('  {0,-9} {1}{2}' -f "[$st]", $r.Name, $(if ($r.Detail) { " ($($r.Detail))" } else { '' })))
    }
    foreach ($m in $Report.AntiCheat.Matrix) {
        $extra = ''
        if ($m.Missing.Count) { $extra = " - missing: $($m.Missing -join ', ')" } elseif ($m.Unknown.Count) { $extra = " - unverified: $($m.Unknown -join ', ')" }
        $null = $sb.AppendLine(('  {0,-9} {1}{2}' -f "[$($m.Status.ToUpperInvariant())]", $m.Name, $extra))
    }
    $null = $sb.AppendLine($line)
    if ($Report.Security) {
        $null = $sb.AppendLine("Security score: $($Report.Security.Score)/100 ($($Report.Security.Grade))")
        if (@($Report.Security.ToFix).Count -eq 0) { $null = $sb.AppendLine('  Nothing to fix.') }
        foreach ($c in @($Report.Security.ToFix)) {
            $route = switch ($c.Fix) { 'Tweak' { "catalog item $($c.Target)" } 'AsrCenter' { 'ASR Center (-Asr)' } default { $c.Target } }
            $null = $sb.AppendLine(('  {0,-9} {1}: {2} -> {3}' -f "[$($c.Status.ToUpperInvariant())]", $c.Name, $c.Value, $route))
        }
        $null = $sb.AppendLine($line)
    }
    $null = $sb.AppendLine('Detected games: ' + $(if ($Report.Games.Count) { (@($Report.Games | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Name) [$($_.AntiCheat)]" }) -join ', ') } else { 'none' }))
    $null = $sb.AppendLine('NVIDIA checklist (read-only):')
    foreach ($n in $Report.NvidiaGuidance) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("  - $($n.Item): $($n.Advice)") }
    $null = $sb.AppendLine('Outside Windows:')
    foreach ($r in $Report.Recommendations) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("  - $($r.Title): $($r.Text)") }
    return $sb.ToString()
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlText {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([AllowNull()][AllowEmptyString()][string]$Text)
    if ($null -eq $Text) { return '' }
    return [System.Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($Text)
}

function Export-IgwtHealthReport {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Writes the health report as a self-contained HTML file (inline CSS, no scripts) or JSON.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Report, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path, [ValidateSet('Html', 'Json')][string]$Format = 'Html')
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Path, "Write $Format report")) { return }
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if ($dir -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force }
    if ($Format -eq 'Json') {
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $Report -Depth 10), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
        return $Path
    }
    $e = { param($t) ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlText $t }
    $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
    $null = $sb.Append(@'
<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>iG Windows Tuner health report</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#f7f7f8;--fg:#1b1b1f;--card:#fff;--muted:#5d5d66;--line:#e2e2e6;--pass:#107c10;--warn:#9d5d00;--fail:#c42b1c;--info:#005fb8}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--bg:#1c1c1c;--fg:#f3f3f3;--card:#2b2b2b;--muted:#b0b0b8;--line:#3a3a3a;--pass:#6ccb5f;--warn:#fce100;--fail:#ff99a4;--info:#60cdff}}
body{font-family:"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);margin:0;padding:16px}
main{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto}h1{font-size:1.5rem;margin:.2rem 0}h2{font-size:1.1rem;margin:1.4rem 0 .5rem}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;margin:8px 0}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}td,th{text-align:left;padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top}
.s{font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}.Pass{color:var(--pass)}.Warn,.Amber,.Unknown{color:var(--warn)}.Fail,.Red{color:var(--fail)}.Info{color:var(--info)}.Green{color:var(--pass)}
.muted{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9em}.adv{font-size:.92em}
</style></head><body><main>
'@)
    $null = $sb.Append("<h1>iG Windows Tuner health report</h1><p class='muted'>$(& $e $Report.Tool) &middot; $(& $e $Report.Generated) &middot; $(& $e $Report.Computer)$(if (-not $Report.Elevated) { ' &middot; not elevated (some checks limited)' })</p>")
    $null = $sb.Append("<div class='card'>$(& $e $Report.Summary.Text)</div>")
    if ($Report.Hardware) {
        $null = $sb.Append("<h2>Hardware profile</h2><div class='card'><table><tr><th>Tag</th><th>Meaning</th></tr>")
        foreach ($t in $Report.Hardware.Tags) { $null = $sb.Append("<tr><td class='s Info'>$(& $e $t.Id)</td><td><b>$(& $e $t.Name)</b><div class='muted'>$(& $e $t.Hint)</div></td></tr>") }
        $null = $sb.Append('</table></div>')
        if (@($Report.Hardware.Overlays).Count) {
            $null = $sb.Append("<div class='card'><table><tr><th>Hardware overlay</th><th>Effect</th></tr>")
            foreach ($o in $Report.Hardware.Overlays) {
                $g = (@($o.Guidance | ForEach-Object { "<div class='adv'>&rarr; $(& $e $_)</div>" }) -join '')
                $src = (@($o.Sources | ForEach-Object { " <a href='$(& $e $_)'>source</a>" }) -join '')
                $null = $sb.Append("<tr><td><b>$(& $e $o.Name)</b><div class='muted'>$(& $e (@($o.Tags) -join ', '))</div></td><td>$(& $e $o.Hint)$src$g</td></tr>")
            }
            $null = $sb.Append('</table></div>')
        }
    }
    $null = $sb.Append("<h2>Anti-cheat readiness: <span class='$($Report.AntiCheat.Overall)'>$($Report.AntiCheat.Overall)</span></h2><div class='card'><table><tr><th>Requirement</th><th>Result</th><th>Detail</th></tr>")
    foreach ($k in $Report.AntiCheat.Requirements.PSObject.Properties) {
        $r = $k.Value
        $st = $(if ($r.Unknown) { 'Unknown' } elseif ($r.Pass) { 'Pass' } else { 'Fail' })
        $null = $sb.Append("<tr><td>$(& $e $r.Name)</td><td class='s $st'>$st</td><td class='muted'>$(& $e $r.Detail)</td></tr>")
    }
    $null = $sb.Append('</table></div><div class="card"><table><tr><th>Anti-cheat</th><th>Result</th><th>Notes</th></tr>')
    foreach ($m in $Report.AntiCheat.Matrix) {
        $note = $m.Note
        if ($m.Missing.Count) { $note = "Missing: $($m.Missing -join ', '). $note" }
        $null = $sb.Append("<tr><td>$(& $e $m.Name)</td><td class='s $($m.Status)'>$($m.Status)</td><td class='muted'>$(& $e $note)</td></tr>")
    }
    $null = $sb.Append('</table></div>')
    if ($Report.Security) {
        $sc = $Report.Security
        $cls = $(if ($sc.Score -ge 90) { 'Pass' } elseif ($sc.Score -ge 75) { 'Info' } elseif ($sc.Score -ge 50) { 'Warn' } else { 'Fail' })
        $null = $sb.Append("<h2>Security score: <span class='$cls'>$($sc.Score)/100 ($(& $e $sc.Grade))</span></h2><div class='card'><table><tr><th>Result</th><th>Check</th><th>Fix</th></tr>")
        foreach ($c in @($sc.Checks)) {
            $route = switch ($c.Fix) { 'Tweak' { "Catalog item $($c.Target)" } 'AsrCenter' { 'ASR Center' } 'None' { '' } default { $c.Target } }
            $null = $sb.Append("<tr><td class='s $($c.Status)'>$(& $e $c.Status)</td><td><b>$(& $e $c.Name)</b>: $(& $e $c.Value)<div class='muted'>$(& $e $c.Hint)</div></td><td class='muted'>$(if ($c.Status -in 'Fail', 'Warn') { & $e $route })</td></tr>")
        }
        $null = $sb.Append('</table></div>')
    }
    foreach ($group in ($Report.Checks | Group-Object Section)) {
        $null = $sb.Append("<h2>$(& $e $group.Name)</h2><div class='card'><table>")
        foreach ($c in $group.Group) {
            $adv = ''
            if ($c.Advice) { $adv = "<div class='adv'>&rarr; $(& $e $c.Advice)</div>" }
            $src = ''
            if ($c.Source) { $src = " <a href='$(& $e $c.Source)'>source</a>" }
            $null = $sb.Append("<tr><td class='s $($c.Status)'>$($c.Status)</td><td><b>$(& $e $c.Name)</b>: $(& $e $c.Value)<div class='muted'>$(& $e $c.Detail)$src</div>$adv</td></tr>")
        }
        $null = $sb.Append('</table></div>')
    }
    $null = $sb.Append("<h2>NVIDIA checklist (read-only)</h2><div class='card'><ul>")
    foreach ($n in $Report.NvidiaGuidance) { $null = $sb.Append("<li><b>$(& $e $n.Item)</b>: $(& $e $n.Advice)</li>") }
    $null = $sb.Append("</ul></div><h2>Outside Windows</h2><div class='card'><ul>")
    foreach ($r in $Report.Recommendations) {
        $src = ''
        if ($r.Source) { $src = " <a href='$(& $e $r.Source)'>link</a>" }
        $null = $sb.Append("<li><b>$(& $e $r.Title)</b>: $(& $e $r.Text)$src</li>")
    }
    $null = $sb.Append('</ul></div></main></body></html>')
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $sb.ToString(), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    return $Path
}
```
