```ps1
# SecureBoot.ps1
# Secure Boot state and the 2023 certificate rollout (Microsoft Windows Production PCA 2011 expires
# 19 Oct 2026). Read-only: iG Windows Tuner never triggers certificate deployment (AvailableUpdates).

$script:IgwtPca2011Expiry = [datetime]'2026-10-19'

function Get-IgwtSecureBootInfo {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $state = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecureBoot\State' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $svc = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecureBoot\Servicing' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $enabled = $null
    if ($state -and $null -ne $state.UEFISecureBootEnabled) { $enabled = ([int]$state.UEFISecureBootEnabled -eq 1) }
    $dbHas2023 = $null; $kekHas2023 = $null; $verified = $false
    if (Test-IgwtIsAdmin) {
        try { if ($null -eq $enabled) { $enabled = [bool](Confirm-SecureBootUEFI -ErrorAction Stop) } } catch { Write-Verbose 'Confirm-SecureBootUEFI failed.' }
        try {
            $db = Get-SecureBootUEFI -Name db -ErrorAction Stop
            $dbHas2023 = ([System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($db.Bytes) -match 'Windows UEFI CA 2023')
            $kek = Get-SecureBootUEFI -Name KEK -ErrorAction Stop
            $kekHas2023 = ([System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($kek.Bytes) -match 'KEK 2K CA 2023')
            $verified = $true
        } catch { Write-Verbose "Get-SecureBootUEFI failed: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Enabled         = $enabled
        CA2023Status    = $(if ($svc) { [string]$svc.UEFICA2023Status } else { '' })
        CA2023Capable   = $(if ($svc -and $null -ne $svc.WindowsUEFICA2023Capable) { [int]$svc.WindowsUEFICA2023Capable } else { $null })
        CA2023Error     = $(if ($svc -and $null -ne $svc.UEFICA2023Error) { [int]$svc.UEFICA2023Error } else { $null })
        DbHas2023       = $dbHas2023
        KekHas2023      = $kekHas2023
        DatabaseChecked = $verified
    }
}

function Get-IgwtSecureBootChecks {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $sb = Get-IgwtSecureBootInfo
    $daysLeft = [int][math]::Ceiling(($script:IgwtPca2011Expiry - (Get-Date)).TotalDays)
    $certOk = ($sb.CA2023Status -eq 'Updated') -or ($sb.DbHas2023 -and $sb.KekHas2023)
    $detail = "Servicing status: $(if ($sb.CA2023Status) { $sb.CA2023Status } else { 'not reported' })"
    if ($null -ne $sb.CA2023Capable) { $detail += "; WindowsUEFICA2023Capable=$($sb.CA2023Capable) (2 = booting the 2023-signed boot manager)" }
    if ($sb.DatabaseChecked) { $detail += "; db has 'Windows UEFI CA 2023': $($sb.DbHas2023); KEK has 'KEK 2K CA 2023': $($sb.KekHas2023)" }
    else { $detail += '; db/KEK contents need an elevated run to read' }
    if ($sb.CA2023Error) { $detail += "; UEFICA2023Error=$($sb.CA2023Error)" }
    $expiryText = $(if ($daysLeft -gt 0) { "Microsoft Windows Production PCA 2011 expires 19 Oct 2026 ($daysLeft day(s) left)." } else { 'Microsoft Windows Production PCA 2011 expired on 19 Oct 2026.' })
    @(
        [pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Security'; Id = 'secureBoot'; Name = 'Secure Boot'; Status = $(if ($sb.Enabled -eq $true) { 'Pass' } elseif ($null -eq $sb.Enabled) { 'Unknown' } else { 'Fail' })
            Value = $(if ($sb.Enabled -eq $true) { 'On' } elseif ($null -eq $sb.Enabled) { 'Unknown' } else { 'Off' }); Detail = 'Required by FACEIT AC, Riot Vanguard (Windows 11), Call of Duty and Battlefield 6.'
            Advice = $(if ($sb.Enabled -ne $true) { 'Enable Secure Boot in BIOS (requires UEFI boot mode, CSM off, and a GPT system disk).' } else { '' })
            Source = 'https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-hardware/design/device-experiences/oem-secure-boot' }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Security'; Id = 'secureBoot2023'; Name = 'Secure Boot 2023 certificates'; Status = $(if ($certOk) { 'Pass' } elseif ($sb.CA2023Status -eq 'InProgress') { 'Warn' } else { 'Fail' })
            Value = $(if ($certOk) { 'Applied' } elseif ($sb.CA2023Status) { $sb.CA2023Status } else { 'Not applied' }); Detail = "$detail. $expiryText"
            Advice = $(if ($certOk) { '' } else { 'Open Windows Security > Device security > Secure Boot and follow the update prompt; install the latest cumulative update and BIOS. iG Windows Tuner does not deploy certificates itself.' })
            Source = 'https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/topic/registry-key-updates-for-secure-boot-windows-devices-with-it-managed-updates-a7be69c9-4634-42e1-9ca1-df06f43f360d' }
    )
}
```

```ps1
# Storage.ps1
# Disk model/bus/health, reliability counters (elevated), TRIM state and free space. Read-only.

function Get-IgwtStorageChecks {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $checks = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $disks = @()
    try { $disks = @(Get-PhysicalDisk -ErrorAction Stop) } catch { $disks = @() }
    foreach ($d in $disks) {
        $rel = $null
        if (Test-IgwtIsAdmin) { try { $rel = $d | Get-StorageReliabilityCounter -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $rel = $null } }
        $detail = "$($d.BusType) $($d.MediaType), $([math]::Round($d.Size / 1GB)) GB"
        $status = $(if ([string]$d.HealthStatus -eq 'Healthy') { 'Pass' } else { 'Warn' })
        if ($rel) {
            if ($null -ne $rel.Wear) { $detail += ", wear $($rel.Wear)%" ; if ([int]$rel.Wear -ge 80) { $status = 'Warn' } }
            if ($null -ne $rel.Temperature -and [int]$rel.Temperature -gt 0) { $detail += ", $($rel.Temperature) C" }
            if ($rel.ReadErrorsUncorrected) { $detail += ", uncorrected read errors $($rel.ReadErrorsUncorrected)"; $status = 'Warn' }
        } else { $detail += ' (reliability counters need an elevated run)' }
        $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Storage'; Id = "disk-$($d.DeviceId)"; Name = 'Disk'; Status = $status; Value = "$($d.FriendlyName): $($d.HealthStatus)"; Detail = $detail; Advice = ''; Source = '' })
    }
    $trim = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem' -Name DisableDeleteNotification -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $trimOn = (-not $trim) -or ([int]$trim.DisableDeleteNotification -eq 0)
    $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Storage'; Id = 'trim'; Name = 'TRIM'; Status = $(if ($trimOn) { 'Pass' } else { 'Warn' }); Value = $(if ($trimOn) { 'Enabled' } else { 'Disabled' })
            Detail = 'DisableDeleteNotification = 0 means TRIM is sent to SSDs.'; Advice = $(if (-not $trimOn) { 'Re-enable TRIM (fsutil behavior set DisableDeleteNotify 0) from an elevated prompt.' } else { '' }); Source = 'https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/administration/windows-commands/fsutil-behavior' })
    try {
        foreach ($v in @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter 'DriveType=3' -ErrorAction Stop)) {
            if (-not $v.Size) { continue }
            $pct = [math]::Round(100 * $v.FreeSpace / $v.Size)
            $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Storage'; Id = "vol-$($v.DeviceID)"; Name = "Free space ($($v.DeviceID))"; Status = $(if ($pct -lt 10) { 'Warn' } else { 'Pass' })
                    Value = "$([math]::Round($v.FreeSpace / 1GB)) GB free of $([math]::Round($v.Size / 1GB)) GB ($pct%)"; Detail = ''; Advice = $(if ($pct -lt 10) { 'Keep at least 10-15% free on SSDs for consistent write performance.' } else { '' }); Source = '' })
        }
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'Win32_LogicalDisk failed.' }
    return $checks.ToArray()
}
```

```ps1
# Vbs.ps1
# Virtualization-based security, memory integrity (HVCI), kernel stack protection and DMA
# protection from Win32_DeviceGuard (documented values, see learn.microsoft.com
# "Enable memory integrity" > "Validate enabled VBS and memory integrity features").

function Get-IgwtDeviceGuardInfo {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Parsed Win32_DeviceGuard. Available = $false when the class cannot be queried. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    try {
        $dg = Get-CimInstance -Namespace 'root\Microsoft\Windows\DeviceGuard' -ClassName Win32_DeviceGuard -ErrorAction Stop
    } catch {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Available = $false; VbsStatus = $null; HvciRunning = $false; HvciConfigured = $false; CredentialGuardRunning = $false;
            KernelShadowStacksRunning = $false; DmaProtectionAvailable = $false; SecureBootAvailable = $false; HypervisorAvailable = $false; MbecAvailable = $false; Error = $_.Exception.Message }
    }
    $avail = @($dg.AvailableSecurityProperties | ForEach-Object { [int]$_ })
    $running = @($dg.SecurityServicesRunning | ForEach-Object { [int]$_ })
    $configured = @($dg.SecurityServicesConfigured | ForEach-Object { [int]$_ })
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Available                 = $true
        VbsStatus                 = [int]$dg.VirtualizationBasedSecurityStatus   # 0 off, 1 enabled not running, 2 running
        HvciRunning               = ($running -contains 2)
        HvciConfigured            = ($configured -contains 2)
        CredentialGuardRunning    = ($running -contains 1)
        KernelShadowStacksRunning = ($running -contains 5)
        HvptRunning               = ($running -contains 7)
        DmaProtectionAvailable    = ($avail -contains 3)
        SecureBootAvailable       = ($avail -contains 2)
        HypervisorAvailable       = ($avail -contains 1)
        MbecAvailable             = ($avail -contains 7)
        CodeIntegrityPolicy       = [int]$dg.CodeIntegrityPolicyEnforcementStatus
        Error                     = $null
    }
}

function Get-IgwtBootFlags {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Read-only view of the boot options Windows started with (HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control
        SystemStartOptions). Detects test signing, kernel debugging and disabled integrity checks
        without ever touching BCD.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([string]$StartOptions)
    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('StartOptions')) {
        try { $StartOptions = [string](Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control' -Name SystemStartOptions -ErrorAction Stop).SystemStartOptions } catch { $StartOptions = '' }
    }
    $tokens = @($StartOptions.Trim() -split '\s+' | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { $_.ToUpperInvariant() })
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Raw              = $StartOptions
        TestSigning      = ($tokens -contains 'TESTSIGNING')
        KernelDebug      = (@($tokens | Where-Object { $_ -eq 'DEBUG' -or $_ -like 'DEBUGPORT=*' -or $_ -like 'DEBUG=*' }).Count -gt 0)
        NoIntegrityCheck = ($tokens -contains 'DISABLE_INTEGRITY_CHECKS')
    }
}

function Get-IgwtVbsChecks {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $dg = Get-IgwtDeviceGuardInfo
    $src = 'https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/security/hardware-security/enable-virtualization-based-protection-of-code-integrity'
    if (-not $dg.Available) {
        return @([pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Security'; Id = 'vbs'; Name = 'Virtualization-based security'; Status = 'Unknown'; Value = 'unavailable'; Detail = $dg.Error; Advice = ''; Source = $src })
    }
    $vbsText = switch ($dg.VbsStatus) { 0 { 'Off' } 1 { 'Enabled, not running' } 2 { 'Running' } default { "Status $($dg.VbsStatus)" } }
    @(
        [pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Security'; Id = 'vbs'; Name = 'Virtualization-based security (VBS)'; Status = $(if ($dg.VbsStatus -eq 2) { 'Pass' } else { 'Fail' }); Value = $vbsText
            Detail = 'Required by FACEIT AC (for IOMMU) and Vanguard On-Demand.'; Advice = $(if ($dg.VbsStatus -ne 2) { 'Enable virtualization (Intel VT-x/VT-d) in BIOS and turn on Memory integrity in Windows Security.' } else { '' }); Source = $src }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Security'; Id = 'hvci'; Name = 'Memory integrity (HVCI)'; Status = $(if ($dg.HvciRunning) { 'Pass' } elseif ($dg.HvciConfigured) { 'Warn' } else { 'Fail' })
            Value = $(if ($dg.HvciRunning) { 'Running' } elseif ($dg.HvciConfigured) { 'Configured, not running (reboot?)' } else { 'Off' }); Detail = 'Required by Vanguard On-Demand; keep it on.'; Advice = ''; Source = $src }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Security'; Id = 'iommu'; Name = 'IOMMU / DMA protection available'; Status = $(if ($dg.DmaProtectionAvailable) { 'Pass' } else { 'Warn' })
            Value = $(if ($dg.DmaProtectionAvailable) { 'Available' } else { 'Not reported' }); Detail = 'Win32_DeviceGuard AvailableSecurityProperties contains 3 (DMA protection). msinfo32 shows "Kernel DMA Protection" for confirmation.'
            Advice = $(if (-not $dg.DmaProtectionAvailable) { 'Enable Intel VT-d in BIOS (Gigabyte: Settings > Miscellaneous > Intel VT-d Technology).' } else { '' }); Source = $src }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Section = 'Security'; Id = 'kss'; Name = 'Kernel-mode hardware-enforced stack protection'; Status = 'Info'; Value = $(if ($dg.KernelShadowStacksRunning) { 'Running' } else { 'Off' })
            Detail = 'Optional extra protection; some older anti-cheat drivers were incompatible.'; Advice = ''; Source = 'https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/security/kernel-mode-hardware-stack-protection' }
    )
}
```

`src/Inspectors/DeviceInspector.ps1`:

```ps1
# DeviceInspector.ps1
# Interrupt and device inspector (read-only): present PCI devices with the interrupt types they
# support (line-based, MSI, MSI-X), the mode they use right now (from the allocated interrupt
# resources), the MSI and affinity-policy registry configuration and the CPUs an affinity override
# targets. Edits go through the deviceInterrupt catalog items, which apply only to GPU, NIC and USB
# host controllers that declare MSI support, and never to the boot-disk controller.

$script:IgwtInterruptPolicyNames = @{
    0 = 'Machine default'; 1 = 'All close processors'; 2 = 'One close processor'; 3 = 'All processors in machine'
    4 = 'Specified processors'; 5 = 'Spread messages across all processors'
}
$script:IgwtInterruptPriorityNames = @{ 0 = 'Undefined'; 1 = 'Low'; 2 = 'Normal'; 3 = 'High' }

function ConvertFrom-IgwtInterruptSupport {
    <# .SYNOPSIS DEVPKEY_PciDevice_InterruptSupport bit mask -> list of supported interrupt types. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param($Mask)
    if ($null -eq $Mask -or [string]$Mask -eq '') { return @() }
    $m = [int]$Mask
    $list = @()
    if ($m -band 1) { $list += 'Line' }
    if ($m -band 2) { $list += 'MSI' }
    if ($m -band 4) { $list += 'MSI-X' }
    return $list
}

function ConvertFrom-IgwtAffinityMask {
    <# .SYNOPSIS AssignmentSetOverride bytes or number -> logical processor numbers. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param($Value)
    if ($null -eq $Value) { return @() }
    $bytes = @()
    if ($Value -is [byte[]] -or $Value -is [object[]]) { $bytes = @($Value | ForEach-Object { [byte]$_ }) }
    else { $bytes = [BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$Value) }
    $cpus = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[int]
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $bytes.Count; $i++) { for ($b = 0; $b -lt 8; $b++) { if ($bytes[$i] -band (1 -shl $b)) { $cpus.Add($i * 8 + $b) } } }
    return $cpus.ToArray()
}

function Get-IgwtAllocatedInterrupts {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Device instance id (upper case) -> allocated IRQ numbers (Win32_PnPAllocatedResource). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $map = @{}
    try {
        foreach ($a in @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PnPAllocatedResource -ErrorAction Stop)) {
            $ante = $a.Antecedent; $dep = $a.Dependent
            if (-not $ante -or [string]$ante.CimClass.CimClassName -ne 'Win32_IRQResource') { continue }
            $id = ([string]$dep.DeviceID).ToUpperInvariant()
            if (-not $id) { continue }
            if (-not $map.ContainsKey($id)) { $map[$id] = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[long] }
            $map[$id].Add([long]$ante.IRQNumber)
        }
    } catch { Write-Verbose "Allocated interrupt resources unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    return $map
}

function Get-IgwtInterruptMode {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Current interrupt mode from allocated IRQ numbers: message-signaled IRQs are reported at 0x80000000 and above. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([AllowEmptyCollection()][long[]]$Irqs)
    $all = @($Irqs)
    if ($all.Count -eq 0) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Mode = 'Unknown'; Messages = 0; Irqs = @() } }
    $msg = @($all | Where-Object { $_ -ge 2147483648 })
    if ($msg.Count -gt 0) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Mode = 'Message-signaled'; Messages = $msg.Count; Irqs = @() } }
    return [pscustomobject]@{ Mode = 'Line-based'; Messages = 0; Irqs = @($all) }
}

function Get-IgwtInterruptInspection {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Read-only interrupt view of present PCI devices: supported and current interrupt mode,
        MSISupported / MessageNumberLimit, affinity policy, priority and target CPUs, and whether
        a deviceInterrupt catalog item may change it.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $devices = @(Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { [string]$_.InstanceId -like 'PCI\*' })
    $props = @{}
    foreach ($d in $devices) {
        # One query per device: a batched query stops returning data after the first device without the keys.
        $k = ([string]$d.InstanceId).ToUpperInvariant()
        $props[$k] = @{}
        try {
            foreach ($p in @(Get-PnpDeviceProperty -InstanceId ([string]$d.InstanceId) -KeyName 'DEVPKEY_PciDevice_InterruptSupport', 'DEVPKEY_PciDevice_InterruptMessageMaximum' -ErrorAction Stop)) {
                $props[$k][[string]$p.KeyName] = $p.Data
            }
        } catch { Write-Verbose "Interrupt properties of $($d.InstanceId) unavailable." }
    }
    $irqs = Get-IgwtAllocatedInterrupts
    $rows = foreach ($d in $devices) {
        $id = [string]$d.InstanceId
        $up = $id.ToUpperInvariant()
        $base = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\$id\Device Parameters\Interrupt Management"
        $read = { param($sub, $name) try { $v = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path "$base\$sub" -Name $name; if ($v.Exists) { $v.Value } else { $null } } catch { $null } }
        $msi = & $read 'MessageSignaledInterruptProperties' 'MSISupported'
        $limit = & $read 'MessageSignaledInterruptProperties' 'MessageNumberLimit'
        $policy = & $read 'Affinity Policy' 'DevicePolicy'
        $priority = & $read 'Affinity Policy' 'DevicePriority'
        $override = & $read 'Affinity Policy' 'AssignmentSetOverride'
        $p = $(if ($props.ContainsKey($up)) { $props[$up] } else { @{} })
        $support = @(ConvertFrom-IgwtInterruptSupport -Mask $p['DEVPKEY_PciDevice_InterruptSupport'])
        $mode = Get-IgwtInterruptMode -Irqs $(if ($irqs.ContainsKey($up)) { @($irqs[$up]) } else { @() })
        $class = [string]$d.Class
        $isUsbHost = ($class -eq 'USB' -and [string]$d.FriendlyName -match '(?i)host controller')
        $catalogClass = $(if ($class -in 'Display', 'Net') { $class } elseif ($isUsbHost) { 'USB' } else { '' })
        $note = ''
        if ($class -in 'SCSIAdapter', 'HDC') { $note = 'Storage controller: never changed by iG Windows Tuner (the boot disk depends on it).' }
        elseif (-not $catalogClass) { $note = 'Shown for information; iG Windows Tuner only changes GPU, network and USB host controllers.' }
        elseif ($support -notcontains 'MSI' -and $support -notcontains 'MSI-X') { $note = 'The device does not report MSI support.' }
        elseif ($mode.Mode -eq 'Line-based' -and $msi -ne 1) { $note = 'Supports MSI but uses a line-based interrupt; the MSI catalog item for this class could switch it (reboot, measure DPC latency).' }
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Name             = [string]$d.FriendlyName
            Class            = $class
            InstanceId       = $id
            Status           = [string]$d.Status
            Supports         = $support
            MessageMaximum   = $p['DEVPKEY_PciDevice_InterruptMessageMaximum']
            CurrentMode      = $mode.Mode
            Messages         = $mode.Messages
            Irqs             = @($mode.Irqs)
            MsiSupported     = $msi
            MessageLimit     = $limit
            DevicePolicy     = $policy
            PolicyName       = $(if ($null -ne $policy -and $script:IgwtInterruptPolicyNames.ContainsKey([int]$policy)) { $script:IgwtInterruptPolicyNames[[int]$policy] } elseif ($null -eq $policy) { 'Machine default (not set)' } else { "Policy $policy" })
            DevicePriority   = $priority
            PriorityName     = $(if ($null -ne $priority -and $script:IgwtInterruptPriorityNames.ContainsKey([int]$priority)) { $script:IgwtInterruptPriorityNames[[int]$priority] } else { 'Undefined' })
            TargetCpus       = @(ConvertFrom-IgwtAffinityMask -Value $override)
            CatalogClass     = $catalogClass
            Note             = $note
        }
    }
    $rows = @($rows | Sort-Object @{ Expression = { if ($_.CatalogClass) { 0 } else { 1 } } }, Class, Name)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Devices          = $rows
        MessageSignaled  = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.CurrentMode -eq 'Message-signaled' }).Count
        LineBased        = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.CurrentMode -eq 'Line-based' }).Count
        Note             = 'Read-only. MSI and affinity changes need a reboot and are made only through the deviceInterrupt catalog items (GPU, network and USB host controllers that declare MSI support).'
    }
}
```

```ps1
# Inspection.ps1
# One entry point for the read-only expert inspectors (CLI -Inspect, GUI Inspectors page) and their
# plain-text rendering.

$script:IgwtInspectionAreas = @('Power', 'Interrupts', 'Network', 'Kernel', 'Timer', 'Crash')

function Get-IgwtInspection {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Runs one or all read-only inspectors: Power (processor power settings of the active plan),
        Interrupts (PCI interrupt modes and affinity), Network (RSS, queues, buffers), Kernel
        (kernel and memory registry values), Timer and Crash (dumps and page file). Each area fails
        on its own and reports the error instead of stopping the others.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([ValidateSet('All', 'Power', 'Interrupts', 'Network', 'Kernel', 'Timer', 'Crash')][string[]]$Area = @('All'))
    $areas = $(if ($Area -contains 'All') { $script:IgwtInspectionAreas } else { @($Area) })
    $result = [ordered]@{ Generated = (Get-Date).ToString('o'); Elevated = (Test-IgwtIsAdmin) }
    foreach ($a in $areas) {
        try {
            $result[$a] = switch ($a) {
                'Power' { Get-IgwtPowerSettingsInspection }
                'Interrupts' { Get-IgwtInterruptInspection }
                'Network' { Get-IgwtNicQueueInspection }
                'Kernel' { Get-IgwtKernelInspection }
                'Timer' { Get-IgwtTimerInspection }
                'Crash' { Get-IgwtCrashInspection }
            }
        } catch { $result[$a] = [pscustomobject]@{ Error = $_.Exception.Message } }
    }
    return [pscustomobject]$result
}

function Format-IgwtInspection {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Plain-text rendering of Get-IgwtInspection for the console. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Inspection)
    $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
    $line = '-' * 78
    $err = { param($o) if ($o -and $o.PSObject.Properties['Error'] -and $o.Error) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("  Error: $($o.Error)"); return $true }; return $false }
    if (-not $Inspection.Elevated) { $null = $sb.AppendLine('Note: not elevated - some RSS values and allocated resources may be incomplete.') }
    if ($Inspection.PSObject.Properties['Power']) {
        $p = $Inspection.Power
        $null = $sb.AppendLine($line); $null = $sb.AppendLine("[Power plan] $($p.SchemeName) ($($p.Scheme))")
        if (-not (& $err $p)) {
            $null = $sb.AppendLine("  $(@($p.Settings).Count) processor settings, $($p.Editable) editable here, $($p.Changed) differ from the Windows default.")
            foreach ($s in @($p.Settings | Where-Object { $_.Level -or $_.ChangedFromDefault })) {
                $flag = $(if ($s.Blocked) { ' [blocked on this hardware]' } elseif ($s.Level) { " [editable: $($s.Level)]" } else { '' })
                $def = $(if ($null -ne $s.DefaultAC) { "  default AC $($s.DefaultAC)/DC $($s.DefaultDC)$(if ($s.DefaultSource -and $s.DefaultSource -ne 'plan') { " ($($s.DefaultSource))" })" } else { '' })
                $null = $sb.AppendLine(('  {0,-20} AC {1,-26} DC {2,-26}{3}{4}{5}' -f $s.Alias, $s.AcText, $s.DcText, $def, $(if ($s.Hidden) { ' hidden' } else { '' }), $flag))
            }
        }
    }
    if ($Inspection.PSObject.Properties['Interrupts']) {
        $i = $Inspection.Interrupts
        $null = $sb.AppendLine($line); $null = $sb.AppendLine('[Interrupts]')
        if (-not (& $err $i)) {
            foreach ($d in @($i.Devices | Where-Object { $_.CatalogClass -or $_.CurrentMode -eq 'Line-based' })) {
                $mode = $(if ($d.CurrentMode -eq 'Message-signaled') { "MSI ($($d.Messages) message(s))" } elseif ($d.CurrentMode -eq 'Line-based') { "line-based (IRQ $(@($d.Irqs) -join ','))" } else { 'unknown' })
                $null = $sb.AppendLine(('  {0,-12} {1,-26} supports {2,-14} policy: {3}{4}' -f $d.Class, $mode, (@($d.Supports) -join '/'), $d.PolicyName, $(if (@($d.TargetCpus).Count) { " CPUs $(@($d.TargetCpus) -join ',')" } else { '' })))
                $null = $sb.AppendLine("               $($d.Name)$(if ($d.Note) { " - $($d.Note)" })")
            }
            $null = $sb.AppendLine("  $($i.MessageSignaled) device(s) use message-signaled interrupts, $($i.LineBased) line-based.")
        }
    }
    if ($Inspection.PSObject.Properties['Network']) {
        $n = $Inspection.Network
        $null = $sb.AppendLine($line); $null = $sb.AppendLine('[Network queues]')
        if (-not (& $err $n)) {
            foreach ($a in @($n.Adapters)) {
                $null = $sb.AppendLine("  $($a.Name) ($($a.Description), $($a.LinkSpeed))")
                $null = $sb.AppendLine(("    RSS {0}, base processor {1}, max processor {2}, receive queues {3}" -f $(if ($null -eq $a.RssEnabled) { 'unknown' } elseif ($a.RssEnabled) { 'on' } else { 'off' }), $(if ($null -ne $a.BaseProcessor) { $a.BaseProcessor } else { '?' }), $(if ($null -ne $a.MaxProcessor) { $a.MaxProcessor } else { '?' }), $(if ($null -ne $a.ReceiveQueues) { $a.ReceiveQueues } else { '?' })))
                if ($a.ReceiveBuffers) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("    receive buffers $($a.ReceiveBuffers.Value) (range $($a.ReceiveBuffers.Min)-$($a.ReceiveBuffers.Max)), transmit buffers $(if ($a.TransmitBuffers) { $a.TransmitBuffers.Value } else { '?' }); discarded received packets: $(if ($null -ne $a.DiscardedPackets) { $a.DiscardedPackets } else { '?' })") }
                foreach ($x in @($a.Advice)) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("    -> $x") }
            }
        }
    }
    if ($Inspection.PSObject.Properties['Kernel']) {
        $k = $Inspection.Kernel
        $null = $sb.AppendLine($line); $null = $sb.AppendLine("[Kernel and memory] $($k.Changed) documented value(s) differ from the Windows default")
        if (-not (& $err $k)) {
            foreach ($key in @($k.Keys)) {
                $null = $sb.AppendLine("  $($key.Name)")
                foreach ($v in @($key.Values | Where-Object { $_.Status -ne 'Default' })) {
                    $link = $(if ($v.Item) { " (catalog: $($v.Item))" } elseif ($v.Rejected) { " (see $($v.Rejected))" } else { '' })
                    $null = $sb.AppendLine(('    [{0,-12}] {1} = {2}{3}{4}' -f $v.Status, $v.Name, $v.Current, $(if ($v.Default) { " (default $($v.Default))" } else { '' }), $link))
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if ($Inspection.PSObject.Properties['Timer']) {
        $t = $Inspection.Timer
        $null = $sb.AppendLine($line); $null = $sb.AppendLine('[Timer]')
        if (-not (& $err $t)) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("  $($t.Behaviour)"); $null = $sb.AppendLine("  $($t.Note)") }
    }
    if ($Inspection.PSObject.Properties['Crash']) {
        $c = $Inspection.Crash
        $null = $sb.AppendLine($line); $null = $sb.AppendLine('[Crash dumps and page file]')
        if (-not (& $err $c)) {
            $null = $sb.AppendLine("  Dump type: $($c.DumpTypeName); restart after a stop error: $(if ($c.AutoReboot -eq 0) { 'no' } else { 'yes' }); stop code details: $(if ($c.DisplayParameters -eq 1) { 'shown' } else { 'default' }); verbose status messages: $(if ($c.VerboseStatus -eq 1) { 'on' } else { 'off' })")
            $null = $sb.AppendLine("  Minidumps: $($c.Minidumps) in $($c.MinidumpFolder)$(if ($c.LatestMinidump) { ", latest $($c.LatestMinidump)" })$(if ($null -ne $c.DumpFileBytes) { "; memory dump on disk: $([Math]::Round($c.DumpFileBytes / 1MB)) MB" })")
            $null = $sb.AppendLine("  Page file: $($c.PageFileMode) ($(@($c.PagingFiles) -join '; '))$(@($c.PageFiles | ForEach-Object { "; $($_.Path) $($_.AllocatedMB) MB allocated, peak $($_.PeakMB) MB" }) -join '')")
            foreach ($x in @($c.Advice)) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("  -> $x") }
        }
    }
    return $sb.ToString()
}
```

`src/Inspectors/KernelInspector.ps1`:

```ps1
# KernelInspector.ps1
# Read-only kernel, memory, timer and crash-dump inspectors.
#   - Kernel and memory: every value under Session Manager\kernel, Memory Management,
#     PriorityControl, Multimedia\SystemProfile (+ the Games task) and CrashControl, annotated from
#     data\inspectors\kernel.json with meaning, Windows default and the catalog item (the only way to
#     change it) or the rejected entry that explains why iG Windows Tuner leaves it alone.
#   - Timer: the GlobalTimerResolutionRequests setting and how to see current requests.
#   - Crash and page file: dump type, dump files on disk, verbose status messages and page files.

function Get-IgwtKernelInspectorCatalog {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Registry keys and documented values from data\inspectors\kernel.json (cached). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([switch]$Force)
    if ($script:IgwtKernelInspectorCache -and -not $Force) { return $script:IgwtKernelInspectorCache }
    $file = Join-Path (Get-IgwtDataFolder) 'inspectors\kernel.json'
    $keys = @()
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file) { $keys = @((Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $file).keys | Where-Object { $_ }) }
    $script:IgwtKernelInspectorCache = $keys
    return $keys
}

function Test-IgwtKernelInspectorCatalog {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Validates data\inspectors\kernel.json (paths, texts, linked catalog and rejected ids). Returns error strings. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $errors = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $file = Join-Path (Get-IgwtDataFolder) 'inspectors\kernel.json'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file)) { $errors.Add('inspectors\kernel.json: missing (kernel and memory inspector).'); return $errors.ToArray() }
    if ((Get-IgwtFileSchemaVersion -Document (Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $file)) -lt $script:IgwtSchemaVersion) { $errors.Add('inspectors\kernel.json: schemaVersion must be 2.') }
    $tweakIds = @{}; foreach ($t in @(Get-IgwtCatalog)) { $tweakIds[[string]$t.id] = $true }
    $rejectedIds = @{}; foreach ($r in @(Get-IgwtRejectedTweaks)) { $rejectedIds[[string]$r.id] = $true }
    $seen = @{}
    foreach ($k in @(Get-IgwtKernelInspectorCatalog -Force)) {
        $label = "inspector key '$($k.id)'"
        if ($seen.ContainsKey([string]$k.id)) { $errors.Add("${label}: duplicate id.") } else { $seen[[string]$k.id] = $true }
        if ([string]$k.path -notmatch '^HKLM:\\') { $errors.Add("${label}: path must start with HKLM:\.") }
        Test-IgwtItemText -Item $k -Label $label -Errors $errors
        $names = @{}
        foreach ($v in @($k.values | Where-Object { $_ })) {
            $vl = "$label value '$($v.name)'"
            if (-not $v.name) { $errors.Add("${label}: a value has no name."); continue }
            if ($names.ContainsKey(([string]$v.name).ToLowerInvariant())) { $errors.Add("${vl}: duplicate.") } else { $names[([string]$v.name).ToLowerInvariant()] = $true }
            if (([string]$v.meaning).Trim().Length -lt 15) { $errors.Add("${vl}: needs a meaning.") }
            if ($null -eq $v.PSObject.Properties['default']) { $errors.Add("${vl}: needs the Windows default (or <absent>).") }
            if ($v.item -and -not $tweakIds.ContainsKey([string]$v.item)) { $errors.Add("${vl}: unknown catalog item '$($v.item)'.") }
            if ($v.rejected -and -not $rejectedIds.ContainsKey([string]$v.rejected)) { $errors.Add("${vl}: unknown rejected entry '$($v.rejected)'.") }
            foreach ($u in @($v.sources | Where-Object { $_ })) { if ([string]$u -notmatch '^https://') { $errors.Add("${vl}: source '$u' must be https.") } }
        }
    }
    return $errors.ToArray()
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtDwordNumber {
    <# .SYNOPSIS A REG_DWORD as an unsigned number (the registry API returns DWORDs as signed Int32). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([uint32])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Value)
    if ($Value -is [int]) { return [BitConverter]::ToUInt32([BitConverter]::GetBytes([int]$Value), 0) }
    $n = [int64]$Value
    if ($n -lt 0) { return [BitConverter]::ToUInt32([BitConverter]::GetBytes([int]$n), 0) }
    return [uint32]$n
}

function Format-IgwtRegistryDisplay {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Short display text for a registry value (DWORDs above 9999 also in hex, binary as a length). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param($Value, [string]$Kind)
    if ($null -eq $Value) { return '' }
    switch ($Kind) {
        'Binary' { return "binary ($(@($Value).Count) bytes)" }
        'MultiString' { return (@($Value) -join '; ') }
        'DWord' {
            $u = ConvertTo-IgwtDwordNumber -Value $Value
            if ($u -gt 9999) { return ('{0} (0x{1:X8})' -f $u, $u) }
            return [string]$u
        }
        'QWord' { return [string]$Value }
        default { return [string]$Value }
    }
}

function Test-IgwtInspectorValueDefault {
    <# .SYNOPSIS True when a current value equals a documented default (numbers, strings or string lists). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param($Current, [string]$Kind, $Default)
    if ($Default -is [array] -or $Kind -eq 'MultiString') { return ((@($Current) -join '|').ToLowerInvariant() -eq (@($Default) -join '|').ToLowerInvariant()) }
    if ($Kind -eq 'DWord') {
        $n = 0L
        if (-not [long]::TryParse([string]$Default, [ref]$n)) { return $false }
        return ((ConvertTo-IgwtDwordNumber -Value $Current) -eq (ConvertTo-IgwtDwordNumber -Value $n))
    }
    if ($Kind -eq 'QWord') { return ([string]$Current -eq [string]$Default) }
    return [string]::Equals([string]$Current, [string]$Default, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
}

function Get-IgwtKernelInspection {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Read-only view of the kernel, memory, priority, multimedia and crash registry keys. Each
        value shows its current data, the Windows default when documented, a status (Default,
        Changed, Absent, Undocumented) and the catalog item or rejected entry it belongs to.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $keys = foreach ($k in @(Get-IgwtKernelInspectorCatalog)) {
        $known = @{}; foreach ($v in @($k.values | Where-Object { $_ })) { $known[([string]$v.name).ToLowerInvariant()] = $v }
        $actual = @{}
        $readable = $true
        try {
            $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath ([string]$k.path)) -ErrorAction Stop
            foreach ($n in $item.GetValueNames()) {
                if (-not $n) { continue }
                $actual[$n.ToLowerInvariant()] = [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $n; Kind = $item.GetValueKind($n).ToString(); Value = $item.GetValue($n, $null, [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueOptions]::DoNotExpandEnvironmentNames) }
            }
        } catch { $readable = $false }
        $rows = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
        foreach ($lower in @($actual.Keys | Sort-Object)) {
            $a = $actual[$lower]; $meta = $known[$lower]
            $status = 'Undocumented'; $defText = ''
            if ($meta) {
                $defText = $(if ([string]$meta.default -eq '<absent>') { 'not set' } else { Format-IgwtRegistryDisplay -Value $meta.default -Kind $a.Kind })
                if ([string]$meta.default -eq '<absent>') {
                    $status = 'Changed'
                    if ($null -ne $meta.PSObject.Properties['absentMeans'] -and (Test-IgwtInspectorValueDefault -Current $a.Value -Kind $a.Kind -Default $meta.absentMeans)) { $status = 'Default' }
                } elseif (Test-IgwtInspectorValueDefault -Current $a.Value -Kind $a.Kind -Default $meta.default) { $status = 'Default' } else { $status = 'Changed' }
            }
            $rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{
                    Name = $a.Name; Kind = $a.Kind; Current = (Format-IgwtRegistryDisplay -Value $a.Value -Kind $a.Kind); Default = $defText; Status = $status
                    Meaning = $(if ($meta) { [string]$meta.meaning } else { 'Not documented by iG Windows Tuner. Leave it unless its vendor documents it.' })
                    Item = $(if ($meta) { [string]$meta.item } else { '' }); Rejected = $(if ($meta) { [string]$meta.rejected } else { '' })
                    Sources = $(if ($meta) { @($meta.sources) } else { @() })
                })
        }
        foreach ($lower in @($known.Keys | Sort-Object)) {
            if ($actual.ContainsKey($lower)) { continue }
            $meta = $known[$lower]
            $isDefault = ([string]$meta.default -eq '<absent>')
            $rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{
                    Name = [string]$meta.name; Kind = ''; Current = 'not set'; Default = $(if ($isDefault) { 'not set' } else { Format-IgwtRegistryDisplay -Value $meta.default -Kind $(if ($meta.default -is [array]) { 'MultiString' } elseif ($meta.default -is [string]) { 'String' } else { 'DWord' }) })
                    Status = $(if ($isDefault) { 'Default' } else { 'Absent' }); Meaning = [string]$meta.meaning; Item = [string]$meta.item; Rejected = [string]$meta.rejected; Sources = @($meta.sources)
                })
        }
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Id = [string]$k.id; Name = [string]$k.name; Path = [string]$k.path; Hint = [string]$k.hint; Description = [string]$k.description; Readable = $readable
            Values = $rows.ToArray(); Changed = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Changed' }).Count
        }
    }
    $keys = @($keys)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Keys    = $keys
        Changed = [int](($keys | Measure-Object -Property Changed -Sum).Sum)
        Note    = 'Read-only. Values can be changed only through the linked catalog item; values linked to a rejected entry are explained and left alone.'
    }
}

function Get-IgwtTimerInspection {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Timer settings (read-only): GlobalTimerResolutionRequests and how to see current resolution requests. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $v = $null
    try { $v = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\kernel' -Name 'GlobalTimerResolutionRequests' } catch { $v = $null }
    $on = ($v -and $v.Exists -and [int]$v.Value -eq 1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        GlobalTimerResolutionRequests = $(if ($v -and $v.Exists) { [int]$v.Value } else { $null })
        Behaviour  = $(if ($on) { 'Global: one process''s timer-resolution request affects the whole system (pre-2004 behaviour).' } else { 'Per process (Windows default since Windows 10 2004): each process gets the resolution it asks for; minimized or occluded windows are ignored on Windows 11.' })
        Item       = 'sched.global-timer-resolution'
        CurrentResolution = $null
        Note       = 'The current timer resolution is not shown: reading it needs an undocumented native call (NtQueryTimerResolution) and iG Windows Tuner keeps a single, documented P/Invoke. As administrator, "powercfg /energy" lists the processes that request a higher timer resolution.'
        Sources    = @('https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/timeapi/nf-timeapi-timebeginperiod')
    }
}

function Get-IgwtCrashInspection {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Crash dump, stop screen, verbose status and page file configuration (read-only). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $cc = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\CrashControl'
    $read = { param($p, $n) try { $r = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $p -Name $n; if ($r.Exists) { $r.Value } else { $null } } catch { $null } }
    $dumpType = & $read $cc 'CrashDumpEnabled'
    $dumpNames = @{ 0 = 'None'; 1 = 'Complete memory dump'; 2 = 'Kernel memory dump'; 3 = 'Small memory dump (minidump)'; 7 = 'Automatic memory dump (Windows default)' }
    $dumpFile = [string](& $read $cc 'DumpFile'); if (-not $dumpFile) { $dumpFile = '%SystemRoot%\MEMORY.DMP' }
    $miniDir = [string](& $read $cc 'MinidumpDir'); if (-not $miniDir) { $miniDir = '%SystemRoot%\Minidump' }
    $dumpPath = [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($dumpFile)
    $miniPath = [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($miniDir)
    $dumpSize = $null
    try { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dumpPath -PathType Leaf) { $dumpSize = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $dumpPath -Force -ErrorAction Stop).Length } } catch { $dumpSize = $null }
    $minis = @()
    try { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $miniPath) { $minis = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $miniPath -Filter '*.dmp' -File -ErrorAction Stop) } } catch { $minis = @() }
    $paging = & $read 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management' 'PagingFiles'
    $pagingList = @($paging | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ -and [string]$_ -ne '' } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
    $mode = 'Custom'
    if ($pagingList.Count -eq 0) { $mode = 'None' }
    elseif ($pagingList.Count -eq 1 -and $pagingList[0] -match '^\?:\\pagefile\.sys$') { $mode = 'SystemManagedAllDrives' }
    elseif (@($pagingList | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '\s0\s+0\s*$' -and $_ -notmatch '^[A-Za-z]:\\pagefile\.sys$' }).Count -eq 0) { $mode = 'SystemManaged' }
    $usage = @()
    try { $usage = @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PageFileUsage -ErrorAction Stop | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Path = [string]$_.Name; AllocatedMB = [int]$_.AllocatedBaseSize; CurrentMB = [int]$_.CurrentUsage; PeakMB = [int]$_.PeakUsage } }) } catch { $usage = @() }
    $verbose = & $read 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' 'VerboseStatus'
    $advice = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    if ($mode -eq 'None') { $advice.Add('No page file is configured. Windows needs one for crash dumps and as commit headroom; never disable it (see rejected.pagefile-off). Catalog item system.pagefile-auto restores a system-managed page file.') }
    if ($null -ne $dumpType -and [int]$dumpType -eq 0) { $advice.Add('Crash dumps are off, so a blue screen leaves nothing to analyze. Small or automatic dumps are recommended.') }
    if ($null -ne $dumpSize -and $dumpSize -gt 1GB) { $advice.Add("An old memory dump of $([Math]::Round($dumpSize / 1GB, 1)) GB is on disk ($dumpPath). Settings > System > Storage > Temporary files can remove it once you have analyzed it.") }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        DumpType         = $dumpType
        DumpTypeName     = $(if ($null -ne $dumpType -and $dumpNames.ContainsKey([int]$dumpType)) { $dumpNames[[int]$dumpType] } elseif ($null -eq $dumpType) { 'Not set (automatic)' } else { "Type $dumpType" })
        AutoReboot       = & $read $cc 'AutoReboot'
        DisplayParameters = & $read $cc 'DisplayParameters'
        DumpFile         = $dumpPath
        DumpFileBytes    = $dumpSize
        MinidumpFolder   = $miniPath
        Minidumps        = $minis.Count
        MinidumpBytes    = [long](($minis | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum)
        LatestMinidump   = $(if ($minis.Count) { ($minis | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).LastWriteTime } else { $null })
        VerboseStatus    = $verbose
        PageFileMode     = $mode
        PagingFiles      = $pagingList
        PageFiles        = $usage
        Advice           = $advice.ToArray()
        Items            = @('system.dump-small', 'system.bsod-details', 'system.verbose-status', 'system.pagefile-auto')
    }
}
```

`src/Inspectors/NetworkInspector.ps1`:

```ps1
# NetworkInspector.ps1
# NIC queue inspector (read-only): receive side scaling (enabled, profile, base and max processor,
# queues), receive and transmit buffers with the driver's allowed range, and discarded-packet
# counters, so recommendations rest on evidence. iG Windows Tuner changes RSS only through the catalog
# item net.rss-on; queue and buffer values are shown with guidance, not edited.

$script:IgwtNicQueueKeywords = @('*RSS', '*RSSProfile', '*NumRssQueues', '*RssBaseProcNumber', '*MaxRssProcessors', '*RssMaxProcNumber', '*ReceiveBuffers', '*TransmitBuffers')

function Get-IgwtNicQueueInspection {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Read-only RSS, queue and buffer view of the physical network adapters, with
        recommendations: RSS on, RSS off logical processor 0 when the driver allows it, and larger
        receive buffers only when the adapter actually discards received packets.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $adapters = @()
    try { $adapters = @(Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { [string]$_.Status -ne 'Not Present' }) } catch { Write-Verbose 'Network adapters unavailable.' }
    $rows = foreach ($a in $adapters) {
        $name = [string]$a.Name
        $rss = $null
        try { $rss = Get-NetAdapterRss -Name $name -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $rss = $null }
        $props = @{}
        try {
            foreach ($p in @(Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $name -AllProperties -ErrorAction Stop)) {
                if ($script:IgwtNicQueueKeywords -contains [string]$p.RegistryKeyword) { $props[[string]$p.RegistryKeyword] = $p }
            }
        } catch { Write-Verbose "Advanced properties of $name unavailable." }
        $stats = $null
        try { $stats = Get-NetAdapterStatistics -Name $name -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $stats = $null }
        $prop = {
            param($kw)
            $p = $props[$kw]
            if (-not $p) { return $null }
            [pscustomobject]@{
                Keyword = $kw; DisplayName = [string]$p.DisplayName; Value = (@($p.RegistryValue) -join ','); DisplayValue = [string]$p.DisplayValue
                Default = [string]$p.DefaultRegistryValue; Min = $p.NumericParameterMinValue; Max = $p.NumericParameterMaxValue
                Allowed = @($p.ValidRegistryValues | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
            }
        }
        $rssEnabled = $null; $base = $null; $maxProc = $null; $queues = $null; $rssProfile = ''
        if ($rss) {
            $rssEnabled = [bool]$rss.Enabled
            if ([string]$rss.BaseProcessorNumber -ne '') { $base = [int]$rss.BaseProcessorNumber }
            if ([string]$rss.MaxProcessorNumber -ne '') { $maxProc = [int]$rss.MaxProcessorNumber }
            if ([string]$rss.NumberOfReceiveQueues -ne '') { $queues = [int]$rss.NumberOfReceiveQueues }
            $rssProfile = [string]$rss.Profile
        }
        $baseProp = & $prop '*RssBaseProcNumber'
        if ($null -eq $base -and $baseProp -and $baseProp.Value -ne '') { $base = [int]$baseProp.Value }
        $rx = & $prop '*ReceiveBuffers'
        $tx = & $prop '*TransmitBuffers'
        $discarded = $null; $rxErrors = $null
        if ($stats) { $discarded = [long]$stats.ReceivedDiscardedPackets; $rxErrors = [long]$stats.ReceivedPacketErrors }
        $advice = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
        if ($rssEnabled -eq $false) { $advice.Add('RSS is off: turn it on (catalog item net.rss-on) so receive processing is spread across cores.') }
        if ($rssEnabled -and $base -eq 0) {
            if ($baseProp) { $advice.Add("RSS starts on logical processor 0, which also services many system interrupts. The driver offers '$($baseProp.DisplayName)': a base of 2 keeps RSS off core 0. Change it in Device Manager > adapter > Advanced if you measure DPC latency problems.") }
            else { $advice.Add('RSS starts on logical processor 0. This driver does not expose the RSS base processor, so Windows keeps its default placement.') }
        }
        if ($rx -and $null -ne $discarded) {
            if ($discarded -gt 0 -and $rx.Max -and [long]$rx.Value -lt [long]$rx.Max) { $advice.Add("$discarded received packet(s) were discarded. Raising '$($rx.DisplayName)' from $($rx.Value) toward $($rx.Max) can help; it uses a little more memory.") }
            elseif ($discarded -eq 0) { $advice.Add('No received packets were discarded since the adapter started: the receive buffers are large enough.') }
        }
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Name              = $name
            Description       = [string]$a.InterfaceDescription
            Status            = [string]$a.Status
            LinkSpeed         = [string]$a.LinkSpeed
            RssEnabled        = $rssEnabled
            RssProfile        = $rssProfile
            BaseProcessor     = $base
            MaxProcessor      = $maxProc
            ReceiveQueues     = $queues
            Queues            = (& $prop '*NumRssQueues')
            BaseProcessorProp = $baseProp
            ReceiveBuffers    = $rx
            TransmitBuffers   = $tx
            DiscardedPackets  = $discarded
            ReceiveErrors     = $rxErrors
            Advice            = $advice.ToArray()
        }
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Adapters = @($rows)
        Note     = 'Read-only. Some RSS values are only visible to administrators. Queue and buffer changes are made in Device Manager > adapter > Advanced; iG Windows Tuner shows the allowed range and evidence (discarded packets).'
    }
}
```

`src/Inspectors/PowerInspector.ps1`:

```ps1
# PowerInspector.ps1
# Power plan engineer (Expert):
#   - read-only view of every setting in a power subgroup of the active plan, hidden ones included
#     (powercfg /qh), with the Windows default for the plan, the hidden flag and hardware blocks
#   - a snapshot-backed editor for the processor settings listed in data\power\processor.json
#     (operation 'Power', reverted through Invoke-IgwtRevert)
# Hardware overlays apply: a setting an active overlay blocks cannot be edited (for example core
# parking and hybrid scheduling on Intel hybrid CPUs). powercfg output is parsed for GUIDs, aliases
# and 0x values, which are not localized; setting names stay in the system language.

$script:IgwtSubProcessor = '54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00'
$script:IgwtPowerHexLine = '^\s+[^:]+:\s*0x([0-9a-fA-F]{8})\s*$'
$script:IgwtPowerIndexLine = '^\s+[^:]+:\s*(\d{3})\s*$'

function ConvertFrom-IgwtPowerCfgQuery {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Parses powercfg /q or /qh output into settings: Guid, Alias, Name, Min, Max, Increment,
        Units, Options (Index, Name), AC and DC indexes. Works on localized output because it
        relies on indentation, GUIDs, upper-case aliases and hex values only.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([AllowEmptyString()][string]$Text)
    $lines = @($Text -split "`r?`n")
    $current = $null
    $settings = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $finish = {
        if ($current) {
            # Numeric settings list min, max and increment before the AC and DC indexes; enumerated
            # settings list only AC and DC. Plans can report UNKNOWN instead of an index.
            $hex = $current.Hex.ToArray()
            $current.Setting.Options = $current.Setting.Options.ToArray()
            $s = $current.Setting
            if ($s.Options.Count -gt 0) {
                if ($hex.Count -ge 2) { $s.AC = [long]$hex[0]; $s.DC = [long]$hex[1] }
            } elseif ($hex.Count -ge 3) {
                $s.Min = [long]$hex[0]; $s.Max = [long]$hex[1]; $s.Increment = [long]$hex[2]
                if ($hex.Count -ge 5) { $s.AC = [long]$hex[3]; $s.DC = [long]$hex[4] }
            } elseif ($hex.Count -eq 2) { $s.AC = [long]$hex[0]; $s.DC = [long]$hex[1] }
            $settings.Add($s)
        }
    }
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {
        $line = $lines[$i]
        $m = [regex]::Match($line, "^\s{4}\S.*?\b($script:IgwtGuidPattern)\b\s*(?:\((.*)\))?\s*$")
        if ($m.Success -and $line -notmatch '^\s{5}') {
            & $finish
            $current = @{
                Hex = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[long]; AfterThirdHex = $false
                Setting = [pscustomobject]@{ Guid = $m.Groups[1].Value.ToLowerInvariant(); Alias = ''; Name = $m.Groups[2].Value.Trim(); Min = $null; Max = $null; Increment = $null; Units = ''
                    Options = (New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]); AC = $null; DC = $null }
            }
            continue
        }
        if (-not $current) { continue }
        $hm = [regex]::Match($line, $script:IgwtPowerHexLine)
        if ($hm.Success) { $current.Hex.Add([Convert]::ToInt64($hm.Groups[1].Value, 16)); continue }
        $im = [regex]::Match($line, $script:IgwtPowerIndexLine)
        if ($im.Success) {
            $name = ''
            if ($i + 1 -lt $lines.Count -and $lines[$i + 1] -match '^\s+[^:]+:\s*(.*)$') { $name = $Matches[1].Trim(); $i++ }
            $current.Setting.Options.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Index = [int]$im.Groups[1].Value; Name = $name })
            continue
        }
        if (-not $current.Setting.Alias -and $current.Hex.Count -eq 0 -and $line -match '^\s{6}[^:]+:\s*([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)\s*$') { $current.Setting.Alias = $Matches[1]; continue }
        if ($current.Hex.Count -eq 3 -and -not $current.Setting.Units -and $line -match '^\s{6}[^:]+:\s*(\S.*)$') { $current.Setting.Units = $Matches[1].Trim() }
    }
    & $finish
    return $settings.ToArray()
}

function Get-IgwtPowerSettingCatalog {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Editable processor settings from data\power\processor.json (cached). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([switch]$Force)
    if ($script:IgwtPowerSettingCache -and -not $Force) { return $script:IgwtPowerSettingCache }
    $file = Join-Path (Get-IgwtDataFolder) 'power\processor.json'
    $list = @()
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file) { $list = @((Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $file).settings | Where-Object { $_ }) }
    $script:IgwtPowerSettingCache = $list
    return $list
}

function Get-IgwtPowerSettingDefinition {
    <# .SYNOPSIS One editable setting by alias or GUID; throws for settings that are not editable. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Setting)
    $s = $Setting.Trim()
    $def = @(Get-IgwtPowerSettingCatalog | Where-Object { [string]::Equals([string]$_.alias, $s, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or [string]::Equals([string]$_.guid, $s, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) }) | Select-Object -First 1
    if (-not $def) { throw "Power setting '$Setting' is not editable in iG Windows Tuner. Editable: $(@(Get-IgwtPowerSettingCatalog | ForEach-Object { $_.alias }) -join ', ')." }
    return $def
}

function Test-IgwtPowerSettingCatalog {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Validates data\power\processor.json. Returns error strings. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $errors = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $file = Join-Path (Get-IgwtDataFolder) 'power\processor.json'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file)) { $errors.Add('power\processor.json: missing (power plan editor settings).'); return $errors.ToArray() }
    if ((Get-IgwtFileSchemaVersion -Document (Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $file)) -lt $script:IgwtSchemaVersion) { $errors.Add('power\processor.json: schemaVersion must be 2.') }
    $seen = @{}
    foreach ($s in @(Get-IgwtPowerSettingCatalog -Force)) {
        $label = "power setting '$($s.alias)'"
        if ([string]$s.alias -notmatch '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$') { $errors.Add("${label}: alias must be the powercfg alias in upper case.") }
        if ([string]$s.guid -notmatch "^$script:IgwtGuidPattern$") { $errors.Add("${label}: guid invalid.") }
        foreach ($k in 'alias', 'guid') { $v = ([string]$s.$k).ToLowerInvariant(); if ($seen.ContainsKey($v)) { $errors.Add("${label}: duplicate $k.") } else { $seen[$v] = $true } }
        if ([string]$s.level -notin 'Advanced', 'Expert') { $errors.Add("${label}: level must be Advanced or Expert.") }
        if (-not $s.group) { $errors.Add("${label}: missing 'group'.") }
        if ([string]$s.guid -eq '5d76a2ca-e8c0-402f-a133-2158492d58ad') { $errors.Add("${label}: processor idle disable is not editable (Lab, rejected).") }
        Test-IgwtItemText -Item $s -Label $label -Errors $errors
        $sources = @($s.sources | Where-Object { $_ })
        if ($sources.Count -eq 0) { $errors.Add("${label}: needs at least one source.") }
        foreach ($u in $sources) { if ([string]$u -notmatch '^https://') { $errors.Add("${label}: source '$u' must be https.") } }
    }
    return $errors.ToArray()
}

function Get-IgwtPowerSettingBlock {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Reason an active hardware overlay blocks editing a power setting (AC, or DC with -Dc), or $null. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Guid, [AllowEmptyCollection()][string[]]$Tags = @(), [switch]$Dc)
    $probe = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'powercfgSetting'; subgroup = $script:IgwtSubProcessor; setting = $Guid.ToLowerInvariant(); ac = 0 }
    if ($Dc) { $probe | Add-Member -NotePropertyName dc -NotePropertyValue 0 }
    foreach ($o in @(Get-IgwtActiveOverlays -Tags $Tags)) {
        foreach ($m in @($o.blockMatching | Where-Object { $_ })) {
            if (Test-IgwtOverlayActionMatch -Action $probe -Matcher $m) { return "Blocked on this hardware by '$($o.name)': $($o.hint)" }
        }
    }
    return $null
}

function Get-IgwtPowerDefaults {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Where the "Windows default" of a plan's settings comes from: Windows' stored defaults for a
        built-in plan; for a copy, the built-in plan it was made from (same name resource); Balanced
        as a labelled reference for Ultimate Performance (Windows stores no defaults for it) and for
        unknown custom plans. Returns Source (label) and Scheme.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Scheme, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Subgroup)
    $builtIn = @($script:IgwtSchemeBalanced, $script:IgwtSchemeHighPerformance, 'a1841308-3541-4fab-bc81-f71556f20b4a', $script:IgwtSchemeUltimateBase)
    $base = $Scheme.ToLowerInvariant()
    if ($builtIn -notcontains $base) {
        # The name resource id ('powrprof.dll,-19') identifies the built-in plan a copy was made from;
        # built-in plans such as Ultimate Performance can be hidden from 'powercfg /list'.
        $resId = {
            param($g)
            try { $fn = [string](Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\User\PowerSchemes\$g" -Name 'FriendlyName').Value } catch { $fn = '' }
            if ($fn -match 'powrprof\.dll,-(\d+)') { return [int]$Matches[1] }
            return $null
        }
        $mine = & $resId $base
        $match = $null
        if ($null -ne $mine) { $match = @($builtIn | Where-Object { (& $resId $_) -eq $mine }) | Select-Object -First 1 }
        if ($match) { $base = [string]$match } else { return [pscustomobject]@{ Source = 'Balanced (reference)'; Scheme = $script:IgwtSchemeBalanced } }
    }
    if ($base -eq $script:IgwtSchemeUltimateBase) {
        # Windows stores no defaults for Ultimate Performance and its hidden base plan reports UNKNOWN,
        # so Balanced is shown as a labelled reference.
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Source = 'Balanced (reference)'; Scheme = $script:IgwtSchemeBalanced }
    }
    $names = @{ $script:IgwtSchemeBalanced = 'Balanced'; $script:IgwtSchemeHighPerformance = 'High performance'; 'a1841308-3541-4fab-bc81-f71556f20b4a' = 'Power saver' }
    $label = $(if ($base -eq $Scheme.ToLowerInvariant()) { 'plan' } else { [string]$names[$base] })
    return [pscustomobject]@{ Source = $label; Scheme = $base }
}

function Get-IgwtPowerDefaultValue {
    <# .SYNOPSIS AC/DC default of one setting from Get-IgwtPowerDefaults (falls back to Balanced), with its source. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Defaults, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Subgroup, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Setting)
    $g = $Setting.ToLowerInvariant()
    $d = Get-IgwtPowerSettingDefault -Scheme $Defaults.Scheme -Subgroup $Subgroup -Setting $g
    if ($d) { return [pscustomobject]@{ AC = $d.AC; DC = $d.DC; Source = $Defaults.Source } }
    $b = Get-IgwtPowerSettingDefault -Scheme $script:IgwtSchemeBalanced -Subgroup $Subgroup -Setting $g
    if ($b) { return [pscustomobject]@{ AC = $b.AC; DC = $b.DC; Source = 'Balanced' } }
    return $null
}

function Get-IgwtPowerHardwareTags {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    try { return @((Get-IgwtHardwareProfile).Tags) } catch { return @() }
}

function Format-IgwtPowerValue {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param($Setting, $Value)
    if ($null -eq $Value) { return '' }
    $opt = @($Setting.Options | Where-Object { $_.Index -eq [int]$Value }) | Select-Object -First 1
    if ($opt) { return "$Value ($($opt.Name))" }
    if ($Setting.Units) { return "$Value $($Setting.Units)" }
    return [string]$Value
}

function Get-IgwtPowerSettingsInspection {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Read-only power plan view: every setting of a subgroup in the active plan (hidden ones
        included) with AC/DC values, the Windows default for that plan (Balanced's when the plan
        is a custom copy), hidden flag, whether iG Windows Tuner can edit it and hardware blocks.
    .PARAMETER Subgroup
        Subgroup alias or GUID (default SUB_PROCESSOR).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([ValidatePattern('^([A-Z_]+|[0-9a-fA-F\-]{36})$')][string]$Subgroup = 'SUB_PROCESSOR')
    $scheme = Get-IgwtActivePowerScheme
    $schemeName = (@(Get-IgwtPowerSchemes | Where-Object { $_.Guid -eq $scheme }) | Select-Object -First 1).Name
    $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/qh', $scheme, $Subgroup)
    if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "powercfg /qh failed: $($r.Output)" }
    $subGuid = $Subgroup
    if ($Subgroup -eq 'SUB_PROCESSOR') { $subGuid = $script:IgwtSubProcessor }
    elseif ($Subgroup -notmatch "^$script:IgwtGuidPattern$") {
        $sm = [regex]::Match($r.Output, "(?m)^\s{2}\S.*?\b($script:IgwtGuidPattern)\b")
        if ($sm.Success) { $subGuid = $sm.Groups[1].Value.ToLowerInvariant() }
    }
    $tags = @(Get-IgwtPowerHardwareTags)
    $catalog = @{}
    foreach ($d in @(Get-IgwtPowerSettingCatalog)) { $catalog[([string]$d.guid).ToLowerInvariant()] = $d }
    $defaults = Get-IgwtPowerDefaults -Scheme $scheme -Subgroup $subGuid
    $rows = foreach ($s in @(ConvertFrom-IgwtPowerCfgQuery -Text $r.Output)) {
        $def = Get-IgwtPowerDefaultValue -Defaults $defaults -Subgroup $subGuid -Setting $s.Guid
        $defSource = $(if ($def) { [string]$def.Source } else { '' })
        $visible = Get-IgwtPowerAttributeVisible -Action ([pscustomobject]@{ subgroup = $subGuid; setting = $s.Guid })
        $meta = $catalog[$s.Guid]
        $blockAc = $null; $blockDc = $null
        if ($meta) { $blockAc = Get-IgwtPowerSettingBlock -Guid $s.Guid -Tags $tags; $blockDc = Get-IgwtPowerSettingBlock -Guid $s.Guid -Tags $tags -Dc }
        $changed = $false
        if ($def -and $null -ne $def.AC) { $changed = ($s.AC -ne $def.AC) -or ($null -ne $def.DC -and $s.DC -ne $def.DC) }
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Guid               = $s.Guid
            Alias              = $s.Alias
            Name               = $s.Name
            Group              = $(if ($meta) { [string]$meta.group } else { '' })
            AC                 = $s.AC
            DC                 = $s.DC
            AcText             = (Format-IgwtPowerValue -Setting $s -Value $s.AC)
            DcText             = (Format-IgwtPowerValue -Setting $s -Value $s.DC)
            DefaultAC          = $(if ($def) { $def.AC } else { $null })
            DefaultDC          = $(if ($def) { $def.DC } else { $null })
            DefaultSource      = $defSource
            ChangedFromDefault = $changed
            Min                = $s.Min
            Max                = $s.Max
            Increment          = $s.Increment
            Units              = $s.Units
            Options            = @($s.Options)
            Hidden             = ($visible -eq $false)
            Editable           = [bool]$meta -and -not $blockAc
            Level              = $(if ($meta) { [string]$meta.level } else { '' })
            Hint               = $(if ($meta) { [string]$meta.hint } else { '' })
            Description        = $(if ($meta) { [string]$meta.description } else { '' })
            Blocked            = [bool]$blockAc
            BlockReason        = [string]$blockAc
            DcBlocked          = [bool]$blockDc -and -not $blockAc
            DcBlockReason      = $(if ($blockDc -and -not $blockAc) { [string]$blockDc } else { '' })
            Sources            = $(if ($meta) { @($meta.sources) } else { @() })
        }
    }
    $rows = @($rows)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Scheme      = $scheme
        SchemeName  = $schemeName
        Subgroup    = $subGuid
        Tags        = $tags
        Settings    = $rows
        Editable    = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Editable }).Count
        Changed     = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.ChangedFromDefault }).Count
        DefaultsFrom = [string]$defaults.Source
        Note        = 'Values apply to the active power plan. Defaults come from Windows (stored plan defaults); a plan copy is compared with the built-in plan it came from, and Ultimate Performance with the built-in Ultimate plan.'
    }
}

function Test-IgwtPowerSettingValue {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Reason a value is invalid for a parsed setting, or $null. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Setting, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][long]$Value)
    if (@($Setting.Options).Count -gt 0) {
        if (@($Setting.Options | Where-Object { $_.Index -eq $Value }).Count -eq 0) { return "$Value is not one of the allowed values ($(@($Setting.Options | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Index) $($_.Name)" }) -join ', '))." }
        return $null
    }
    if ($null -ne $Setting.Min -and ($Value -lt $Setting.Min -or $Value -gt $Setting.Max)) { return "$Value is outside the allowed range $($Setting.Min)-$($Setting.Max)$(if ($Setting.Units) { " $($Setting.Units)" })." }
    if ($Setting.Increment -and [long]$Setting.Increment -gt 1 -and (($Value - [long]$Setting.Min) % [long]$Setting.Increment) -ne 0) { return "$Value is not a multiple of the step $($Setting.Increment)." }
    return $null
}

function Get-IgwtPowerSettingChangePlan {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Validates a power setting change without changing anything (used by -DryRun and by
        Invoke-IgwtPowerSettingChange): editable setting, available in the active plan, values in
        the range powercfg reports, not blocked by a hardware overlay. Throws with the reason when
        the change is not allowed; returns Definition, Scheme, Parsed, NewAC, NewDC, Change and
        HasChange otherwise.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Setting, [Nullable[long]]$AC, [Nullable[long]]$DC, [switch]$Default)
    $def = Get-IgwtPowerSettingDefinition -Setting $Setting
    $guid = ([string]$def.guid).ToLowerInvariant()
    $scheme = Get-IgwtActivePowerScheme
    $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -Arguments @('/qh', $scheme, $script:IgwtSubProcessor, $guid)
    $parsed = @(ConvertFrom-IgwtPowerCfgQuery -Text $r.Output | Where-Object { $_.Guid -eq $guid }) | Select-Object -First 1
    if (-not $parsed -or $null -eq $parsed.AC) { throw "Power setting $($def.alias) is not available in the active plan on this PC." }
    if ($Default) {
        $d = Get-IgwtPowerDefaultValue -Defaults (Get-IgwtPowerDefaults -Scheme $scheme -Subgroup $script:IgwtSubProcessor) -Subgroup $script:IgwtSubProcessor -Setting $guid
        if (-not $d -or $null -eq $d.AC) { throw "Windows has no stored default for $($def.alias)." }
        $AC = [long]$d.AC
        if ($null -ne $d.DC) { $DC = [long]$d.DC }
    }
    if ($null -eq $AC -and $null -eq $DC) { throw 'Give -AC, -DC or -Default.' }
    foreach ($pair in @(@{ Name = 'AC'; Value = $AC }, @{ Name = 'DC'; Value = $DC })) {
        if ($null -eq $pair.Value) { continue }
        $bad = Test-IgwtPowerSettingValue -Setting $parsed -Value ([long]$pair.Value)
        if ($bad) { throw "$($def.alias) $($pair.Name): $bad" }
    }
    $tags = @(Get-IgwtPowerHardwareTags)
    $block = Get-IgwtPowerSettingBlock -Guid $guid -Tags $tags -Dc:($null -ne $DC)
    if ($block) { throw "$($def.alias): $block" }
    $newAc = $(if ($null -ne $AC) { [long]$AC } else { [long]$parsed.AC })
    $newDc = $(if ($null -ne $DC) { [long]$DC } else { [long]$parsed.DC })
    $change = "AC $(Format-IgwtPowerValue -Setting $parsed -Value $parsed.AC) -> $(Format-IgwtPowerValue -Setting $parsed -Value $newAc); DC $(Format-IgwtPowerValue -Setting $parsed -Value $parsed.DC) -> $(Format-IgwtPowerValue -Setting $parsed -Value $newDc)"
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Definition = $def; Scheme = $scheme; Guid = $guid; Parsed = $parsed; NewAC = $newAc; NewDC = $newDc
        HasChange = -not ($newAc -eq $parsed.AC -and $newDc -eq $parsed.DC); Change = $change
    }
}

function Invoke-IgwtPowerSettingChange {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Changes one editable processor setting of the active power plan after writing a snapshot
        (operation 'Power'). Values are checked against the range powercfg reports; settings
        blocked by a hardware overlay are refused. Expert settings need -AcknowledgeRisk.
    .PARAMETER Setting
        Alias (for example PERFEPP) or GUID from data\power\processor.json.
    .PARAMETER AC
        New plugged-in value. Omit to leave it unchanged.
    .PARAMETER DC
        New battery value. Omit to leave it unchanged.
    .PARAMETER Default
        Set AC and DC to the Windows default of the plan (Balanced as reference for Ultimate copies).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Setting, [Nullable[long]]$AC, [Nullable[long]]$DC, [switch]$Default, [switch]$AcknowledgeRisk)
    if (-not $script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) {
        if (-not (Test-IgwtIsAdmin)) { throw 'Power plan changes need administrator rights.' }
        Initialize-IgwtDataRoot
    }
    $def = Get-IgwtPowerSettingDefinition -Setting $Setting
    if ([string]$def.level -eq 'Expert' -and -not $AcknowledgeRisk) { throw "'$($def.alias)' is an Expert setting. Review its description, then confirm with -AcknowledgeRisk." }
    $plan = Get-IgwtPowerSettingChangePlan -Setting $Setting -AC $AC -DC $DC -Default:$Default
    if (-not $plan.HasChange) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Snapshot = $null; Changes = 0; Results = @() } }
    $scheme = $plan.Scheme; $guid = $plan.Guid; $parsed = $plan.Parsed; $newAc = $plan.NewAC; $newDc = $plan.NewDC; $change = $plan.Change
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$($def.alias) in plan $scheme", $change)) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Snapshot = $null; Changes = 0; Results = @() } }
    $snap = New-IgwtSnapshot -Operation 'Power' -Detail "$($def.alias): $change"
    Save-IgwtSnapshot -Snapshot $snap
    $data = [ordered]@{ scheme = $scheme; subgroup = $script:IgwtSubProcessor; setting = $guid; ac = [long]$parsed.AC; dc = [long]$parsed.DC }
    $actions = @([ordered]@{ index = 0; type = 'powerSettingValue'; fingerprint = "powerSettingValue|$guid"; data = $data })
    Add-IgwtSnapshotEntry -Snapshot $snap -TweakId "power:$($def.alias)" -Actions $actions -Result 'Applied' -Message $change -Level ([string]$def.level)
    try {
        Set-IgwtPowerSettingIndex -Scheme $scheme -Subgroup $script:IgwtSubProcessor -Setting $guid -AC $(if ($newAc -ne $parsed.AC) { $newAc } else { $null }) -DC $(if ($newDc -ne $parsed.DC) { $newDc } else { $null })
        Write-IgwtLog -Message "Power setting $($def.alias): $change. Snapshot: $($snap.Path)"
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Snapshot = $snap.Path; Changes = 1; Results = @([pscustomobject]@{ Target = [string]$def.alias; Change = $change; Result = 'Applied'; Message = '' }) }
    } catch {
        Add-IgwtSnapshotEntry -Snapshot $snap -TweakId "power:$($def.alias)" -Actions $actions -Result 'Failed' -Message $_.Exception.Message -Level ([string]$def.level)
        Write-IgwtLog -Level Error -Message "Power setting $($def.alias): $($_.Exception.Message)"
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Snapshot = $snap.Path; Changes = 1; Results = @([pscustomobject]@{ Target = [string]$def.alias; Change = $change; Result = 'Failed'; Message = $_.Exception.Message }) }
    }
}

function Restore-IgwtPowerSettingSnapshot {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Reverts a 'Power' snapshot. Setting GUIDs are validated against data\power\processor.json
        and the plan must still exist. The current values are captured in a new snapshot first.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$SnapshotPath)
    $doc = Read-IgwtSnapshot -Path $SnapshotPath
    if ([string]$doc.operation -ne 'Power') { throw 'This is not a power plan snapshot.' }
    $entries = @($doc.entries | Where-Object { $_ -and [string]$_.result -in 'Applied', 'Failed' })
    [array]::Reverse($entries)
    $results = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    if ($entries.Count -eq 0 -or -not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$($entries.Count) power setting(s) from $(Split-Path $SnapshotPath -Leaf)", 'Revert')) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Snapshot = $null; Results = @() } }
    $undo = New-IgwtSnapshot -Operation 'Power' -Detail "revert of $(Split-Path $SnapshotPath -Leaf)"
    Save-IgwtSnapshot -Snapshot $undo
    foreach ($e in $entries) {
        $tid = [string]$e.tweakId
        foreach ($a in @($e.actions | Where-Object { $_ })) {
            try {
                if ([string]$a.type -ne 'powerSettingValue') { throw "Unknown power snapshot action '$($a.type)'." }
                $def = Get-IgwtPowerSettingDefinition -Setting ([string]$a.data.setting)
                $guid = ([string]$def.guid).ToLowerInvariant()
                $scheme = ([string]$a.data.scheme).ToLowerInvariant()
                if ($scheme -notmatch "^$script:IgwtGuidPattern$") { throw 'Snapshot does not contain a valid plan GUID.' }
                if (-not (Test-IgwtPowerSchemeExists -Guid $scheme)) { throw "Power plan $scheme no longer exists." }
                $cur = Get-IgwtPowerSettingValue -Scheme $scheme -Subgroup $script:IgwtSubProcessor -Setting $guid
                if ($cur) {
                    Add-IgwtSnapshotEntry -Snapshot $undo -TweakId $tid -Actions @([ordered]@{ index = 0; type = 'powerSettingValue'; fingerprint = "powerSettingValue|$guid"; data = [ordered]@{ scheme = $scheme; subgroup = $script:IgwtSubProcessor; setting = $guid; ac = [long]$cur.AC; dc = [long]$cur.DC } }) -Result 'Applied' -Message 'before revert'
                }
                Set-IgwtPowerSettingIndex -Scheme $scheme -Subgroup $script:IgwtSubProcessor -Setting $guid -AC ([long]$a.data.ac) -DC ([long]$a.data.dc)
                $results.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Id = $tid; Result = 'Reverted'; Message = '' })
            } catch {
                $results.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Id = $tid; Result = 'Failed'; Message = $_.Exception.Message })
                Write-IgwtLog -Level Error -Message "Power revert of ${tid}: $($_.Exception.Message)"
            }
        }
    }
    Write-IgwtLog -Message "Power snapshot $(Split-Path $SnapshotPath -Leaf) reverted. Undo snapshot: $($undo.Path)"
    return [pscustomobject]@{ Snapshot = $undo.Path; Results = $results.ToArray() }
}
```
