`src/Manage/Diagnostics.ps1`:

```ps1
# Diagnostics.ps1
# Read-only diagnostics: DPC and ISR percentages from performance counters with top processes,
# reliability history, crashes (BugCheck, Kernel-Power 41, unexpected shutdowns, app crashes and
# the minidump list), boot performance (Diagnostics-Performance event 100) and the driver inventory
# with date and signer. Nothing here changes the system.

function Get-IgwtProcessorRawSample {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        One raw sample of the _Total processor counters. Formatted (cooked) WMI counters need two
        reads in the same query, so percentages are computed from raw deltas instead. Mock this in tests.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $c = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PerfRawData_PerfOS_Processor -Filter "Name='_Total'" -ErrorAction Stop
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Dpc = [double]$c.PercentDPCTime; Isr = [double]$c.PercentInterruptTime; Idle = [double]$c.PercentIdleTime; Interrupts = [double]$c.InterruptsPersec; Dpcs = [double]$c.DPCsQueuedPersec
        Time100ns = [double]$c.Timestamp_Sys100NS; PerfTime = [double]$c.Timestamp_PerfTime; PerfFreq = [double]$c.Frequency_PerfTime
    }
}

function ConvertFrom-IgwtProcessorRawPair {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Percentages and rates between two raw samples (100 ns timers against Timestamp_Sys100NS, counts against the performance clock). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$First, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Second)
    $dt = $Second.Time100ns - $First.Time100ns
    $sec = $(if ($Second.PerfFreq -gt 0) { ($Second.PerfTime - $First.PerfTime) / $Second.PerfFreq } else { $dt / 1e7 })
    if ($dt -le 0 -or $sec -le 0) { return $null }
    # Double literals: with an int first argument PowerShell picks Math.Min(int, int) and truncates fractions.
    $pct = { param($a, $b) [Math]::Max([double]0, [Math]::Min([double]100, [double](100 * ($b - $a) / $dt))) }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Dpc = (& $pct $First.Dpc $Second.Dpc); Isr = (& $pct $First.Isr $Second.Isr); Cpu = (100 - (& $pct $First.Idle $Second.Idle))
        InterruptsPerSec = [Math]::Max([double]0, [double](($Second.Interrupts - $First.Interrupts) / $sec)); DpcRate = [Math]::Max([double]0, [double](($Second.Dpcs - $First.Dpcs) / $sec))
    }
}

function Get-IgwtDpcIsrSample {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Samples the DPC and ISR percentages Samples times (one second apart) and lists the top
        processes by CPU. Windows only exposes totals; LatencyMon or WPA name the driver behind
        high DPC time.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([ValidateRange(1, 60)][int]$Samples = 5, [ValidateRange(1, 50)][int]$Top = 10)
    $rows = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $cpuTimes = { $h = @{}; foreach ($p in @(Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { try { $h[[int]$p.Id] = [pscustomobject]@{ Name = [string]$p.ProcessName; Cpu = [double]$p.TotalProcessorTime.TotalSeconds; WorkingSet = [double]$p.WorkingSet64 } } catch { Write-Verbose "No CPU time for $($p.Id)" } }; $h }
    $before = & $cpuTimes
    $clock = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
    $prev = Get-IgwtProcessorRawSample
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Samples; $i++) {
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
        $cur = Get-IgwtProcessorRawSample
        $pair = ConvertFrom-IgwtProcessorRawPair -First $prev -Second $cur
        if ($pair) { $rows.Add($pair) }
        $prev = $cur
    }
    if ($rows.Count -eq 0) { throw 'The processor counters did not advance.' }
    $list = $rows.ToArray()
    $stat = { param($p) $m = $list | Measure-Object -Property $p -Average -Maximum; [pscustomobject]@{ Average = [Math]::Round([double]$m.Average, 3); Max = [Math]::Round([double]$m.Maximum, 3) } }
    # Top processes: CPU time used during the sampling window, as a share of all logical processors.
    $after = & $cpuTimes
    $window = [Math]::Max(0.5, $clock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds) * [Math]::Max(1, [Environment]::ProcessorCount)
    $procs = @($after.Keys | Where-Object { $before.ContainsKey($_) -and $_ -ne 0 } | ForEach-Object {
            $b = $before[$_]; $a = $after[$_]
            [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $a.Name; ProcessId = [int]$_; CpuPercent = [Math]::Round([Math]::Max([double]0, [double](100 * ($a.Cpu - $b.Cpu) / $window)), 2); WorkingSetMB = [Math]::Round($a.WorkingSet / 1MB, 1) }
        } | Sort-Object CpuPercent, WorkingSetMB -Descending | Select-Object -First $Top)
    $dpc = & $stat 'Dpc'; $isr = & $stat 'Isr'
    $advice = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    if ($dpc.Average -ge 2 -or $isr.Average -ge 1) { $advice.Add('DPC or interrupt time is high for an idle desktop. Run LatencyMon to find the driver; update chipset, network, audio and GPU drivers first.') }
    elseif ($dpc.Max -ge 5) { $advice.Add('Short DPC spikes were measured. Check again while idle; if they repeat, LatencyMon names the driver.') }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Samples   = $list
        Dpc       = $dpc
        Isr       = $isr
        DpcRate   = & $stat 'DpcRate'
        Interrupts = & $stat 'InterruptsPerSec'
        Cpu       = & $stat 'Cpu'
        TopProcesses = $procs
        Advice    = $advice.ToArray()
        Note      = 'Percentages of total CPU time across all cores. Below 1 % DPC and 0.5 % ISR while idle is normal. Measure while the PC is otherwise idle.'
    }
}

function Get-IgwtReliabilityHistory {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Reliability Monitor data: stability index trend and recent reliability records (read-only). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([ValidateRange(1, 365)][int]$Days = 30, [ValidateRange(1, 500)][int]$Max = 100)
    $since = (Get-Date).AddDays(-$Days)
    $index = @(); $records = @(); $err = ''
    try {
        $index = @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ReliabilityStabilityMetrics -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.TimeGenerated -ge $since } |
                Sort-Object TimeGenerated | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Time = $_.TimeGenerated; Index = [Math]::Round([double]$_.SystemStabilityIndex, 2) } })
    } catch { $err = 'Reliability metrics unavailable (the RacTask scheduled task collects them).' }
    try {
        $records = @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ReliabilityRecords -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.TimeGenerated -ge $since } |
                Sort-Object TimeGenerated -Descending | Select-Object -First $Max | ForEach-Object {
                    [pscustomobject]@{ Time = $_.TimeGenerated; Source = [string]$_.SourceName; Product = [string]$_.ProductName; EventId = [int]$_.EventIdentifier; Message = ([string]$_.Message -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim() }
                })
    } catch { if (-not $err) { $err = 'Reliability records unavailable.' } }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Days = $Days; Index = $index; Current = $(if ($index.Count) { $index[$index.Count - 1].Index } else { $null })
        Records = $records; Error = $err; Note = 'Stability index from 1 (unstable) to 10 (stable), the same data as Reliability Monitor (perfmon /rel).'
    }
}

function Get-IgwtEventSafe {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Get-WinEvent with a filter hashtable; returns an empty list when the log has no match or is unreadable. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][hashtable]$Filter, [int]$Max = 50)
    try { @(Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable $Filter -MaxEvents $Max -ErrorAction Stop) } catch { @() }
}

function Get-IgwtCrashHistory {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Crashes from the event logs: BugCheck (blue screens), Kernel-Power 41 (lost power or hard
        hang), EventLog 6008 (unexpected shutdown) and application crashes (event 1000), plus the
        minidump list.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([ValidateRange(1, 365)][int]$Days = 30)
    $since = (Get-Date).AddDays(-$Days)
    $rows = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $specs = @(
        @{ Kind = 'BugCheck'; Filter = @{ LogName = 'System'; ProviderName = 'Microsoft-Windows-WER-SystemErrorReporting'; Id = 1001; StartTime = $since } }
        @{ Kind = 'KernelPower41'; Filter = @{ LogName = 'System'; ProviderName = 'Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Power'; Id = 41; StartTime = $since } }
        @{ Kind = 'UnexpectedShutdown'; Filter = @{ LogName = 'System'; ProviderName = 'EventLog'; Id = 6008; StartTime = $since } }
        @{ Kind = 'AppCrash'; Filter = @{ LogName = 'Application'; ProviderName = 'Application Error'; Id = 1000; StartTime = $since } }
    )
    foreach ($s in $specs) {
        foreach ($ev in @(Get-IgwtEventSafe -Filter $s.Filter -Max 50)) {
            $msg = ([string]$ev.Message -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
            $detail = $msg
            if ($s.Kind -eq 'BugCheck' -and $msg -match '(0x[0-9a-fA-F]{8})') { $detail = "Stop code $($Matches[1]). $msg" }
            elseif ($s.Kind -eq 'AppCrash' -and $ev.Properties.Count -ge 4) { $detail = "$($ev.Properties[0].Value) crashed in $($ev.Properties[3].Value)" }
            $rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Time = $ev.TimeCreated; Kind = $s.Kind; EventId = [int]$ev.Id; Detail = $(if ($detail.Length -gt 300) { $detail.Substring(0, 300) } else { $detail }) })
        }
    }
    $crash = Get-IgwtCrashInspection
    $minis = @()
    try { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $crash.MinidumpFolder) { $minis = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $crash.MinidumpFolder -Filter '*.dmp' -File -ErrorAction Stop | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $_.Name; Time = $_.LastWriteTime; SizeKB = [Math]::Round($_.Length / 1KB) } }) } }
    catch { $minis = @() }
    $list = @($rows.ToArray() | Sort-Object Time -Descending)
    $count = { param($k) @($list | Where-Object { $_.Kind -eq $k }).Count }
    $advice = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    if ((& $count 'BugCheck') -gt 0) { $advice.Add('Blue screens were recorded. The stop code and the minidump (WinDbg: !analyze -v) name the cause; undo recent overclocks and update drivers first.') }
    if ((& $count 'KernelPower41') -gt (& $count 'BugCheck')) { $advice.Add('Kernel-Power 41 without a blue screen usually means a hard hang or power loss: check memory/CPU stability (XMP, undervolt), PSU and the latest BIOS microcode.') }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Days = $Days; Events = $list
        Counts = [pscustomobject]@{ BugCheck = & $count 'BugCheck'; KernelPower41 = & $count 'KernelPower41'; UnexpectedShutdown = & $count 'UnexpectedShutdown'; AppCrash = & $count 'AppCrash' }
        Minidumps = $minis; MinidumpFolder = $crash.MinidumpFolder; DumpType = $crash.DumpTypeName; Advice = $advice.ToArray()
        Note = 'Read-only. Minidumps are never deleted here; the cleaner handles them with its own rule.'
    }
}

function Get-IgwtBootPerformance {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Boot durations from Diagnostics-Performance event 100 (administrator rights needed to read that log). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([ValidateRange(1, 100)][int]$Max = 10)
    $events = @(Get-IgwtEventSafe -Filter @{ LogName = 'Microsoft-Windows-Diagnostics-Performance/Operational'; Id = 100 } -Max $Max)
    $rows = foreach ($ev in $events) {
        $data = @{}
        try { foreach ($d in ([xml]$ev.ToXml()).Event.EventData.Data) { $data[[string]$d.Name] = [string]$d.'#text' } } catch { Write-Verbose 'Event XML unreadable.' }
        $ms = { param($n) if ($data.ContainsKey($n) -and $data[$n] -match '^\d+$') { [long]$data[$n] } else { $null } }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Time = $ev.TimeCreated; BootMs = & $ms 'BootTime'; MainPathMs = & $ms 'MainPathBootTime'; PostBootMs = & $ms 'BootPostBootTime'; Degraded = ([string]$ev.LevelDisplayName -ne 'Information') }
    }
    $rows = @($rows)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Boots = $rows
        AverageBootSeconds = $(if (@($rows | Where-Object { $_.BootMs }).Count) { [Math]::Round((@($rows | Where-Object { $_.BootMs }) | Measure-Object -Property BootMs -Average).Average / 1000, 1) } else { $null })
        Error = $(if ($rows.Count -eq 0) { 'No boot records readable (the Diagnostics-Performance log needs administrator rights).' } else { '' })
        Note = 'MainPath is the time to the desktop; PostBoot is the time until the system is idle. Startup apps mostly add PostBoot time.'
    }
}

function Get-IgwtDriverInventory {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Signed PnP drivers with device, class, version, date, provider and signer. Flags unsigned
        drivers and non-Microsoft drivers older than three years.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([switch]$IncludeMicrosoft)
    $cut = (Get-Date).AddYears(-3)
    $rows = foreach ($d in @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PnPSignedDriver -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.DeviceName -and $_.DriverVersion })) {
        $ms = ([string]$d.DriverProviderName -eq 'Microsoft')
        if ($ms -and -not $IncludeMicrosoft) { continue }
        $date = $d.DriverDate
        $flag = ''
        # Intel chipset INFs use the placeholder date 1968-07-18 on purpose (so any real driver ranks higher); not old.
        if (-not $d.IsSigned) { $flag = 'Unsigned' } elseif (-not $ms -and $date -and $date -lt $cut -and $date.Year -ge 2000) { $flag = 'Old' }
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Device = [string]$d.DeviceName; Class = [string]$d.DeviceClass; Version = [string]$d.DriverVersion; Date = $(if ($date) { $date.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd') } else { '' })
            Provider = [string]$d.DriverProviderName; Signer = [string]$d.Signer; Inf = [string]$d.InfName; Signed = [bool]$d.IsSigned; Flag = $flag
        }
    }
    $rows = @($rows | Sort-Object Class, Device)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Drivers = $rows
        Counts = [pscustomobject]@{ Total = $rows.Count; Unsigned = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Flag -eq 'Unsigned' }).Count; Old = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Flag -eq 'Old' }).Count }
        Note = 'Read-only. Old is a hint, not a fault: some devices never get newer drivers. Update GPU, chipset, network and audio drivers from the vendor.'
    }
}

function Get-IgwtDiagnostics {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Runs the selected diagnostics (DpcIsr, Reliability, Crashes, Boot, Drivers); each failure is reported, not thrown. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([ValidateSet('DpcIsr', 'Reliability', 'Crashes', 'Boot', 'Drivers')][string[]]$Area = @('DpcIsr', 'Reliability', 'Crashes', 'Boot', 'Drivers'), [int]$Days = 30, [int]$Samples = 5)
    $out = [ordered]@{ Generated = (Get-Date).ToString('o') }
    foreach ($a in $Area) {
        try {
            $out[$a] = switch ($a) {
                'DpcIsr' { Get-IgwtDpcIsrSample -Samples $Samples }
                'Reliability' { Get-IgwtReliabilityHistory -Days $Days }
                'Crashes' { Get-IgwtCrashHistory -Days $Days }
                'Boot' { Get-IgwtBootPerformance }
                'Drivers' { Get-IgwtDriverInventory }
            }
        } catch { $out[$a] = [pscustomobject]@{ Error = $_.Exception.Message } }
    }
    return [pscustomobject]$out
}

function Format-IgwtDiagnostics {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Plain-text rendering of Get-IgwtDiagnostics. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Diagnostics)
    $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
    $p = $Diagnostics.PSObject.Properties
    if ($p['DpcIsr'] -and -not $Diagnostics.DpcIsr.PSObject.Properties['Error']) {
        $d = $Diagnostics.DpcIsr
        $null = $sb.AppendLine("[DPC / ISR] DPC avg $($d.Dpc.Average) % (max $($d.Dpc.Max) %), ISR avg $($d.Isr.Average) % (max $($d.Isr.Max) %), $([Math]::Round($d.Interrupts.Average)) interrupts/s")
        foreach ($t in @($d.TopProcesses | Select-Object -First 5)) { $null = $sb.AppendLine(('    {0,-30} {1,5} % CPU  {2,8} MB' -f $t.Name, $t.CpuPercent, $t.WorkingSetMB)) }
        foreach ($a in $d.Advice) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("    -> $a") }
    }
    if ($p['Reliability'] -and -not $Diagnostics.Reliability.PSObject.Properties['Records']) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("[Reliability] $($Diagnostics.Reliability.Error)") }
    elseif ($p['Reliability']) {
        $r = $Diagnostics.Reliability
        $null = $sb.AppendLine("[Reliability] Stability index: $(if ($null -ne $r.Current) { $r.Current } else { 'n/a' }); $(@($r.Records).Count) records in $($r.Days) days $(if ($r.Error) { "($($r.Error))" })")
        foreach ($x in @($r.Records | Select-Object -First 8)) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("    $($x.Time) $($x.Source): $($x.Product)") }
    }
    if ($p['Crashes'] -and $Diagnostics.Crashes.PSObject.Properties['Counts']) {
        $c = $Diagnostics.Crashes
        $null = $sb.AppendLine("[Crashes, $($c.Days) days] BugCheck $($c.Counts.BugCheck), Kernel-Power 41 $($c.Counts.KernelPower41), unexpected shutdown $($c.Counts.UnexpectedShutdown), app crashes $($c.Counts.AppCrash); minidumps $(@($c.Minidumps).Count) ($($c.DumpType))")
        foreach ($x in @($c.Events | Where-Object { $_.Kind -ne 'AppCrash' } | Select-Object -First 8)) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("    $($x.Time) $($x.Kind): $($x.Detail)") }
        foreach ($a in $c.Advice) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("    -> $a") }
    }
    if ($p['Boot'] -and $Diagnostics.Boot.PSObject.Properties['Boots']) {
        $b = $Diagnostics.Boot
        $null = $sb.AppendLine("[Boot] $(if ($b.Error) { $b.Error } else { "Average boot $($b.AverageBootSeconds) s over $(@($b.Boots).Count) boots" })")
        foreach ($x in @($b.Boots | Select-Object -First 5)) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("    $($x.Time) total $($x.BootMs) ms, main path $($x.MainPathMs) ms, post boot $($x.PostBootMs) ms") }
    }
    if ($p['Drivers'] -and $Diagnostics.Drivers.PSObject.Properties['Counts']) {
        $dr = $Diagnostics.Drivers
        $null = $sb.AppendLine("[Drivers] $($dr.Counts.Total) non-Microsoft drivers, $($dr.Counts.Unsigned) unsigned, $($dr.Counts.Old) older than three years")
        foreach ($x in @($dr.Drivers | Where-Object { $_.Flag } | Select-Object -First 10)) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("    [$($x.Flag)] $($x.Device) $($x.Version) $($x.Date) ($($x.Provider))") }
    }
    foreach ($a in $p) { if ($a.Value -and $a.Value.PSObject.Properties['Error'] -and $a.Value.PSObject.Properties.Name.Count -eq 1) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("[$($a.Name)] error: $($a.Value.Error)") } }
    return $sb.ToString()
}
```

`src/Manage/Inventory.ps1`:

```ps1
# Inventory.ps1
# Read-only inventories for the management modules: services (with a "safe to change" rating and
# the catalog items and presets that touch them), scheduled tasks, installed Win32 and Appx apps,
# and optional features and capabilities. Changes go through Invoke-IgwtManagedChange.

function Get-IgwtCatalogServiceMap {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Service name (lower case) -> catalog items (and the presets that include them) that change it. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $map = @{}
    $presets = @(); try { $presets = @(Get-IgwtPreset) } catch { $presets = @() }
    foreach ($t in @(Get-IgwtCatalog)) {
        $names = @()
        foreach ($a in @($t.actions)) {
            if ([string]$a.type -eq 'service') { $names += [string]$a.name }
            elseif ([string]$a.type -eq 'serviceSet') { $names += @($a.services | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.name }) }
        }
        foreach ($n in $names) {
            $k = $n.ToLowerInvariant()
            if (-not $map.ContainsKey($k)) { $map[$k] = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object] }
            $in = @($presets | Where-Object { @($_.tweaks) -contains $t.id } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.name })
            $map[$k].Add([pscustomobject]@{ Id = [string]$t.id; Name = [string]$t.name; Presets = $in })
        }
    }
    return $map
}

function Get-IgwtServiceInventory {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Every Win32 service with display name, description, status, startup type, dependencies and
        a rating: Protected (never changed), Catalogued (a catalog item manages it), Windows (part
        of Windows: change only when you know what depends on it) or ThirdParty.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $cat = Get-IgwtCatalogServiceMap
    $deps = @{}
    try {
        foreach ($s in @(Get-Service -ErrorAction Stop)) {
            $deps[([string]$s.Name).ToLowerInvariant()] = [pscustomobject]@{ DependsOn = @($s.ServicesDependedOn | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Name }); Dependents = @($s.DependentServices | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Name }) }
        }
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'Service dependencies unavailable.' }
    $windir = [string]$env:SystemRoot
    $rows = foreach ($s in @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Service -ErrorAction Stop)) {
        $name = [string]$s.Name
        $lower = $name.ToLowerInvariant()
        $start = [string]$s.StartMode
        if ($start -eq 'Auto') { $start = $(if ($s.DelayedAutoStart) { 'AutomaticDelayed' } else { 'Automatic' }) }
        $protect = Get-IgwtServiceProtection -Name $name
        $path = [string]$s.PathName
        $inWindowsDir = ($windir -and $path.TrimStart('"').StartsWith($windir, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        $items = @(); if ($cat.ContainsKey($lower)) { $items = $cat[$lower].ToArray() }
        $rating = $(if ($protect) { 'Protected' } elseif ($items.Count) { 'Catalogued' } elseif ($inWindowsDir) { 'Windows' } else { 'ThirdParty' })
        $advice = switch ($rating) {
            'Protected' { $protect }
            'Catalogued' { "Managed by catalog item(s) $(@($items | ForEach-Object { $_.Id }) -join ', '); prefer those, they include the documented reasons." }
            'Windows' { 'Part of Windows. Change it only when you know which feature needs it; Manual is safer than Disabled.' }
            default { 'Installed by an application. Manual or Disabled is fine when you do not use that application.' }
        }
        $d = $deps[$lower]
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Name = $name; DisplayName = [string]$s.DisplayName; Description = [string]$s.Description; State = [string]$s.State; StartupType = $start
            Account = [string]$s.StartName; Path = $path; Rating = $rating; Advice = $advice; CatalogItems = $items
            DependsOn = $(if ($d) { @($d.DependsOn) } else { @() }); Dependents = $(if ($d) { @($d.Dependents) } else { @() })
            CanChange = ($rating -ne 'Protected')
        }
    }
    $rows = @($rows | Sort-Object DisplayName)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Services = $rows
        Counts   = [pscustomobject]@{ Total = $rows.Count; Running = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.State -eq 'Running' }).Count; Protected = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Rating -eq 'Protected' }).Count; ThirdParty = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Rating -eq 'ThirdParty' }).Count }
        Note     = 'Read-only. Changes are snapshot-backed (Invoke-IgwtManagedChange -Kind service) and protected services are refused.'
    }
}

function Get-IgwtTaskInventory {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Every scheduled task with state, author, action, last result and whether iG Windows Tuner may disable it. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $rows = foreach ($t in @(Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction Stop)) {
        $full = "$($t.TaskPath)$($t.TaskName)"
        $protected = $false
        try { Assert-IgwtTaskAllowed -Path ([string]$t.TaskPath) } catch { $protected = $true }
        if ($full -match $script:IgwtAntiCheatTaskPattern) { $protected = $true }
        $exec = @($t.Actions | ForEach-Object { if ($_.PSObject.Properties['Execute'] -and $_.Execute) { "$($_.Execute) $($_.Arguments)".Trim() } elseif ($_.PSObject.Properties['ClassId'] -and $_.ClassId) { "COM handler $($_.ClassId)" } }) -join '; '
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Path = $full; TaskPath = [string]$t.TaskPath; Name = [string]$t.TaskName; State = [string]$t.State; Author = [string]$t.Author; Description = [string]$t.Description
            Action = $exec; IsMicrosoft = ([string]$t.TaskPath -like '\Microsoft\*'); Protected = $protected; CanDisable = (-not $protected -and [string]$t.State -ne 'Disabled')
        }
    }
    $rows = @($rows | Sort-Object Path)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Tasks  = $rows
        Counts = [pscustomobject]@{ Total = $rows.Count; Disabled = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.State -eq 'Disabled' }).Count; ThirdParty = @($rows | Where-Object { -not $_.IsMicrosoft }).Count }
        Note   = 'Tasks are only enabled or disabled, never created or deleted. Windows Defender, Windows Update, TPM, BitLocker, restore, time and anti-cheat tasks are protected. The curated telemetry set is catalog item privacy.telemetry-tasks-off.'
    }
}

function Get-IgwtAppInventory {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Installed Win32 apps (uninstall entries) and Appx packages, with protection and removal notes. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $win32 = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $roots = @('HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall', 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall', 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall')
    foreach ($root in $roots) {
        try {
            foreach ($k in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath $root) -ErrorAction Stop)) {
                $name = [string]$k.GetValue('DisplayName')
                if (-not $name -or [int]$k.GetValue('SystemComponent', 0) -eq 1 -or [string]$k.GetValue('ParentKeyName')) { continue }
                $win32.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Name = $name; Version = [string]$k.GetValue('DisplayVersion'); Publisher = [string]$k.GetValue('Publisher'); InstallDate = [string]$k.GetValue('InstallDate')
                        SizeMB = $(if ($k.GetValue('EstimatedSize')) { [Math]::Round([double]$k.GetValue('EstimatedSize') / 1024, 1) } else { $null }); Scope = $(if ($root -like 'HKCU*') { 'User' } else { 'Machine' }) })
            }
        } catch { Write-Verbose "Uninstall key not readable: $root" }
    }
    $appx = @()
    try {
        $appx = @(Get-AppxPackage -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { -not $_.IsFramework } | ForEach-Object {
                $prot = Test-IgwtAppxProtected -Package ([string]$_.Name)
                $system = ([string]$_.SignatureKind -eq 'System')
                [pscustomobject]@{ Name = [string]$_.Name; Version = [string]$_.Version; Publisher = [string]$_.PublisherId; Inbox = ([string]$_.SignatureKind -in 'System', 'Store' -and [string]$_.Publisher -like '*Microsoft*')
                    Protected = ($prot -or $system); CanRemove = -not ($prot -or $system)
                    Note = $(if ($prot) { 'Protected: needed by the Store, gaming services, security or the shell.' } elseif ($system) { 'System component: cannot be removed.' } else { 'Removal is reversible only partially: iG Windows Tuner re-registers the app or reinstalls it from the Microsoft Store.' }) }
            })
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'Appx packages unavailable.' }
    $unique = @($win32 | Sort-Object Name, Version -Unique)
    [pscustomobject]@{ Win32 = $unique; Appx = @($appx | Sort-Object Name); Note = 'Win32 apps are uninstalled with their own uninstaller (Settings > Apps); iG Windows Tuner only removes inbox Appx apps, with a snapshot.' }
}

function Get-IgwtFeatureInventory {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Optional features and capabilities with their state (administrator rights needed to read them). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $features = @(); $caps = @(); $err = ''
    try {
        $features = @(Get-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -ErrorAction Stop | ForEach-Object {
                [pscustomobject]@{ Name = [string]$_.FeatureName; State = [string]$_.State; Protected = (Test-IgwtNamePattern -Name ([string]$_.FeatureName) -Patterns $script:IgwtProtectedFeatures) }
            } | Sort-Object Name)
    } catch { $err = 'Optional features need administrator rights to read.' }
    try {
        $caps = @(Get-WindowsCapability -Online -ErrorAction Stop | ForEach-Object {
                [pscustomobject]@{ Name = [string]$_.Name; State = [string]$_.State; Protected = (Test-IgwtNamePattern -Name ([string]$_.Name) -Patterns $script:IgwtProtectedCapabilities) }
            } | Sort-Object Name)
    } catch { if (-not $err) { $err = 'Capabilities need administrator rights to read.' } }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Features = $features; Capabilities = $caps; Error = $err; Note = 'Changes are snapshot-backed (Invoke-IgwtManagedChange -Kind feature/capability); protected entries are refused.' }
}
```

`src/Manage/ManagedChange.ps1`:

```ps1
# ManagedChange.ps1
# One audited path for the changes the management modules offer (service startup type, scheduled
# task enable/disable, inbox app removal, optional features, capabilities, app firewall rules).
# Each change becomes a synthetic action of an existing, tested action type, is snapshotted
# (operation 'Manage') and applied through the normal dispatch. On revert the action is rebuilt from
# the stored kind/target/value and validated again against the protection rules, so an edited
# snapshot cannot target a protected service, task, app or Windows firewall rule.

$script:IgwtManagedKinds = @('service', 'task', 'appx', 'feature', 'capability', 'firewallRule')
$script:IgwtManagedValues = @{
    service      = @('Automatic', 'AutomaticDelayed', 'Manual', 'Disabled')
    task         = @('Enabled', 'Disabled')
    appx         = @('Removed')
    feature      = @('Enabled', 'Disabled')
    capability   = @('Installed', 'NotPresent')
    firewallRule = @('Enabled', 'Disabled')
}
# Features and capabilities the manager never changes.
$script:IgwtProtectedFeatures = @('Windows-Defender*', 'NetFx4*', 'Microsoft-Windows-Subsystem-Linux', 'VirtualMachinePlatform', 'Printing-PrintToPDFServices-Features', 'SearchEngine-Client-Package')
$script:IgwtProtectedCapabilities = @('Language.*', 'Microsoft.Windows.Notepad*', 'Microsoft.Windows.PowerShell.ISE*', 'Windows.Client.ShellComponents*', 'OpenSSH.Client*')
$script:IgwtAntiCheatTaskPattern = '(?i)(vgc|vanguard|faceit|easyanticheat|battleye|ricochet|javelin)'

function Get-IgwtServiceRules {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Protected service rules from data\manage\services.json (cached). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([switch]$Force)
    if ($script:IgwtServiceRuleCache -and -not $Force) { return $script:IgwtServiceRuleCache }
    $file = Join-Path (Get-IgwtDataFolder) 'manage\services.json'
    $rules = @()
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file) { $rules = @((Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $file).protected | Where-Object { $_ }) }
    $script:IgwtServiceRuleCache = $rules
    return $rules
}

function Get-IgwtServiceProtection {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Reason a service is protected from changes, or $null. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Name)
    if ($script:IgwtProtectedServices -contains $Name) { return 'Protected by iG Windows Tuner (anti-cheat or core security).' }
    foreach ($r in @(Get-IgwtServiceRules)) {
        if (@($r.names) -contains $Name) { return [string]$r.reason }
        foreach ($p in @($r.patterns | Where-Object { $_ })) { if ($Name -like [string]$p) { return [string]$r.reason } }
    }
    return $null
}

function Test-IgwtManageCatalog {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Validates data\manage\services.json and nic-keywords.json. Returns error strings (empty = valid). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string[]])]
    param()
    $errors = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $root = Join-Path (Get-IgwtDataFolder) 'manage'
    $svcFile = Join-Path $root 'services.json'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $svcFile)) { $errors.Add('manage\services.json: missing.') }
    else {
        $groups = @((Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $svcFile).protected | Where-Object { $_ })
        if ($groups.Count -eq 0) { $errors.Add('manage\services.json: no protected groups.') }
        $all = @($groups | ForEach-Object { @($_.names) } | Where-Object { $_ })
        foreach ($g in $groups) {
            if (-not [string]$g.reason -or ([string]$g.reason).Length -gt 200) { $errors.Add('manage\services.json: every group needs a reason of 200 characters or fewer.') }
            if (@($g.names).Count + @($g.patterns | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -eq 0) { $errors.Add('manage\services.json: empty group.') }
        }
        foreach ($must in 'RpcSs', 'DcomLaunch', 'BFE', 'mpssvc', 'WinDefend', 'EventLog', 'Winmgmt', 'CryptSvc', 'Audiosrv', 'Dhcp', 'Dnscache', 'nsi', 'TrustedInstaller', 'vgc', 'EasyAntiCheat_EOS', 'BEService') {
            if (@($all | Where-Object { [string]$_ -eq $must }).Count -eq 0) { $errors.Add("manage\services.json: required protected service '$must' is missing.") }
        }
    }
    $nicFile = Join-Path $root 'nic-keywords.json'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $nicFile)) { $errors.Add('manage\nic-keywords.json: missing.') }
    else {
        $doc = Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $nicFile
        if (-not ([string]$doc.source -like 'https://*')) { $errors.Add('manage\nic-keywords.json: source must be an https URL.') }
        $seenKw = @{}
        foreach ($k in @($doc.keywords | Where-Object { $_ })) {
            $kw = [string]$k.keyword
            if (-not $kw.StartsWith('*')) { $errors.Add("manage\nic-keywords.json: '$kw' is not a standardized keyword (must start with *).") }
            if ($seenKw.ContainsKey($kw.ToLowerInvariant())) { $errors.Add("manage\nic-keywords.json: duplicate '$kw'.") }
            $seenKw[$kw.ToLowerInvariant()] = $true
            if (-not [string]$k.description -or ([string]$k.description).Length -gt 240) { $errors.Add("manage\nic-keywords.json: '$kw' needs a description of 240 characters or fewer.") }
        }
    }
    return $errors.ToArray()
}

function Test-IgwtNamePattern {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Name, [string[]]$Patterns)
    foreach ($p in @($Patterns)) { if ($Name -like $p) { return $true } }
    return $false
}

function Test-IgwtWindowsFirewallRule {
    <# .SYNOPSIS True for rules that ship with Windows (resource-string group such as '@FirewallAPI.dll,-...'). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Rule)
    return ([string]$Rule.Group -like '@*' -or [string]$Rule.DisplayGroup -like '@*' -or [string]$Rule.Name -like 'iGWindowsTuner-*')
}

function New-IgwtManagedAction {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Validates a management change and returns the synthetic action that performs it. Throws
        with the reason when the target is protected or the value is not allowed.
    #>
    [Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions', '', Justification = 'Validates and builds an in-memory action only; Invoke-IgwtManagedChange applies it.')]
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateSet('service', 'task', 'appx', 'feature', 'capability', 'firewallRule')][string]$Kind,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Target, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Value, [switch]$Provisioned)
    if ($script:IgwtManagedValues[$Kind] -notcontains $Value) { throw "Value '$Value' is not allowed for $Kind (allowed: $($script:IgwtManagedValues[$Kind] -join ', '))." }
    $t = $Target.Trim()
    if (-not $t) { throw 'The target is empty.' }
    switch ($Kind) {
        'service' {
            if ($t -notmatch '^[\w\.\-\$ ]{1,256}$') { throw "'$t' is not a valid service name." }
            $why = Get-IgwtServiceProtection -Name $t
            if ($why) { throw "Service '$t' is protected: $why" }
            $svc = @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Service -Filter "Name='$($t -replace "'", "''")'" -ErrorAction Stop) | Select-Object -First 1
            if (-not $svc) { throw "Service '$t' does not exist." }
            if ([string]$svc.ServiceType -match '(?i)driver') { throw "'$t' is a driver; iG Windows Tuner only changes Win32 services." }
            return [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'service'; name = [string]$svc.Name; startupType = $Value; default = $Value; stop = $false }
        }
        'task' {
            if ($t -notmatch '^\\') { throw "Give the full task path, for example '\Microsoft\Windows\...\TaskName'." }
            $i = $t.LastIndexOf('\')
            $path = $t.Substring(0, $i + 1); $name = $t.Substring($i + 1)
            if (-not $name) { throw 'The task name is missing.' }
            Assert-IgwtTaskAllowed -Path $path
            if ($t -match $script:IgwtAntiCheatTaskPattern) { throw "Task '$t' belongs to an anti-cheat and is never changed." }
            return [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'scheduledTask'; path = $path; name = $name; on = $Value; default = $(if ($Value -eq 'Disabled') { 'Enabled' } else { 'Disabled' }) }
        }
        'appx' {
            if ($t -notmatch '^[\w\.\-]+$') { throw "'$t' is not a valid package name." }
            if (Test-IgwtAppxProtected -Package $t) { throw "App '$t' is protected (Store, App Installer, Xbox identity, Gaming Services, Windows Security, WebView2, frameworks and shell)." }
            $pkg = @(Get-AppxPackage -Name $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) | Select-Object -First 1
            if ($pkg -and ($pkg.IsFramework -or [string]$pkg.SignatureKind -eq 'System')) { throw "App '$t' is a framework or system component and is never removed." }
            return [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'appx'; package = $t; on = 'Removed'; default = 'Installed'; provisioned = [bool]$Provisioned }
        }
        'feature' {
            if ($t -notmatch '^[\w\.\-]+$') { throw "'$t' is not a valid feature name." }
            if (Test-IgwtNamePattern -Name $t -Patterns $script:IgwtProtectedFeatures) { throw "Feature '$t' is protected (Defender, .NET 4, WSL and virtualization, Print to PDF, search)." }
            return [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'optionalFeature'; feature = $t; on = $Value; default = $(if ($Value -eq 'Enabled') { 'Disabled' } else { 'Enabled' }) }
        }
        'capability' {
            if ($t -notmatch '^[\w\.\-~]+$') { throw "'$t' is not a valid capability name." }
            if (Test-IgwtNamePattern -Name $t -Patterns $script:IgwtProtectedCapabilities) { throw "Capability '$t' is protected (languages, Notepad, shell components, OpenSSH client)." }
            return [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'capability'; name = $t; on = $Value; default = $(if ($Value -eq 'Installed') { 'NotPresent' } else { 'Installed' }) }
        }
        'firewallRule' {
            $rule = @(Get-NetFirewallRule -Name $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) | Select-Object -First 1
            if (-not $rule) { throw "Firewall rule '$t' does not exist." }
            if (Test-IgwtWindowsFirewallRule -Rule $rule) { throw "'$($rule.DisplayName)' is a Windows or iG Windows Tuner rule; the rule browser only changes rules that apps created." }
            return [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'managedFirewallRule'; name = [string]$rule.Name; on = $Value }
        }
    }
}

function Get-IgwtManagedSnapshotData {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action)
    if ([string]$Action.type -eq 'managedFirewallRule') {
        $r = @(Get-NetFirewallRule -Name ([string]$Action.name) -ErrorAction Stop) | Select-Object -First 1
        return @{ enabled = ([string]$r.Enabled -eq 'True') }
    }
    return (Get-IgwtActionSnapshot -Action $Action -Context $null)
}

function Test-IgwtManagedActionOn {
    <# .SYNOPSIS True when the target already has the requested value. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([bool])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Action)
    if ([string]$Action.type -eq 'managedFirewallRule') {
        $r = @(Get-NetFirewallRule -Name ([string]$Action.name) -ErrorAction Stop) | Select-Object -First 1
        return (([string]$r.Enabled -eq 'True') -eq ([string]$Action.on -eq 'Enabled'))
    }
    $states = @(Get-IgwtActionState -Action $Action -Context $null | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.State })
    return ((Get-IgwtStateRollup -States $states) -eq 'On')
}

function Get-IgwtManagedChangePlan {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Dry run of Invoke-IgwtManagedChange: validates the change (protection rules) and reports whether anything would change. Read-only. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateSet('service', 'task', 'appx', 'feature', 'capability', 'firewallRule')][string]$Kind,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Target, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Value, [switch]$Provisioned)
    $action = New-IgwtManagedAction -Kind $Kind -Target $Target -Value $Value -Provisioned:$Provisioned
    $already = Test-IgwtManagedActionOn -Action $action
    $current = $null
    if ([string]$action.type -ne 'managedFirewallRule') { $current = @(Get-IgwtActionState -Action $action -Context $null | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Current }) -join ', ' }
    else { $current = $(if ((Get-IgwtManagedSnapshotData -Action $action).enabled) { 'Enabled' } else { 'Disabled' }) }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Kind = $Kind; Target = $Target; Value = $Value; Current = $current; HasChange = -not $already
        Change = $(if ($already) { 'Already set; nothing to change.' } else { "$Kind $Target : $current -> $Value" })
        Reversible = $(if ($Kind -eq 'appx') { 'partial (re-registered or reinstalled from the Microsoft Store)' } else { 'full (snapshot)' })
    }
}

function Invoke-IgwtManagedChange {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Applies one management change after writing a snapshot (operation 'Manage'): service
        startup type, scheduled task enable/disable, inbox app removal (reversible partially:
        re-registered or reinstalled from the Store), optional feature, capability or app firewall
        rule state. Protection rules are checked first.
    .PARAMETER Kind
        service, task, appx, feature, capability or firewallRule.
    .PARAMETER Target
        Service name, full task path, package name, feature, capability or firewall rule name.
    .PARAMETER Value
        Service: Automatic, AutomaticDelayed, Manual, Disabled. Task: Enabled, Disabled. Appx: Removed.
        Feature: Enabled, Disabled. Capability: Installed, NotPresent. Firewall rule: Enabled, Disabled.
    .PARAMETER Provisioned
        Appx: also remove the provisioned copy so new user profiles do not get it.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateSet('service', 'task', 'appx', 'feature', 'capability', 'firewallRule')][string]$Kind,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Target, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Value, [switch]$Provisioned)
    if (-not $script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) {
        if (-not (Test-IgwtIsAdmin)) { throw 'Management changes need administrator rights.' }
        Initialize-IgwtDataRoot
    }
    $action = New-IgwtManagedAction -Kind $Kind -Target $Target -Value $Value -Provisioned:$Provisioned
    if (Test-IgwtManagedActionOn -Action $action) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Snapshot = $null; Changes = 0; Results = @() } }
    $label = "$Kind $Target -> $Value"
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Target, "$Kind -> $Value")) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Snapshot = $null; Changes = 0; Results = @() } }
    $snap = New-IgwtSnapshot -Operation 'Manage' -Detail $label
    Save-IgwtSnapshot -Snapshot $snap
    $tid = "manage:${Kind}:$Target"
    $entryAction = [ordered]@{ index = 0; type = [string]$action.type; fingerprint = "managed|$Kind|$Target"; data = (Get-IgwtManagedSnapshotData -Action $action)
        managed = [ordered]@{ kind = $Kind; target = $Target; value = $Value; provisioned = [bool]$Provisioned } }
    Add-IgwtSnapshotEntry -Snapshot $snap -TweakId $tid -Actions @($entryAction) -Result 'Applied' -Message $label
    try {
        if ([string]$action.type -eq 'managedFirewallRule') { Set-NetFirewallRule -Name ([string]$action.name) -Enabled $(if ($Value -eq 'Enabled') { 'True' } else { 'False' }) -ErrorAction Stop }
        else { Invoke-IgwtActionApply -Action $action -Context $null -Mode on }
        Write-IgwtLog -Message "Managed change: $label. Snapshot: $($snap.Path)"
        $msg = $(if ($Kind -eq 'service') { 'The new startup type applies from the next start of the service or Windows.' } elseif ($Kind -eq 'appx') { 'Revert re-registers the app or reinstalls it from the Store.' } else { '' })
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Snapshot = $snap.Path; Changes = 1; Results = @([pscustomobject]@{ Target = $Target; Change = $label; Result = 'Applied'; Message = $msg }) }
    } catch {
        Add-IgwtSnapshotEntry -Snapshot $snap -TweakId $tid -Actions @($entryAction) -Result 'Failed' -Message $_.Exception.Message
        Write-IgwtLog -Level Error -Message "Managed change $label failed: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Snapshot = $snap.Path; Changes = 1; Results = @([pscustomobject]@{ Target = $Target; Change = $label; Result = 'Failed'; Message = $_.Exception.Message }) }
    }
}

function Restore-IgwtManagedSnapshot {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Reverts a 'Manage' snapshot. Each action is rebuilt from its stored kind, target and value
        and validated again (protected targets are refused); the restore data comes from the file,
        the action definition from code. The current state is captured in a new snapshot first.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$SnapshotPath)
    $doc = Read-IgwtSnapshot -Path $SnapshotPath
    if ([string]$doc.operation -ne 'Manage') { throw 'This is not a management snapshot.' }
    # A failed change has an Applied and a Failed entry with the same data: restore it once.
    $seen = @{}
    $entries = @($doc.entries | Where-Object { $_ -and [string]$_.result -in 'Applied', 'Failed' } | Where-Object { $k = [string]$_.tweakId; if ($seen.ContainsKey($k)) { $false } else { $seen[$k] = $true; $true } })
    [array]::Reverse($entries)
    $results = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    if ($entries.Count -eq 0 -or -not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$($entries.Count) change(s) from $(Split-Path $SnapshotPath -Leaf)", 'Revert')) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Snapshot = $null; Results = @() } }
    $undo = New-IgwtSnapshot -Operation 'Manage' -Detail "revert of $(Split-Path $SnapshotPath -Leaf)"
    Save-IgwtSnapshot -Snapshot $undo
    foreach ($e in $entries) {
        $tid = [string]$e.tweakId
        foreach ($a in @($e.actions | Where-Object { $_ })) {
            try {
                $m = $a.managed
                if (-not $m -or $script:IgwtManagedKinds -notcontains [string]$m.kind) { throw 'Snapshot entry has no valid management kind.' }
                $action = New-IgwtManagedAction -Kind ([string]$m.kind) -Target ([string]$m.target) -Value ([string]$m.value) -Provisioned:([bool]$m.provisioned)
                if ([string]$action.type -ne [string]$a.type) { throw 'Snapshot action type does not match its kind.' }
                $current = Get-IgwtManagedSnapshotData -Action $action
                Add-IgwtSnapshotEntry -Snapshot $undo -TweakId $tid -Actions @([ordered]@{ index = 0; type = [string]$action.type; fingerprint = [string]$a.fingerprint; data = $current; managed = $m }) -Result 'Applied' -Message 'before revert'
                if ([string]$action.type -eq 'managedFirewallRule') { Set-NetFirewallRule -Name ([string]$action.name) -Enabled $(if ([bool]$a.data.enabled) { 'True' } else { 'False' }) -ErrorAction Stop }
                else { Restore-IgwtActionSnapshot -Action $action -Snapshot $a.data -Context $null }
                $results.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Id = $tid; Result = 'Reverted'; Message = '' })
            } catch {
                $results.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Id = $tid; Result = 'Failed'; Message = $_.Exception.Message })
                Write-IgwtLog -Level Error -Message "Management revert of ${tid}: $($_.Exception.Message)"
            }
        }
    }
    Write-IgwtLog -Message "Management snapshot $(Split-Path $SnapshotPath -Leaf) reverted. Undo snapshot: $($undo.Path)"
    return [pscustomobject]@{ Snapshot = $undo.Path; Results = $results.ToArray() }
}
```

```ps1
# NetworkToolkit.ps1
# Network toolkit: adapter inspector (every advanced property with a description), user-initiated
# DNS benchmark and latency/jitter/loss monitor, firewall rule browser (app rules can be enabled or
# disabled through Invoke-IgwtManagedChange; Windows rules are never changed or deleted) and a
# read-only hosts-file viewer. Listening ports: Get-IgwtNetworkSurface.

$script:IgwtDnsBenchmarkServers = @(
    [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'Cloudflare'; Address = '1.1.1.1' }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'Quad9'; Address = '9.9.9.9' }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'Google'; Address = '8.8.8.8' }
)
$script:IgwtDnsBenchmarkNames = @('www.microsoft.com', 'store.steampowered.com', 'www.riotgames.com', 'www.ea.com', 'www.epicgames.com')
$script:IgwtHostTargetPattern = '^(?=.{1,253}$)(([A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9\-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?)(\.[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9\-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?)*|\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3}|[0-9A-Fa-f:]+)$'

function Get-IgwtNicKeywordDescriptions {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    if ($script:IgwtNicKeywordCache) { return $script:IgwtNicKeywordCache }
    $map = @{}
    $file = Join-Path (Get-IgwtDataFolder) 'manage\nic-keywords.json'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file) { foreach ($k in @((Read-IgwtJsonFile -Path $file).keywords | Where-Object { $_ })) { $map[([string]$k.keyword).ToLowerInvariant()] = [string]$k.description } }
    $script:IgwtNicKeywordCache = $map
    return $map
}

function Get-IgwtAdapterPropertyInspection {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Every advanced property of the physical network adapters with value, allowed values, default and a description (read-only). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $desc = Get-IgwtNicKeywordDescriptions
    $adapters = foreach ($a in @(Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction Stop)) {
        $props = foreach ($p in @(Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name ([string]$a.Name) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName })) {
            $kw = [string]$p.RegistryKeyword
            [pscustomobject]@{
                Keyword = $kw; DisplayName = [string]$p.DisplayName; Value = [string]$p.DisplayValue; RegistryValue = (@($p.RegistryValue) -join ',')
                Default = [string]$p.DefaultRegistryValue; Allowed = (@($p.ValidDisplayValues | Where-Object { $_ }) -join ', ')
                Range = $(if ($null -ne $p.NumericParameterMaxValue) { "$($p.NumericParameterMinValue)-$($p.NumericParameterMaxValue)" } else { '' })
                Standardized = $kw.StartsWith('*')
                Description = $(if ($desc.ContainsKey($kw.ToLowerInvariant())) { $desc[$kw.ToLowerInvariant()] } elseif ($kw.StartsWith('*')) { 'Standardized NDIS keyword; see the Microsoft documentation.' } else { 'Vendor-specific setting; see the adapter vendor documentation.' })
                ChangedFromDefault = ([string]$p.DefaultRegistryValue -and (@($p.RegistryValue) -join ',') -ne [string]$p.DefaultRegistryValue)
            }
        }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Name = [string]$a.Name; Description = [string]$a.InterfaceDescription; Status = [string]$a.Status; LinkSpeed = [string]$a.LinkSpeed; Properties = @($props | Sort-Object DisplayName) }
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Adapters = @($adapters); Note = 'Read-only. Adapter settings change only through catalog items (Network category) or Device Manager.' }
}

function Measure-IgwtDnsQuery {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Time of one DNS query in milliseconds against a server ($null on failure). Mock this in tests. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Server, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Name)
    $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
    try { $null = Resolve-DnsName -Name $Name -Server $Server -DnsOnly -NoHostsFile -QuickTimeout -Type A -ErrorAction Stop } catch { return $null }
    $sw.Stop()
    return [Math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds, 1)
}

function Invoke-IgwtDnsBenchmark {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        User-initiated DNS benchmark: resolves gaming-related names against the current DNS servers
        and a few public resolvers, several rounds each, and reports median and worst latency and
        failures. Uses the network; changes nothing.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([ValidateRange(1, 10)][int]$Rounds = 3, [string[]]$Servers, [string[]]$Names = $script:IgwtDnsBenchmarkNames)
    $targets = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    try {
        foreach ($d in @(Get-DnsClientServerAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction Stop | ForEach-Object { $_.ServerAddresses } | Where-Object { $_ } | Select-Object -Unique)) {
            $targets.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'Current'; Address = [string]$d })
        }
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'Current DNS servers unavailable.' }
    foreach ($s in $script:IgwtDnsBenchmarkServers) { if (@($targets | Where-Object { $_.Address -eq $s.Address }).Count -eq 0) { $targets.Add($s) } }
    if ($Servers) { $targets = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]; foreach ($s in $Servers) { if ($s -match $script:IgwtHostTargetPattern) { $targets.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'Custom'; Address = $s }) } } }
    $rows = foreach ($t in $targets) {
        $times = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[double]; $fail = 0
        for ($r = 0; $r -lt $Rounds; $r++) {
            foreach ($n in $Names) { $ms = Measure-IgwtDnsQuery -Server $t.Address -Name $n; if ($null -eq $ms) { $fail++ } else { $times.Add([double]$ms) } }
        }
        $sorted = @($times.ToArray() | Sort-Object)
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Name = $t.Name; Server = $t.Address; Queries = ($Rounds * @($Names).Count); Failures = $fail
            MedianMs = $(if ($sorted.Count) { $sorted[[int][Math]::Floor(($sorted.Count - 1) / 2)] } else { $null })
            WorstMs = $(if ($sorted.Count) { $sorted[$sorted.Count - 1] } else { $null })
        }
    }
    $rows = @($rows | Sort-Object @{ Expression = { if ($null -eq $_.MedianMs) { [double]::MaxValue } else { $_.MedianMs } } })
    [pscustomobject]@{ Results = $rows; Note = 'Lower median latency means faster name lookups (mostly noticeable when launchers and browsers start). It does not change in-game ping. iG Windows Tuner offers DNS over HTTPS items in the Network category.' }
}

function Invoke-IgwtPingProbe {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Round-trip times in ms for Count echo requests ($null entries for lost replies). Mock this in tests. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Target, [int]$Count = 20)
    $ping = New-Object System.Net.NetworkInformation.Ping
    try {
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Count; $i++) {
            $r = $null
            try { $r = $ping.Send($Target, 1000) } catch { $r = $null }
            if ($r -and [string]$r.Status -eq 'Success') { [double]$r.RoundtripTime } else { $null }
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200
        }
    } finally { $ping.Dispose() }
}

function Test-IgwtNetworkLatency {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        User-initiated latency, jitter and packet-loss monitor for targets you choose (host names or
        IP addresses): Count echo requests per target. Jitter is the mean difference between
        consecutive replies. Uses the network; changes nothing.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string[]]$Target, [ValidateRange(4, 200)][int]$Count = 20)
    $rows = foreach ($t in $Target) {
        $name = $t.Trim()
        if ($name -notmatch $script:IgwtHostTargetPattern) { [pscustomobject]@{ Target = $name; Error = 'Not a valid host name or IP address.' }; continue }
        $samples = @(Invoke-IgwtPingProbe -Target $name -Count $Count)
        $ok = @($samples | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ } | ForEach-Object { [double]$_ })
        $jitter = $null
        if ($ok.Count -ge 2) { $d = for ($i = 1; $i -lt $ok.Count; $i++) { [Math]::Abs($ok[$i] - $ok[$i - 1]) }; $jitter = [Math]::Round((@($d) | Measure-Object -Average).Average, 1) }
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Target = $name; Sent = $samples.Count; Received = $ok.Count
            LossPercent = $(if ($samples.Count) { [Math]::Round(100 * ($samples.Count - $ok.Count) / $samples.Count, 1) } else { $null })
            AvgMs = $(if ($ok.Count) { [Math]::Round(($ok | Measure-Object -Average).Average, 1) } else { $null })
            MinMs = $(if ($ok.Count) { ($ok | Measure-Object -Minimum).Minimum } else { $null })
            MaxMs = $(if ($ok.Count) { ($ok | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum } else { $null })
            JitterMs = $jitter; Error = ''
        }
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Results = @($rows); Note = 'Some servers ignore ping (ICMP); 100 % loss then says nothing about game traffic. Run a bufferbloat test for latency under load.' }
}

function Get-IgwtFirewallRuleList {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Firewall rule browser (read-only): name, display name, direction, action, enabled, profile,
        group, program, and whether it is a Windows rule. Only rules created by apps can be enabled
        or disabled (Invoke-IgwtManagedChange -Kind firewallRule); nothing is ever deleted.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([string]$Search, [switch]$AppRulesOnly)
    $programs = @{}
    try { foreach ($f in @(Get-NetFirewallApplicationFilter -ErrorAction Stop)) { $programs[[string]$f.InstanceID] = [string]$f.Program } } catch { Write-Verbose 'Application filters unavailable.' }
    $rows = foreach ($r in @(Get-NetFirewallRule -ErrorAction Stop)) {
        $win = Test-IgwtWindowsFirewallRule -Rule $r
        if ($AppRulesOnly -and $win) { continue }
        $prog = [string]$programs[[string]$r.Name]
        $row = [pscustomobject]@{
            Name = [string]$r.Name; DisplayName = [string]$r.DisplayName; Direction = [string]$r.Direction; Action = [string]$r.Action; Enabled = ([string]$r.Enabled -eq 'True')
            Profile = [string]$r.Profile; Group = [string]$r.DisplayGroup; Program = $prog; IsWindowsRule = $win; CanChange = -not $win
        }
        if ($Search) {
            $s = $Search.Trim()
            if ("$($row.DisplayName) $($row.Name) $($row.Program) $($row.Group)".IndexOf($s, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -lt 0) { continue }
        }
        $row
    }
    $rows = @($rows | Sort-Object DisplayName)
    [pscustomobject]@{ Rules = $rows; AppRules = @($rows | Where-Object { -not $_.IsWindowsRule }).Count; Note = 'Windows rules are shown but never changed or deleted. App rules can be enabled or disabled with a snapshot.' }
}

function Get-IgwtHostsFile {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Read-only hosts-file viewer that flags entries other than localhost, and blocks of Microsoft endpoints. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([string]$Path = (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\drivers\etc\hosts'))
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Path = $Path; Exists = $false; Entries = @(); Unexpected = 0; Note = 'No hosts file.' } }
    $rows = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $n = 0
    foreach ($line in @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path -ErrorAction Stop)) {
        $n++
        $text = ($line -replace '#.*$', '').Trim()
        if (-not $text) { continue }
        $parts = @($text -split '\s+')
        if ($parts.Count -lt 2) { continue }
        $ip = $parts[0]
        foreach ($h in $parts[1..($parts.Count - 1)]) {
            $flag = 'Expected'; $note = ''
            if ($h -in 'localhost', 'localhost.localdomain' -and $ip -in '127.0.0.1', '::1') { $flag = 'Expected' }
            elseif ($h -match '(?i)(microsoft|windows|msft|live|bing|office|azure|xbox|msn)\.(com|net)$' -and $ip -in '0.0.0.0', '127.0.0.1', '::', '::1') { $flag = 'BlocksMicrosoft'; $note = 'Blocks a Microsoft endpoint. Microsoft Defender flags this (HostsFileHijack) and it can break Windows Update, activation or Xbox services.' }
            else { $flag = 'Unexpected'; $note = 'Not a default entry. Make sure you added it on purpose; malware uses the hosts file to redirect sites.' }
            $rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Line = $n; Address = $ip; HostName = $h; Flag = $flag; Note = $note })
        }
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Path = $Path; Exists = $true; Entries = $rows.ToArray(); Unexpected = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Flag -ne 'Expected' }).Count; Note = 'Read-only. iG Windows Tuner never edits the hosts file.' }
}
```
