`src/Manage/Persistence.ps1`:

```ps1
# Persistence.ps1
# Persistence Inspector (read-only, Autoruns-style): Run/RunOnce keys (including WOW6432Node),
# Startup folders, non-Microsoft services and drivers, non-Microsoft scheduled tasks, WMI event
# subscriptions, Winlogon Shell/Userinit, IFEO Debugger values, AppInit_DLLs and browser extensions,
# with the Authenticode signature of each file. The only actions offered are documented disable
# mechanisms that already exist elsewhere: startup entries (StartupApproved), services (startup
# type) and scheduled tasks (disable), each snapshot-backed. Everything else is reported for review.

$script:IgwtSignatureCache = @{}

function Resolve-IgwtCommandPath {
    <# .SYNOPSIS The executable or DLL path inside a command line, image path or registry value. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([AllowEmptyString()][string]$Command)
    if (-not $Command) { return '' }
    $c = [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($Command.Trim())
    $c = $c -replace '^\\\?\?\\', '' -replace '^\\SystemRoot\\', "$env:SystemRoot\"
    if ($c -match '^(?i)system32\\') { $c = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot $c }
    $path = ''
    if ($c.StartsWith('"')) { $end = $c.IndexOf('"', 1); if ($end -gt 1) { $path = $c.Substring(1, $end - 1) } }
    else {
        $m = [regex]::Match($c, '^(?i)(.+?\.(exe|dll|sys|com|bat|cmd|ps1|vbs|js|scr|cpl|ocx))(\s|,|$)')
        $path = $(if ($m.Success) { $m.Groups[1].Value } else { ($c -split '\s+')[0] })
    }
    if ($path -and $path -notmatch '^[A-Za-z]:\\' -and $path -notmatch '^\\\\') {
        $candidate = Join-Path (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32') $path
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate) { $path = $candidate }
    }
    return $path
}

function Get-IgwtFileSignature {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Authenticode status and signer of a file (cached). Status NotFound when the file is missing. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([AllowEmptyString()][string]$Path)
    if (-not $Path) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Status = 'NoFile'; Signer = ''; IsMicrosoft = $false } }
    $k = $Path.ToLowerInvariant()
    if ($script:IgwtSignatureCache.ContainsKey($k)) { return $script:IgwtSignatureCache[$k] }
    $r = [pscustomobject]@{ Status = 'NotFound'; Signer = ''; IsMicrosoft = $false }
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf) {
        try {
            $s = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $Path -ErrorAction Stop
            $subject = $(if ($s.SignerCertificate) { [string]$s.SignerCertificate.Subject } else { '' })
            $cn = $(if ($subject -match '^CN=(?:"([^"]+)"|([^,]+))') { $(if ($Matches[1]) { $Matches[1] } else { $Matches[2] }) } else { $subject })
            # WHQL-signed third-party drivers carry a Microsoft signature; the file's company name tells them apart.
            $company = ''
            try { $company = [string](Get-Item -LiteralPath $Path -ErrorAction Stop).VersionInfo.CompanyName } catch { $company = '' }
            $r = [pscustomobject]@{ Status = [string]$s.Status; Signer = $cn; IsMicrosoft = ([string]$s.Status -eq 'Valid' -and $subject -match 'O=Microsoft Corporation' -and (-not $company -or $company -match 'Microsoft')) }
        } catch { $r = [pscustomobject]@{ Status = 'Unknown'; Signer = ''; IsMicrosoft = $false } }
    }
    $script:IgwtSignatureCache[$k] = $r
    return $r
}

function New-IgwtPersistenceEntry {
    [Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions', '', Justification = 'Builds an in-memory object only.')]
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([string]$Category, [string]$Location, [string]$Name, [string]$Command, [string]$Severity = 'Info', [string]$Note = '', [string]$ActionKind = 'None', [string]$ActionTarget = '', $Enabled = $null, [switch]$NoSignature)
    $file = Resolve-IgwtCommandPath -Command $Command
    $sig = $(if ($NoSignature) { [pscustomobject]@{ Status = ''; Signer = ''; IsMicrosoft = $false } } else { Get-IgwtFileSignature -Path $file })
    if ($Severity -eq 'Info' -and -not $NoSignature -and $sig.Status -notin 'Valid', '') { $Severity = 'Review' }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Category = $Category; Location = $Location; Name = $Name; Command = $Command; File = $file; Signature = $sig.Status; Signer = $sig.Signer; IsMicrosoft = $sig.IsMicrosoft
        Enabled = $Enabled; Severity = $Severity; Note = $Note; ActionKind = $ActionKind; ActionTarget = $ActionTarget
    }
}

function Get-IgwtRunKeyEntries {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $keys = @(
        @{ Path = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run'; Scope = 'HKLM-Run' }
        @{ Path = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce'; Scope = '' }
        @{ Path = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run'; Scope = 'HKLM-Run32' }
        @{ Path = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce'; Scope = '' }
        @{ Path = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run'; Scope = 'HKCU-Run' }
        @{ Path = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce'; Scope = '' }
    )
    $startup = @{}
    try { foreach ($s in @(Get-IgwtStartupItem)) { $startup["$($s.Scope)|$($s.Name)"] = $s } } catch { Write-Verbose 'Startup items unavailable.' }
    foreach ($k in $keys) {
        try {
            $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath $k.Path) -ErrorAction Stop
            foreach ($n in $item.GetValueNames()) {
                if (-not $n) { continue }
                $cmd = [string]$item.GetValue($n)
                $st = $startup["$($k.Scope)|$n"]
                New-IgwtPersistenceEntry -Category 'Run keys' -Location $k.Path -Name $n -Command $cmd -Enabled $(if ($st) { [bool]$st.Enabled } else { $true }) `
                    -ActionKind $(if ($k.Scope) { 'StartupEntry' } else { 'None' }) -ActionTarget $(if ($k.Scope) { "$($k.Scope)|$n" } else { '' }) -Note $(if (-not $k.Scope) { 'RunOnce entries run once at the next sign-in and then delete themselves.' } else { '' })
            }
        } catch { Write-Verbose "Key not readable: $($k.Path)" }
    }
    foreach ($f in @(@{ Path = '%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup'; Scope = 'User-Folder' }, @{ Path = '%ProgramData%\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\StartUp'; Scope = 'Common-Folder' })) {
        $dir = [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($f.Path)
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { continue }
        foreach ($file in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne 'desktop.ini' })) {
            $target = $file.FullName
            if ($file.Extension -eq '.lnk') {
                try { $sh = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell; $target = [string]$sh.CreateShortcut($file.FullName).TargetPath } catch { $target = $file.FullName }
            }
            $st = $startup["$($f.Scope)|$($file.Name)"]
            New-IgwtPersistenceEntry -Category 'Startup folders' -Location $dir -Name $file.Name -Command $target -Enabled $(if ($st) { [bool]$st.Enabled } else { $true }) -ActionKind 'StartupEntry' -ActionTarget "$($f.Scope)|$($file.Name)"
        }
    }
}

function Get-IgwtPersistenceInventory {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Read-only persistence view (Autoruns-style) with signature status. Severity: Info (signed,
        expected), Review (unsigned, unknown signer or missing file) or Warn (a location malware
        typically uses: IFEO Debugger, AppInit_DLLs, changed Winlogon values, WMI command or script
        consumers). ActionKind tells which documented disable mechanism applies (StartupEntry,
        Service, Task) or None.
    .PARAMETER IncludeMicrosoft
        Also list Microsoft-signed services, drivers and tasks (slow: every file is checked).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([switch]$IncludeMicrosoft)
    $entries = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $add = { param($e) foreach ($x in @($e)) { if ($x) { $entries.Add($x) } } }
    & $add (Get-IgwtRunKeyEntries)
    try {
        foreach ($s in @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Service -ErrorAction Stop)) {
            # Without administrator rights Windows hides the image path of a few protected services.
            if (-not [string]$s.PathName) { if ($IncludeMicrosoft) { $entries.Add((New-IgwtPersistenceEntry -Category 'Services' -Location 'Services' -Name "$($s.DisplayName) ($($s.Name))" -Command '' -NoSignature -Enabled ([string]$s.StartMode -ne 'Disabled') -Note 'Image path not readable without administrator rights.')) }; continue }
            $e = New-IgwtPersistenceEntry -Category 'Services' -Location 'Services' -Name "$($s.DisplayName) ($($s.Name))" -Command ([string]$s.PathName) -Enabled ([string]$s.StartMode -ne 'Disabled') `
                -ActionKind $(if (Get-IgwtServiceProtection -Name ([string]$s.Name)) { 'None' } else { 'Service' }) -ActionTarget ([string]$s.Name) -Note "Startup: $($s.StartMode), state: $($s.State)"
            if ($IncludeMicrosoft -or -not $e.IsMicrosoft) { $entries.Add($e) }
        }
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'Services unavailable.' }
    try {
        foreach ($d in @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_SystemDriver -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { [string]$_.StartMode -in 'Boot', 'System', 'Auto' })) {
            $e = New-IgwtPersistenceEntry -Category 'Drivers' -Location 'Drivers' -Name "$($d.DisplayName) ($($d.Name))" -Command ([string]$d.PathName) -Enabled $true -Note "Startup: $($d.StartMode), state: $($d.State)"
            if ($IncludeMicrosoft -or -not $e.IsMicrosoft) { $entries.Add($e) }
        }
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'Drivers unavailable.' }
    try {
        foreach ($t in @(Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction Stop)) {
            $full = "$($t.TaskPath)$($t.TaskName)"
            foreach ($a in @($t.Actions | Where-Object { $_.PSObject.Properties['Execute'] -and $_.Execute })) {
                $e = New-IgwtPersistenceEntry -Category 'Scheduled tasks' -Location ([string]$t.TaskPath) -Name ([string]$t.TaskName) -Command "$($a.Execute) $($a.Arguments)" -Enabled ([string]$t.State -ne 'Disabled') `
                    -ActionKind 'Task' -ActionTarget $full -Note "Author: $($t.Author)"
                if ($IncludeMicrosoft -or -not ($e.IsMicrosoft -and [string]$t.TaskPath -like '\Microsoft\*')) { $entries.Add($e) }
            }
        }
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'Scheduled tasks unavailable.' }
    try {
        $binds = @(Get-CimInstance -Namespace 'root\subscription' -ClassName '__FilterToConsumerBinding' -ErrorAction Stop)
        foreach ($c in @(Get-CimInstance -Namespace 'root\subscription' -ClassName '__EventConsumer' -ErrorAction Stop)) {
            $cls = [string]$c.CimClass.CimClassName
            $cmd = $(if ($c.PSObject.Properties['CommandLineTemplate'] -and $c.CommandLineTemplate) { [string]$c.CommandLineTemplate } elseif ($c.PSObject.Properties['ScriptText'] -and $c.ScriptText) { 'script: ' + ([string]$c.ScriptText).Substring(0, [Math]::Min(80, ([string]$c.ScriptText).Length)) } else { '' })
            $bound = @($binds | Where-Object { [string]$_.Consumer -match [regex]::Escape([string]$c.Name) }).Count -gt 0
            $known = ([string]$c.Name -eq 'SCM Event Log Consumer' -and $cls -eq 'NTEventLogEventConsumer')
            $sev = $(if ($known) { 'Info' } elseif ($cls -in 'CommandLineEventConsumer', 'ActiveScriptEventConsumer') { 'Warn' } else { 'Review' })
            $entries.Add((New-IgwtPersistenceEntry -Category 'WMI subscriptions' -Location 'root\subscription' -Name "$($c.Name) [$cls]" -Command $cmd -Severity $sev -Enabled $bound -NoSignature `
                        -Note $(if ($known) { 'Windows default consumer.' } else { 'WMI event consumers run code when an event fires; investigate unknown ones (Defender scan, Autoruns).' })))
        }
    } catch { Write-Verbose 'WMI subscriptions unavailable.' }
    $wl = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon'
    foreach ($v in @(@{ Name = 'Shell'; Expected = '^explorer\.exe$' }, @{ Name = 'Userinit'; Expected = '^(?i)[A-Z]:\\Windows\\system32\\userinit\.exe,?$' })) {
        try {
            $r = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $wl -Name $v.Name
            if ($r.Exists) {
                $ok = ([string]$r.Value).Trim() -match $v.Expected
                $entries.Add((New-IgwtPersistenceEntry -Category 'Winlogon' -Location $wl -Name $v.Name -Command ([string]$r.Value) -Severity $(if ($ok) { 'Info' } else { 'Warn' }) -NoSignature -Note $(if ($ok) { 'Windows default.' } else { 'Changed from the Windows default; malware uses this value to start with every sign-in.' })))
            }
        } catch { Write-Verbose 'Winlogon not readable.' }
    }
    foreach ($ifeo in 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options', 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options') {
        try {
            foreach ($k in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath $ifeo) -ErrorAction Stop)) {
                $dbg = $k.GetValue('Debugger')
                if ($dbg) { $entries.Add((New-IgwtPersistenceEntry -Category 'IFEO Debugger' -Location $ifeo -Name ([string]$k.PSChildName) -Command ([string]$dbg) -Severity 'Warn' -Note 'A Debugger value starts another program instead of this one. Legitimate uses are rare (developer tools); malware uses it to hijack programs.')) }
            }
        } catch { Write-Verbose "IFEO not readable: $ifeo" }
    }
    foreach ($w in 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Windows', 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Windows') {
        try {
            $dlls = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $w -Name 'AppInit_DLLs'
            $load = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $w -Name 'LoadAppInit_DLLs'
            if ($dlls.Exists -and ([string]$dlls.Value).Trim()) {
                $entries.Add((New-IgwtPersistenceEntry -Category 'AppInit_DLLs' -Location $w -Name 'AppInit_DLLs' -Command ([string]$dlls.Value) -Severity 'Warn' -Enabled ($load.Exists -and [int]$load.Value -eq 1) -Note 'DLLs loaded into every process that loads user32.dll. Deprecated; on Secure Boot systems Windows ignores them.'))
            }
        } catch { Write-Verbose "AppInit not readable: $w" }
    }
    foreach ($b in @(Get-IgwtBrowserExtensions)) { $entries.Add($b) }
    $list = $entries.ToArray()
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Generated = (Get-Date).ToString('o')
        Entries   = $list
        Counts    = [pscustomobject]@{ Total = $list.Count; Warn = @($list | Where-Object { $_.Severity -eq 'Warn' }).Count; Review = @($list | Where-Object { $_.Severity -eq 'Review' }).Count }
        Note      = 'Read-only. Startup entries, services and tasks can be disabled through their documented mechanisms with a snapshot; other locations are reported for review (use Microsoft Defender or Autoruns to investigate).'
    }
}

function Get-IgwtBrowserExtensions {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Installed Chromium (Chrome, Edge, Brave) and Firefox extensions of the current user (read-only). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    $browsers = @(
        @{ Name = 'Chrome'; Root = '%LOCALAPPDATA%\Google\Chrome\User Data' }
        @{ Name = 'Edge'; Root = '%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Edge\User Data' }
        @{ Name = 'Brave'; Root = '%LOCALAPPDATA%\BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\User Data' }
    )
    foreach ($b in $browsers) {
        $root = [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($b.Root)
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $root)) { continue }
        foreach ($profileDir in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'Default' -or $_.Name -like 'Profile *' })) {
            $ext = Join-Path $profileDir.FullName 'Extensions'
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ext)) { continue }
            foreach ($idDir in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $ext -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^[a-p]{32}$' })) {
                $manifest = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $idDir.FullName -Filter 'manifest.json' -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) | Select-Object -First 1
                $name = $idDir.Name; $version = ''
                if ($manifest) {
                    try { $m = Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifest.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction Stop | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($m.name -and [string]$m.name -notlike '__MSG_*') { $name = [string]$m.name }; $version = [string]$m.version } catch { Write-Verbose "Manifest unreadable: $($manifest.FullName)" }
                }
                New-IgwtPersistenceEntry -Category 'Browser extensions' -Location "$($b.Name) / $($profileDir.Name)" -Name "$name $version".Trim() -Command $idDir.Name -NoSignature -Note 'Review extensions you did not install; they can read the pages you visit.'
            }
        }
    }
    $ff = [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('%APPDATA%\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles')
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ff) {
        foreach ($p in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $ff -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
            $json = Join-Path $p.FullName 'extensions.json'
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $json)) { continue }
            try {
                $doc = Get-Content -LiteralPath $json -Raw -ErrorAction Stop | ConvertFrom-Json
                foreach ($a in @($doc.addons | Where-Object { $_ -and [string]$_.type -eq 'extension' -and [string]$_.location -eq 'app-profile' })) {
                    New-IgwtPersistenceEntry -Category 'Browser extensions' -Location "Firefox / $($p.Name)" -Name "$($a.defaultLocale.name) $($a.version)".Trim() -Command ([string]$a.id) -NoSignature -Enabled ([bool]$a.active) -Note 'Review extensions you did not install; they can read the pages you visit.'
                }
            } catch { Write-Verbose "Firefox extensions unreadable: $json" }
        }
    }
}

function Export-IgwtPersistenceReport {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Writes the persistence inventory as a self-contained HTML file (no scripts) or JSON. #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Inventory, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path, [ValidateSet('Html', 'Json')][string]$Format = 'Html')
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Path, "Write $Format persistence report")) { return }
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if ($dir -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force }
    if ($Format -eq 'Json') { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $Inventory -Depth 6), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))); return $Path }
    $e = { param($t) ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlText $t }
    $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
    $null = $sb.Append('<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>iG Windows Tuner persistence report</title><style>body{font-family:"Segoe UI",sans-serif;margin:16px;color:#1b1b1f;background:#fff}@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){body{color:#f3f3f3;background:#1c1c1c}}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%}td,th{border-bottom:1px solid #8884;padding:4px 6px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;font-size:13px}.Warn{color:#c42b1c;font-weight:600}.Review{color:#9d5d00;font-weight:600}</style></head><body>')
    $null = $sb.Append("<h1>iG Windows Tuner persistence report</h1><p>$(& $e $Inventory.Generated) - $($Inventory.Counts.Total) entries, $($Inventory.Counts.Warn) warnings, $($Inventory.Counts.Review) to review. Read-only report.</p>")
    foreach ($g in ($Inventory.Entries | Group-Object Category)) {
        $null = $sb.Append("<h2>$(& $e $g.Name)</h2><table><tr><th>Severity</th><th>Name</th><th>Command / file</th><th>Signature</th><th>Note</th></tr>")
        foreach ($x in $g.Group) { $null = $sb.Append("<tr><td class='$($x.Severity)'>$($x.Severity)</td><td>$(& $e $x.Name)<br><small>$(& $e $x.Location)</small></td><td>$(& $e $x.Command)</td><td>$(& $e $x.Signature) $(& $e $x.Signer)</td><td>$(& $e $x.Note)</td></tr>") }
        $null = $sb.Append('</table>')
    }
    $null = $sb.Append('</body></html>')
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $sb.ToString(), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    return $Path
}
```

`src/Manage/SystemReport.ps1`:

```ps1
# SystemReport.ps1
# Full system report: the health report plus diagnostics, Windows Update status, services and
# persistence summaries, the driver inventory and iG Windows Tuner item states, exported as one
# self-contained HTML file (inline CSS, no scripts) or JSON. Read-only.

function Get-IgwtSystemReport {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Collects the full read-only system report. Each section that fails is recorded with its
        error instead of stopping the report.
    .PARAMETER Quick
        Skips the slow sections (persistence signatures, DPC sampling).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([switch]$Quick, [int]$Days = 30)
    $section = { param($name, $block) try { & $block } catch { [pscustomobject]@{ Error = "${name}: $($_.Exception.Message)" } } }
    $health = & $section 'Health' { Get-IgwtHealthReport }
    $areas = @('Reliability', 'Crashes', 'Boot', 'Drivers'); if (-not $Quick) { $areas = @('DpcIsr') + $areas }
    $diag = & $section 'Diagnostics' { Get-IgwtDiagnostics -Area $areas -Days $Days -Samples 3 }
    $updates = & $section 'Updates' { Get-IgwtUpdateStatus -Count 20 }
    $services = & $section 'Services' { $s = Get-IgwtServiceInventory; [pscustomobject]@{ Counts = $s.Counts; ThirdPartyRunning = @($s.Services | Where-Object { $_.Rating -eq 'ThirdParty' -and $_.State -eq 'Running' } | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $_.Name; DisplayName = $_.DisplayName; StartupType = $_.StartupType } }) } }
    $persistence = $null
    if (-not $Quick) { $persistence = & $section 'Persistence' { $p = Get-IgwtPersistenceInventory; [pscustomobject]@{ Counts = $p.Counts; Flagged = @($p.Entries | Where-Object { $_.Severity -ne 'Info' } | Select-Object Category, Name, Command, Signature, Severity, Note) } } }
    $items = & $section 'Items' { @(Get-IgwtAllTweakStates | Where-Object { $_.State -in 'On', 'Partial', 'ManagedByPolicy' } | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Id = [string]$_.Id; State = [string]$_.State } }) }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Generated   = (Get-Date).ToString('o')
        Tool        = "iG Windows Tuner $script:IgwtVersion"
        Computer    = $env:COMPUTERNAME
        Health      = $health
        Diagnostics = $diag
        Updates     = $updates
        Services    = $services
        Persistence = $persistence
        ActiveItems = $items
        Note        = 'Read-only report. It contains the computer name and installed software; review it before sharing.'
    }
}

function ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlTable {
    <# .SYNOPSIS HTML table (encoded) of the given rows and properties. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([AllowNull()][object[]]$Rows, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string[]]$Property, [int]$Max = 200)
    $list = @($Rows | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ } | Select-Object -First $Max)
    if ($list.Count -eq 0) { return "<p class='muted'>None.</p>" }
    $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
    $null = $sb.Append('<table><tr>')
    foreach ($p in $Property) { $null = $sb.Append("<th>$(ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlText $p)</th>") }
    $null = $sb.Append('</tr>')
    foreach ($r in $list) {
        $null = $sb.Append('<tr>')
        foreach ($p in $Property) { $v = $(if ($r.PSObject.Properties[$p]) { $r.$p } else { '' }); $null = $sb.Append("<td>$(ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlText (@($v) -join ', '))</td>") }
        $null = $sb.Append('</tr>')
    }
    $null = $sb.Append('</table>')
    return $sb.ToString()
}

function Export-IgwtSystemReport {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Writes the full system report as self-contained HTML (no scripts) or JSON. #>
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Report, [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path, [ValidateSet('Html', 'Json')][string]$Format = 'Html')
    if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($Path, "Write $Format system report")) { return }
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if ($dir -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force }
    $utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    if ($Format -eq 'Json') { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $Report -Depth 8), $utf8); return $Path }
    $e = { param($t) ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlText $t }
    $has = { param($o, $n) $o -and $o.PSObject.Properties[$n] }
    $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
    $null = $sb.Append('<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>iG Windows Tuner system report</title><style>')
    $null = $sb.Append(':root{--bg:#f7f7f8;--fg:#1b1b1f;--card:#fff;--muted:#5d5d66;--line:#e2e2e6;--warn:#9d5d00;--fail:#c42b1c}@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--bg:#1c1c1c;--fg:#f3f3f3;--card:#2b2b2b;--muted:#b0b0b8;--line:#3a3a3a;--warn:#fce100;--fail:#ff99a4}}')
    $null = $sb.Append('body{font-family:"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);margin:0;padding:16px}main{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto}h2{font-size:1.1rem;margin:1.4rem 0 .5rem}.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;margin:8px 0;overflow-x:auto}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}td,th{text-align:left;padding:5px 7px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top;font-size:13px}.muted{color:var(--muted)}.adv{color:var(--warn)}.err{color:var(--fail)}')
    $null = $sb.Append('</style></head><body><main>')
    $null = $sb.Append("<h1>iG Windows Tuner system report</h1><p class='muted'>$(& $e $Report.Tool) &middot; $(& $e $Report.Generated) &middot; $(& $e $Report.Computer)</p><p class='muted'>$(& $e $Report.Note)</p>")
    $card = { param($title, $body) $null = $sb.Append("<h2>$(& $e $title)</h2><div class='card'>$body</div>") }
    $advice = { param($list) (@($list | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { "<p class='adv'>&rarr; $(& $e $_)</p>" }) -join '') }
    $err = { param($o) if (& $has $o 'Error' -and $o.Error) { "<p class='err'>$(& $e $o.Error)</p>" } else { '' } }
    $h = $Report.Health
    if (& $has $h 'Summary') {
        & $card 'System' "<p>$(& $e $h.Summary.Text)</p>$(ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlTable -Rows $h.Checks -Property Section, Name, Status, Value, Advice)"
        if ($h.Security) { & $card "Security score $($h.Security.Score)/100 ($($h.Security.Grade))" (ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlTable -Rows $h.Security.Checks -Property Name, Status, Value) }
    } else { & $card 'System' (& $err $h) }
    $d = $Report.Diagnostics
    if (& $has $d 'DpcIsr') {
        $x = $d.DpcIsr
        if (& $has $x 'Dpc') { & $card 'DPC and ISR' ("<p>DPC average $($x.Dpc.Average) % (max $($x.Dpc.Max) %), ISR average $($x.Isr.Average) % (max $($x.Isr.Max) %).</p>" + (& $advice $x.Advice) + (ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlTable -Rows $x.TopProcesses -Property Name, CpuPercent, WorkingSetMB)) }
        else { & $card 'DPC and ISR' (& $err $x) }
    }
    if (& $has $d 'Reliability') { $x = $d.Reliability; & $card "Reliability (index $(if (& $has $x 'Current') { $x.Current } else { 'n/a' }))" ((& $err $x) + $(if (& $has $x 'Records') { ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlTable -Rows $x.Records -Property Time, Source, Product, Message -Max 50 } else { '' })) }
    if (& $has $d 'Crashes') { $x = $d.Crashes; & $card 'Crashes' ((& $err $x) + $(if (& $has $x 'Events') { (& $advice $x.Advice) + (ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlTable -Rows $x.Events -Property Time, Kind, Detail -Max 60) + '<h3>Minidumps</h3>' + (ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlTable -Rows $x.Minidumps -Property Name, Time, SizeKB) } else { '' })) }
    if (& $has $d 'Boot') { $x = $d.Boot; & $card 'Boot performance' ((& $err $x) + $(if (& $has $x 'Boots') { ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlTable -Rows $x.Boots -Property Time, BootMs, MainPathMs, PostBootMs } else { '' })) }
    if (& $has $d 'Drivers') { $x = $d.Drivers; & $card 'Drivers (non-Microsoft)' ((& $err $x) + $(if (& $has $x 'Drivers') { ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlTable -Rows $x.Drivers -Property Device, Class, Version, Date, Provider, Signer, Flag -Max 400 } else { '' })) }
    $u = $Report.Updates
    if (& $has $u 'Services') { & $card 'Windows Update' ((& $err $u) + (& $advice $u.Advice) + (ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlTable -Rows $u.Services -Property Name, Status, StartType) + (ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlTable -Rows $u.Policies -Property Name, Value) + (ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlTable -Rows $u.History -Property Date, Title, Result, HResult -Max 20)) }
    else { & $card 'Windows Update' (& $err $u) }
    $s = $Report.Services
    if (& $has $s 'Counts') { & $card "Services ($($s.Counts.Total), $($s.Counts.Running) running)" ("<p>Running third-party services:</p>" + (ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlTable -Rows $s.ThirdPartyRunning -Property Name, DisplayName, StartupType)) }
    $p = $Report.Persistence
    if (& $has $p 'Counts') { & $card "Persistence ($($p.Counts.Warn) warnings, $($p.Counts.Review) to review)" (ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlTable -Rows $p.Flagged -Property Severity, Category, Name, Command, Signature, Note -Max 300) }
    elseif ($p) { & $card 'Persistence' (& $err $p) }
    & $card 'iG Windows Tuner items in effect' (ConvertTo-IgwtHtmlTable -Rows @($Report.ActiveItems) -Property Id, State -Max 500)
    $null = $sb.Append('</main></body></html>')
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $sb.ToString(), $utf8)
    return $Path
}
```

`src/Manage/Updates.ps1`:

```ps1
# Updates.ps1
# Windows Update: read-only status (services, pending restart, Windows Update for Business policies)
# and update history from the Windows Update Agent (COM, query only). Policies are changed only
# through catalog items (wufbPolicy action type), never directly.

$script:IgwtWuResultNames = @{ 0 = 'Not started'; 1 = 'In progress'; 2 = 'Succeeded'; 3 = 'Succeeded with errors'; 4 = 'Failed'; 5 = 'Aborted' }

function Get-IgwtUpdateHistoryRaw {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Raw update history from the Windows Update Agent (IUpdateSearcher.QueryHistory, read-only). Mock this in tests. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([ValidateRange(1, 500)][int]$Count = 40)
    if ($script:IgwtSettings.TestMode) { throw 'TestMode safety: the Windows Update Agent must be mocked in tests.' }
    $session = New-Object -ComObject 'Microsoft.Update.Session'
    $searcher = $session.CreateUpdateSearcher()
    $total = $searcher.GetTotalHistoryCount()
    if ($total -le 0) { return @() }
    $items = $searcher.QueryHistory(0, [Math]::Min($Count, $total))
    foreach ($h in $items) { [pscustomobject]@{ Date = $h.Date; Title = [string]$h.Title; ResultCode = [int]$h.ResultCode; HResult = [int]$h.HResult; Operation = [int]$h.Operation } }
}

function Get-IgwtUpdateStatus {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Read-only Windows Update status: update services, pending restart, Windows Update for
        Business policy values, the last successful update and recent history with failures.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([ValidateRange(1, 500)][int]$Count = 100)
    $services = foreach ($n in 'wuauserv', 'UsoSvc', 'WaaSMedicSvc', 'BITS') {
        try { $s = Get-Service -Name $n -ErrorAction Stop; [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $n; Status = [string]$s.Status; StartType = [string]$s.StartType } }
        catch { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $n; Status = 'Missing'; StartType = '' } }
    }
    $pending = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    foreach ($k in @(@{ P = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WindowsUpdate\Auto Update\RebootRequired'; T = 'Windows Update' }, @{ P = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Component Based Servicing\RebootPending'; T = 'Component servicing' })) {
        try { if (Test-IgwtRegistryKey -Path $k.P) { $pending.Add($k.T) } } catch { Write-Verbose "Not readable: $($k.P)" }
    }
    $pol = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate'
    $policies = foreach ($n in 'DeferFeatureUpdates', 'DeferFeatureUpdatesPeriodInDays', 'DeferQualityUpdates', 'DeferQualityUpdatesPeriodInDays', 'TargetReleaseVersion', 'ProductVersion', 'TargetReleaseVersionInfo') {
        try { $v = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $pol -Name $n; if ($v.Exists) { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $n; Value = [string]$v.Value } } } catch { Write-Verbose "Policy not readable: $n" }
    }
    $history = @(); $err = ''
    try {
        $history = @(Get-IgwtUpdateHistoryRaw -Count $Count | ForEach-Object {
                [pscustomobject]@{ Date = $_.Date; Title = $_.Title; Result = $(if ($script:IgwtWuResultNames.ContainsKey([int]$_.ResultCode)) { $script:IgwtWuResultNames[[int]$_.ResultCode] } else { "Code $($_.ResultCode)" })
                    HResult = $(if ([int]$_.HResult) { '0x{0:X8}' -f [int]$_.HResult } else { '' }) }
            })
    } catch { $err = "Update history unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    # Defender definition updates arrive several times a day; they do not show that Windows itself is updated.
    $ok = @($history | Where-Object { $_.Result -like 'Succeeded*' -and $_.Title -notmatch 'Security Intelligence Update' } | Sort-Object Date -Descending)
    $failed = @($history | Where-Object { $_.Result -in 'Failed', 'Aborted' })
    $advice = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    if (@($services | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'wuauserv' -and $_.StartType -eq 'Disabled' }).Count) { $advice.Add('The Windows Update service is disabled; security updates are not installed. Set it back to Manual (iG Windows Tuner never disables it).') }
    if ($pending.Count) { $advice.Add("A restart is pending ($($pending -join ', ')). Restart to finish installing updates.") }
    if ($ok.Count -and ((Get-Date) - [datetime]$ok[0].Date).TotalDays -gt 45) { $advice.Add('No update was installed successfully in the last 45 days. Open Settings > Windows Update and check for updates.') }
    if ($failed.Count) { $advice.Add("$($failed.Count) update(s) failed recently; the error code (HResult) identifies the cause in Microsoft's documentation.") }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Services        = @($services)
        PendingRestart  = $pending.ToArray()
        Policies        = @($policies)
        LastSuccess     = $(if ($ok.Count) { $ok[0].Date } else { $null })
        History         = $history
        Failed          = $failed.Count
        Error           = $err
        Advice          = $advice.ToArray()
        Note            = 'Read-only. Windows Update for Business policies are changed only through catalog items (for example update.defer-feature-90).'
    }
}
```

`src/Security/AsrAudit.ps1`:

```ps1
# AsrAudit.ps1
# ASR audit view (read-only): reads the Microsoft Defender Operational log for attack surface
# reduction, controlled folder access, network protection and configuration events, groups them by
# rule, program and path, and recommends the next step (promote a quiet Audit rule, exclude a
# trusted program, or ignore expected noise). Nothing here changes the system.
# Event IDs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/attack-surface-reduction-windows-events

$script:IgwtDefenderOperationalLog = 'Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational'
$script:IgwtProtectionEvents = @{
    1121 = @{ Feature = 'ASR'; Action = 'Blocked' }
    1122 = @{ Feature = 'ASR'; Action = 'Audited' }
    1129 = @{ Feature = 'ASR'; Action = 'WarnBypassed' }
    1123 = @{ Feature = 'ControlledFolderAccess'; Action = 'Blocked' }
    1124 = @{ Feature = 'ControlledFolderAccess'; Action = 'Audited' }
    1127 = @{ Feature = 'ControlledFolderAccess'; Action = 'Blocked' }
    1128 = @{ Feature = 'ControlledFolderAccess'; Action = 'Audited' }
    1125 = @{ Feature = 'NetworkProtection'; Action = 'Audited' }
    1126 = @{ Feature = 'NetworkProtection'; Action = 'Blocked' }
    5007 = @{ Feature = 'Configuration'; Action = 'Changed' }
}
# Event fields that are not shown in the Detail column (versions, and command lines that can hold secrets).
$script:IgwtProtectionHiddenFields = @('Product Name', 'Product Version', 'Unused', 'Unused2', 'Unused3', 'Unused4', 'Unused5', 'Unused6', 'Detection Time',
    'Security intelligence Version', 'Engine Version', 'Target Commandline', 'Parent Commandline', 'Inhertiance Flags', 'Inheritance Flags', 'ID', 'Path', 'Process Name', 'User', 'Old Value', 'New Value')
$script:IgwtAsrMinimumAuditDays = 7

function ConvertFrom-IgwtProtectionEvent {
    <# .SYNOPSIS One Defender event -> Time, EventId, Feature, Action, RuleId, Path, Process, User, Detail. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$WinEvent)
    $data = @{}
    try {
        $xml = [xml]$WinEvent.ToXml()
        foreach ($d in @($xml.Event.EventData.Data)) { if ($d -and $d.Name) { $data[[string]$d.Name] = [string]$d.'#text' } }
    } catch { Write-Verbose "Event $($WinEvent.Id) could not be parsed." }
    $meta = $script:IgwtProtectionEvents[[int]$WinEvent.Id]
    if (-not $meta) { $meta = @{ Feature = 'Other'; Action = 'Other' } }
    $get = { param($n) if ($data.ContainsKey($n)) { [string]$data[$n] } else { '' } }
    $detail = @(foreach ($k in ($data.Keys | Sort-Object)) {
            if ($script:IgwtProtectionHiddenFields -notcontains $k -and [string]$data[$k]) { "${k}: $($data[$k])" }
        }) -join '; '
    if ($detail.Length -gt 240) { $detail = $detail.Substring(0, 237) + '...' }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Time     = $WinEvent.TimeCreated
        EventId  = [int]$WinEvent.Id
        Feature  = [string]$meta.Feature
        Action   = [string]$meta.Action
        RuleId   = (& $get 'ID').ToLowerInvariant()
        Path     = (& $get 'Path')
        Process  = (& $get 'Process Name')
        User     = (& $get 'User')
        OldValue = (& $get 'Old Value')
        NewValue = (& $get 'New Value')
        Detail   = $detail
    }
}

function Get-IgwtProtectionEvents {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Reads ASR (1121/1122/1129), controlled folder access (1123/1124/1127/1128), network protection
        (1125/1126) and configuration (5007) events from the Defender Operational log. Read-only.
        Readable is false (with a reason) when the log cannot be read.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([ValidateRange(1, 90)][int]$Days = 14, [ValidateRange(1, 50000)][int]$MaxEvents = 5000)
    $filter = @{ LogName = $script:IgwtDefenderOperationalLog; Id = [int[]]@($script:IgwtProtectionEvents.Keys); StartTime = (Get-Date).AddDays(-$Days) }
    $raw = @(); $readable = $true; $err = ''
    try { $raw = @(Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable $filter -MaxEvents $MaxEvents -ErrorAction Stop) }
    catch {
        if ([string]$_.FullyQualifiedErrorId -like 'NoMatchingEventsFound*') { $raw = @() }
        elseif ($_.Exception -is [System.UnauthorizedAccessException] -or [string]$_.Exception.Message -match '(?i)unauthorized|access is denied') {
            $readable = $false; $err = 'Reading the Defender log needs administrator rights on this PC. Run iG Windows Tuner as administrator to see the audit view.'
        } else { $readable = $false; $err = "The Defender log could not be read: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    }
    $logStart = $null
    if ($readable) {
        try { $oldest = @(Get-WinEvent -LogName $script:IgwtDefenderOperationalLog -MaxEvents 1 -Oldest -ErrorAction Stop); if ($oldest.Count) { $logStart = $oldest[0].TimeCreated } }
        catch { Write-Verbose 'Oldest Defender event not readable.' }
    }
    $items = foreach ($e in $raw) { if ($e) { ConvertFrom-IgwtProtectionEvent -WinEvent $e } }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Readable = $readable; Error = $err; Days = $Days; LogStart = $logStart; Truncated = ($raw.Count -ge $MaxEvents); Events = @($items) }
}

function Get-IgwtAsrProgramSuggestion {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Next step for one program a rule reported: Ignore, Review or ExcludeIfTrusted (with the exact file to exclude). #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Definition, [AllowEmptyString()][string]$Path)
    if ([string]$Definition.key -eq 'lsass') {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Suggestion = 'Ignore'; Exclusion = ''; Reason = 'Programs that open LSASS are only denied memory access, not stopped; Microsoft says these events can be ignored unless something actually breaks.' }
    }
    if (-not $Path) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Suggestion = 'Review'; Exclusion = ''; Reason = 'The event has no file path.' } }
    if ($env:SystemRoot -and (Test-IgwtPathUnder -Path $Path -Parent ([string]$env:SystemRoot))) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Suggestion = 'Review'; Exclusion = ''; Reason = 'A Windows component triggered this rule. Investigate the parent program instead; Windows paths cannot be excluded.' }
    }
    $check = Test-IgwtAsrExclusion -Path $Path
    if ($check.Valid) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Suggestion = 'ExcludeIfTrusted'; Exclusion = $Path; Reason = 'If you trust this program, add a per-rule exclusion for this exact file (not its folder).' }
    }
    return [pscustomobject]@{ Suggestion = 'Review'; Exclusion = ''; Reason = "Not excludable: $($check.Reason)" }
}

function Get-IgwtAsrAudit {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        ASR audit view (read-only). Groups events by rule and by program/path and recommends:
        PromoteToBlock / PromoteToWarn (quiet Audit rule), ReviewPrograms (Audit rule with hits),
        ReviewBlocks (blocking rule with hits), KeepAuditing (log covers fewer than 7 days),
        EnableAudit (rule not configured) or None.
    .PARAMETER Events
        Output of Get-IgwtProtectionEvents (read from the log when omitted).
    .PARAMETER Status
        Output of Get-IgwtAsrStatus (read when omitted).
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([ValidateRange(1, 90)][int]$Days = 14, $Events, $Status)
    if (-not $Events) { $Events = Get-IgwtProtectionEvents -Days $Days }
    if (-not $Status) { try { $Status = Get-IgwtAsrStatus } catch { $Status = $null } }
    $all = @($Events.Events | Where-Object { $_ })
    $asr = @($all | Where-Object { $_.Feature -eq 'ASR' })
    $coverage = 0.0
    if ($Events.LogStart) { $coverage = [Math]::Round([Math]::Min([double]$Events.Days, ((Get-Date) - [datetime]$Events.LogStart).TotalDays), 1) }
    $statusById = @{}
    if ($Status) { foreach ($r in @($Status.Rules)) { $statusById[[string]$r.Id] = $r } }

    $rules = foreach ($def in @(Get-IgwtAsrCatalog)) {
        $id = ([string]$def.id).ToLowerInvariant()
        $evs = @($asr | Where-Object { $_.RuleId -eq $id })
        $mode = 'Unknown'
        if ($statusById.ContainsKey($id)) { $mode = [string]$statusById[$id].Mode }
        $programs = @($evs | Group-Object { "$($_.Path)|$($_.Process)" } | ForEach-Object {
                $g = @($_.Group | Sort-Object Time -Descending)
                $s = Get-IgwtAsrProgramSuggestion -Definition $def -Path ([string]$g[0].Path)
                [pscustomobject]@{
                    Path         = [string]$g[0].Path
                    Process      = [string]$g[0].Process
                    Count        = $g.Count
                    Blocked      = @($g | Where-Object { $_.Action -eq 'Blocked' }).Count
                    Audited      = @($g | Where-Object { $_.Action -eq 'Audited' }).Count
                    WarnBypassed = @($g | Where-Object { $_.Action -eq 'WarnBypassed' }).Count
                    LastSeen     = $g[0].Time
                    Suggestion   = $s.Suggestion
                    Exclusion    = $s.Exclusion
                    Reason       = $s.Reason
                }
            } | Sort-Object Count -Descending)
        $blocked = @($evs | Where-Object { $_.Action -eq 'Blocked' }).Count
        $audited = @($evs | Where-Object { $_.Action -eq 'Audited' }).Count
        $bypassed = @($evs | Where-Object { $_.Action -eq 'WarnBypassed' }).Count
        $actionable = @($programs | Where-Object { $_.Suggestion -ne 'Ignore' })
        $rec = 'None'; $text = ''
        if ($def.serverOnly) { $text = 'Exchange servers only; nothing to do on Windows 11.' }
        elseif ($mode -in 'NotConfigured', 'Off') {
            if ([string]$def.recommendedMode -ne 'NotConfigured') { $rec = 'EnableAudit'; $text = "Not active. Recommended: $($def.recommendedMode). Start in Audit to see what it would block." }
        } elseif ($mode -eq 'Audit') {
            if ($actionable.Count -gt 0) { $rec = 'ReviewPrograms'; $text = "$($actionable.Count) program(s) would have been blocked. Exclude the ones you trust (exact file), then promote the rule." }
            elseif ($coverage -lt $script:IgwtAsrMinimumAuditDays) { $rec = 'KeepAuditing'; $text = "The Defender log only covers $coverage day(s); keep auditing for at least $($script:IgwtAsrMinimumAuditDays) days before promoting." }
            elseif ([string]$def.gamerImpactLevel -in 'medium', 'high' -and $def.supportsWarn) { $rec = 'PromoteToWarn'; $text = "No audit hits in $coverage day(s). Warn is the safer next step for this rule: a block can be bypassed for 24 hours (administrator approval needed)." }
            else { $rec = 'PromoteToBlock'; $text = "No audit hits in $coverage day(s): switching to Block should not affect this PC." }
        } elseif ($mode -in 'Block', 'Warn') {
            if ($actionable.Count -gt 0) { $rec = 'ReviewBlocks'; $text = "$($actionable.Count) program(s) were blocked. If a trusted program stopped working, add a per-rule exclusion for its exact file." }
            elseif ($programs.Count -gt 0) { $text = 'Only expected events (see the program list).' }
            else { $text = 'Active, no events.' }
        }
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Id                 = $id
            Key                = [string]$def.key
            Name               = [string]$def.name
            Mode               = $mode
            Blocked            = $blocked
            Audited            = $audited
            WarnBypassed       = $bypassed
            Total              = $evs.Count
            LastSeen           = $(if ($evs.Count) { ($evs | Sort-Object Time -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).Time } else { $null })
            Programs           = $programs
            Recommendation     = $rec
            RecommendationText = $text
        }
    }
    $knownIds = @(Get-IgwtAsrCatalog | ForEach-Object { ([string]$_.id).ToLowerInvariant() })
    $unknown = @($asr | Where-Object { $_.RuleId -and $knownIds -notcontains $_.RuleId } | Group-Object RuleId | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ RuleId = $_.Name; Count = $_.Count } })
    $cfa = @($all | Where-Object { $_.Feature -eq 'ControlledFolderAccess' } | Group-Object Process | ForEach-Object {
            $g = @($_.Group | Sort-Object Time -Descending)
            [pscustomobject]@{ Process = [string]$_.Name; Count = $g.Count; Blocked = @($g | Where-Object { $_.Action -eq 'Blocked' }).Count; Audited = @($g | Where-Object { $_.Action -eq 'Audited' }).Count
                LastPath = [string]$g[0].Path; LastSeen = $g[0].Time
                Advice = 'If this is a trusted program (for example a game saving to Documents), allow it in Windows Security > Ransomware protection > Allow an app.' }
        } | Sort-Object Count -Descending)
    $np = @($all | Where-Object { $_.Feature -eq 'NetworkProtection' } | Group-Object Process | ForEach-Object {
            $g = @($_.Group | Sort-Object Time -Descending)
            [pscustomobject]@{ Process = [string]$_.Name; Count = $g.Count; Blocked = @($g | Where-Object { $_.Action -eq 'Blocked' }).Count; Audited = @($g | Where-Object { $_.Action -eq 'Audited' }).Count
                LastDetail = [string]$g[0].Detail; LastSeen = $g[0].Time }
        } | Sort-Object Count -Descending)
    $config = @($all | Where-Object { $_.Feature -eq 'Configuration' -and ("$($_.OldValue) $($_.NewValue)" -match '(?i)Exploit Guard|AttackSurfaceReduction|ASR') } |
            Sort-Object Time -Descending | Select-Object -First 15 | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Time = $_.Time; OldValue = $_.OldValue; NewValue = $_.NewValue } })
    $rules = @($rules)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Generated              = (Get-Date).ToString('o')
        Readable               = [bool]$Events.Readable
        Error                  = [string]$Events.Error
        Days                   = [int]$Events.Days
        CoverageDays           = $coverage
        Truncated              = [bool]$Events.Truncated
        Rules                  = $rules
        UnknownRules           = $unknown
        ControlledFolderAccess = $cfa
        NetworkProtection      = $np
        ConfigChanges          = $config
        Totals                 = [pscustomobject]@{
            AsrBlocked   = @($asr | Where-Object { $_.Action -eq 'Blocked' }).Count
            AsrAudited   = @($asr | Where-Object { $_.Action -eq 'Audited' }).Count
            WarnBypassed = @($asr | Where-Object { $_.Action -eq 'WarnBypassed' }).Count
            Cfa          = @($all | Where-Object { $_.Feature -eq 'ControlledFolderAccess' }).Count
            Network      = @($all | Where-Object { $_.Feature -eq 'NetworkProtection' }).Count
            ToReview     = @($rules | Where-Object { $_.Recommendation -in 'ReviewPrograms', 'ReviewBlocks' }).Count
            ToPromote    = @($rules | Where-Object { $_.Recommendation -in 'PromoteToBlock', 'PromoteToWarn' }).Count
        }
    }
}

function Format-IgwtAsrAudit {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Plain-text rendering of the ASR audit view for the console. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    [OutputType([string])]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Audit)
    $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
    $null = $sb.AppendLine("ASR audit view: last $($Audit.Days) day(s); the Defender log covers $($Audit.CoverageDays) day(s).")
    if (-not $Audit.Readable) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("  $($Audit.Error)"); return $sb.ToString() }
    $t = $Audit.Totals
    $null = $sb.AppendLine("  ASR blocks $($t.AsrBlocked), audits $($t.AsrAudited), warn bypasses $($t.WarnBypassed); controlled folder access $($t.Cfa); network protection $($t.Network).")
    if ($Audit.Truncated) { $null = $sb.AppendLine('  Note: the event limit was reached; older events are not included.') }
    $null = $sb.AppendLine(('-' * 78))
    foreach ($r in $Audit.Rules) {
        if ($r.Total -eq 0 -and $r.Recommendation -eq 'None') { continue }
        $null = $sb.AppendLine(('[{0,-13}] {1}' -f $r.Mode, $r.Name))
        if ($r.Total) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("    events: $($r.Blocked) blocked, $($r.Audited) audited, $($r.WarnBypassed) bypassed; last $($r.LastSeen)") }
        foreach ($p in @($r.Programs | Select-Object -First 5)) {
            $null = $sb.AppendLine("    - $($p.Count)x $($p.Path)$(if ($p.Process) { " (process: $($p.Process))" })")
            $null = $sb.AppendLine("      $($p.Suggestion): $($p.Reason)")
        }
        if ($r.RecommendationText) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("    -> $($r.Recommendation): $($r.RecommendationText)") }
    }
    if (@($Audit.ControlledFolderAccess).Count) {
        $null = $sb.AppendLine('Controlled folder access:')
        foreach ($c in @($Audit.ControlledFolderAccess | Select-Object -First 10)) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("  - $($c.Count)x $($c.Process) (blocked $($c.Blocked), audited $($c.Audited))") }
    }
    if (@($Audit.NetworkProtection).Count) {
        $null = $sb.AppendLine('Network protection:')
        foreach ($n in @($Audit.NetworkProtection | Select-Object -First 10)) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("  - $($n.Count)x $($n.Process) (blocked $($n.Blocked), audited $($n.Audited))") }
    }
    if (@($Audit.ConfigChanges).Count) { $null = $sb.AppendLine("ASR configuration changes: $(@($Audit.ConfigChanges).Count) (latest $($Audit.ConfigChanges[0].Time))") }
    return $sb.ToString()
}
```
