`tests/Cleaner.Tests.ps1`:

```ps1
# Cleaning engine tests. Every file operation happens inside $TestDrive fixtures, and the engine
# refuses deletions outside the test root in TestMode (Set-IgwtCleanerTestRoot). Service, process,
# Recycle Bin, Delivery Optimization, DISM and pnputil calls are mocked.

BeforeAll {
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'TestHelpers.ps1')
    Initialize-IgwtTestEnvironment
    Set-IgwtCleanerTestRoot -Path $TestDrive

    function New-TestFolder {
        [Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions', '', Justification = 'Creates TestDrive fixtures only.')]
        [CmdletBinding()]
        param()
        $p = Join-Path $TestDrive ('t' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 10))
        $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $p -Force
        return $p
    }
    function New-Fixture {
        [Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions', '', Justification = 'Creates TestDrive fixtures only.')]
        [CmdletBinding()]
        param([string]$Path, [int]$Bytes = 16, [double]$AgeHours = 0)
        $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force }
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($Path, (New-Object byte[] $Bytes))
        if ($AgeHours -gt 0) {
            $t = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddHours(-$AgeHours)
            [System.IO.File]::SetCreationTimeUtc($Path, $t)
            [System.IO.File]::SetLastWriteTimeUtc($Path, $t)
        }
        return $Path
    }
    function New-TestRule {
        [Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions', '', Justification = 'Builds an in-memory rule object only.')]
        [CmdletBinding()]
        param([hashtable]$Props)
        $base = [ordered]@{ id = 'clean.test.fixture'; name = 'Fixture'; category = 'System'; level = 'Standard'; method = 'files'
            hint = 'Fixture rule.'; description = 'Fixture rule used by the Pester suite to exercise the cleaning engine.'; sideEffects = ''; roots = @() }
        foreach ($k in $Props.Keys) { $base[$k] = $Props[$k] }
        $o = [pscustomobject]$base
        return (InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ R = $o } { param($R) ConvertTo-IgwtNormalizedCleanerRule -Rule $R })
    }
    function Use-TestRules([object[]]$Rules) {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ R = $Rules } { param($R) $script:IgwtCleanerRuleCache = @($R); $script:IgwtCleanerProtection = $null }
    }
    function Invoke-TestScan($Rule) {
        Use-TestRules @($Rule)
        return (Invoke-IgwtCleanerScan -RuleId $Rule.id)
    }
    function Invoke-TestClean($Rule) {
        $scan = Invoke-TestScan $Rule
        $clean = Invoke-IgwtCleanerClean -Scan $scan
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Scan = $scan.Rules[0]; Clean = $clean.Rules[0]; LogFile = $clean.LogFile }
    }
    function Set-TestShellFolder {
        [Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions', '', Justification = 'Writes to the Pester TestRegistry: drive only.')]
        [CmdletBinding()]
        param([string]$Name, [string]$Value)
        $key = 'TestRegistry:\HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Shell Folders'
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $key)) { $null = New-Item -Path $key -Force }
        $null = New-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $key -Name $Name -Value $Value -PropertyType String -Force
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { $script:IgwtCleanerProtection = $null }
    }
}

AfterAll {
    InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { $script:IgwtCleanerRuleCache = $null; $script:IgwtCleanerProtection = $null; $script:IgwtLastCleanerScan = $null }
    Set-IgwtCleanerTestRoot -Path ''
}

Describe 'Cleaner rule catalog' {
    BeforeAll {
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-IgwtSteamLibraryPaths { @((Join-Path $TestDrive 'SteamFixture')) }
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { $script:IgwtCleanerRuleCache = $null }
        $script:Rules = @(Get-IgwtCleanerRules -Force)
    }
    AfterAll { InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { $script:IgwtCleanerRuleCache = $null } }

    It 'validates without errors' { @(Test-IgwtCleanerCatalog) | Should -BeNullOrEmpty }
    It 'ships rules in every category' {
        foreach ($c in 'System', 'Gaming', 'Browsers', 'Apps', 'Developer', 'Downloads') { @($script:Rules | Where-Object { $_.category -eq $c }).Count | Should -BeGreaterThan 0 -Because $c }
    }
    It 'gives every rule a hint of 140 characters or less and a description' {
        foreach ($r in $script:Rules) {
            ([string]$r.hint).Length | Should -BeLessOrEqual 140 -Because $r.id
            ([string]$r.hint).Length | Should -BeGreaterThan 10 -Because $r.id
            ([string]$r.description).Length | Should -BeGreaterOrEqual 40 -Because $r.id
        }
    }
    It 'keeps Advanced and Expert rules opt-in' {
        foreach ($r in ($script:Rules | Where-Object { $_.level -ne 'Standard' })) { $r.default | Should -BeFalse -Because $r.id }
    }
    It 'requires the Downloads rule to be opt-in and to use the Recycle Bin' {
        $d = @($script:Rules | Where-Object { $_.allowDownloads })
        $d.Count | Should -Be 1
        $d[0].recycle | Should -BeTrue
        $d[0].default | Should -BeFalse
    }
    It 'lists the browser process for every browser rule' {
        foreach ($r in ($script:Rules | Where-Object { $_.category -eq 'Browsers' })) { @($r.requiresClosed).Count | Should -BeGreaterThan 0 -Because $r.id }
    }
    It 'cleans browsers only through allowed cache folder names' {
        $allowed = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { $script:IgwtBrowserCacheNames }
        foreach ($r in ($script:Rules | Where-Object { $_.method -eq 'browserCache' })) {
            foreach ($d in @($r.profileCacheDirs) + @($r.rootCacheDirs)) { $d | Should -BeIn $allowed -Because $r.id }
        }
    }
    It 'never deletes Windows.old or Docker data directly (guidance only)' {
        (Get-IgwtCleanerRules | Where-Object { $_.id -eq 'clean.windows-old' }).method | Should -Be 'guidance'
        (Get-IgwtCleanerRules | Where-Object { $_.id -eq 'clean.dev.docker' }).method | Should -Be 'guidance'
    }
    It 'reports every broken rule property' {
        $bad = @(
            (New-TestRule @{ id = 'Bad Id' })
            (New-TestRule @{ id = 'clean.bad.hint'; hint = ('x' * 141); roots = @('%TEMP%\IgwtFixture') })
            (New-TestRule @{ id = 'clean.bad.desc'; description = 'short'; roots = @('%TEMP%\IgwtFixture') })
            (New-TestRule @{ id = 'clean.bad.category'; category = 'Nope'; roots = @('%TEMP%\IgwtFixture') })
            (New-TestRule @{ id = 'clean.bad.default'; level = 'Expert'; default = $true; roots = @('%TEMP%\IgwtFixture') })
            (New-TestRule @{ id = 'clean.bad.downloads'; allowDownloads = $true; roots = @('%USERPROFILE%\Downloads') })
            (New-TestRule @{ id = 'clean.bad.browser'; category = 'Browsers'; roots = @('%TEMP%\IgwtFixture') })
            (New-TestRule @{ id = 'clean.bad.source'; sources = @('http://example.com'); roots = @('%TEMP%\IgwtFixture') })
            (New-TestRule @{ id = 'clean.bad.root'; roots = @('%SystemRoot%\System32') })
            (New-TestRule @{ id = 'clean.bad.cookies'; method = 'browserCache'; userDataRoots = @('%LOCALAPPDATA%\X\User Data'); profileCacheDirs = @('Cookies'); requiresClosed = @('x') })
            (New-TestRule @{ id = 'clean.bad.noroots' })
        )
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-IgwtCleanerRules { $bad }
        $errors = (@(Test-IgwtCleanerCatalog) -join "`n")
        $errors | Should -Match "Bad Id: id must start with 'clean.'"
        $errors | Should -Match 'clean.bad.hint: hint is 141 characters'
        $errors | Should -Match 'clean.bad.desc: description is too short'
        $errors | Should -Match "clean.bad.category: unknown category 'Nope'"
        $errors | Should -Match 'clean.bad.default: only Standard rules may be on by default'
        $errors | Should -Match 'clean.bad.downloads: rules that clean Downloads must send files to the Recycle Bin'
        $errors | Should -Match 'clean.bad.browser: browser rules must list the browser process'
        $errors | Should -Match "clean.bad.source: source 'http://example.com' must be https"
        $errors | Should -Match 'clean.bad.root: root .* resolves to a protected location'
        $errors | Should -Match "clean.bad.cookies: 'Cookies' is not an allowed browser cache folder name"
        $errors | Should -Match "clean.bad.noroots: 'files' rules need roots"
    }
}

Describe 'Path canonicalization and the denylist' {
    It 'refuses empty, relative, UNC and device paths' -ForEach @(
        @{ P = '' }, @{ P = 'relative\path' }, @{ P = '\\server\share\x' }, @{ P = '\\?\C:\Windows' }, @{ P = '\\.\C:\x' }, @{ P = 'C:relative' }
    ) {
        $path = $P
        { InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ X = $path } { param($X) ConvertTo-IgwtCanonicalPath -Path $X } } | Should -Throw
    }
    It 'resolves ".." segments before any check' {
        $c = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ X = "$env:SystemRoot\Temp\..\System32" } { param($X) ConvertTo-IgwtCanonicalPath -Path $X }
        $c | Should -Be (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32')
    }
    It 'expands 8.3 short names so they cannot bypass the denylist' {
        $short = (New-Object -ComObject Scripting.FileSystemObject).GetFolder($env:ProgramFiles).ShortPath
        if ($short -eq $env:ProgramFiles) { Set-ItResult -Skipped -Because '8.3 names are disabled on this volume' ; return }
        $c = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ X = "$short\IgwtNotThere" } { param($X) ConvertTo-IgwtCanonicalPath -Path $X }
        $c | Should -Be (Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'IgwtNotThere')
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ X = $c } { param($X) Test-IgwtCleanerPathProtected -Path $X } | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
    It 'protects <P>' -ForEach @(
        @{ P = "$env:SystemDrive\" }
        @{ P = "$env:SystemRoot" }
        @{ P = "$env:SystemRoot\explorer.exe" }
        @{ P = "$env:SystemRoot\System32\kernel32.dll" }
        @{ P = "$env:SystemRoot\WinSxS\x.manifest" }
        @{ P = "$env:SystemRoot\Installer\x.msi" }
        @{ P = "$env:ProgramFiles\App\app.exe" }
        @{ P = "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Steam\steamapps\common\Game\game.exe" }
        @{ P = "$env:ProgramData" }
        @{ P = "$env:ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Scans\x.bin" }
        @{ P = "$env:USERPROFILE" }
        @{ P = "$env:USERPROFILE\notes.txt" }
        @{ P = "$env:USERPROFILE\Documents\thesis.docx" }
        @{ P = "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\x.lnk" }
        @{ P = "$env:USERPROFILE\Saved Games\save.dat" }
        @{ P = "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\setup.exe" }
        @{ P = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA" }
        @{ P = "$env:APPDATA" }
        @{ P = "$env:USERPROFILE\AppData\LocalLow" }
        @{ P = "$env:APPDATA\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\a.default\places.sqlite" }
        @{ P = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data" }
        @{ P = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\Default\Cookies" }
        @{ P = "$env:SystemDrive\`$Recycle.Bin\S-1-5-21-1\x" }
    ) {
        $path = $P
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ X = $path } { param($X) $script:IgwtCleanerProtection = $null; Test-IgwtCleanerPathProtected -Path (ConvertTo-IgwtCanonicalPath -Path $X) } | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
    It 'allows <P>' -ForEach @(
        @{ P = "$env:TEMP\x.tmp" }
        @{ P = "$env:SystemRoot\Temp\x.tmp" }
        @{ P = "$env:SystemRoot\SoftwareDistribution\Download\abc\x.cab" }
        @{ P = "$env:SystemRoot\Logs\CBS\CbsPersist_1.log" }
        @{ P = "$env:SystemRoot\Minidump\a.dmp" }
        @{ P = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\D3DSCache\x\y.idx" }
        @{ P = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Cache\Cache_Data\f_000001" }
        @{ P = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\a.default\cache2\entries\x" }
        @{ P = "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Steam\steamapps\shadercache\730\x.bin" }
        @{ P = "$env:USERPROFILE\.gradle\caches\modules-2\x.jar" }
    ) {
        $path = $P
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ X = $path } { param($X) $script:IgwtCleanerProtection = $null; Test-IgwtCleanerPathProtected -Path (ConvertTo-IgwtCanonicalPath -Path $X) } | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
    It 'allows Downloads only for the opt-in rule' {
        $p = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { ConvertTo-IgwtCanonicalPath -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\old.zip" }
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ X = $p } { param($X) Test-IgwtCleanerPathProtected -Path $X -AllowDownloads } | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
    It 'protects a redirected Documents folder read from Shell Folders' {
        $docs = New-TestFolder
        Set-TestShellFolder -Name 'Personal' -Value $docs
        try {
            InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ X = (Join-Path $docs 'report.docx') } { param($X) Test-IgwtCleanerPathProtected -Path $X } | Should -Match 'protected folder'
        } finally { Remove-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'TestRegistry:\HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Shell Folders' -Name 'Personal'; InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { $script:IgwtCleanerProtection = $null } }
    }
    It 'flags reparse points, cloud placeholders and offline files by attribute' -ForEach @(
        @{ A = 0x400; Skip = $true }, @{ A = 0x1000; Skip = $true }, @{ A = 0x40000; Skip = $true }, @{ A = 0x400000; Skip = $true }
        @{ A = 0x400020; Skip = $true }, @{ A = 0x5; Skip = $true }, @{ A = 0x20; Skip = $false }, @{ A = 0x1; Skip = $false }, @{ A = 0x80; Skip = $false }
    ) {
        $a = [long]$A
        $r = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ X = $a } { param($X) Test-IgwtCleanerAttributesSkippable -Attributes $X }
        if ($Skip) { $r | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty } else { $r | Should -BeNullOrEmpty }
    }
    It 'lets system files through only when the rule allows them' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Test-IgwtCleanerAttributesSkippable -Attributes 0x5 -AllowSystemFiles } | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
}

Describe 'Root resolution refuses malicious roots' {
    AfterEach { Remove-Item Env:\IGWT_TEST_EVIL -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
    It 'refuses <T>' -ForEach @(
        @{ T = 'C:\' }
        @{ T = '%SystemDrive%\' }
        @{ T = '%USERPROFILE%' }
        @{ T = '%USERPROFILE%\Documents' }
        @{ T = '%SystemRoot%' }
        @{ T = '%SystemRoot%\System32' }
        @{ T = '%ProgramFiles%' }
        @{ T = '%ProgramData%' }
        @{ T = '%LOCALAPPDATA%' }
        @{ T = '%TEMP%\..\..' }
        @{ T = '%TEMP%\..\..\..\Documents' }
        @{ T = '\\server\share\cache' }
        @{ T = '\\?\C:\Windows\Temp' }
    ) {
        $rule = New-TestRule @{ roots = @($T) }
        $res = @(InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ R = $rule } { param($R) $script:IgwtCleanerProtection = $null; Resolve-IgwtCleanerRoots -Rule $R })
        $res.Count | Should -BeGreaterThan 0
        foreach ($x in $res) { $x.Status | Should -Be 'Refused' }
    }
    It 'refuses a root injected through an environment variable' {
        $env:IGWT_TEST_EVIL = "$env:SystemRoot\System32"
        $rule = New-TestRule @{ roots = @('%IGWT_TEST_EVIL%') }
        $res = @(InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ R = $rule } { param($R) Resolve-IgwtCleanerRoots -Rule $R })
        $res[0].Status | Should -Be 'Refused'
    }
    It 'skips roots with unresolved environment variables instead of guessing' {
        $rule = New-TestRule @{ roots = @('%IGWT_TEST_UNSET_VAR%\cache') }
        @(InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ R = $rule } { param($R) Resolve-IgwtCleanerRoots -Rule $R }) | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
    It 'refuses a root that is itself a junction' {
        $base = New-TestFolder
        $target = Join-Path $base 'target'; $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $target
        $link = Join-Path $base 'link'; $null = New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $link -Value $target
        $rule = New-TestRule @{ roots = @($link) }
        $res = @(InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ R = $rule } { param($R) Resolve-IgwtCleanerRoots -Rule $R })
        $res[0].Status | Should -Be 'Refused'
        $res[0].Reason | Should -Match 'reparse point'
    }
    It 'expands allUsers roots from the profile list (real user SIDs only)' {
        $users = New-TestFolder
        $a = Join-Path $users 'alice'; $b = Join-Path $users 'bob'
        $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $a 'AppData\Local\IgwtFixtureCache') -Force
        $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $b 'AppData\Local\IgwtFixtureCache') -Force
        $list = 'TestRegistry:\HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList'
        foreach ($e in @(@{ S = 'S-1-5-21-1-2-3-1001'; P = $a }, @{ S = 'S-1-5-21-1-2-3-1002'; P = $b }, @{ S = 'S-1-5-18'; P = $a })) {
            $k = Join-Path $list $e.S
            $null = New-Item -Path $k -Force
            $null = New-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $k -Name ProfileImagePath -Value $e.P -PropertyType ExpandString -Force
        }
        $rule = New-TestRule @{ roots = @('%LOCALAPPDATA%\IgwtFixtureCache'); allUsers = $true }
        $res = @(InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ R = $rule } { param($R) Resolve-IgwtCleanerRoots -Rule $R -AllUsers } | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Ok' })
        @($res.Path) | Should -Contain (Join-Path $a 'AppData\Local\IgwtFixtureCache')
        @($res.Path) | Should -Contain (Join-Path $b 'AppData\Local\IgwtFixtureCache')
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $list -Recurse -Force
    }
}

Describe 'Scan then clean on fixtures' {
    It 'deletes the scanned files, removes emptied subfolders and keeps the root' {
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $f1 = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'a.tmp') 100
        $f2 = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'sub\deeper\b.tmp') 200
        $rule = New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root) }
        $r = Invoke-TestClean $rule
        $r.Scan.Status | Should -Be 'Ready'
        $r.Scan.Count | Should -Be 2
        $r.Scan.Bytes | Should -Be 300
        $r.Clean.DeletedCount | Should -Be 2
        $r.Clean.DeletedBytes | Should -Be 300
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $f1 | Should -BeFalse
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $f2 | Should -BeFalse
        Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'sub') | Should -BeFalse
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $root | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'writes every deleted path to the JSONL deletion log' {
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $f = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'logged.tmp') 10
        $r = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root) })
        $lines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $r.LogFile | ForEach-Object { $_ | ConvertFrom-Json })
        @($lines.path) | Should -Contain $f
        ($lines | Where-Object { $_.path -eq $f }).rule | Should -Be 'clean.test.fixture'
    }
    It 'never deletes files that appeared after the scan' {
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $null = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'old.tmp')
        $rule = New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root) }
        $scan = Invoke-TestScan $rule
        $new = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'new.tmp')
        $null = Invoke-IgwtCleanerClean -Scan $scan
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $new | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'skips files that changed after the scan' {
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $f = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'changing.log') 10
        $rule = New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root) }
        $scan = Invoke-TestScan $rule
        [System.IO.File]::AppendAllText($f, 'more')
        $c = (Invoke-IgwtCleanerClean -Scan $scan).Rules[0]
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $f | Should -BeTrue
        $c.Skipped.Keys | Should -Contain 'changed since the scan'
    }
    It 'skips files that are locked by another process' {
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $f = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'locked.tmp') 10
        $rule = New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root) }
        $scan = Invoke-TestScan $rule
        $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($f, 'Open', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
        try { $c = (Invoke-IgwtCleanerClean -Scan $scan).Rules[0] } finally { $fs.Dispose() }
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $f | Should -BeTrue
        $c.Skipped.Keys | Should -Contain 'in use'
        $c.Status | Should -Be 'Cleaned'
    }
    It 'applies the minimum age using the newer of creation and write time' {
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $old = New-Fixture -Path (Join-Path $root 'old.tmp') -Bytes 10 -AgeHours 72
        $young = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'young.tmp') 10
        $extracted = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'extracted.tmp') 10
        [System.IO.File]::SetLastWriteTimeUtc($extracted, [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddDays(-30))
        $r = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root); minAgeHours = 24 })
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $old | Should -BeFalse
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $young | Should -BeTrue
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $extracted | Should -BeTrue
        $r.Scan.Count | Should -Be 1
    }
    It 'honours include and exclude patterns' {
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $thumb = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'thumbcache_256.db')
        $icon = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'iconcache_256.db')
        $other = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'notes.txt')
        $null = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root); include = @('thumbcache_*.db', 'iconcache*'); exclude = @('iconcache*'); recurse = $false })
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $thumb | Should -BeFalse
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $icon | Should -BeTrue
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $other | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'keeps the newest files when keepNewest is set' {
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $files = foreach ($i in 1..5) { New-Fixture -Path (Join-Path $root "dump$i.dmp") -Bytes 10 -AgeHours (10 * $i) }
        $r = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root); keepNewest = 2 })
        $r.Scan.Count | Should -Be 3
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $files[0] | Should -BeTrue
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $files[1] | Should -BeTrue
        foreach ($f in $files[2..4]) { Test-Path -LiteralPath $f | Should -BeFalse }
    }
    It 'skips offline (cloud placeholder) files so cleaning never triggers a download' {
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $f = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'placeholder.bin')
        [System.IO.File]::SetAttributes($f, [System.IO.FileAttributes]::Offline)
        $r = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root) })
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $f | Should -BeTrue
        $r.Scan.Skipped.Keys | Should -Contain 'cloud placeholder or offline file (would trigger a download)'
    }
    It 'skips read-only files unless the rule allows system files' {
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $f = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'readonly.tmp')
        [System.IO.File]::SetAttributes($f, [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReadOnly)
        $r = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root) })
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $f | Should -BeTrue
        $r.Clean.Skipped.Keys | Should -Contain 'read-only file'
        [System.IO.File]::SetAttributes($f, [System.IO.FileAttributes]::Normal)
    }
    It 'reports NotPresent when no root exists and GuidanceOnly for guidance rules' {
        $missing = Join-Path (New-TestFolder) 'nothing-here'
        (Invoke-TestScan (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($missing) })).Rules[0].Status | Should -Be 'NotPresent'
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $f = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'big.vhdx') 1000
        $r = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ method = 'guidance'; roots = @($root); notes = 'Use the app.' })
        $r.Scan.Status | Should -Be 'GuidanceOnly'
        $r.Scan.Bytes | Should -Be 1000
        $r.Clean.Status | Should -Be 'Skipped'
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $f | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'reports RequiresAdmin for admin rules when not elevated' {
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Test-IgwtIsAdmin { $false }
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $null = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'x.tmp')
        (Invoke-TestScan (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root); requiresAdmin = $true })).Rules[0].Status | Should -Be 'RequiresAdmin'
    }
    It 'never closes apps: a running blocker skips the rule' {
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-Process { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'igwtfixtureapp' } } -ParameterFilter { @($Name) -contains 'igwtfixtureapp' }
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $f = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'x.tmp')
        $r = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root); requiresClosed = @('igwtfixtureapp') })
        $r.Scan.Status | Should -Be 'RequiresClose'
        $r.Clean.Status | Should -Be 'Skipped'
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $f | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'refuses to clean without a scan' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { $script:IgwtLastCleanerScan = $null }
        { Invoke-IgwtCleanerClean } | Should -Throw '*Run a scan first*'
    }
    It 'deletes nothing with -WhatIf' {
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $f = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'x.tmp')
        $scan = Invoke-TestScan (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root) })
        $null = Invoke-IgwtCleanerClean -Scan $scan -WhatIf
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $f | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'stops between files when cancelled' {
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $f = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'x.tmp')
        $scan = Invoke-TestScan (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root) })
        $cts = New-Object System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource
        $cts.Cancel()
        $null = Invoke-IgwtCleanerClean -Scan $scan -CancelToken $cts.Token
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $f | Should -BeTrue
        (Invoke-IgwtCleanerScan -RuleId 'clean.test.fixture' -CancelToken $cts.Token).Rules[0].Status | Should -Be 'Cancelled'
    }
}

Describe 'Reparse points and tampering' {
    It 'never follows a junction inside a root and never deletes the junction' {
        $base = New-TestFolder
        $root = Join-Path $base 'root'
        $outside = Join-Path $base 'outside'
        $precious = New-Fixture (Join-Path $outside 'precious.txt')
        $null = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'junk.tmp')
        $link = Join-Path $root 'link'
        $null = New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $link -Value $outside
        $r = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root) })
        @($r.Scan.Items | Where-Object { $_.Path -like "$link*" }) | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
        $r.Scan.Count | Should -Be 1
        $r.Scan.Skipped.Keys | Should -Contain 'reparse point (not followed)'
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $precious | Should -BeTrue
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $link | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'never follows a directory symbolic link' {
        $base = New-TestFolder
        $root = Join-Path $base 'root'; $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $root
        $outside = Join-Path $base 'outside'
        $precious = New-Fixture (Join-Path $outside 'precious.txt')
        try { $null = New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path (Join-Path $root 'sym') -Value $outside -ErrorAction Stop }
        catch { Set-ItResult -Skipped -Because 'creating symbolic links needs Developer Mode or elevation'; return }
        $null = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root) })
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $precious | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'refuses a delete when a folder was swapped for a junction after the scan' {
        $base = New-TestFolder
        $root = Join-Path $base 'root'
        $victim = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'sub\file.txt') 10
        $scan = Invoke-TestScan (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root) })
        $ticks = $scan.Rules[0].Items[0].LastWriteTicks
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'sub') -Recurse -Force
        $outside = Join-Path $base 'outside'
        $precious = New-Fixture (Join-Path $outside 'file.txt') 10
        [System.IO.File]::SetLastWriteTimeUtc($precious, (New-Object DateTime($ticks, [DateTimeKind]::Utc)))
        $null = New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path (Join-Path $root 'sub') -Value $outside
        $c = (Invoke-IgwtCleanerClean -Scan $scan).Rules[0]
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $precious | Should -BeTrue
        $c.Skipped.Keys | Should -Contain 'a parent folder is (or became) a reparse point'
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $victim | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'refuses scan entries that were edited to point outside the rule' {
        $base = New-TestFolder
        $root = Join-Path $base 'root'
        $null = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'a.tmp')
        $precious = New-Fixture (Join-Path $base 'outside\precious.txt')
        $scan = Invoke-TestScan (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root) })
        $item = $scan.Rules[0].Items[0]
        $item.Path = $precious; $item.Size = 16; $item.LastWriteTicks = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $precious).LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks
        $c = (Invoke-IgwtCleanerClean -Scan $scan).Rules[0]
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $precious | Should -BeTrue
        $c.Skipped.Keys | Should -Contain 'outside the rule root'
        # Also widen the root and the scan's root list: the clean phase re-resolves the rule's roots.
        $item.Root = Join-Path $base 'outside'
        $scan.Rules[0].ResolvedRoots = @($item.Root)
        $c = (Invoke-IgwtCleanerClean -Scan $scan).Rules[0]
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $precious | Should -BeTrue
        $c.Skipped.Keys | Should -Contain 'root is not one of the rule roots'
    }
    It 'refuses paths that change under canonicalization (.. segments)' {
        $base = New-TestFolder
        $root = Join-Path $base 'root'; $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $root
        $precious = New-Fixture (Join-Path $base 'outside\precious.txt')
        $entry = [pscustomobject]@{ Path = "$root\..\outside\precious.txt"; Size = 16; LastWriteTicks = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $precious).LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks; Root = $root }
        $rule = New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root) }
        $rule | Add-Member -NotePropertyName ResolvedRoots -NotePropertyValue @($root) -Force
        $o = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ E = $entry; R = $rule } { param($E, $R) Remove-IgwtCleanerFile -Entry $E -Rule $R }
        $o.Result | Should -Be 'Refused'
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $precious | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'refuses anything outside the test root in TestMode' {
        $entry = [pscustomobject]@{ Path = "$env:SystemRoot\Temp\igwt-not-there.tmp"; Size = 0; LastWriteTicks = 0; Root = "$env:SystemRoot\Temp" }
        $rule = New-TestRule @{ roots = @("$env:SystemRoot\Temp") }
        $rule | Add-Member -NotePropertyName ResolvedRoots -NotePropertyValue @("$env:SystemRoot\Temp") -Force
        $o = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ E = $entry; R = $rule } { param($E, $R) Remove-IgwtCleanerFile -Entry $E -Rule $R }
        $o.Result | Should -Be 'Refused'
        $o.Reason | Should -Match 'TestMode'
    }
    It 'refuses browser profile data that is not a cache folder' {
        $base = New-TestFolder
        $prof = Join-Path $base 'User Data\Default'
        $cookies = New-Fixture (Join-Path $prof 'Cookies')
        $cache = New-Fixture (Join-Path $prof 'Cache\Cache_Data\f_000001')
        $rule = New-TestRule @{ roots = @($prof) }
        $rule | Add-Member -NotePropertyName ResolvedRoots -NotePropertyValue @($prof) -Force
        foreach ($p in $cookies, $cache) {
            $fi = Get-Item -LiteralPath $p
            $e = [pscustomobject]@{ Path = $p; Size = $fi.Length; LastWriteTicks = $fi.LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks; Root = $prof }
            $o = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ E = $e; R = $rule } { param($E, $R) Remove-IgwtCleanerFile -Entry $E -Rule $R }
            if ($p -eq $cookies) { $o.Result | Should -Be 'Refused' } else { $o.Result | Should -Be 'Deleted' }
        }
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $cookies | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'cleans only cache folders of every Chromium profile' {
        $base = New-TestFolder
        $udr = Join-Path $base 'User Data'
        $keep = @((New-Fixture (Join-Path $udr 'Default\Cookies')), (New-Fixture (Join-Path $udr 'Default\History')), (New-Fixture (Join-Path $udr 'Local State')), (New-Fixture (Join-Path $udr 'Profile 2\Login Data')))
        $gone = @((New-Fixture (Join-Path $udr 'Default\Cache\Cache_Data\f_1')), (New-Fixture (Join-Path $udr 'Profile 2\Code Cache\js\a')), (New-Fixture (Join-Path $udr 'ShaderCache\data_0')))
        $notProfile = New-Fixture (Join-Path $udr 'Crashpad\Cache\x')
        $rule = New-TestRule @{ category = 'Browsers'; method = 'browserCache'; browser = 'chromium'; userDataRoots = @($udr); profileCacheDirs = @('Cache', 'Code Cache'); rootCacheDirs = @('ShaderCache'); requiresClosed = @('igwtfixturebrowser') }
        $null = Invoke-TestClean $rule
        foreach ($k in $keep) { Test-Path -LiteralPath $k | Should -BeTrue -Because $k }
        foreach ($g in $gone) { Test-Path -LiteralPath $g | Should -BeFalse -Because $g }
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $notProfile | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'refuses a rule root inside a redirected Downloads folder unless the rule is the opt-in Downloads rule' {
        $dl = New-TestFolder
        Set-TestShellFolder -Name '{374DE290-123F-4565-9164-39C4925E467B}' -Value $dl
        try {
            $f = New-Fixture -Path (Join-Path $dl 'setup.exe') -Bytes 10 -AgeHours 2000
            $r = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($dl) })
            $r.Scan.Status | Should -Be 'Refused'
            $r.Clean.Status | Should -Be 'Skipped'
            Test-Path -LiteralPath $f | Should -BeTrue
            Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Send-IgwtToRecycleBin { }
            $r = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ category = 'Downloads'; roots = @($dl); allowDownloads = $true; recycle = $true; minAgeHours = 1440 })
            $r.Clean.DeletedCount | Should -Be 1
            Should -Invoke Send-IgwtToRecycleBin -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -Times 1 -Exactly -ParameterFilter { $Path -eq $f }
            Test-Path -LiteralPath $f | Should -BeTrue -Because 'the Recycle Bin call is mocked, so a permanent delete would have removed it'
        } finally {
            Remove-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'TestRegistry:\HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Shell Folders' -Name '{374DE290-123F-4565-9164-39C4925E467B}'
            InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { $script:IgwtCleanerProtection = $null }
        }
    }
}

Describe 'Services and special methods' {
    BeforeEach {
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-Service { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $Name[0]; Status = 'Running' } }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Stop-Service { }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Start-Service { }
    }
    It 'restarts stopped services even when cleaning throws' {
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $null = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'x.tmp')
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Remove-IgwtCleanerFile { throw 'simulated failure' }
        $r = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root); services = @('igwtfixturesvc') })
        $r.Clean.Status | Should -Be 'Error'
        Should -Invoke Stop-Service -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -Times 1 -Exactly
        Should -Invoke Start-Service -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -Times 1 -Exactly -ParameterFilter { $Name[0] -eq 'igwtfixturesvc' }
    }
    It 'does not start services that were not running before' {
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-Service { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $Name[0]; Status = 'Stopped' } }
        $root = New-TestFolder
        $null = New-Fixture (Join-Path $root 'x.tmp')
        $null = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ roots = @($root); services = @('igwtfixturesvc') })
        Should -Invoke Stop-Service -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -Times 0 -Exactly
        Should -Invoke Start-Service -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -Times 0 -Exactly
    }
    It 'empties only Recycle Bins that hold data' {
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-IgwtRecycleBinUsage { @([pscustomobject]@{ Drive = 'C'; Bytes = 500; Items = 2 }, [pscustomobject]@{ Drive = 'D'; Bytes = 0; Items = 0 }) }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Clear-RecycleBin { }
        $r = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ method = 'recycleBin' })
        $r.Scan.Bytes | Should -Be 500
        $r.Clean.DeletedBytes | Should -Be 500
        Should -Invoke Clear-RecycleBin -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -Times 1 -Exactly -ParameterFilter { $DriveLetter[0] -eq 'C' }
    }
    It 'uses the Delivery Optimization cmdlets' {
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-DeliveryOptimizationPerfSnap { [pscustomobject]@{ CacheSizeBytes = 4096 } }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Delete-DeliveryOptimizationCache { }
        $r = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ method = 'deliveryOptimization'; requiresAdmin = $true })
        $r.Scan.Bytes | Should -Be 4096
        Should -Invoke Delete-DeliveryOptimizationCache -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -Times 1 -Exactly
    }
    It 'runs DISM component cleanup through Repair-WindowsImage (ResetBase only for the Expert rule)' {
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Test-IgwtIsAdmin { $true }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-IgwtComponentStoreAnalysis { [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = 1GB; Recommended = $true; Packages = 3 } }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Repair-WindowsImage { }
        $r = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ method = 'dism'; requiresAdmin = $true })
        $r.Scan.Bytes | Should -Be 1GB
        Should -Invoke Repair-WindowsImage -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -Times 1 -Exactly -ParameterFilter { $StartComponentCleanup -and -not $ResetBase }
        $null = Invoke-TestClean (New-TestRule @{ id = 'clean.test.resetbase'; method = 'dism'; requiresAdmin = $true; resetBase = $true; level = 'Expert' })
        Should -Invoke Repair-WindowsImage -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -Times 1 -Exactly -ParameterFilter { $ResetBase }
    }
    It 'parses the DISM component store report' {
        $text = "Component Store (WinSxS) information:`r`n`r`nWindows Explorer Reported Size of Component Store : 7.12 GB`r`n`r`nBackups and Disabled Features : 1.50 GB`r`n`r`nNumber of Reclaimable Packages : 4`r`nComponent Store Cleanup Recommended : Yes"
        $r = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ T = $text } { param($T) ConvertFrom-IgwtComponentStoreReport -Text $T }
        $r.Bytes | Should -Be ([long](1.5 * 1GB))
        $r.Packages | Should -Be 4
        $r.Recommended | Should -BeTrue
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { ConvertFrom-IgwtSizeText '512.00 MB' } | Should -Be 512MB
    }
    It 'never runs dism.exe or pnputil.exe unmocked in TestMode' {
        { InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Get-IgwtComponentStoreAnalysis } } | Should -Throw '*TestMode*'
        { InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Invoke-IgwtPnpUtilDelete -Inf 'oem12.inf' } } | Should -Throw '*TestMode*'
        { InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Invoke-IgwtPnpUtilDelete -Inf 'oem12.inf /force' } } | Should -Throw '*Refusing*'
    }
    It 'offers only older, unused third-party driver packages' {
        $ds = New-TestFolder
        foreach ($d in 'a1', 'a2', 'b1', 'b2', 'c1') { $null = New-Fixture (Join-Path $ds "$d\pkg.cat") 100 }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-WindowsDriver {
            @(
```

```ps1
BeforeAll {
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'TestHelpers.ps1')
    Initialize-IgwtTestEnvironment
    $script:Ctx = New-IgwtTestContext

    function Get-TestValue([string]$Path, [string]$Name) {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ P = $Path; N = $Name } { param($P, $N) Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $P -Name $N }
    }
    function Write-TestValue([string]$Path, [string]$Name, [string]$Kind, $Value) {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ P = $Path; N = $Name; K = $Kind; V = $Value } { param($P, $N, $K, $V) Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $P -Name $N -Kind $K -Value $V }
    }
    function Clear-TestValue([string]$Path, [string]$Name) {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ P = $Path; N = $Name } { param($P, $N) Remove-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $P -Name $N }
    }
    function Initialize-TestSeed {
        # Machine state similar to the target PC: mouse values written as DWORD by an old tool,
        # DirectX string with only the VRR item, Game Mode value absent, AutoRun values absent.
        Write-TestValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseSpeed' -Kind 'DWord' -Value 0
        Write-TestValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseThreshold1' -Kind 'DWord' -Value 0
        Write-TestValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseThreshold2' -Kind 'DWord' -Value 0
        Write-TestValue -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences' -Name 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings' -Kind 'String' -Value 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;'
        Clear-TestValue -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\GameBar' -Name 'AutoGameModeEnabled'
        Write-TestValue -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\GameBar' -Name 'AutoGameModeEnabled' -Kind 'DWord' -Value 0
        Clear-TestValue -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' -Name 'NoDriveTypeAutoRun'
        Clear-TestValue -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' -Name 'NoAutorun'
    }
    $script:Ids = @('gfx.game-mode', 'gfx.windowed-optimizations', 'input.pointer-precision-off', 'sec.autorun-off')

Describe 'Apply and revert real catalog tweaks (TestRegistry)' {
    BeforeAll { Initialize-TestSeed }

    It 'starts Off for the seeded state' {
        $states = Get-IgwtAllTweakStates -Id $script:Ids -Context $script:Ctx
        foreach ($s in $states) { $s.State | Should -Not -Be 'On' -Because $s.Id }
    }

    It 'dry run changes nothing' {
        $plan = Get-IgwtPlan -Id $script:Ids -Context $script:Ctx
        @($plan | Where-Object Plan -EQ 'Change').Count | Should -Be 4
        (Get-TestValue 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' 'MouseSpeed').Kind | Should -Be 'DWord'
        (Get-TestValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' 'NoAutorun').Exists | Should -BeFalse
    }

    It 'applies, verifies and writes a snapshot' {
        $r = Invoke-IgwtApply -Id $script:Ids -Context $script:Ctx
        @($r.Results | Where-Object Result -EQ 'Applied').Count | Should -Be 4
        @($r.Results | Where-Object { $_.Result -eq 'Applied' -and -not $_.Verified }).Count | Should -Be 0
        $r.Snapshot | Should -Exist
        $doc = Get-Content $r.Snapshot -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        $doc.schema | Should -Be 2
        $doc.catalogSchema | Should -Be 2
        @($doc.entries).Count | Should -Be 4
        foreach ($e in $doc.entries) { $e.result | Should -Be 'Applied'; $e.actions[0].fingerprint | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty; $e.level | Should -Be 'Standard' -Because $e.tweakId }
        foreach ($s in (Get-IgwtAllTweakStates -Id $script:Ids -Context $script:Ctx)) { $s.State | Should -Be 'On' -Because $s.Id }
        (Get-TestValue 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' 'MouseSpeed').Kind | Should -Be 'String'
        (Get-TestValue 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences' 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings').Value | Should -Be 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1;'
    }

    It 'is idempotent (second apply changes nothing and writes no snapshot)' {
        $r = Invoke-IgwtApply -Id $script:Ids -Context $script:Ctx
        @($r.Results | Where-Object Result -EQ 'Unchanged').Count | Should -Be 4
        $r.Snapshot | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }

    It 'reverts by id to the exact previous values (types and absent values)' {
        $r = Invoke-IgwtRevert -Id $script:Ids -Context $script:Ctx
        @($r.Results | Where-Object Result -EQ 'Reverted').Count | Should -Be 4
        $m = Get-TestValue 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' 'MouseSpeed'
        $m.Kind | Should -Be 'DWord'; $m.Value | Should -Be 0
        (Get-TestValue 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences' 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings').Value | Should -Be 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;'
        (Get-TestValue 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\GameBar' 'AutoGameModeEnabled').Value | Should -Be 0
        (Get-TestValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' 'NoAutorun').Exists | Should -BeFalse
    }

    It 'does not revert twice' {
        $r = Invoke-IgwtRevert -Id $script:Ids -Context $script:Ctx
        @($r.Results).Count | Should -Be 0
    }

    It 'reverts everything from the last apply with -Last' {
        $null = Invoke-IgwtApply -Id 'sec.autorun-off' -Context $script:Ctx
        (Get-TestValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' 'NoAutorun').Value | Should -Be 1
        $r = Invoke-IgwtRevert -Last -Context $script:Ctx
        @($r.Results | Where-Object Result -EQ 'Reverted').Id | Should -Be 'sec.autorun-off'
        (Get-TestValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' 'NoAutorun').Exists | Should -BeFalse
    }

    It 'resets to documented Windows defaults' {
        $null = Invoke-IgwtApply -Id 'input.pointer-precision-off' -Context $script:Ctx
        $r = Invoke-IgwtApply -Id 'input.pointer-precision-off' -Mode default -Operation ResetDefault -Context $script:Ctx
        @($r.Results | Where-Object Result -EQ 'Applied').Count | Should -Be 1
        (Get-TestValue 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' 'MouseSpeed').Value | Should -Be '1'
        (Get-TestValue 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' 'MouseThreshold1').Value | Should -Be '6'
        (Get-TestValue 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' 'MouseThreshold2').Value | Should -Be '10'
    }
}
```

`tests/Handlers.Tests.ps1`:

```ps1
# Round-trip tests for the 2.0 action handlers: detect -> snapshot (serialized like a snapshot
# file) -> apply -> detect -> restore -> detect. Registry-backed handlers run in TestRegistry;
# cmdlet-backed handlers use stateful mocks. Nothing touches the real system.

BeforeAll {
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'TestHelpers.ps1')
    Initialize-IgwtTestEnvironment

    function Invoke-RoundTrip {
        [CmdletBinding()]
        param($Action, $Context)
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ A = $Action; C = $Context } {
            param($A, $C)
            if (-not $C) { $C = New-IgwtContext -Override @{ IsAdmin = $true; Build = 26300 } }
            $roll = { param($items) Get-IgwtStateRollup -States @($items | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.State }) }
            $before = @(Get-IgwtActionState -Action $A -Context $C)
            $snap = Get-IgwtActionSnapshot -Action $A -Context $C
            $json = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $snap -Depth 20 | ConvertFrom-Json
            $null = Invoke-IgwtActionApply -Action $A -Context $C -Mode on
            $after = @(Get-IgwtActionState -Action $A -Context $C)
            Restore-IgwtActionSnapshot -Action $A -Snapshot $json -Context $C
            $restored = @(Get-IgwtActionState -Action $A -Context $C)
            [pscustomobject]@{ Before = (& $roll $before); After = (& $roll $after); Restored = (& $roll $restored); Items = $after; Snapshot = $json }
        }
    }
    function Get-Reg([string]$Path, [string]$Name) { InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ P = $Path; N = $Name } { param($P, $N) Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $P -Name $N } }
    function Write-Reg([string]$Path, [string]$Name, [string]$Kind, $Value) { InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ P = $Path; N = $Name; K = $Kind; V = $Value } { param($P, $N, $K, $V) Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $P -Name $N -Kind $K -Value $V } }
    function ConvertTo-Act([hashtable]$H) { [pscustomobject]$H }
}

Describe 'storageSense and wufbPolicy (registry composites)' {
    It 'round-trips a Storage Sense policy and removes what did not exist' {
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action (ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'storageSense'; setting = 'cadence'; value = 7 })
        $r.Before | Should -Be 'Off'; $r.After | Should -Be 'On'; $r.Restored | Should -Be 'Off'
        (Get-Reg 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\StorageSense' 'ConfigStorageSenseGlobalCadence').Exists | Should -BeFalse
    }
    It 'round-trips a feature update deferral (two policy values)' {
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action (ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'wufbPolicy'; setting = 'featureDeferralDays'; value = 90 })
        $r.After | Should -Be 'On'
        @($r.Items).Count | Should -Be 2
        $r.Restored | Should -Be 'Off'
        (Get-Reg 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' 'DeferFeatureUpdatesPeriodInDays').Exists | Should -BeFalse
    }
    It 'restores an existing quality deferral exactly' {
        Write-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name 'DeferQualityUpdates' -Kind 'DWord' -Value 1
        Write-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name 'DeferQualityUpdatesPeriodInDays' -Kind 'DWord' -Value 5
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action (ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'wufbPolicy'; setting = 'qualityDeferralDays'; value = 10 })
        $r.After | Should -Be 'On'
        (Get-Reg 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' 'DeferQualityUpdatesPeriodInDays').Value | Should -Be 5
    }
    It 'pins a target release with string values' {
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action (ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'wufbPolicy'; setting = 'targetRelease'; value = [pscustomobject]@{ product = 'Windows 11'; version = '25H2' } })
        $r.After | Should -Be 'On'
        @($r.Items | Where-Object { $_.Target -like '*TargetReleaseVersionInfo' }).Desired | Should -Match '25H2'
        $r.Restored | Should -Be 'Off'
    }
}

Describe 'deviceInterrupt' {
    BeforeAll {
        $script:GpuA = 'PCI\VEN_10DE&DEV_2216&SUBSYS_404B1458&REV_A1\4&8BD6E8D&0&0008'
        $script:GpuB = 'PCI\VEN_8086&DEV_A780&SUBSYS_00001458&REV_04\3&11583659&0&10'
        $script:BaseA = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\$($script:GpuA)\Device Parameters\Interrupt Management"
        $script:BaseB = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\$($script:GpuB)\Device Parameters\Interrupt Management"
    }
    BeforeEach {
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-PnpDevice { @([pscustomobject]@{ InstanceId = $script:GpuA; FriendlyName = 'NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080'; Status = 'OK' }, [pscustomobject]@{ InstanceId = $script:GpuB; FriendlyName = 'Intel UHD Graphics 770'; Status = 'OK' }) }
        Write-Reg -Path "$($script:BaseA)\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties" -Name 'MSISupported' -Kind 'DWord' -Value 0
        Write-Reg -Path "$($script:BaseB)" -Name 'Placeholder' -Kind 'DWord' -Value 1
    }
    It 'sets MSI mode only where the driver declares MSI support and restores exactly' {
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action (ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'deviceInterrupt'; deviceClass = 'Display'; msiSupported = 1; devicePolicy = 5 })
        @($r.Items | Where-Object { $_.State -eq 'NotApplicable' }).Note | Should -Match 'does not declare MSI support'
        $r.After | Should -Be 'On'
        (Get-Reg "$($script:BaseA)\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties" 'MSISupported').Value | Should -Be 0
        (Get-Reg "$($script:BaseA)\Affinity Policy" 'DevicePolicy').Exists | Should -BeFalse
        (Get-Reg "$($script:BaseB)\Affinity Policy" 'DevicePolicy').Exists | Should -BeFalse
        $r.Restored | Should -Be 'Off'
    }
    It 'has no Windows default to reset to' {
        { InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Invoke-IgwtActionApply -Action ([pscustomobject]@{ type = 'deviceInterrupt'; deviceClass = 'Display'; msiSupported = 1 }) -Context (New-IgwtContext -Override @{}) -Mode default } } | Should -Throw '*no documented Windows default*'
    }
    It 'refuses device classes other than Display, Net and USB' {
        { InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Get-IgwtCompositeParts -Action ([pscustomobject]@{ type = 'deviceInterrupt'; deviceClass = 'SCSIAdapter'; msiSupported = 1 }) } } | Should -Throw '*not allowed*'
    }
    It 'never touches USB host controllers when Windows runs from a USB disk' {
        $ctx = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { New-IgwtContext -Override @{ HardwareProfile = [pscustomobject]@{ Facts = [pscustomobject]@{ systemDisk = [pscustomobject]@{ bus = 'USB' } } } } }
        $items = @(InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ C = $ctx } { param($C) Get-IgwtActionState -Action ([pscustomobject]@{ type = 'deviceInterrupt'; deviceClass = 'USB'; msiSupported = 1 }) -Context $C })
        $items[0].State | Should -Be 'NotApplicable'
        $items[0].Note | Should -Match 'USB disk'
    }
}

Describe 'serviceSet' {
    BeforeEach {
        foreach ($n in 'IgwtTestSvcA', 'IgwtTestSvcB') { Write-Reg -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\$n" -Name 'Start' -Kind 'DWord' -Value 3 }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-Service { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $Name[0]; Status = 'Stopped' } }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Set-Service {
            $v = switch ([string]$StartupType) { 'Automatic' { 2 } 'Manual' { 3 } 'Disabled' { 4 } }
            Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath "TestRegistry:\HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\$Name" -Name Start -Value $v
        }
    }
    It 'round-trips several services as one action' {
        $a = ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'serviceSet'; services = @([pscustomobject]@{ name = 'IgwtTestSvcA'; startupType = 'Disabled'; default = 'Manual' }, [pscustomobject]@{ name = 'IgwtTestSvcB'; startupType = 'Disabled'; default = 'Manual' }) }
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action $a
        $r.Before | Should -Be 'Off'; $r.After | Should -Be 'On'; $r.Restored | Should -Be 'Off'
        (Get-Reg 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\IgwtTestSvcB' 'Start').Value | Should -Be 3
    }
    It 'refuses protected services inside a set' {
        Write-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\WinDefend' -Name 'Start' -Kind 'DWord' -Value 2
        $a = ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'serviceSet'; services = @([pscustomobject]@{ name = 'WinDefend'; startupType = 'Disabled'; default = 'Automatic' }) }
        { InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ A = $a } { param($A) Invoke-IgwtActionApply -Action $A -Context (New-IgwtContext -Override @{}) } } | Should -Throw '*protected*'
    }
}

Describe 'powercfgAttribute and powercfgSettingAcDc' {
    BeforeAll {
        $script:Sub = '54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00'
        $script:Set = '0cc5b647-c1df-4637-891a-dec35c318583'
        $script:Scheme = '381b4222-f694-41f0-9685-ff5bb260df2e'
    }
    It 'shows a hidden power setting and restores the exact Attributes value' {
        Write-Reg -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\PowerSettings\$($script:Sub)\$($script:Set)" -Name 'Attributes' -Kind 'DWord' -Value 1
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg {
            if ($Arguments[0] -eq '-attributes') {
                $v = $(if ($Arguments[3] -eq '-ATTRIB_HIDE') { 2 } else { 1 })
                Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath "TestRegistry:\HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\PowerSettings\$($Arguments[1])\$($Arguments[2])" -Name Attributes -Value $v
            }
            [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = '' }
        }
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action (ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'powercfgAttribute'; label = 'Core parking min cores'; subgroup = $script:Sub; setting = $script:Set; visible = $true; default = 'hidden' })
        $r.Before | Should -Be 'Off'; $r.After | Should -Be 'On'; $r.Restored | Should -Be 'Off'
        (Get-Reg "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\PowerSettings\$($script:Sub)\$($script:Set)" 'Attributes').Value | Should -Be 1
        Should -Invoke Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -ParameterFilter { $Arguments[0] -eq '-attributes' -and $Arguments[3] -eq '-ATTRIB_HIDE' } -Times 1 -Exactly
    }
    It 'reports a power setting that does not exist as not applicable' {
        $items = @(InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ S = $script:Sub } { param($S) Get-IgwtActionState -Action ([pscustomobject]@{ type = 'powercfgAttribute'; label = 'x'; subgroup = $S; setting = '11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555'; visible = $true }) -Context $null })
        $items[0].State | Should -Be 'NotApplicable'
    }
    It 'round-trips separate AC and DC values' {
        $script:Pc = @{ AC = 0; DC = 2 }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg {
            switch ($Arguments[0]) {
                '/getactivescheme' { [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = "Power Scheme GUID: $($script:Scheme)  (Balanced)" } }
                '/list' { [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = "Power Scheme GUID: $($script:Scheme)  (Balanced) *" } }
                '/query' { [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = ("Current AC Power Setting Index: 0x{0:x8}`r`nCurrent DC Power Setting Index: 0x{1:x8}" -f $script:Pc.AC, $script:Pc.DC) } }
                '/setacvalueindex' { $script:Pc.AC = [int]$Arguments[4]; [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = '' } }
                '/setdcvalueindex' { $script:Pc.DC = [int]$Arguments[4]; [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = '' } }
                default { [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = '' } }
            }
        }
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action (ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'powercfgSettingAcDc'; label = 'EPP'; subgroup = $script:Sub; setting = '36687f9e-e3a5-4dbf-b1dc-15eb381c6863'; ac = 0; dc = 50; defaultAc = 50; defaultDc = 50 })
        $r.After | Should -Be 'On'
        $r.Restored | Should -Be 'Off'
        $script:Pc.AC | Should -Be 0
        $script:Pc.DC | Should -Be 2
    }
}

Describe 'firewallRule' {
    BeforeEach {
        $script:Fw = @{}
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-NetFirewallRule {
            if ($Name) { if ($script:Fw.ContainsKey($Name[0])) { $script:Fw[$Name[0]] } }
            else { @($script:Fw.Values | Where-Object { $_.DisplayGroup -eq $DisplayGroup[0] }) }
        }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner New-NetFirewallRule { $script:Fw[$Name] = [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $Name; DisplayGroup = 'iG Windows Tuner'; Enabled = 'True'; Action = [string]$Action; Direction = [string]$Direction } }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Remove-NetFirewallRule { $null = $script:Fw.Remove($Name[0]) }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Set-NetFirewallRule { $script:Fw[$Name[0]].Enabled = [string]$Enabled }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Disable-NetFirewallRule { foreach ($n in $Name) { $script:Fw[$n].Enabled = 'False' } }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Enable-NetFirewallRule { foreach ($n in $Name) { $script:Fw[$n].Enabled = 'True' } }
    }
    It 'creates an iG Windows Tuner block rule and removes it on revert' {
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action (ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'firewallRule'; rule = 'iGWindowsTuner-Block-LLMNR-In'; displayName = 'iG Windows Tuner: block LLMNR inbound'; direction = 'Inbound'; action = 'Block'; protocol = 'UDP'; localPort = '5355' })
        $r.Before | Should -Be 'Off'; $r.After | Should -Be 'On'; $r.Restored | Should -Be 'Off'
        $script:Fw.ContainsKey('iGWindowsTuner-Block-LLMNR-In') | Should -BeFalse
        Should -Invoke New-NetFirewallRule -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -Times 1 -Exactly -ParameterFilter { $Group -eq 'iG Windows Tuner' -and $LocalPort[0] -eq '5355' }
    }
    It 'disables a rule group and restores each rule''s exact state' {
        foreach ($x in @(@('RA-1', 'True'), @('RA-2', 'True'), @('RA-3', 'False'))) { $script:Fw[$x[0]] = [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $x[0]; DisplayGroup = 'Remote Assistance'; Enabled = $x[1]; Direction = 'Inbound'; Action = 'Allow' } }
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action (ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'firewallRule'; displayGroup = 'Remote Assistance'; on = 'Disabled'; default = 'Enabled' })
        $r.After | Should -Be 'On'
        $script:Fw['RA-1'].Enabled | Should -Be 'True'
        $script:Fw['RA-3'].Enabled | Should -Be 'False'
    }
    It 'refuses rules it does not own and allow rules' {
        { InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Invoke-IgwtActionApply -Action ([pscustomobject]@{ type = 'firewallRule'; rule = 'CoreNet-DHCP-In'; displayName = 'x'; direction = 'Inbound'; action = 'Block' }) -Context $null } } | Should -Throw "*own firewall rules*"
        { InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Invoke-IgwtActionApply -Action ([pscustomobject]@{ type = 'firewallRule'; rule = 'iGWindowsTuner-Open'; displayName = 'x'; direction = 'Inbound'; action = 'Allow' }) -Context $null } } | Should -Throw '*only creates Block rules*'
    }
}

Describe 'appx, winget and capability' {
    BeforeEach {
        $script:AppInstalled = $true
        $script:AppDir = Join-Path $TestDrive 'WindowsApps\Microsoft.BingWeather_4.53'
        $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $script:AppDir -Force
        Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:AppDir 'AppxManifest.xml') -Value '<Package/>'
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-AppxPackage { if ($script:AppInstalled) { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $Name; PackageFullName = 'Microsoft.BingWeather_4.53_x64__8wekyb3d8bbwe'; InstallLocation = $script:AppDir } } }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Remove-AppxPackage { $script:AppInstalled = $false }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Add-AppxPackage { $script:AppInstalled = $true }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-AppxProvisionedPackage { @([pscustomobject]@{ DisplayName = 'Microsoft.BingWeather'; PackageName = 'Microsoft.BingWeather_4.53_neutral_~_8wekyb3d8bbwe' }) }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Remove-AppxProvisionedPackage { }
        $script:Winget = @{}
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Invoke-IgwtWinget {
            switch ($Arguments[0]) {
                'list' { [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = $(if ($script:Winget[$Arguments[2]]) { 0 } else { -1978335212 }); Output = '' } }
                'install' { $script:Winget[$Arguments[2]] = $true; [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = '' } }
                'uninstall' { $script:Winget[$Arguments[2]] = $false; [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = '' } }
            }
        }
    }
    It 'removes an inbox app and re-registers it on revert' {
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action (ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'appx'; package = 'Microsoft.BingWeather'; on = 'Removed'; default = 'Installed'; provisioned = $true })
        $r.Before | Should -Be 'Off'; $r.After | Should -Be 'On'; $r.Restored | Should -Be 'Off'
        Should -Invoke Remove-AppxProvisionedPackage -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -Times 1 -Exactly
        Should -Invoke Add-AppxPackage -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -Times 1 -Exactly -ParameterFilter { $Register -and $Path -like '*AppxManifest.xml' }
    }
    It 'reinstalls from the Store when the app files are gone' {
        $a = ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'appx'; package = 'Microsoft.BingWeather'; on = 'Removed'; default = 'Installed'; storeId = '9WZDNCRFJ3Q2' }
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ A = $a } { param($A) Restore-IgwtActionSnapshot -Action $A -Snapshot ([pscustomobject]@{ installed = $true; installLocation = 'C:\Gone' }) -Context $null } -ErrorAction Stop 2>$null
        Should -Invoke Invoke-IgwtWinget -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -Times 0 -Exactly
        $script:AppInstalled = $false
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ A = $a } { param($A) Restore-IgwtActionSnapshot -Action $A -Snapshot ([pscustomobject]@{ installed = $true; installLocation = 'C:\Gone' }) -Context $null }
        Should -Invoke Invoke-IgwtWinget -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -Times 1 -Exactly -ParameterFilter { $Arguments[0] -eq 'install' -and ($Arguments -join ' ') -match '--source msstore' }
    }
    It 'never removes protected apps' {
        { InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Invoke-IgwtActionApply -Action ([pscustomobject]@{ type = 'appx'; package = 'Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller'; on = 'Removed'; default = 'Installed' }) -Context $null } } | Should -Throw '*protected*'
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Test-IgwtAppxProtected -Package 'Microsoft.VCLibs.140.00' } | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'round-trips a winget install' {
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action (ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'winget'; id = 'Microsoft.PowerToys'; on = 'Installed'; default = 'NotInstalled' })
        $r.Before | Should -Be 'Off'; $r.After | Should -Be 'On'; $r.Restored | Should -Be 'Off'
        Should -Invoke Invoke-IgwtWinget -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -ParameterFilter { $Arguments[0] -eq 'uninstall' } -Times 1 -Exactly
    }
    It 'round-trips removing a Windows capability' {
        $script:Cap = 'Installed'
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-WindowsCapability { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.WordPad~~~~0.0.1.0'; State = $script:Cap } }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Remove-WindowsCapability { $script:Cap = 'NotPresent' }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Add-WindowsCapability { $script:Cap = 'Installed' }
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action (ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'capability'; name = 'Microsoft.Windows.WordPad~~~~0.0.1.0'; on = 'NotPresent'; default = 'Installed' })
        $r.Before | Should -Be 'Off'; $r.After | Should -Be 'On'; $r.Restored | Should -Be 'Off'
    }
}

Describe 'processMitigation and exploitSystem' {
    BeforeEach {
        $script:Mit = @{}
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-ProcessMitigation {
            $key = $(if ($System) { 'system' } else { $Name })
            $get = { param($m) if ($script:Mit.ContainsKey("$key|$m")) { $script:Mit["$key|$m"] } else { 'NOTSET' } }
            [pscustomobject]@{ DEP = [pscustomobject]@{ Enable = (& $get 'DEP') }; SEHOP = [pscustomobject]@{ Enable = (& $get 'SEHOP') }
                ASLR = [pscustomobject]@{ BottomUp = (& $get 'BottomUp'); HighEntropy = (& $get 'HighEntropy'); ForceRelocateImages = (& $get 'ForceRelocateImages') }
                CFG = [pscustomobject]@{ Enable = (& $get 'CFG') } }
        }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Set-ProcessMitigation {
            $key = $(if ($System) { 'system' } else { $Name })
            foreach ($m in @($Enable)) { if ($m) { $script:Mit["$key|$m"] = 'ON' } }
            foreach ($m in @($Disable)) { if ($m) { if ($Remove) { $null = $script:Mit.Remove("$key|$m") } else { $script:Mit["$key|$m"] = 'OFF' } } }
        }
    }
    It 'round-trips a per-program mitigation from NOTSET (restored with -Remove)' {
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action (ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'processMitigation'; process = 'dota2.exe'; mitigation = 'BottomUp'; on = 'ON' })
        $r.Before | Should -Be 'Off'; $r.After | Should -Be 'On'; $r.Restored | Should -Be 'Off'
        $script:Mit.ContainsKey('dota2.exe|BottomUp') | Should -BeFalse
        Should -Invoke Set-ProcessMitigation -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -ParameterFilter { $Remove -and $Disable -contains 'BottomUp' } -Times 1 -Exactly
    }
    It 'restores an explicit OFF exactly' {
        $script:Mit['system|SEHOP'] = 'OFF'
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action (ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'exploitSystem'; mitigation = 'SEHOP'; on = 'ON' })
        $r.After | Should -Be 'On'
        $script:Mit['system|SEHOP'] | Should -Be 'OFF'
    }
    It 'never turns system-wide exploit protection off' {
        { InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Invoke-IgwtActionApply -Action ([pscustomobject]@{ type = 'exploitSystem'; mitigation = 'DEP'; on = 'OFF' }) -Context $null } } | Should -Throw '*never turns system-wide*'
    }
    It 'treats "use default" as on for repair-only items and writes nothing' {
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action (ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'exploitSystem'; mitigation = 'CFG'; on = 'ON'; equivalentOn = @('NOTSET') })
        $r.Before | Should -Be 'On'; $r.After | Should -Be 'On'
        Should -Invoke Set-ProcessMitigation -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -Times 0 -Exactly
    }
    It 'repairs an explicit OFF for repair-only items and restores it exactly' {
        $script:Mit['system|DEP'] = 'OFF'
        $r = Invoke-RoundTrip -Action (ConvertTo-Act @{ type = 'exploitSystem'; mitigation = 'DEP'; on = 'ON'; equivalentOn = @('NOTSET') })
        $r.Before | Should -Be 'Off'; $r.After | Should -Be 'On'
        $script:Mit['system|DEP'] | Should -Be 'OFF'
    }
}

Describe 'cleanerRule and the DefaultApp check' {

        $script:CleanStatus = 'Ready'
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Invoke-IgwtCleanerScan { [pscustomobject]@{ Rules = @([pscustomobject]@{ RuleId = 'clean.user.temp'; Name = 'User temporary files'; Status = $script:CleanStatus; Bytes = $(if ($script:CleanStatus -eq 'Ready') { 2048 } else { 0 }); Count = 3; Reason = '' }) } }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Invoke-IgwtCleanerClean { $script:CleanStatus = 'Empty'; [pscustomobject]@{ Rules = @([pscustomobject]@{ RuleId = 'clean.user.temp'; Status = 'Cleaned'; Reason = '' }) } }

        $items[0].State | Should -Be 'Off'
        $items[0].Current | Should -Be 'FirefoxURL-308046B0AF4A39CB'
        $items[0].Note | Should -Match 'Settings'
    }

Describe '2.0 action validation' {
    It 'reports invalid 2.0 actions' {
        $base = (Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:IgwtProjectRoot 'data\tweaks\input.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).tweaks[0]
        $make = {
            param([string]$Id, $Action, [string]$Level = 'Standard', [string]$Reversible = 'full', [string]$Requires = 'none')
            $raw = $base | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 | ConvertFrom-Json
            $raw.id = $Id; $raw.level = $Level; $raw.reversible = $Reversible; $raw.requires = $Requires; $raw.sideEffects = 'test side effects'
            $raw.actions = @([pscustomobject]$Action)
            InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ R = $raw } { param($R) ConvertTo-IgwtNormalizedTweak -Tweak $R -SourceFile 'input.json' }
        }
        $bad = @(
            (& $make 'input.v2-cadence' @{ type = 'storageSense'; setting = 'cadence'; value = 5 })
            (& $make 'input.v2-quality' @{ type = 'wufbPolicy'; setting = 'qualityDeferralDays'; value = 45 })
            (& $make 'input.v2-irq' @{ type = 'deviceInterrupt'; deviceClass = 'Display'; msiSupported = 1 })
            (& $make 'input.v2-svc' @{ type = 'serviceSet'; services = @([pscustomobject]@{ name = 'WinDefend'; startupType = 'Disabled'; default = 'Automatic' }) })
            (& $make 'input.v2-task' @{ type = 'scheduledTask'; path = '\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\'; name = 'Scheduled Start'; on = 'Disabled'; default = 'Enabled' })
            (& $make 'input.v2-fw' @{ type = 'firewallRule'; rule = 'iGWindowsTuner-Open'; displayName = 'x'; direction = 'Inbound'; action = 'Allow' })
            (& $make 'input.v2-fwgroup' @{ type = 'firewallRule'; displayGroup = 'Remote Desktop'; on = 'Enabled'; default = 'Enabled' })
            (& $make 'input.v2-appx' @{ type = 'appx'; package = 'Microsoft.WindowsStore'; on = 'Removed'; default = 'Installed' })
            (& $make 'input.v2-winget' @{ type = 'winget'; id = 'bad id;rm'; on = 'Installed'; default = 'NotInstalled' })
            (& $make 'input.v2-mit' @{ type = 'processMitigation'; process = 'game.exe'; mitigation = 'CFG'; on = 'OFF' })
            (& $make 'input.v2-sys' @{ type = 'exploitSystem'; mitigation = 'DEP'; on = 'OFF' })
            (& $make 'input.v2-syseq' @{ type = 'exploitSystem'; mitigation = 'DEP'; on = 'ON'; equivalentOn = @('OFF') })
            (& $make 'input.v2-clean' @{ type = 'cleanerRule'; rule = 'clean.user.temp' })
            (& $make 'input.v2-check' @{ type = 'check'; checker = 'DefaultApp'; extension = '.pdf' })
        )
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-IgwtCatalog { $bad }
        $errors = (@(Test-IgwtCatalog) -join "`n")
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.v2-cadence action\[0\]: cadence must be one of 0, 1, 7, 30'
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.v2-quality action\[0\]: quality update deferral must be 0-30 days'
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.v2-irq action\[0\]: interrupt changes need requires ''reboot'''
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.v2-irq action\[0\]: device interrupt items must be level Expert or Lab'
        $errors | Should -Match "input.v2-svc action\[0\]: service 'WinDefend' is protected"
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.v2-task action\[0\]: tasks under .* are protected'
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.v2-fw action\[0\]: iG Windows Tuner only creates Block rules'
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.v2-fwgroup action\[0\]: rule groups may only be disabled'
        $errors | Should -Match "input.v2-appx action\[0\]: app 'Microsoft.WindowsStore' is protected"
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.v2-appx action\[0\]: app removal is not fully reversible'
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.v2-winget action\[0\]: winget needs a package id'
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.v2-mit action\[0\]: turning a mitigation off needs level Expert or Lab'
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.v2-sys action\[0\]: system-wide exploit protection may only be turned ON'
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.v2-syseq action\[0\]: equivalentOn may only contain NOTSET'
        $errors | Should -Match "input.v2-clean action\[0\]: items that run a cleaner rule must be reversible 'none'"
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.v2-check action\[0\]: DefaultApp needs extension or protocol, and progId'
    }
    It 'gives every 2.0 action an identifying fingerprint without changing 1.0 fingerprints' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner {
            Get-IgwtActionFingerprint ([pscustomobject]@{ type = 'serviceSet'; services = @([pscustomobject]@{ name = 'A' }, [pscustomobject]@{ name = 'B' }) }) | Should -Be 'serviceSet|services=A,B'
            Get-IgwtActionFingerprint ([pscustomobject]@{ type = 'processMitigation'; process = 'x.exe'; mitigation = 'CFG'; on = 'ON' }) | Should -Be 'processMitigation|process=x.exe|mitigation=CFG'
            Get-IgwtActionFingerprint ([pscustomobject]@{ type = 'registry'; path = 'HKCU:\A'; name = 'B'; on = 1 }) | Should -Be 'registry|path=HKCU:\A|name=B'
        }
    }
}
```

```ps1
# Hardware profile engine tests. Facts come from tests\fixtures\hardware (this PC is the primary
# fixture, captured read-only with -Hardware -Json); no detection runs against the real machine.

BeforeAll {
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'TestHelpers.ps1')
    Initialize-IgwtTestEnvironment
    $script:FixtureDir = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'fixtures\hardware'
    function Get-Fixture([string]$Name) { Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:FixtureDir "$Name.json") -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json }
    function Get-FixtureTags([string]$Name) { @((Get-IgwtHardwareProfile -Facts (Get-Fixture $Name)).Tags) }
    function Get-TestPreset([string[]]$Include, [string[]]$Exclude = @(), [string]$Ceiling = 'Advanced') {
        [pscustomobject]@{ id = 'test'; name = 'Test'; include = $Include; exclude = $Exclude; levelCeiling = $Ceiling; antiCheatPolicy = 'safeOnly'; gaming = $true; tweaks = $Include }
    }
}

Describe 'Hardware fixtures' {
    It 'provides the six fixtures from the spec' {
        $names = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $script:FixtureDir -Filter *.json | ForEach-Object { $_.BaseName } | Sort-Object)
        $names | Should -Be @('amd-laptop', 'amd-x3d-dualccd-desktop', 'intel-arc-desktop', 'intel-laptop', 'this-pc', 'vm')
    }
    It 'keeps fixtures free of serial numbers and other identifiers (<_>)' -ForEach @('amd-laptop', 'amd-x3d-dualccd-desktop', 'intel-arc-desktop', 'intel-laptop', 'this-pc', 'vm') {
        $f = Get-Fixture $_
        $f.schemaVersion | Should -Be 2
        @($f.PSObject.Properties.Name | Sort-Object) | Should -Be @('battery', 'cpu', 'gpus', 'memoryGB', 'modernStandby', 'name', 'nics', 'os', 'portableChassis', 'schemaVersion', 'system', 'systemDisk')
        foreach ($n in @($f.gpus) + @($f.nics)) { [string]$n.pnp | Should -Match '^(VEN_[0-9A-F]{4}&DEV_[0-9A-F]{4})?$' }
    }
}

Describe 'Hardware tag detection' {

    }

        $vm | Should -Not -Contain 'intel.hybrid'

        $vm | Should -Not -Contain 'formfactor.desktop'
    }
    It 'detects a Hyper-V guest by manufacturer and model, not by HypervisorPresent' {

        $f.system.model = 'VMware20,1'

    }
    It 'reads Modern Standby from powercfg /a' {

        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Test-IgwtModernStandby } | Should -BeFalse
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg { [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = "The following sleep states are available on this system:`r`n    Standby (S0 Low Power Idle) Network Connected`r`n    Hibernate`r`n`r`nThe following sleep states are not available on this system:`r`n    Standby (S3)`r`n" } }
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Test-IgwtModernStandby } | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'strips instance data from PCI ids' {

        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { ConvertTo-IgwtPciId 'VMBUS\{f8615163}' } | Should -Be ''
    }

Describe 'Hardware overlays: presets per fixture' {

Describe 'Hardware blocks in state detection and apply' {
    BeforeAll {
        $script:Tweak = New-IgwtTestTweak -Id 'test.hwblock' -Actions @(@{ type = 'registry'; path = 'HKCU:\Software\IgwtTest\HwBlock'; name = 'V'; valueType = 'DWord'; on = 1; default = '<absent>' })
        $fake = @([pscustomobject]@{ id = 'overlay.test-block'; name = 'Test block'; tags = @('vm'); hint = 'Test hint.'; add = @(); block = @('test.hwblock'); blockMatching = @(); guidance = @() })
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-IgwtHardwareOverlays { $fake }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-IgwtTweak { $script:Tweak } -ParameterFilter { @($Id) -contains 'test.hwblock' }
        $script:VmCtx = New-IgwtTestContext -Extra @{ HardwareTags = @('vm') }
        $script:PcCtx = New-IgwtTestContext -Extra @{ HardwareTags = @('formfactor.desktop') }
        function Get-Value { InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path 'HKCU:\Software\IgwtTest\HwBlock' -Name 'V' } }
    }

        (Get-IgwtTweakState -Tweak $script:Tweak -Context $script:PcCtx).State | Should -Be 'Off'
    }
    It 'refuses to apply a blocked item' {
        $r = Invoke-IgwtApply -Id 'test.hwblock' -Context $script:VmCtx
```
