```ps1
        (Get-Value).Exists | Should -BeFalse
    }
    It 'still shows an already-applied blocked item as On so it can be turned off' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path 'HKCU:\Software\IgwtTest\HwBlock' -Name 'V' -Kind DWord -Value 1 }
        $s = Get-IgwtTweakState -Tweak $script:Tweak -Context $script:VmCtx
        $s.State | Should -Be 'On'
        $s.Blocked | Should -BeTrue
        $s.Reason | Should -Match 'turning it off is recommended'
        $r = Invoke-IgwtApply -Id 'test.hwblock' -Mode default -Operation ResetDefault -Context $script:VmCtx
        $r.Results[0].Result | Should -Be 'Applied'
        (Get-Value).Exists | Should -BeFalse
    }
    It 'requires the hardware tags an item declares' {
        $t = New-IgwtTestTweak -Id 'test.needsnvidia' -Actions @(@{ type = 'registry'; path = 'HKCU:\Software\IgwtTest\Nv'; name = 'V'; valueType = 'DWord'; on = 1; default = '<absent>' })
        $t.hardware.tags = @('gpu.nvidia')
        (Get-IgwtTweakState -Tweak $t -Context $script:PcCtx).Reason | Should -Match 'Needs hardware tag\(s\) gpu.nvidia'
        $t.hardware.tags = @(); $t.hardware.excludeTags = @('formfactor.desktop')
        (Get-IgwtTweakState -Tweak $t -Context $script:PcCtx).State | Should -Be 'NotApplicable'
    }
}

Describe 'Hardware knowledge base validation' {
    It 'validates without errors' { @(Test-IgwtHardwareCatalog) | Should -BeNullOrEmpty }
    It 'gives every overlay https sources, a basis and at least one effect' {
        foreach ($o in @(Get-IgwtHardwareOverlays -Force)) {

        }
    }
    It 'reports broken overlays and detection rules' {

            [pscustomobject]@{ id = 'overlay.empty'; name = 'Empty'; tags = @('vm'); hint = 'Does nothing.'; description = 'An overlay without any effect, which the validator must reject.'; basis = 'igwt'; sources = @('https://learn.microsoft.com/') }
        )
        $badRules = @([pscustomobject]@{ tag = 'gpu.voodoo'; when = [pscustomobject]@{ moonPhase = 'full'; cpuName = '(' } })
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-IgwtHardwareOverlays { $badOverlays }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-IgwtDetectionRules { $badRules }
        $errors = (@(Test-IgwtHardwareCatalog) -join "`n")
        $errors | Should -Match "overlay 'bad id': id must look like 'overlay.name'"
        $errors | Should -Match "unknown tag 'gpu.voodoo'"
        $errors | Should -Match 'hint is 141 characters'
        $errors | Should -Match 'basis must be vendor, reviewer or igwt'
        $errors | Should -Match "source 'http://example.com' must be https"
        $errors | Should -Match "unknown item 'no.such-item'"
        $errors | Should -Match "'no.such-item' is both added and blocked"
        $errors | Should -Match "every blockMatching entry needs 'type'"
        $errors | Should -Match "unknown blockMatching field 'colour'"
        $errors | Should -Match "overlay 'overlay.empty': needs block, blockMatching, add or guidance"
        $errors | Should -Match "detection rule for 'gpu.voodoo': unknown tag"
        $errors | Should -Match "unknown condition 'moonPhase'"
        $errors | Should -Match "invalid regex in 'cpuName'"
        $errors | Should -Match "hardware tag 'vm': no detection rule"
    }
}
```

`tests/Health.Tests.ps1`:

```ps1
BeforeAll {
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'TestHelpers.ps1')
    Initialize-IgwtTestEnvironment
}

Describe 'Health parsers (pure functions)' {
    It 'parses the 4-byte microcode revision format (current builds)' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { ConvertFrom-IgwtMicrocodeRevision -Bytes ([byte[]](0x2F, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00)) | Should -Be 0x12F }
    }
    It 'parses the 8-byte microcode revision format (revision in the high DWORD)' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { ConvertFrom-IgwtMicrocodeRevision -Bytes ([byte[]](0, 0, 0, 0, 0x2B, 0x01, 0, 0)) | Should -Be 0x12B }
    }
    It 'falls back to the low DWORD when the high DWORD is zero' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { ConvertFrom-IgwtMicrocodeRevision -Bytes ([byte[]](0x2F, 0x01, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)) | Should -Be 0x12F }
    }
    It 'returns -1 for missing data' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { ConvertFrom-IgwtMicrocodeRevision -Bytes ([byte[]]@()) | Should -Be -1 }
    }

    It 'detects test signing and kernel debugging from SystemStartOptions' -ForEach @(
        @{ Opt = ' NOEXECUTE=OPTIN  FVEBOOT=2666496  NOVGA'; Test = $false; Debug = $false }
        @{ Opt = ' TESTSIGNING NOEXECUTE=OPTIN'; Test = $true; Debug = $false }
        @{ Opt = ' DEBUG DEBUGPORT=NET NOEXECUTE=OPTIN'; Test = $false; Debug = $true }
        @{ Opt = ' NODEBUG NOEXECUTE=OPTIN'; Test = $false; Debug = $false }
    ) {
        $o = $Opt
        $flags = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ O = $o } { param($O) Get-IgwtBootFlags -StartOptions $O }
        $flags.TestSigning | Should -Be $Test
        $flags.KernelDebug | Should -Be $Debug
    }

    It 'accepts 239 Hz on a 240 Hz display but flags 60 Hz' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner {
            Test-IgwtRefreshRateOk -Current 239 -Maximum 240 | Should -BeTrue
            Test-IgwtRefreshRateOk -Current 60 -Maximum 240 | Should -BeFalse
        }
    }

    It 'reads the BAR1 size from nvidia-smi output (Resizable BAR)' {
        $sample = "    FB Memory Usage`r`n        Total                             : 10240 MiB`r`n    BAR1 Memory Usage`r`n        Total                             : 16384 MiB`r`n        Used                              : 1 MiB"
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ S = $sample } { param($S) ConvertFrom-IgwtNvidiaBar1 -Text $S } | Should -Be 16384
    }

    It 'extracts Steam library paths from libraryfolders.vdf' {
        $vdf = '"libraryfolders" { "0" { "path" "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Steam" } "1" { "path" "D:\\SteamLibrary" } }'
        $paths = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ V = $vdf } { param($V) ConvertFrom-IgwtSteamLibraryVdf -Text $V }
        $paths | Should -Be @('C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam', 'D:\SteamLibrary')
    }
}

Describe 'Anti-cheat readiness roll-up' {
    BeforeAll {
        function Get-Req([bool]$Pass, [bool]$Unknown = $false) { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'r'; Pass = $Pass; Unknown = $Unknown; Detail = '' } }
        function Get-ReqSet([hashtable]$Override = @{}) {
            $o = [ordered]@{ tpm = (Get-Req $true); secureBoot = (Get-Req $true); secureBoot2023 = (Get-Req $true); vbs = (Get-Req $true); hvci = (Get-Req $true)
                iommu = (Get-Req $true); win11 = (Get-Req $true); win1125h2 = (Get-Req $true); noTestSign = (Get-Req $true) }
            foreach ($k in $Override.Keys) { $o[$k] = $Override[$k] }
            return [pscustomobject]$o
        }
    }

    It 'is Green when every requirement passes' {
        (Get-IgwtAntiCheatReadiness -Requirements (Get-ReqSet)).Overall | Should -Be 'Green'
    }

    It 'is Amber when only Vanguard On-Demand prerequisites are missing (HVCI off)' {
        $r = Get-IgwtAntiCheatReadiness -Requirements (Get-ReqSet @{ hvci = (Get-Req $false) })
        $r.Overall | Should -Be 'Amber'
        ($r.Matrix | Where-Object Id -EQ 'vanguardOnDemand').Status | Should -Be 'Fail'
        ($r.Matrix | Where-Object Id -EQ 'faceit').Status | Should -Be 'Pass'
    }

    It 'is Red when Secure Boot is off (FACEIT, Vanguard, CoD and BF6 fail)' {
        $r = Get-IgwtAntiCheatReadiness -Requirements (Get-ReqSet @{ secureBoot = (Get-Req $false) })
        $r.Overall | Should -Be 'Red'
        foreach ($id in 'faceit', 'vanguard', 'ricochet', 'javelin') { ($r.Matrix | Where-Object Id -EQ $id).Status | Should -Be 'Fail' }
        ($r.Matrix | Where-Object Id -EQ 'vac').Status | Should -Be 'Pass'
    }

    It 'is Red when test signing is active' {
        (Get-IgwtAntiCheatReadiness -Requirements (Get-ReqSet @{ noTestSign = (Get-Req $false) })).Overall | Should -Be 'Red'
    }

    It 'marks FACEIT as failing without IOMMU' {
        $r = Get-IgwtAntiCheatReadiness -Requirements (Get-ReqSet @{ iommu = (Get-Req $false) })
        ($r.Matrix | Where-Object Id -EQ 'faceit').Status | Should -Be 'Fail'
    }
}
```

```ps1
# Expert inspectors and the power plan editor (phase 6). powercfg, PnP, CIM and NetAdapter
# cmdlets are mocked; registry access stays in TestRegistry. Nothing touches the real system.

BeforeAll {
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'TestHelpers.ps1')
    Initialize-IgwtTestEnvironment

    $script:Plan = '98bdb6d0-a4b4-4553-9c5b-a1fd54831f74'
    $script:Balanced = '381b4222-f694-41f0-9685-ff5bb260df2e'
    $script:Defs = @{
        PERFEPP = @{ Guid = '36687f9e-e3a5-4dbf-b1dc-15eb381c6863'; Name = 'Processor energy performance preference policy'; Min = 0; Max = 100; Inc = 1; Units = '%' }
        PERFBOOSTMODE = @{ Guid = 'be337238-0d82-4146-a960-4f3749d470c7'; Name = 'Processor performance boost mode'; Options = @('Disabled', 'Enabled', 'Aggressive', 'Efficient Enabled', 'Efficient Aggressive') }
        CPMINCORES = @{ Guid = '0cc5b647-c1df-4637-891a-dec35c318583'; Name = 'Processor performance core parking min cores'; Min = 0; Max = 100; Inc = 1; Units = '%' }
        PROCTHROTTLEMIN = @{ Guid = '893dee8e-2bef-41e0-89c6-b55d0929964c'; Name = 'Minimum processor state'; Min = 0; Max = 100; Inc = 1; Units = '%' }
        IDLEDISABLE = @{ Guid = '5d76a2ca-e8c0-402f-a133-2158492d58ad'; Name = 'Processor idle disable'; Options = @('Enable idle', 'Disable idle') }
    }

    function ConvertTo-PowerCfgText {
        # Builds powercfg /qh style output for the settings in $script:PowerState (AC/DC or $null for UNKNOWN).
        param([string[]]$Aliases, [string]$Scheme = $script:Plan)
        $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
        $null = $sb.AppendLine("Power Scheme GUID: $Scheme  (Test plan)")
        $null = $sb.AppendLine("  Subgroup GUID: $script:Sub  (Processor power management)")
        $null = $sb.AppendLine('    GUID Alias: SUB_PROCESSOR')
        foreach ($a in $Aliases) {
            $d = $script:Defs[$a]; $st = $script:PowerState[$a]
            $null = $sb.AppendLine("    Power Setting GUID: $($d.Guid)  ($($d.Name))")
            $null = $sb.AppendLine("      GUID Alias: $a")
            if ($d.Options) {
                for ($i = 0; $i -lt $d.Options.Count; $i++) { $null = $sb.AppendLine(('      Possible Setting Index: {0:D3}' -f $i)); $null = $sb.AppendLine("      Possible Setting Friendly Name: $($d.Options[$i])") }
            } else {
                $null = $sb.AppendLine(('      Minimum Possible Setting: 0x{0:x8}' -f $d.Min)); $null = $sb.AppendLine(('      Maximum Possible Setting: 0x{0:x8}' -f $d.Max))
                $null = $sb.AppendLine(('      Possible Settings increment: 0x{0:x8}' -f $d.Inc)); $null = $sb.AppendLine("      Possible Settings units: $($d.Units)")
            }
            foreach ($k in 'AC', 'DC') {
                $v = $(if ($st) { $st[$k] } else { $null })
                $null = $sb.AppendLine("    Current $k Power Setting Index: $(if ($null -ne $v) { '0x{0:x8}' -f [int]$v } else { 'UNKNOWN' })")
            }
            $null = $sb.AppendLine('')
        }
        return $sb.ToString()
    }

    function Initialize-PowerMock {
        param([string[]]$Tags = @())
        $script:PowerState = @{ PERFEPP = @{ AC = 5; DC = 50 }; PERFBOOSTMODE = @{ AC = 2; DC = 2 }; CPMINCORES = @{ AC = 4; DC = 4 }; PROCTHROTTLEMIN = @{ AC = 100; DC = 5 }; IDLEDISABLE = @{ AC = 0; DC = 0 } }
        $script:PowerTags = $Tags
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-IgwtHardwareProfile { [pscustomobject]@{ Tags = @($script:PowerTags) } }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg {
            $cmd = ([string]$Arguments[0]).ToLowerInvariant()
            switch ($cmd) {
                '/getactivescheme' { return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = "Power Scheme GUID: $script:Plan  (Test plan)" } }
                '/list' { return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = "Power Scheme GUID: $script:Plan  (Test plan) *`nPower Scheme GUID: $script:Balanced  (Balanced)" } }
                '/qh' {
                    $aliases = @($script:Defs.Keys | Sort-Object)
                    if ($Arguments.Count -ge 4) { $aliases = @($script:Defs.Keys | Where-Object { $script:Defs[$_].Guid -eq [string]$Arguments[3] }) }
                    return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = (ConvertTo-PowerCfgText -Aliases $aliases) }
                }
                '/query' {
                    $alias = @($script:Defs.Keys | Where-Object { $script:Defs[$_].Guid -eq [string]$Arguments[3] })[0]
                    return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = (ConvertTo-PowerCfgText -Aliases @($alias)) }
                }
                { $_ -in '/setacvalueindex', '/setdcvalueindex' } {
                    $alias = @($script:Defs.Keys | Where-Object { $script:Defs[$_].Guid -eq [string]$Arguments[3] })[0]
                    $script:PowerState[$alias][$(if ($cmd -eq '/setacvalueindex') { 'AC' } else { 'DC' })] = [int]$Arguments[4]
                    return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = '' }
                }
                default { return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 0; Output = '' } }
            }
        }
        $root = 'TestRegistry:\HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power'
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $root -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        foreach ($s in @(@{ G = $script:Plan; F = '@%SystemRoot%\system32\powrprof.dll,-19,Ultimate Performance' }, @{ G = $script:Balanced; F = '@%SystemRoot%\system32\powrprof.dll,-15,Balanced' }, @{ G = 'e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61'; F = '@%SystemRoot%\system32\powrprof.dll,-19,Ultimate Performance' })) {
            $null = New-Item -Path "$root\User\PowerSchemes\$($s.G)" -Force
            $null = New-ItemProperty -Path "$root\User\PowerSchemes\$($s.G)" -Name FriendlyName -Value $s.F -PropertyType String
        }
        foreach ($a in 'PERFEPP', 'PERFBOOSTMODE', 'CPMINCORES', 'PROCTHROTTLEMIN') {
            $k = "$root\PowerSettings\$script:Sub\$($script:Defs[$a].Guid)"
            $null = New-Item -Path "$k\DefaultPowerSchemeValues\$script:Balanced" -Force
            $null = New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name Attributes -Value $(if ($a -eq 'PROCTHROTTLEMIN') { 2 } else { 1 }) -PropertyType DWord
            $def = @{ PERFEPP = @(33, 50); PERFBOOSTMODE = @(2, 2); CPMINCORES = @(100, 10); PROCTHROTTLEMIN = @(5, 5) }[$a]
            $null = New-ItemProperty -Path "$k\DefaultPowerSchemeValues\$script:Balanced" -Name ACSettingIndex -Value $def[0] -PropertyType DWord
            $null = New-ItemProperty -Path "$k\DefaultPowerSchemeValues\$script:Balanced" -Name DCSettingIndex -Value $def[1] -PropertyType DWord
        }
    }
}

Describe 'powercfg output parser' {
    It 'reads numeric and enumerated settings, ranges, units and AC/DC indexes' {
        $script:PowerState = @{ PERFEPP = @{ AC = 5; DC = 50 }; PERFBOOSTMODE = @{ AC = 2; DC = 1 } }
        $p = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ T = (ConvertTo-PowerCfgText -Aliases @('PERFEPP', 'PERFBOOSTMODE')) } { param($T) ConvertFrom-IgwtPowerCfgQuery -Text $T }
        @($p).Count | Should -Be 2
        $epp = $p | Where-Object { $_.Alias -eq 'PERFEPP' }
        $epp.Guid | Should -Be '36687f9e-e3a5-4dbf-b1dc-15eb381c6863'
        $epp.Min | Should -Be 0; $epp.Max | Should -Be 100; $epp.Units | Should -Be '%'
        $epp.AC | Should -Be 5; $epp.DC | Should -Be 50
        $boost = $p | Where-Object { $_.Alias -eq 'PERFBOOSTMODE' }
        @($boost.Options).Count | Should -Be 5
        $boost.Options[2].Name | Should -Be 'Aggressive'
        $boost.AC | Should -Be 2; $boost.DC | Should -Be 1
    }
    It 'treats UNKNOWN indexes as unknown instead of shifting the range values' {
        $script:PowerState = @{ PERFEPP = @{ AC = $null; DC = $null } }
        $p = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ T = (ConvertTo-PowerCfgText -Aliases @('PERFEPP')) } { param($T) ConvertFrom-IgwtPowerCfgQuery -Text $T }
        $p[0].AC | Should -BeNullOrEmpty; $p[0].Max | Should -Be 100
    }
    It 'does not depend on the localized labels' {
        $text = "Energieschema-GUID: $script:Plan  (Test)`n  GUID der Untergruppe: $script:Sub  (Prozessor)`n    GUID-Alias: SUB_PROCESSOR`n" +
        "    GUID der Energieeinstellung: 893dee8e-2bef-41e0-89c6-b55d0929964c  (Minimaler Leistungszustand des Prozessors)`n      GUID-Alias: PROCTHROTTLEMIN`n" +
        "      Minimale moegliche Einstellung: 0x00000000`n      Maximale moegliche Einstellung: 0x00000064`n      Schrittweite: 0x00000001`n      Einheiten: %`n" +
        "    Index der aktuellen Wechselstromeinstellung: 0x00000064`n    Index der aktuellen Gleichstromeinstellung: 0x00000005`n"
        $p = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ T = $text } { param($T) ConvertFrom-IgwtPowerCfgQuery -Text $T }
        $p[0].Alias | Should -Be 'PROCTHROTTLEMIN'; $p[0].AC | Should -Be 100; $p[0].DC | Should -Be 5; $p[0].Units | Should -Be '%'
    }

Describe 'Power plan inspector and editor' {
    BeforeEach { Initialize-PowerMock }

    It 'lists settings with defaults, hidden state and editability (read-only)' {
        $i = Get-IgwtPowerSettingsInspection
        $i.Scheme | Should -Be $script:Plan
        $i.DefaultsFrom | Should -Be 'Balanced (reference)'
        $epp = $i.Settings | Where-Object { $_.Alias -eq 'PERFEPP' }
        $epp.Editable | Should -BeTrue; $epp.Hidden | Should -BeTrue
        $epp.DefaultAC | Should -Be 33; $epp.ChangedFromDefault | Should -BeTrue
        ($i.Settings | Where-Object { $_.Alias -eq 'PROCTHROTTLEMIN' }).Hidden | Should -BeFalse
        ($i.Settings | Where-Object { $_.Alias -eq 'IDLEDISABLE' }).Editable | Should -BeFalse
        Should -Invoke Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -ParameterFilter { $Arguments[0] -like '/set*' } -Times 0 -Exactly
    }
    It 'marks settings blocked by hardware overlays (Intel hybrid core parking, laptop battery values)' {
        Initialize-PowerMock -Tags @('intel.hybrid')
        $i = Get-IgwtPowerSettingsInspection
        ($i.Settings | Where-Object { $_.Alias -eq 'CPMINCORES' }).Blocked | Should -BeTrue
        ($i.Settings | Where-Object { $_.Alias -eq 'CPMINCORES' }).Editable | Should -BeFalse
        ($i.Settings | Where-Object { $_.Alias -eq 'PERFEPP' }).Blocked | Should -BeFalse
        { Invoke-IgwtPowerSettingChange -Setting CPMINCORES -AC 100 -AcknowledgeRisk } | Should -Throw '*Blocked on this hardware*'
        Initialize-PowerMock -Tags @('formfactor.laptop')
        ($i = Get-IgwtPowerSettingsInspection) | Out-Null
        ($i.Settings | Where-Object { $_.Alias -eq 'PERFEPP' }).DcBlocked | Should -BeTrue
        { Invoke-IgwtPowerSettingChange -Setting PERFEPP -DC 0 -AcknowledgeRisk } | Should -Throw '*Blocked on this hardware*'
        (Get-IgwtPowerSettingChangePlan -Setting PERFEPP -AC 0).HasChange | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'refuses values outside the reported range, unknown settings and missing acknowledgement' {
        { Invoke-IgwtPowerSettingChange -Setting PERFEPP -AC 101 -AcknowledgeRisk } | Should -Throw '*outside the allowed range*'
        { Invoke-IgwtPowerSettingChange -Setting PERFBOOSTMODE -AC 9 -AcknowledgeRisk } | Should -Throw '*not one of the allowed values*'
        { Invoke-IgwtPowerSettingChange -Setting IDLEDISABLE -AC 1 -AcknowledgeRisk } | Should -Throw '*not editable*'
        { Invoke-IgwtPowerSettingChange -Setting PERFEPP -AC 10 } | Should -Throw '*AcknowledgeRisk*'
        { Invoke-IgwtPowerSettingChange -Setting PERFEPP -AcknowledgeRisk } | Should -Throw '*-AC, -DC or -Default*'
        Should -Invoke Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -ParameterFilter { $Arguments[0] -like '/set*' } -Times 0 -Exactly
    }
    It 'changes a setting after a snapshot and reverts it exactly' {
        $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerSettingChange -Setting PERFEPP -AC 20 -AcknowledgeRisk
        $r.Changes | Should -Be 1
        $script:PowerState.PERFEPP.AC | Should -Be 20; $script:PowerState.PERFEPP.DC | Should -Be 50
        Should -Invoke Invoke-IgwtPowerCfg -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner -ParameterFilter { $Arguments[0] -eq '/setdcvalueindex' } -Times 0 -Exactly
        $doc = Get-Content -LiteralPath $r.Snapshot -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        $doc.operation | Should -Be 'Power'
        $doc.entries[0].actions[0].data.ac | Should -Be 5
        $rev = Invoke-IgwtRevert -SnapshotPath $r.Snapshot
        @($rev.Results)[0].Result | Should -Be 'Reverted'
        $script:PowerState.PERFEPP.AC | Should -Be 5; $script:PowerState.PERFEPP.DC | Should -Be 50
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $rev.Snapshot | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'returns a setting to the Windows default' {
        $null = Invoke-IgwtPowerSettingChange -Setting PROCTHROTTLEMIN -Default -AcknowledgeRisk
        $script:PowerState.PROCTHROTTLEMIN.AC | Should -Be 5; $script:PowerState.PROCTHROTTLEMIN.DC | Should -Be 5
    }
    It 'writes nothing for a no-op change' {
        $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerSettingChange -Setting PERFBOOSTMODE -AC 2 -AcknowledgeRisk
        $r.Changes | Should -Be 0; $r.Snapshot | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
    It 'rejects snapshot entries for settings the editor does not cover' {
        $r = Invoke-IgwtPowerSettingChange -Setting PERFEPP -AC 20 -AcknowledgeRisk
        $doc = Get-Content -LiteralPath $r.Snapshot -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        $doc.entries[0].actions[0].data.setting = $script:Defs.IDLEDISABLE.Guid
        Set-Content -LiteralPath $r.Snapshot -Value ($doc | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20) -Encoding UTF8
        @((Invoke-IgwtRevert -SnapshotPath $r.Snapshot).Results)[0].Result | Should -Be 'Failed'
        $script:PowerState.IDLEDISABLE.AC | Should -Be 0
    }
    It 'compares plan copies with the built-in plan they came from' {
        $hp = '8c5e7fda-e8bf-4a96-9a85-a6e23a8c635c'; $copy = '11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555'
        $root = 'TestRegistry:\HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\User\PowerSchemes'
        foreach ($g in $hp, $copy) { $null = New-Item -Path "$root\$g" -Force; $null = New-ItemProperty -Path "$root\$g" -Name FriendlyName -Value '@%SystemRoot%\system32\powrprof.dll,-13,High performance' -PropertyType String }
        (InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ C = $copy; S = $script:Sub } { param($C, $S) Get-IgwtPowerDefaults -Scheme $C -Subgroup $S }).Source | Should -Be 'High performance'
        (InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ C = $script:Balanced; S = $script:Sub } { param($C, $S) Get-IgwtPowerDefaults -Scheme $C -Subgroup $S }).Source | Should -Be 'plan'
    }
}

Describe 'Kernel, timer and crash inspectors (read-only)' {

        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-CimInstance -ParameterFilter { $ClassName -eq 'Win32_PageFileUsage' } { @([pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'C:\pagefile.sys'; AllocatedBaseSize = 2048; CurrentUsage = 10; PeakUsage = 40 }) }
    }
    It 'annotates values with defaults, status and the catalog or rejected entry' {

    }
```

```ps1
# Management and diagnostic modules (phase 7). CIM, service, task, Appx, firewall, event log,
# DNS and ping access is mocked; registry access stays in TestRegistry and files in TestDrive.
# Nothing touches the real system.

BeforeAll {
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'TestHelpers.ps1')
    Initialize-IgwtTestEnvironment

    function Write-TestReg {
        param([string]$Path, [string]$Name, $Value, [string]$Kind = 'DWord')
        $p = $Path -replace '^HKLM:\\', 'TestRegistry:\HKLM\' -replace '^HKCU:\\', 'TestRegistry:\HKCU\'
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { $null = New-Item -Path $p -Force }
        $null = New-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $p -Name $Name -Value $Value -PropertyType $Kind -Force
    }
    function Get-TestRegValue {
        param([string]$Path, [string]$Name)
        $p = $Path -replace '^HKLM:\\', 'TestRegistry:\HKLM\'
        return (Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $p -Name $Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).$Name
    }
    function Initialize-ServiceMock {
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-CimInstance -ParameterFilter { $ClassName -eq 'Win32_Service' } {
            $all = @(
                [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'IgwtTestSvc'; DisplayName = 'Igwt test service'; Description = 'Test'; State = 'Running'; StartMode = 'Manual'; DelayedAutoStart = $false; StartName = 'LocalSystem'; PathName = 'C:\Program Files\Test\svc.exe'; ServiceType = 'Own Process' }
                [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'IgwtTestDrv'; DisplayName = 'Igwt test driver'; Description = ''; State = 'Running'; StartMode = 'System'; DelayedAutoStart = $false; StartName = ''; PathName = 'C:\Windows\system32\drivers\t.sys'; ServiceType = 'Kernel Driver' }
                [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'WinDefend'; DisplayName = 'Microsoft Defender Antivirus Service'; Description = ''; State = 'Running'; StartMode = 'Auto'; DelayedAutoStart = $false; StartName = 'LocalSystem'; PathName = "$env:SystemRoot\x\MsMpEng.exe"; ServiceType = 'Own Process' }
                [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'DiagTrack'; DisplayName = 'Connected User Experiences and Telemetry'; Description = ''; State = 'Running'; StartMode = 'Auto'; DelayedAutoStart = $false; StartName = 'LocalSystem'; PathName = "$env:SystemRoot\System32\svchost.exe -k utcsvc -p"; ServiceType = 'Share Process' }
                [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'Fax'; DisplayName = 'Fax'; Description = ''; State = 'Stopped'; StartMode = 'Manual'; DelayedAutoStart = $false; StartName = 'NetworkService'; PathName = "$env:SystemRoot\system32\fxssvc.exe"; ServiceType = 'Own Process' }
            )
            if ($Filter -match "Name='([^']+)'") { $n = $Matches[1]; return @($all | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq $n }) }
            return $all
        }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-Service { if ($Name) { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $Name[0]; Status = 'Running'; StartType = 'Manual'; ServicesDependedOn = @(); DependentServices = @() } } else { @([pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'Fax'; ServicesDependedOn = @([pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'RpcSs' }); DependentServices = @() }) } }
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Set-Service {
            $v = switch ([string]$StartupType) { 'Automatic' { 2 } 'Manual' { 3 } 'Disabled' { 4 } }
            Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath "TestRegistry:\HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\$Name" -Name Start -Value $v
        }
        foreach ($n in 'IgwtTestSvc', 'WinDefend', 'Fax') { Write-TestReg -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\$n" -Name 'Start' -Value 3 }
    }

Describe 'Managed changes (snapshot, apply, revert)' {
    BeforeEach { Initialize-ServiceMock }

    It 'changes a service startup type with a Manage snapshot and reverts it' {
        $r = Invoke-IgwtManagedChange -Kind service -Target 'Fax' -Value 'Disabled'
        @($r.Results)[0].Result | Should -Be 'Applied'
        Get-TestRegValue 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Fax' 'Start' | Should -Be 4
        $doc = Get-Content -LiteralPath $r.Snapshot -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        $doc.operation | Should -Be 'Manage'
        $doc.entries[0].actions[0].managed.kind | Should -Be 'service'
        $rev = Invoke-IgwtRevert -SnapshotPath $r.Snapshot
        @($rev.Results)[0].Result | Should -Be 'Reverted'
        Get-TestRegValue 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Fax' 'Start' | Should -Be 3
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $rev.Snapshot | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'does nothing when the value is already set' {
        $r = Invoke-IgwtManagedChange -Kind service -Target 'Fax' -Value 'Manual'
        $r.Changes | Should -Be 0
        (Get-IgwtManagedChangePlan -Kind service -Target 'Fax' -Value 'Manual').HasChange | Should -BeFalse
        (Get-IgwtManagedChangePlan -Kind service -Target 'Fax' -Value 'Disabled').HasChange | Should -BeTrue
    }
    It 'refuses protected services, drivers, unknown services and invalid values' {

        { Invoke-IgwtManagedChange -Kind service -Target 'Fax' -Value 'Boot' } | Should -Throw '*not allowed*'
        Get-TestRegValue 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\WinDefend' 'Start' | Should -Be 3
    }
    It 'refuses a tampered snapshot that points at a protected service' {

        Set-Content -LiteralPath $r.Snapshot -Value ($doc | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20) -Encoding UTF8

    }
    It 'disables and re-enables a scheduled task but refuses security and anti-cheat tasks' {

        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Enable-ScheduledTask { $script:TaskState = 'Ready' }

        @($r.Results)[0].Result | Should -Be 'Applied'
        $script:TaskState | Should -Be 'Disabled'

        $script:TaskState | Should -Be 'Ready'
        { Invoke-IgwtManagedChange -Kind task -Target '\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Defender\Windows Defender Scheduled Scan' -Value 'Disabled' } | Should -Throw '*protected*'
        { Invoke-IgwtManagedChange -Kind task -Target '\Riot Vanguard\vgc update' -Value 'Disabled' } | Should -Throw '*anti-cheat*'
        { Invoke-IgwtManagedChange -Kind task -Target 'Consolidator' -Value 'Disabled' } | Should -Throw '*full task path*'
    }
    It 'refuses protected apps, features and capabilities' {

        { Invoke-IgwtManagedChange -Kind feature -Target 'NetFx4-AdvSrvs' -Value 'Disabled' } | Should -Throw '*protected*'

    It 'refuses system and framework packages even when not on the protected list' {

    It 'switches an app firewall rule with a snapshot and never changes Windows rules' {

        $inv.Counts.Warn | Should -BeGreaterOrEqual 3
    }
    It 'exports a self-contained HTML report without scripts and with encoded text' {
        $inv = [pscustomobject]@{ Generated = 'now'; Counts = [pscustomobject]@{ Total = 1; Warn = 1; Review = 0 }
            Entries = @([pscustomobject]@{ Category = 'Run keys'; Location = 'HKCU'; Name = '<script>alert(1)</script>'; Command = 'x'; Signature = 'NotSigned'; Signer = ''; Severity = 'Warn'; Note = '' }) }
        $path = Export-IgwtPersistenceReport -Inventory $inv -Path (Join-Path $TestDrive 'p.html')

        $html | Should -Not -Match '<script'
        $html | Should -Match '&lt;script&gt;'
        $json = Export-IgwtPersistenceReport -Inventory $inv -Path (Join-Path $TestDrive 'p.json') -Format Json
        (Get-Content -LiteralPath $json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).Counts.Warn | Should -Be 1
    }

    }

Describe 'Diagnostics (read-only)' {
    It 'computes DPC and ISR percentages from raw counter deltas' {

    }
    It 'collects BugCheck, Kernel-Power and app crashes with the minidump list' {

        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-WinEvent {
            switch ([int]$FilterHashtable.Id) {
                1001 { [pscustomobject]@{ TimeCreated = (Get-Date).AddDays(-1); Id = 1001; Message = 'The computer has rebooted from a bugcheck. The bugcheck was: 0x0000009f (0x3, 0x1, 0x2, 0x3).'; Properties = @() } }
                41 { 1..2 | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ TimeCreated = (Get-Date).AddDays(-$_); Id = 41; Message = 'The system has rebooted without cleanly shutting down first.'; Properties = @() } } }
                1000 { [pscustomobject]@{ TimeCreated = (Get-Date).AddDays(-3); Id = 1000; Message = 'Faulting application'; Properties = @([pscustomobject]@{ Value = 'game.exe' }, [pscustomobject]@{ Value = '1.0' }, [pscustomobject]@{ Value = '0' }, [pscustomobject]@{ Value = 'gfx.dll' }) } }
                default { throw 'No events were found that match the specified selection criteria.' }
            }
        }
        $c = Get-IgwtCrashHistory -Days 30
        $c.Counts.BugCheck | Should -Be 1; $c.Counts.KernelPower41 | Should -Be 2; $c.Counts.UnexpectedShutdown | Should -Be 0; $c.Counts.AppCrash | Should -Be 1
        @($c.Events | Where-Object { $_.Kind -eq 'BugCheck' })[0].Detail | Should -Match '^Stop code 0x0000009f'

    It 'flags unsigned and old drivers but not the Intel placeholder date' {
```

`tests/Registry.Tests.ps1`:

```ps1
BeforeAll {
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'TestHelpers.ps1')
    Initialize-IgwtTestEnvironment
}

Describe 'Registry redirection safety' {
    It 'refuses paths that are not redirected into TestRegistry in TestMode' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { { Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath 'Registry::HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\X' } | Should -Throw '*TestMode safety*' }
    }
    It 'redirects HKLM and HKCU into TestRegistry' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner {
            Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Test' | Should -Be 'TestRegistry:\HKLM\SOFTWARE\Test'
            Resolve-IgwtRegistryPath 'HKCU:\Software\Test' | Should -Be 'TestRegistry:\HKCU\Software\Test'
        }
    }
}

Describe 'Snapshot fidelity for every REG type' {
    BeforeEach {
        $script:Key = "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\IgwtTest\Fidelity$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0,6))"
    }

    It 'round-trips <Kind> exactly through snapshot JSON' -ForEach @(
        @{ Kind = 'DWord'; Value = 0 }
        @{ Kind = 'DWord'; Value = '0xFFFFFFFF' }
        @{ Kind = 'QWord'; Value = '18446744073709551615' }
        @{ Kind = 'String'; Value = 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;' }
        @{ Kind = 'ExpandString'; Value = '%SystemRoot%\System32\x.dll' }
        @{ Kind = 'MultiString'; Value = @('one', 'two', '') }
        @{ Kind = 'Binary'; Value = '0001FF7F80' }
    ) {
        $k = $script:Key; $kind = $Kind; $val = $Value
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ Key = $k; Kind = $kind; Val = $val } {
            param($Key, $Kind, $Val)
            Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $Key -Name 'V' -Kind $Kind -Value (ConvertFrom-IgwtSerializableValue -Data $Val -Kind $Kind)
            $action = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'registry'; path = $Key; name = 'V'; valueType = $Kind; on = $null; default = '<absent>' }
            $snap = Get-IgwtRegistrySnapshot -Action $action
            $json = $snap | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | ConvertFrom-Json
            Remove-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $Key -Name 'V'
            (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $Key -Name 'V').Exists | Should -BeFalse
            Restore-IgwtRegistrySnapshot -Action $action -Snapshot $json
            $after = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $Key -Name 'V'
            $after.Exists | Should -BeTrue
            $after.Kind | Should -Be $Kind
            Test-IgwtRegistryValueEqual $after.Value (ConvertFrom-IgwtSerializableValue -Data $Val -Kind $Kind) $Kind | Should -BeTrue
        }
    }

    It 'keeps REG_EXPAND_SZ unexpanded' {
        $k = $script:Key
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ Key = $k } {
            param($Key)
            Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $Key -Name 'E' -Kind ExpandString -Value '%windir%\foo'
            (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $Key -Name 'E').Value | Should -Be '%windir%\foo'
        }
    }

    It 'restores "value did not exist" and removes keys iG Windows Tuner created' {
        $k = "$script:Key\Deep\Er"
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ Key = $k } {
            param($Key)
            $action = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'registry'; path = $Key; name = 'N'; valueType = 'DWord'; on = 1; default = '<absent>' }
            $snap = (Get-IgwtRegistrySnapshot -Action $action) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | ConvertFrom-Json
            $snap.items[0].exists | Should -BeFalse
            $snap.items[0].missingDepth | Should -BeGreaterOrEqual 3
            Invoke-IgwtRegistryApply -Action $action
            (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $Key -Name 'N').Value | Should -Be 1
            Restore-IgwtRegistrySnapshot -Action $action -Snapshot $snap
            (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $Key -Name 'N').Exists | Should -BeFalse
            Test-IgwtRegistryKey -Path $Key | Should -BeFalse
            Test-IgwtRegistryKey -Path ($Key -replace '\\Deep\\Er$', '') | Should -BeFalse
        }
    }

    It 'never deletes a pre-existing key that still holds other values' {
        $k = $script:Key
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ Key = $k } {
            param($Key)
            Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path "$Key\Sub" -Name 'Other' -Kind String -Value 'keep'
            $action = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'registry'; path = "$Key\Sub\New"; name = 'N'; valueType = 'DWord'; on = 1; default = '<absent>' }
            $snap = (Get-IgwtRegistrySnapshot -Action $action) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | ConvertFrom-Json
            Invoke-IgwtRegistryApply -Action $action
            Restore-IgwtRegistrySnapshot -Action $action -Snapshot $snap
            Test-IgwtRegistryKey -Path "$Key\Sub\New" | Should -BeFalse
            (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path "$Key\Sub" -Name 'Other').Value | Should -Be 'keep'
        }
    }
}

Describe 'Registry action semantics' {
    It 'rewrites a wrongly typed value (DWORD 0 -> REG_SZ "0") and reverts to the original DWORD' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner {
            $p = 'HKCU:\Control Panel\MouseTypeTest'
            Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $p -Name 'MouseSpeed' -Kind DWord -Value 0
            $a = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'registry'; path = $p; name = 'MouseSpeed'; valueType = 'String'; on = '0'; default = '1' }
            (Get-IgwtRegistryState -Action $a).State | Should -Be 'Off'
            $snap = (Get-IgwtRegistrySnapshot -Action $a) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | ConvertFrom-Json
            Invoke-IgwtRegistryApply -Action $a
            $v = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $p -Name 'MouseSpeed'
            $v.Kind | Should -Be 'String'; $v.Value | Should -Be '0'
            (Get-IgwtRegistryState -Action $a).State | Should -Be 'On'
            Restore-IgwtRegistrySnapshot -Action $a -Snapshot $snap
            $r = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $p -Name 'MouseSpeed'
            $r.Kind | Should -Be 'DWord'; $r.Value | Should -Be 0
        }
    }

    It 'clears only the hotkey bit with bitClear and preserves other flags' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner {
            $p = 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeysTest'
            Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $p -Name 'Flags' -Kind String -Value '511'
            $a = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'registry'; path = $p; name = 'Flags'; valueType = 'String'; on = '506'; bitClear = 4; default = '510'; absentValue = '510' }
            (Get-IgwtRegistryState -Action $a).State | Should -Be 'Off'
            Invoke-IgwtRegistryApply -Action $a
            (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $p -Name 'Flags').Value | Should -Be '507'
            (Get-IgwtRegistryState -Action $a).State | Should -Be 'On'
        }
    }

    It 'treats absent values using absentValue and equivalentOn values as on' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner {
            $p = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\IgwtTest\Semantics'
            $a = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'registry'; path = $p; name = 'A'; valueType = 'DWord'; on = 1; default = '<absent>'; absentValue = 1 }
            (Get-IgwtRegistryState -Action $a).State | Should -Be 'On'
            $b = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'registry'; path = $p; name = 'B'; valueType = 'DWord'; on = 2; default = '<absent>'; equivalentOn = @(1) }
            Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $p -Name 'B' -Kind DWord -Value 1
            (Get-IgwtRegistryState -Action $b).State | Should -Be 'On'
            $c = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'registry'; path = $p; name = 'C'; valueType = 'DWord'; on = '<absent>'; default = '<absent>'; equivalentOn = @(0) }
            Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $p -Name 'C' -Kind DWord -Value 1
            (Get-IgwtRegistryState -Action $c).State | Should -Be 'Off'
            Invoke-IgwtRegistryApply -Action $c
            (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $p -Name 'C').Exists | Should -BeFalse
        }
    }

    It 'writes onlyIfAbsent values only when missing' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner {
            $p = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\IgwtTest\OnlyIfAbsent'
            Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $p -Name 'W' -Kind DWord -Value 1
            $a = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'registry'; path = $p; name = 'W'; valueType = 'DWord'; on = 2; onlyIfAbsent = $true; default = '<absent>' }
            Invoke-IgwtRegistryApply -Action $a
            (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $p -Name 'W').Value | Should -Be 1
        }
    }

    It 'resets to the documented Windows default' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner {
            $p = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\IgwtTest\Default'
            $a = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'registry'; path = $p; name = 'D'; valueType = 'DWord'; on = 10; default = 20 }
            Invoke-IgwtRegistryApply -Action $a
            Invoke-IgwtRegistryApply -Action $a -Mode default
            (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $p -Name 'D').Value | Should -Be 20
        }
    }

    It 'parses microcode-style hex and negative DWORD inputs' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner {
            ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 '0xFFFFFFFF' | Should -Be 4294967295
            ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 (-1) | Should -Be 4294967295
            ConvertTo-IgwtUInt64 10 | Should -Be 10
        }
    }
}
```

`tests/RegistryListMerge.Tests.ps1`:

```ps1
BeforeAll {
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'TestHelpers.ps1')
    Initialize-IgwtTestEnvironment

Describe 'Semicolon list parsing' {
    It 'adds an item without touching unrelated items' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Set-IgwtListItem -Text 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;' -Key 'SwapEffectUpgradeEnable' -Value '1' | Should -Be 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1;' }
    }
    It 'replaces an existing item in place (case-insensitive key)' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Set-IgwtListItem -Text 'A=1;swapeffectupgradeenable=0;B=2;' -Key 'SwapEffectUpgradeEnable' -Value '1' | Should -Be 'A=1;swapeffectupgradeenable=1;B=2;' }
    }
    It 'removes only the requested item' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Remove-IgwtListItem -Text 'A=1;VRROptimizeEnable=1;B=2;' -Key 'VRROptimizeEnable' | Should -Be 'A=1;B=2;' }
    }
    It 'preserves raw items without an equals sign' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner { Set-IgwtListItem -Text 'Legacy;A=1;' -Key 'B' -Value '2' | Should -Be 'Legacy;A=1;B=2;' }
    }
    It 'handles empty and missing strings' {
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner {
            Set-IgwtListItem -Text '' -Key 'A' -Value '1' | Should -Be 'A=1;'
            Remove-IgwtListItem -Text $null -Key 'A' | Should -Be ''
        }
    }
}

Describe 'registryListMerge action' {
    BeforeAll {
        $script:Path = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences'
    }

    It 'merges into an existing string and reverts to the exact original' {
        $path = $script:Path
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ P = $path } {
            param($P)
            Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $P -Name 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings' -Kind String -Value 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;Custom=7;'
            $a = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'registryListMerge'; path = $P; name = 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings'; item = 'SwapEffectUpgradeEnable'; on = '1'; off = '<remove>'; default = '<remove>' }
            (Get-IgwtListMergeState -Action $a).State | Should -Be 'Off'
            $snap = (Get-IgwtRegistrySnapshot -Action $a) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | ConvertFrom-Json
            Invoke-IgwtListMergeApply -Action $a
            (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $P -Name 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings').Value | Should -Be 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;Custom=7;SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1;'
            (Get-IgwtListMergeState -Action $a).State | Should -Be 'On'
            Invoke-IgwtListMergeApply -Action $a
            (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $P -Name 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings').Value | Should -Be 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;Custom=7;SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1;'
            Restore-IgwtRegistrySnapshot -Action $a -Snapshot $snap
            (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $P -Name 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings').Value | Should -Be 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;Custom=7;'
        }
    }

    It 'creates the value when absent and the default removes it again' {
        $path = $script:Path
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ P = $path } {
            param($P)
            Remove-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $P -Name 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings'
            $a = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'registryListMerge'; path = $P; name = 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings'; item = 'VRROptimizeEnable'; on = '1'; off = '<remove>'; default = '<remove>' }
            Invoke-IgwtListMergeApply -Action $a
            (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $P -Name 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings').Value | Should -Be 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;'
            Invoke-IgwtListMergeApply -Action $a -Mode default
            (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $P -Name 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings').Exists | Should -BeFalse
        }
    }

    It 'removing one item keeps the others' {
        $path = $script:Path
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ P = $path } {
            param($P)
            Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $P -Name 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings' -Kind String -Value 'SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1;VRROptimizeEnable=1;'
            $a = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'registryListMerge'; path = $P; name = 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings'; item = 'SwapEffectUpgradeEnable'; on = '1'; off = '<remove>'; default = '<remove>' }
            Invoke-IgwtListMergeApply -Action $a -Mode off
            (Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $P -Name 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings').Value | Should -Be 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;'
        }
    }
}
```

`tests/Safety.Tests.ps1`:

```ps1
# Static checks that the shipped code stays transparent and never contains the techniques the
# project rules forbid (BCD edits, obfuscation, download-and-execute, persistence, security
# tampering). These scan the source text; they do not execute anything.

BeforeAll {
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'TestHelpers.ps1')
    $script:Shipped = @(Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $script:IgwtProjectRoot 'src'), (Join-Path $script:IgwtProjectRoot 'data') -Recurse -File -Include *.ps1, *.psm1, *.psd1, *.json, *.xaml) +
        @(Get-Item (Join-Path $script:IgwtProjectRoot 'iGWindowsTuner.ps1'), (Join-Path $script:IgwtProjectRoot 'Start-iGWindowsTuner.cmd'))
    $script:Code = @($script:Shipped | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.ps1', '.psm1', '.psd1', '.cmd' })
    function Get-Matches([string]$Pattern, [object[]]$Files = $script:Code) {
        foreach ($f in $Files) {
            $i = 0
            foreach ($line in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName)) {
                $i++
                if ($line -match $Pattern -and $line -notmatch '^\s*#') { "$($f.Name):${i}: $($line.Trim())" }
            }
        }
    }
}

Describe 'Forbidden techniques are absent from shipped code' {
    It 'never runs bcdedit' { Get-Matches '(?i)bcdedit(\.exe)?\s' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty }
    It 'never uses Invoke-Expression or iex' { Get-Matches '(?i)\b(Invoke-Expression|iex)\b' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty }
    It 'never uses -EncodedCommand or Base64 decoding' { Get-Matches '(?i)(EncodedCommand|FromBase64String|ToBase64String)' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty }
    It 'never downloads anything' { Get-Matches '(?i)(Invoke-WebRequest|Invoke-RestMethod|DownloadString|DownloadFile|Net\.WebClient|Start-BitsTransfer|\biwr\b|\bcurl\b|\bwget\b)' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty }
    It 'never creates persistence (tasks, services, Run keys, WMI subscriptions)' {
        Get-Matches '(?i)(Register-ScheduledTask|New-ScheduledTask|schtasks|New-Service|sc\.exe\s+create|__EventFilter|Register-WmiEvent|Register-CimIndicationEvent)' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
        Get-Matches '(?i)Set-ItemProperty.*CurrentVersion\\Run' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
    It 'never hides windows' { Get-Matches '(?i)WindowStyle\s+Hidden|-w\s+hidden|CreateNoWindow' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty }
    It 'never changes machine or user execution policy' { Get-Matches '(?i)Set-ExecutionPolicy' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty }
    It 'never touches AMSI, ETW, real-time protection, Tamper Protection or Defender exclusions' {
        Get-Matches '(?i)(AmsiUtils|amsiInitFailed|EtwEventWrite|DisableRealtimeMonitoring|DisableBehaviorMonitoring|DisableIOAVProtection|TamperProtection\s*=|ExclusionPath|ExclusionProcess|ExclusionExtension)' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
    It 'never disables driver signature enforcement or enables test signing' { Get-Matches '(?i)(testsigning\s+on|nointegritychecks|DISABLE_INTEGRITY_CHECKS\s*=)' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty }
    It 'uses no UAC bypass (only Start-Process -Verb RunAs)' {
        Get-Matches '(?i)(fodhelper|eventvwr|ms-settings\\shell|computerdefaults|sdclt|ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin\s*=\s*0)' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
        foreach ($h in @(Get-Matches '(?i)-Verb\s+RunAs')) { $h | Should -Match '^Elevation\.ps1:' }
    }
    It 'contains exactly one Add-Type with C# source (the SystemParametersInfo P/Invoke)' {
        $typeDefs = @(Get-Matches '(?i)Add-Type\s+-TypeDefinition')
        $typeDefs.Count | Should -Be 1
        $typeDefs[0] | Should -Match 'Custom\.ps1'
        @(Get-Matches '(?i)DllImport').Count | Should -Be 1
    }
    It 'runs only the allowed external executables' {
        foreach ($i in @(Get-Matches '&\s*\$exe\b')) { $i | Should -Match '^(PowerCfg|Gpu|CleanerEngine|Apps)\.ps1:' }
        $literals = foreach ($m in @(Get-Matches "(?i)'[^']*\.exe'")) { foreach ($x in [regex]::Matches($m, "(?i)'([^']*\.exe)'")) { Split-Path $x.Groups[1].Value -Leaf } }
        foreach ($e in @($literals)) { $e | Should -BeIn @('powercfg.exe', 'nvidia-smi.exe', 'powershell.exe', 'pwsh.exe', 'explorer.exe', 'dism.exe', 'pnputil.exe', 'winget.exe') }
    }
    It 'builds no command names from strings at runtime' {
        Get-Matches '(?i)&\s*\(\s*["''].*\$' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
        Get-Matches '(?i)\[scriptblock\]::Create' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
        Get-Matches '(?i)\.AddScript\(' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
    It 'never names things bypass, stealth or kill' {
        Get-Matches '(?i)function\s+\S*(bypass|stealth|kill)' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
    It 'only uses -ExecutionPolicy Bypass for the process (launcher and UAC relaunch)' {
        foreach ($h in @(Get-Matches '(?i)ExecutionPolicy')) { $h | Should -Match '(?i)-ExecutionPolicy[''"]?,?\s*[''"]?Bypass' }
    }
}

Describe '2.0 action handlers stay within their limits' {
    It 'never creates, imports or deletes scheduled tasks (enable/disable only)' {
        Get-Matches '(?i)(Register-ScheduledTask|Unregister-ScheduledTask|New-ScheduledTask|Set-ScheduledTask|schtasks)' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
    It 'creates firewall rules only in the iG Windows Tuner group and only as Block rules' {
        foreach ($h in @(Get-Matches '(?i)New-NetFirewallRule')) { $h | Should -Match '^Firewall\.ps1:' }
        Get-Matches "(?i)Action\s*=\s*'Allow'" | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
    It 'runs winget only through Invoke-IgwtWinget and never with --force' {
        foreach ($h in @(Get-Matches '(?i)winget\.exe')) { $h | Should -Match '^Apps\.ps1:' }
        Get-Matches "(?i)'--force'" | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
    It 'never writes BCD (there is no bcd action handler)' {
        Get-Matches "(?i)'bcd'\s*\{" | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
}

Describe 'Module structure' {
    It 'defines every function only once (a later file would silently replace the earlier one)' {
        $names = foreach ($f in @($script:Code | Where-Object { $_.Extension -eq '.ps1' -and $_.FullName -like '*\src\*' })) {
            foreach ($m in (Select-String -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Pattern '^\s*function\s+([A-Za-z0-9\-]+)')) { $m.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value }
        }
        @($names | Group-Object | Where-Object { $_.Count -gt 1 } | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }) | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
    It 'never writes $name? in a string (PowerShell reads it as a variable named "name?"; use ${name}?)' {
        Get-Matches '\$[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\?' | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
}
```

`tests/Schema.Tests.ps1`:

```ps1
# Schema v2 and v1 migration tests. The v1 data and the v1 snapshot come from tests\fixtures\v1
# (frozen iG Windows Tuner 1.0 files). Migration runs only on TestDrive copies; registry work uses
# TestRegistry through the normal test redirection.

BeforeAll {
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'TestHelpers.ps1')
    Initialize-IgwtTestEnvironment
    $script:Fixture = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'fixtures\v1'
    $script:RepoData = Join-Path $script:IgwtProjectRoot 'data'

    function New-V1DataCopy {
        [Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions', '', Justification = 'Creates TestDrive fixtures only.')]
        [CmdletBinding()]
        param()
        $dest = Join-Path $TestDrive ('v1data-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8))
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:Fixture 'data') -Destination $dest -Recurse
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:RepoData 'hardware') -Destination $dest -Recurse
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:RepoData 'asr') -Destination $dest -Recurse   # 2.0 ASR rule catalog (no v1 equivalent)
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:RepoData 'power') -Destination $dest -Recurse # 2.0 power plan editor settings (no v1 equivalent)
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:RepoData 'migration') -Destination $dest -Recurse
        return $dest
    }
    function Get-RawTweaks([string]$Folder) {
        foreach ($f in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Folder 'tweaks') -Filter *.json)) { @((Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).tweaks) }
    }
    function Get-Fingerprints($Tweak) {
        @($Tweak.actions | ForEach-Object { $a = $_; InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ A = $a } { param($A) Get-IgwtActionFingerprint $A } })
    }
}

AfterAll { Set-IgwtEnvironment -DataFolder '' }

Describe 'Schema v2: every shipped item' {
    BeforeAll {
        $script:Tweaks = @(Get-IgwtCatalog -Force)
        $script:Rules = @(Get-IgwtCleanerRules -Force)
        $script:Presets = @(Get-IgwtPreset)
        $script:Tags = @(Get-IgwtHardwareTagDefinitions -Force)
    }
    It 'declares schemaVersion 2 in every data file' {
        $files = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $script:RepoData -Recurse -Filter *.json | Where-Object { $_.Directory.Name -in 'tweaks', 'presets', 'cleaner', 'hardware', 'migration' })
        $files.Count | Should -BeGreaterThan 15
        foreach ($f in $files) { (Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).schemaVersion | Should -Be 2 -Because $f.Name }
    }
    It 'contains no v1 fields in the data files' {
        foreach ($t in (Get-RawTweaks $script:RepoData)) {
            $t.PSObject.Properties['antiCheatSafe'] | Should -BeNullOrEmpty -Because $t.id
            $t.PSObject.Properties['expert'] | Should -BeNullOrEmpty -Because $t.id
            $t.appliesTo.PSObject.Properties['hardware'] | Should -BeNullOrEmpty -Because $t.id
        }
        foreach ($f in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:RepoData 'presets') -Filter *.json)) { (Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).PSObject.Properties['tweaks'] | Should -BeNullOrEmpty -Because $f.Name }
    }
    It 'validates without errors' {
        @(Test-IgwtCatalog) | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
        @(Test-IgwtCleanerCatalog) | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
    It 'gives every tweak, cleaner rule, preset and hardware tag a hint of 140 characters or fewer and a description' {
        $items = @($script:Tweaks | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Label = "tweak $($_.id)"; Hint = [string]$_.hint; Description = [string]$_.description } }) +
            @($script:Rules | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Label = "rule $($_.id)"; Hint = [string]$_.hint; Description = [string]$_.description } }) +
            @($script:Presets | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Label = "preset $($_.id)"; Hint = [string]$_.hint; Description = [string]$_.description } }) +
            @($script:Tags | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Label = "tag $($_.id)"; Hint = [string]$_.hint; Description = [string]$_.description } })
        $items.Count | Should -BeGreaterThan 130
        foreach ($i in $items) {
            $i.Hint.Trim() | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty -Because $i.Label
            $i.Hint.Length | Should -BeLessOrEqual 140 -Because $i.Label
            $i.Description.Length | Should -BeGreaterOrEqual 40 -Because $i.Label
        }
    }
    It 'gives every tweak and cleaner rule a valid level, tier, antiCheat, reversible, source and known hardware tags' {
        $known = @($script:Tags.id)
        foreach ($i in @($script:Tweaks) + @($script:Rules)) {
            $i.level | Should -BeIn @('Standard', 'Advanced', 'Expert', 'Lab') -Because $i.id
            (InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ I = $i } { param($I) Get-IgwtItemTier -Item $I }) | Should -BeIn @('A', 'B') -Because $i.id
            (InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ V = $i.antiCheat } { param($V) ConvertTo-IgwtAntiCheatInfo -Value $V }).Valid | Should -BeTrue -Because $i.id
            $i.reversible | Should -BeIn @('full', 'partial', 'none') -Because $i.id
            $i.source | Should -BeIn @('igwt', 'winutil', 'microsoft') -Because $i.id
            if ($i.source -eq 'winutil') { [string]$i.attribution | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty -Because $i.id }
            $i.PSObject.Properties['sideEffects'] | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty -Because $i.id
            foreach ($t in @($i.hardware.tags) + @($i.hardware.excludeTags)) { if ($t) { $t | Should -BeIn $known -Because $i.id } }
        }
    }
    It 'keeps Lab, rejected and non-safe items out of every gaming preset' {
        $rejected = @(Get-IgwtRejectedTweaks | ForEach-Object { $_.id })
        foreach ($p in $script:Presets) {
            foreach ($id in $p.tweaks) {
                $t = $script:Tweaks | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $id }
                $t.level | Should -Not -Be 'Lab' -Because "$($p.id): $id"
                $id | Should -Not -BeIn $rejected
                if ($p.gaming) { $t.antiCheat | Should -Be 'safe' -Because "$($p.id): $id" }
            }
        }
    }
    It 'marks the item that breaks anti-cheat as Lab and names the anti-cheats' {
        $t = $script:Tweaks | Where-Object { $_.id -eq 'sec.vbs-hvci-off-expert' }
        $t.level | Should -Be 'Lab'
        @($t.antiCheat.breaks) | Should -Contain 'FACEIT'
        @($t.antiCheat.breaks) | Should -Contain 'Riot Vanguard'
        $t.expert | Should -BeTrue
        $t.antiCheatSafe | Should -BeFalse
    }
    It 'reports every broken v2 field' {
        $base = (Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:RepoData 'tweaks\input.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).tweaks[0]
        $make = {
            param([string]$Id, [scriptblock]$Change)
            $raw = $base | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 | ConvertFrom-Json
            $raw.id = $Id
            & $Change $raw
            InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ R = $raw } { param($R) ConvertTo-IgwtNormalizedTweak -Tweak $R -SourceFile 'input.json' }
        }
        $bad = @(
            (& $make 'input.bad-hint' { param($r) $r.hint = 'x' * 141 })
            (& $make 'input.bad-desc' { param($r) $r.description = '' })
            (& $make 'input.bad-level' { param($r) $r.level = 'Ultra' })
            (& $make 'input.bad-ac' { param($r) $r.antiCheat = 'maybe' })
            (& $make 'input.bad-breaks' { param($r) $r.antiCheat = [pscustomobject]@{ breaks = @('FACEIT') }; $r.level = 'Advanced' })
            (& $make 'input.bad-rev' { param($r) $r.reversible = 'sometimes' })
            (& $make 'input.bad-partial' { param($r) $r.reversible = 'partial'; $r.sideEffects = '' })
            (& $make 'input.bad-winutil' { param($r) $r.source = 'winutil' })
            (& $make 'input.bad-tag' { param($r) $r.hardware.tags = @('gpu.voodoo') })
            (& $make 'input.bad-cond' { param($r) $r.appliesTo | Add-Member -NotePropertyName conditions -NotePropertyValue @('moonPhase') -Force })
            (& $make 'input.bad-legacy' { param($r) $r | Add-Member -NotePropertyName antiCheatSafe -NotePropertyValue $true })
            (& $make 'input.bad-expert' { param($r) $r.level = 'Expert' })
        )
        Mock -ModuleName iGWindowsTuner Get-IgwtCatalog { $bad }
        $errors = (@(Test-IgwtCatalog) -join "`n")
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.bad-hint: hint is 141 characters'
        $errors | Should -Match "input.bad-desc: missing 'description'"
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.bad-level: level must be Standard, Advanced, Expert or Lab'
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.bad-ac: antiCheat must be'
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.bad-breaks: an item that breaks anti-cheat must be level Lab'
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.bad-rev: reversible must be full, partial or none'
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.bad-partial: items that are not fully reversible must describe it in sideEffects'
        $errors | Should -Match "input.bad-winutil: WinUtil-derived items need an 'attribution'"
        $errors | Should -Match "input.bad-tag: unknown hardware tag 'gpu.voodoo'"
        $errors | Should -Match "input.bad-cond: unknown appliesTo condition 'moonPhase'"
        $errors | Should -Match "input.bad-legacy: v1 field 'antiCheatSafe' is not used in schema v2"
        $errors | Should -Match 'input.bad-expert: Expert and Lab items need a warning text'
    }
}

Describe 'v1 to v2 data migration' {
    BeforeAll {
        $script:V1 = New-V1DataCopy
        $script:RawV1 = @(Get-RawTweaks $script:V1)
        $script:Report = @(Convert-IgwtDataToV2 -DataFolder $script:V1)
        $script:RawV2 = @(Get-RawTweaks $script:V1)
    }
    AfterEach { Set-IgwtEnvironment -DataFolder '' }

    It 'converts every v1 tweak and preset file' {
        $script:Report.Count | Should -Be 10
        foreach ($r in $script:Report) { $r.FromSchema | Should -Be 1 -Because $r.File; $r.Changed | Should -BeTrue -Because $r.File }
        @($script:Report | Where-Object { $_.Kind -eq 'preset' }).Count | Should -Be 3
    }
    It 'is idempotent' {
        $again = @(Convert-IgwtDataToV2 -DataFolder $script:V1)
        @($again | Where-Object { $_.Changed }) | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
        foreach ($r in $again) { $r.FromSchema | Should -Be 2 }
    }
    It 'keeps every id and every action unchanged, so snapshot fingerprints stay valid' {
        $script:RawV2.Count | Should -Be $script:RawV1.Count
        foreach ($old in $script:RawV1) {
            $new = $script:RawV2 | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $old.id }
            $new | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty -Because $old.id
            ($new.actions | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress) | Should -Be ($old.actions | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress) -Because $old.id
            (Get-Fingerprints $new) | Should -Be (Get-Fingerprints $old) -Because $old.id
            foreach ($k in 'name', 'category', 'hint', 'description', 'risk', 'requires') { $new.$k | Should -Be $old.$k -Because "$($old.id).$k" }
        }
    }
    It 'maps the v1 fields to v2 fields' {
        foreach ($t in $script:RawV2) {
            $t.PSObject.Properties['antiCheatSafe'] | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
            $t.PSObject.Properties['expert'] | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
            $t.reversible | Should -Be 'full'
            $t.source | Should -Be 'igwt'
            $t.sideEffects | Should -Be ''
            @($t.hardware.tags).Count | Should -Be 0
            $t.appliesTo.minBuild | Should -Be 26100
        }
        $get = { param($id) $script:RawV2 | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $id } }
        $lab = & $get 'sec.vbs-hvci-off-expert'
        $lab.level | Should -Be 'Lab'
        @($lab.antiCheat.breaks) | Should -Be @('FACEIT', 'Riot Vanguard')
        (& $get 'sched.global-timer-resolution').level | Should -Be 'Expert'
        (& $get 'sched.global-timer-resolution').antiCheat | Should -Be 'safe'
        foreach ($t in $script:RawV2 | Where-Object { $_.level -eq 'Standard' }) { $t.evidence.tier | Should -Be 'A'; $t.risk | Should -Be 'low' }
        foreach ($t in $script:RawV1 | Where-Object { -not $_.expert -and $_.evidence.tier -eq 'B' }) { (& $get $t.id).level | Should -Be 'Advanced' -Because $t.id }
    }
    It 'moves appliesTo.hardware checks to appliesTo.conditions' {
        foreach ($old in $script:RawV1 | Where-Object { $_.appliesTo.hardware }) {
            $new = $script:RawV2 | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $old.id }
            foreach ($p in $old.appliesTo.hardware.PSObject.Properties) {
                $expected = $p.Name
                if ($expected -eq 'defender') { $expected = 'defenderActive' }
                @($new.appliesTo.conditions) | Should -Contain $expected -Because $old.id
            }
        }
        @(($script:RawV2 | Where-Object { $_.id -eq 'net.eee-off' }).appliesTo.conditions) | Should -Contain 'wiredAdapter'
    }
    It 'turns v1 presets into intent presets with the same members' {
        foreach ($name in 'competitive', 'balanced', 'hardened') {
            $old = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:Fixture "data\presets\$name.json") -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
            $new = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:V1 "presets\$name.json") -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
            $new.schemaVersion | Should -Be 2
            @($new.include) | Should -Be @($old.tweaks)
            @($new.exclude).Count | Should -Be 0
            $new.levelCeiling | Should -Be 'Advanced'
            $new.antiCheatPolicy | Should -Be 'safeOnly'
            $new.gaming | Should -BeTrue
            $new.hint.Length | Should -BeLessOrEqual 140
            $new.hint | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty
        }
    }
    It 'passes v2 validation after migration' {
        Set-IgwtEnvironment -DataFolder $script:V1
        # The kernel inspector data links to 2.0 catalog items, so a v1 folder ships without it.
        @(Test-IgwtCatalog | Where-Object { $_ -notlike 'inspectors\kernel.json: missing*' -and $_ -notlike 'manage\*.json: missing.' }) | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
        (Get-IgwtPreset -Name 'balanced').tweaks.Count | Should -Be 35
    }
    It 'still loads unmigrated v1 files by upgrading them in memory' {
        $raw = New-V1DataCopy
        Set-IgwtEnvironment -DataFolder $raw
        $cat = @(Get-IgwtCatalog -Force)
        $cat.Count | Should -Be 65
        $vbs = $cat | Where-Object { $_.id -eq 'sec.vbs-hvci-off-expert' }
        $vbs.level | Should -Be 'Lab'
        $vbs.expert | Should -BeTrue
        $vbs.antiCheatSafe | Should -BeFalse
        ($cat | Where-Object { $_.id -eq 'net.eee-off' }).appliesTo.conditions | Should -Contain 'wiredAdapter'
        (Get-IgwtPreset -Name 'competitive').tweaks.Count | Should -Be 44
        $errors = (@(Test-IgwtCatalog) -join "`n")
        $errors | Should -Match 'schemaVersion 1; run tools\\Convert-IgwtV1Data.ps1'
        $errors | Should -Not -Match 'hint is|antiCheat must be|level must be'
    }
    It 'applies renamed ids from the id map to presets' {
        $copy = New-V1DataCopy
        $map = Join-Path $copy 'migration\id-map.json'
        '{ "schemaVersion": 2, "renamed": { "gfx.game-mode": "gfx.game-mode-renamed" } }' | Set-Content -LiteralPath $map -Encoding ASCII
        $null = Convert-IgwtDataToV2 -DataFolder $copy
        $p = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $copy 'presets\balanced.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        @($p.include) | Should -Contain 'gfx.game-mode-renamed'
        @($p.include) | Should -Not -Contain 'gfx.game-mode'
    }
    It 'upgrades pre-v2 cleaner rules with conservative values' {
        $rules = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner {
            @(
                ConvertTo-IgwtV2CleanerRule -Rule ([pscustomobject]@{ id = 'clean.a'; method = 'files'; roots = @('%TEMP%') })
                ConvertTo-IgwtV2CleanerRule -Rule ([pscustomobject]@{ id = 'clean.b'; method = 'files'; recycle = $true; sources = @('https://learn.microsoft.com/x') })
                ConvertTo-IgwtV2CleanerRule -Rule ([pscustomobject]@{ id = 'clean.c'; method = 'guidance' })
                ConvertTo-IgwtV2CleanerRule -Rule ([pscustomobject]@{ id = 'clean.d'; method = 'files'; reversible = 'none'; tier = 'A'; level = 'Expert' })
            )
        }
        $rules[0].tier | Should -Be 'B'; $rules[0].reversible | Should -Be 'none'; $rules[0].antiCheat | Should -Be 'safe'; $rules[0].level | Should -Be 'Standard'
        $rules[1].tier | Should -Be 'A'; $rules[1].reversible | Should -Be 'partial'
        $rules[2].reversible | Should -Be 'full'
        $rules[3].tier | Should -Be 'A'; $rules[3].level | Should -Be 'Expert'
        foreach ($r in $rules) { $r.source | Should -Be 'igwt'; @($r.hardware.tags).Count | Should -Be 0 }
    }
}

Describe 'Data file JSON writer' {
    It 'round-trips every migrated data file and keeps it ASCII' {
        foreach ($f in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $script:RepoData -Recurse -Filter *.json | Where-Object { $_.Directory.Name -in 'tweaks', 'presets', 'cleaner', 'asr' })) {
            $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f.FullName)
            $doc = $text | ConvertFrom-Json
            $again = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ D = $doc } { param($D) ConvertTo-IgwtJson -InputObject $D }
            $again | Should -Be $text -Because $f.Name
            $text | Should -Not -Match '[^\x00-\x7F]' -Because $f.Name
            $text | Should -Not -Match '\\u003c' -Because "$($f.Name) keeps <absent> readable"
        }
    }
    It 'escapes quotes, backslashes, control and non-ASCII characters' {
        $value = [pscustomobject]@{ s = ('a"b\c' + "`n`t" + [char]0xE9 + [char]0x1F + '<absent>'); n = 42; d = 1.5; b = $false; z = $null; e = @(); o = [pscustomobject]@{} }
        $json = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ V = $value } { param($V) ConvertTo-IgwtJson -InputObject $V }
        $json | Should -Match '\\u00e9'
        $json | Should -Match '<absent>'
        $back = $json | ConvertFrom-Json
        $back.s | Should -BeExactly $value.s
        $back.n | Should -Be 42
        $back.d | Should -Be 1.5
        $back.b | Should -BeFalse
        $back.z | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
        @($back.e).Count | Should -Be 0
    }
}

Describe 'v1 snapshots after migration' {
    BeforeAll {
        $script:SnapName = 'snapshot-20261017-010119-000-Apply-v1fix.json'
        $script:Backups = Get-IgwtDataPath -Kind Backups
        $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $script:Backups -Force
        $script:SnapPath = Join-Path $script:Backups $script:SnapName
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:Fixture $script:SnapName) -Destination $script:SnapPath -Force
        $script:SnapHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $script:SnapPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
        $script:Ctx = New-IgwtTestContext

        function Write-TestValue([string]$Path, [string]$Name, [string]$Kind, $Value) {
            InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ P = $Path; N = $Name; K = $Kind; V = $Value } { param($P, $N, $K, $V) Set-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $P -Name $N -Kind $K -Value $V }
        }
        function Get-TestValue([string]$Path, [string]$Name) {
            InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ P = $Path; N = $Name } { param($P, $N) Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $P -Name $N }
        }
        # The state right after the 1.0 apply that wrote the fixture snapshot.
        function Write-AfterApplyState {
            Write-TestValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseSpeed' -Kind 'String' -Value '0'
            Write-TestValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseThreshold1' -Kind 'String' -Value '0'
            Write-TestValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseThreshold2' -Kind 'String' -Value '0'
            Write-TestValue -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences' -Name 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings' -Kind 'String' -Value 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1;'
            Write-TestValue -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\GameBar' -Name 'AutoGameModeEnabled' -Kind 'DWord' -Value 1
            Write-TestValue -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' -Name 'NoDriveTypeAutoRun' -Kind 'DWord' -Value 255
            Write-TestValue -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' -Name 'NoAutorun' -Kind 'DWord' -Value 1
        }
    }

    It 'reads the schema 1 file as schema 2 in memory and leaves the file unchanged' {
        $doc = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ P = $script:SnapPath } { param($P) Read-IgwtSnapshot -Path $P }
        $doc.schema | Should -Be 2
        $doc.migratedFrom | Should -Be 1
        $doc.catalogSchema | Should -Be 1
        @($doc.entries).Count | Should -Be 4
        foreach ($e in $doc.entries) { $e.level | Should -Be 'Standard' -Because $e.tweakId }
        (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $script:SnapPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash | Should -Be $script:SnapHash
        $listed = @(Get-IgwtSnapshotList | Where-Object { $_.File -eq $script:SnapName })
        @($listed[0].Applied | Sort-Object) | Should -Be @('gfx.game-mode', 'gfx.windowed-optimizations', 'input.pointer-precision-off', 'sec.autorun-off')
    }
    It 'refuses snapshot schemas it does not know' {
        $bad = Join-Path $TestDrive 'snapshot-bad-schema.json'
        (Get-Content -LiteralPath $script:SnapPath -Raw).Replace('"schema":  1', '"schema":  3') | Set-Content -LiteralPath $bad -Encoding UTF8
        { InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ P = $bad } { param($P) Read-IgwtSnapshot -Path $P } } | Should -Throw '*unsupported format*'
    }
    It 'reverts one tweak from the v1 snapshot by id' {
        Write-AfterApplyState
        $r = Invoke-IgwtRevert -Id 'gfx.game-mode' -Context $script:Ctx
        @($r.Results | Where-Object Result -EQ 'Reverted').Id | Should -Be 'gfx.game-mode'
        $v = Get-TestValue 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\GameBar' 'AutoGameModeEnabled'
        $v.Kind | Should -Be 'DWord'; $v.Value | Should -Be 0
    }
    It 'reverts every entry of the v1 snapshot to the exact captured values' {
        Write-AfterApplyState
        $r = Invoke-IgwtRevert -SnapshotPath $script:SnapPath -Context $script:Ctx
        @($r.Results | Where-Object Result -EQ 'Reverted').Count | Should -Be 4
        @($r.Results | Where-Object Result -EQ 'Failed') | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
        foreach ($m in @(@('MouseSpeed', '1'), @('MouseThreshold1', '6'), @('MouseThreshold2', '10'))) {
            $v = Get-TestValue 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' $m[0]
            $v.Kind | Should -Be 'String'; $v.Value | Should -Be $m[1]
        }
        (Get-TestValue 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences' 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings').Value | Should -Be 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;'
        (Get-TestValue 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\GameBar' 'AutoGameModeEnabled').Value | Should -Be 0
        (Get-TestValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' 'NoDriveTypeAutoRun').Exists | Should -BeFalse
        (Get-TestValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' 'NoAutorun').Exists | Should -BeFalse
        $revert = Get-Content -LiteralPath $r.Snapshot -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        $revert.schema | Should -Be 2
        foreach ($e in $revert.entries) { $e.level | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty }
    }
    It 'writes schema 2 copies elsewhere that keep the captured data and revert the same way' {
        $out = Join-Path $TestDrive 'snapcopies'
        $copy = Convert-IgwtSnapshotToV2 -Path $script:SnapPath -Destination $out
        { Convert-IgwtSnapshotToV2 -Path $script:SnapPath -Destination $script:Backups } | Should -Throw '*Refusing to overwrite*'
        $old = Get-Content -LiteralPath $script:SnapPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        $new = Get-Content -LiteralPath $copy -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        $new.schema | Should -Be 2
        $new.migratedFrom | Should -Be 1
        foreach ($e in $old.entries) {
            $n = $new.entries | Where-Object { $_.tweakId -eq $e.tweakId }
            ($n.actions | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress) | Should -Be ($e.actions | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress) -Because $e.tweakId
        }
        Write-AfterApplyState
        $r = Invoke-IgwtRevert -SnapshotPath $copy -Context $script:Ctx
        @($r.Results | Where-Object Result -EQ 'Reverted').Count | Should -Be 4
        (Get-TestValue 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' 'MouseSpeed').Value | Should -Be '1'
    }
    It 'maps renamed ids when it upgrades a v1 snapshot' {
        $doc = Get-Content -LiteralPath $script:SnapPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        $up = InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner -Parameters @{ D = $doc } { param($D) ConvertTo-IgwtV2Snapshot -Document $D -Catalog @() -IdMap @{ 'gfx.game-mode' = 'gfx.game-mode-renamed' } }
        $e = $up.entries | Where-Object { $_.originalTweakId -eq 'gfx.game-mode' }
        $e.tweakId | Should -Be 'gfx.game-mode-renamed'
        $e.actions[0].fingerprint | Should -Be 'registry|path=HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\GameBar|name=AutoGameModeEnabled'
    }
}
```
