`tests/TestHelpers.ps1`:

```ps1
# TestHelpers.ps1
# Shared setup for the iG Windows Tuner Pester 5 suite.
# Safety: tests never touch the real HKLM/HKCU. Every registry path is redirected into Pester's
# TestRegistry: drive, and the engine's TestMode throws if any path escapes the redirect.
# External executables (powercfg, nvidia-smi) throw in TestMode unless mocked, and all
# system-changing cmdlets (Defender, NetAdapter, NetQos, DNS, services) are mocked per test.
# The suite refuses to run elevated on a real machine so an unmocked call cannot change anything.

$script:IgwtProjectRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot

function Assert-IgwtTestNotElevated {
    $principal = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal([Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent())
    if ($principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator) -and -not $env:IGWT_ALLOW_ELEVATED_TESTS) {
        throw 'Run the iG Windows Tuner tests from a NON-elevated PowerShell (set IGWT_ALLOW_ELEVATED_TESTS=1 only inside Windows Sandbox).'
    }
}

function Initialize-IgwtTestEnvironment {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Imports the module and redirects all registry access into TestRegistry:. Call from BeforeAll. #>
    Assert-IgwtTestNotElevated
    Import-Module (Join-Path $script:IgwtProjectRoot 'src\iGWindowsTuner.psd1') -Force
    $null = New-Item -Path 'TestRegistry:\HKLM' -Force
    $null = New-Item -Path 'TestRegistry:\HKCU' -Force
    $redirect = [ordered]@{ 'HKLM:\' = 'TestRegistry:\HKLM\'; 'HKCU:\' = 'TestRegistry:\HKCU\' }
    Set-IgwtEnvironment -TestMode -DataRoot (Join-Path $TestDrive 'IgwtData') -RegistryRedirect $redirect
}

function New-IgwtTestContext {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Engine context with no real adapters or games (tests add what they need). #>
    [Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions', '', Justification = 'Builds or refreshes in-memory objects only; changes no system state.')]
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([hashtable]$Extra = @{})
    $o = @{ IsAdmin = $true; Build = 26300; EditionId = 'Professional'; IsRdp = $false; WiredAdapters = @(); Games = @(); GpuCount = 1; HasNvidia = $true; HybridCpu = $true; DefenderActive = $true }
    foreach ($k in $Extra.Keys) { $o[$k] = $Extra[$k] }
    return (New-IgwtContext -Override $o)
}

function New-IgwtTestTweak {
    <# .SYNOPSIS Minimal normalized (schema v2) tweak object for engine tests, including the computed expert/antiCheatSafe/tier properties. #>
    [Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions', '', Justification = 'Builds or refreshes in-memory objects only; changes no system state.')]
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([string]$Id, [object[]]$Actions, [string]$Requires = 'none', [int]$Order = 50, [switch]$Expert, [string[]]$ConflictsWith = @())
    $level = 'Standard'
    if ($Expert) { $level = 'Expert' }
    $t = [pscustomobject]@{
        id = $Id; name = "Test $Id"; category = 'Security'; level = $level; hint = 'test'; description = 'test (measure)'
        evidence = [pscustomobject]@{ tier = 'A'; sources = @('https://learn.microsoft.com/'); notes = '' }
        impact = [pscustomobject]@{ performance = 'none'; latency = 'none'; security = '0' }
        risk = 'low'; antiCheat = 'safe'; reversible = 'full'; sideEffects = ''; requires = $Requires; order = $Order; warning = 'w'
        source = 'igwt'; attribution = ''; hardware = [pscustomobject]@{ tags = @(); excludeTags = @() }
        conflictsWith = $ConflictsWith; status = 'Active'; statusReason = ''; policyKeys = @(); postApply = $null; group = ''; revertNote = ''
        appliesTo = [pscustomobject]@{ minBuild = 26100; conditions = @() }
        actions = @($Actions | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]$_ })
        expert = [bool]$Expert; antiCheatSafe = $true; antiCheatText = 'Anti-cheat safe'; tier = 'A'
    }
    return $t
}
```

`tests/Xaml.Tests.ps1`:

```ps1
BeforeAll {
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'TestHelpers.ps1')
    Initialize-IgwtTestEnvironment
}

Describe 'GUI XAML (headless)' {
    It 'Theme.xaml and MainWindow.xaml are well-formed XML' {
        $dir = Join-Path $script:IgwtProjectRoot 'src\Gui'
        { [xml](Get-Content (Join-Path $dir 'Theme.xaml') -Raw) } | Should -Not -Throw
        { [xml](Get-Content (Join-Path $dir 'MainWindow.xaml') -Raw) } | Should -Not -Throw
    }

    It 'parses into a WPF Window with every named control the GUI uses' {
        if ([System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.GetApartmentState() -ne 'STA') { Set-ItResult -Skipped -Because 'WPF parsing requires an STA thread (powershell.exe default).'; return }
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner {
            $w = New-IgwtMainWindow
            $w | Should -BeOfType System.Windows.Window
            foreach ($n in $script:IgwtGuiControlNames) { $w.FindName($n) | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty -Because "control $n" }
            $w.MinWidth | Should -Be 1100
            $w.MinHeight | Should -Be 720
        }
    }

    It 'defines the theme resources referenced by the window' {
        if ([System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.GetApartmentState() -ne 'STA') { Set-ItResult -Skipped -Because 'STA required'; return }
        InModuleScope iGWindowsTuner {
            $w = New-IgwtMainWindow
            foreach ($k in 'BrushBackground', 'BrushAccent', 'ToggleSwitch', 'AccentButton', 'NavItem', 'RowItem', 'Card', 'Badge', 'FontIcons') {
                $w.FindResource($k) | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty -Because $k
            }
        }
    }

    It 'runs only exported module commands in the background worker' {
        $gui = Get-Content (Join-Path $script:IgwtProjectRoot 'src\Gui\Gui.ps1') -Raw
        $commands = @([regex]::Matches($gui, "Start-IgwtGuiJob -Command '([^']+)'") | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value } | Select-Object -Unique)
        $commands | Should -Contain 'Invoke-IgwtCleanerScan'
        $commands | Should -Contain 'Invoke-IgwtCleanerClean'
        $commands | Should -Contain 'Get-IgwtDiskUsage'
        $exported = @((Get-Module iGWindowsTuner).ExportedFunctions.Keys)
        foreach ($cmd in $commands) { $cmd | Should -BeIn $exported -Because "the worker runspace can only call exported commands ($cmd)" }
    }

    It 'gives every navigation entry a tooltip' {
        $xaml = [xml](Get-Content (Join-Path $script:IgwtProjectRoot 'src\Gui\MainWindow.xaml') -Raw)
        $ns = New-Object System.Xml.XmlNamespaceManager($xaml.NameTable)
        $ns.AddNamespace('w', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation')
        $items = @($xaml.SelectNodes("//w:ListBox[@*[local-name()='Name']='NavList']/w:ListBoxItem", $ns))
        $items.Count | Should -BeGreaterThan 10
        foreach ($i in $items) { $i.GetAttribute('ToolTip') | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty -Because $i.GetAttribute('Tag') }
        @($items | ForEach-Object { $_.GetAttribute('Tag') }) | Should -Contain 'Cleaner'
        @($items | ForEach-Object { $_.GetAttribute('Tag') }) | Should -Contain 'Storage'
        @($items | ForEach-Object { $_.GetAttribute('Tag') }) | Should -Contain 'Disk'
    }

    It 'gives every button, checkbox, combo box and text box a tooltip' {
        $xaml = [xml](Get-Content (Join-Path $script:IgwtProjectRoot 'src\Gui\MainWindow.xaml') -Raw)
        $ns = New-Object System.Xml.XmlNamespaceManager($xaml.NameTable)
        $ns.AddNamespace('w', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation')
        $controls = @($xaml.SelectNodes('//w:Button | //w:CheckBox | //w:ComboBox | //w:TextBox', $ns))
        $controls.Count | Should -BeGreaterThan 30
        foreach ($ctl in $controls) {
            $label = '{0} {1}{2}' -f $ctl.LocalName, $ctl.GetAttribute('Name', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml'), $ctl.GetAttribute('Content')
            $ctl.GetAttribute('ToolTip') | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty -Because $label
        }
    }

    It 'uses only inbox fonts and no external assets' {
        $dir = Join-Path $script:IgwtProjectRoot 'src\Gui'
        $text = (Get-ChildItem $dir -Filter *.xaml | ForEach-Object { Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw }) -join "`n"
        $text | Should -Not -Match '(?i)(https?://(?!schemas\.microsoft\.com))'
        $text | Should -Not -Match '(?i)\.(png|jpg|ico|gif)\b'
        $text | Should -Match 'Segoe Fluent Icons'
    }
}
```

`tools/Build-Docs.ps1`:

```ps1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Generates docs\TWEAKS.md, docs\PRESETS.md and docs\REJECTED_TWEAKS.md from the data files.
.DESCRIPTION
    The catalog (data\tweaks\*.json), presets and data\rejected.json are the single source of
    truth; these three documents are regenerated from them and should not be edited by hand.
.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\Build-Docs.ps1
#>
[CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
param()
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
Import-Module (Join-Path $root 'src\iGWindowsTuner.psd1') -Force
$docs = Join-Path $root 'docs'
$catalog = @(Get-IgwtCatalog -Force)
$presets = @(Get-IgwtPreset)
$rejected = @(Get-IgwtRejectedTweaks)
$categories = @('Power & CPU', 'Graphics & Display', 'Input', 'Network', 'Background & Privacy', 'Storage', 'Security', 'System')
$nl = "`r`n"

function ConvertTo-MdCell([string]$Text) { return ($Text -replace '\|', '\|' -replace "`r?`n", ' ') }

function Format-Code([string]$Text) { return ([char]96 + $Text + [char]96) }

function Format-DocAction($a) {
    $c = { param($x) Format-Code ([string]$x) }
    switch ($a.type) {
        'registry' {
            $on = [string]$a.on
            if ($null -ne $a.bitClear) { $on = ('clear bit 0x{0:X} (e.g. {1})' -f [int]$a.bitClear, $a.on) }
            $s = 'Registry {0} = {1} ({2}); Windows default {3}' -f (& $c "$($a.path)\$($a.name)"), (& $c $on), $a.valueType, (& $c $a.default)
            if ($null -ne $a.absentValue) { $s += '; absent means ' + (& $c $a.absentValue) }
            if ($a.onlyIfAbsent) { $s += '; only written when missing' }
            return $s
        }
        'adapterRegistry' { return ('Registry (active wired adapter) {0} = {1} ({2}); default {3}' -f (& $c "$($a.path)\$($a.name)"), (& $c $a.on), $a.valueType, (& $c $a.default)) }
        'netAdapterPower' { return ('Active wired adapter driver key {0} = {1} ("allow the computer to turn off this device" cleared); default {2}' -f (& $c 'PnPCapabilities'), (& $c '24'), (& $c '0')) }
        'registryListMerge' { return ('Merge {0} into {1} (other items preserved); default {2}' -f (& $c "$($a.item)=$($a.on)"), (& $c "$($a.path)\$($a.name)"), (& $c $a.default)) }
        'powercfgScheme' { return ('Activate power scheme {0} (revert re-activates the previous scheme)' -f (& $c $a.scheme)) }
        'powercfgSetting' {
            $s = 'Active plan: {0} ({1} / {2}) AC = {3}' -f $a.label, (& $c $a.subgroup), (& $c $a.setting), (& $c $a.ac)
            if ($null -ne $a.dc) { $s += ', DC = ' + (& $c $a.dc) }
            return ($s + "; default from the plan's DefaultPowerSchemeValues")
        }
        'service' {
            $stop = ''
            if ($a.stop) { $stop = ' and stop it' }
            return ('Service {0} startup {1}{2}; Windows default {3}' -f (& $c $a.name), (& $c $a.startupType), $stop, (& $c $a.default))
        }
        'netAdapterAdvanced' {
            $fb = ''
            if (@($a.fallback).Count) { $fb = '; fallback only if the keyword is missing: ' + (@($a.fallback | ForEach-Object { "'{0}' = '{1}'" -f $_.displayName, $_.displayValue }) -join ', ') }
            return ('Adapter advanced property {0} = {1} (no adapter restart){2}; default {3}' -f (& $c $a.keyword), (& $c $a.on), $fb, (& $c $a.default))
        }
        'netQosPolicy' { return ('Policy-based QoS {0}: DSCP {1} for {2} traffic of games marked qos in games.json' -f (& $c "$($a.namePrefix)<game>"), (& $c $a.dscp), (& $c $a.protocol)) }
        'dnsDoh' { return ('DNS servers of the active wired adapter set to {0} with DoH auto-upgrade (fallback to plain DNS: {1}); revert restores DHCP/static servers and DoH entries' -f $a.provider, [bool]$a.allowFallbackToUdp) }
        'mpPreference' { return ('{0}; Windows default {1}' -f (& $c "Set-MpPreference -$($a.setting) $($a.on)"), (& $c $a.default)) }
        'asrRule' { return ('ASR rule {0} ({1}) = {2}; default not configured' -f (& $c $a.id), $a.label, (& $c $a.on)) }
        'optionalFeature' { return ('Optional feature {0} = {1}; default {2}' -f (& $c $a.feature), (& $c $a.on), (& $c $a.default)) }
        'custom' {
            $map = @{
                UltimatePlan      = 'Duplicate {0} (or reuse an existing Ultimate copy) and activate it; revert re-activates the previous plan and deletes only a copy iG Windows Tuner created' -f (& $c 'e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61')
                Hibernate         = '{0}; revert {1} if it was enabled' -f (& $c 'powercfg /hibernate off'), (& $c '/hibernate on')
                TcpAutoTuning     = '{0} if not Normal; revert restores the previous level' -f (& $c 'Set-NetTCPSetting -SettingName Internet -AutoTuningLevelLocal Normal')
                FirewallProfiles  = '{0}; revert restores each profile' -f (& $c 'Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain,Private,Public -Enabled True -DefaultInboundAction Block')
                WifiAdapter       = '{0} for physical Wi-Fi adapters that are not connected; revert re-enables them' -f (& $c 'Disable-NetAdapter')
                GameGpuPreference = 'Merge {0} into {1} for detected games' -f (& $c 'GpuPreference=2'), (& $c 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences\<game exe path>')
                CfaAllowGames     = '{0} for detected games; revert removes only what was added' -f (& $c 'Add-MpPreference -ControlledFolderAccessAllowedApplications <game exe>')
            }
            return $map[[string]$a.handler]
        }
        'check' {
            if ($a.checker -eq 'DefaultApp') { return ('Reads the default app for {0} (expects {1}); change it in Settings > Apps > Default apps' -f (& $c "$($a.extension)$($a.protocol)"), (& $c $a.progId)) }
            return ('Verifies at runtime: {0} (Win32_DeviceGuard)' -f (& $c $a.checker))
        }
        { $_ -in 'storageSense', 'wufbPolicy' } {
            $parts = @(& (Get-Module iGWindowsTuner) { param($x) Get-IgwtCompositeParts -Action $x } $a)
            return (@($parts | ForEach-Object { 'Policy {0} = {1} ({2}); Windows default {3}' -f (& $c "$($_.Action.path)\$($_.Action.name)"), (& $c $_.Action.on), $_.Action.valueType, (& $c $_.Action.default) }) -join '; ')
        }
        'serviceSet' { return ('Services {0} startup type {1}; Windows defaults {2}' -f (@($a.services | ForEach-Object { & $c $_.name }) -join ', '), (@($a.services | ForEach-Object { $_.startupType } | Select-Object -Unique) -join '/'), (@($a.services | ForEach-Object { "$($_.name)=$($_.default)" }) -join ', ')) }
        'deviceInterrupt' {
            $set = @('msiSupported', 'messageNumberLimit', 'devicePolicy', 'devicePriority' | Where-Object { $null -ne $a.$_ } | ForEach-Object { "$_=$($a.$_)" })
            return ('Interrupt settings {0} of present PCI {1} devices (Interrupt Management registry keys); the driver default is restored from the snapshot' -f ($set -join ', '), $a.deviceClass)
        }
        'powercfgAttribute' { return ('Power setting {0} {1} in Power Options (powercfg -attributes); default {2}' -f (& $c "$($a.subgroup)/$($a.setting)"), $(if ($a.visible) { 'shown' } else { 'hidden' }), $a.default) }
        'powercfgSettingAcDc' { return ('Active plan: {0} ({1} / {2}) AC = {3}, DC = {4}' -f $a.label, (& $c $a.subgroup), (& $c $a.setting), (& $c $a.ac), (& $c $a.dc)) }
        'scheduledTask' { return ('Scheduled task {0} {1}; Windows default {2}' -f (& $c "$($a.path)$($a.name)"), $a.on, $a.default) }
        'firewallRule' {
            if ($a.rule) { return ('Windows Firewall block rule {0} ({1}{2}{3}) in group iG Windows Tuner; revert removes it' -f (& $c $a.rule), $a.direction, $(if ($a.protocol) { " $($a.protocol)" }), $(if ($a.localPort) { " port $($a.localPort)" })) }
            return ('Disables the Windows Firewall rule group {0}{1}; revert restores each rule' -f (& $c $a.displayGroup), $(if ($a.direction) { " ($($a.direction))" }))
        }
        'appx' { return ('Removes app {0} for the current user{1}; revert re-registers it or reinstalls it from the Store' -f (& $c $a.package), $(if ($a.provisioned) { ' and its provisioned copy' })) }
        'winget' { return ('winget package {0} {1} (source {2})' -f (& $c $a.id), $a.on, $(if ($a.source) { $a.source } else { 'winget' })) }
        'capability' { return ('Windows capability {0} {1}; default {2}' -f (& $c $a.name), $a.on, $a.default) }
        'processMitigation' { return ('Exploit protection {0} = {1} for {2}; default not set' -f (& $c $a.mitigation), $a.on, (& $c $a.process)) }
        'exploitSystem' { return ('System-wide exploit protection {0} = {1}; default not set' -f (& $c $a.mitigation), $a.on) }
        'cleanerRule' { return ('Runs cleaner rule {0} (scan, then clean only what the scan found); deleted files cannot be restored' -f (& $c $a.rule)) }
    }
}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ TWEAKS.md
$sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
$null = $sb.Append("# iG Windows Tuner tweak catalog$nl$nl")
$null = $sb.Append("> Generated by ``tools\Build-Docs.ps1`` from ``data\tweaks\*.json``. Do not edit by hand.$nl$nl")
$null = $sb.Append("$($catalog.Count) tweaks: $(@($catalog | Where-Object { $_.evidence.tier -eq 'A' }).Count) Tier A (documented by Microsoft or the vendor), $(@($catalog | Where-Object { $_.evidence.tier -eq 'B' }).Count) Tier B (situational; measure before and after). Presets: C = Competitive, B = Balanced, H = Hardened.$nl$nl")
$null = $sb.Append("Levels: $(@('Standard', 'Advanced', 'Expert', 'Lab' | ForEach-Object { $lv = $_; "$(@($catalog | Where-Object { $_.level -eq $lv }).Count) $lv" }) -join ', '). Standard is for everyone; Advanced is for power users; Expert needs an acknowledgement; Lab items knowingly break something (anti-cheat, a security feature) and are never in a preset.$nl$nl")
$null = $sb.Append("| Category | Tier A | Tier B | Total |$nl|---|---|---|---|$nl")
foreach ($c in $categories) {
    $in = @($catalog | Where-Object { $_.category -eq $c })
    $null = $sb.Append("| $c | $(@($in | Where-Object { $_.evidence.tier -eq 'A' }).Count) | $(@($in | Where-Object { $_.evidence.tier -eq 'B' }).Count) | $($in.Count) |$nl")
}
$null = $sb.Append($nl)
foreach ($c in $categories) {
    $null = $sb.Append("## $c$nl$nl| Id | Name | Level | Tier | Risk | Restart | Presets | Anti-cheat |$nl|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|$nl")
    foreach ($t in ($catalog | Where-Object { $_.category -eq $c })) {
        $p = (@($presets | Where-Object { $_.tweaks -contains $t.id } | ForEach-Object { $_.name.Substring(0, 1) }) -join '')
        if (-not $p) { $p = '-' }
        $null = $sb.Append("| ``$($t.id)`` | $(ConvertTo-MdCell $t.name) | $($t.level) | $($t.evidence.tier) | $($t.risk) | $($t.requires) | $p | $(if ($t.antiCheatSafe) { 'safe' } else { "**$($t.antiCheatText)**" }) |$nl")
    }
    $null = $sb.Append($nl)
    foreach ($t in ($catalog | Where-Object { $_.category -eq $c })) {
        $null = $sb.Append("### $($t.name)$nl$nl")
        $null = $sb.Append("``$($t.id)`` | $($t.level) | Tier $($t.evidence.tier) | risk $($t.risk) | restart: $($t.requires) | $($t.antiCheatText) | reversible: $($t.reversible) | impact: performance $($t.impact.performance), latency $($t.impact.latency), security $($t.impact.security)$nl$nl")
        if ($t.sideEffects) { $null = $sb.Append("**Side effects:** $($t.sideEffects)$nl$nl") }
        if ($t.warning) { $null = $sb.Append("> **Warning:** $($t.warning)$nl$nl") }
        $null = $sb.Append("*$($t.hint)*$nl$nl$($t.description)$nl$nl**Changes**$nl$nl")
        foreach ($a in $t.actions) { $null = $sb.Append("- $(Format-DocAction $a)$nl") }
        $null = $sb.Append("$nl**Sources**$nl$nl")
        foreach ($s in $t.evidence.sources) { $null = $sb.Append("- <$s>$nl") }
        if ($t.evidence.notes) { $null = $sb.Append("$nl*Evidence notes:* $($t.evidence.notes)$nl") }
        $null = $sb.Append("$nl**Revert:** $(Get-IgwtTweakRevertDescription -Tweak $t)$nl$nl")
    }
}
$tweaksPath = Join-Path $docs 'TWEAKS.md'
if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($tweaksPath, 'Write')) { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($tweaksPath, $sb.ToString(), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))) }

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ PRESETS.md
$sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
$null = $sb.Append("# iG Windows Tuner presets$nl$nl> Generated by ``tools\Build-Docs.ps1`` from ``data\presets\*.json``. Do not edit by hand.$nl$nl")
$null = $sb.Append("Choosing a preset stages only the tweaks whose current state differs; you can untick items before applying. Expert toggles and anything that is not anti-cheat safe are never part of a preset.$nl$nl")
$null = $sb.Append("| Preset | Tweaks | Tier A | Tier B | Needs reboot | Needs sign-out |$nl|---|---|---|---|---|---|$nl")
foreach ($p in $presets) {
    $m = @($catalog | Where-Object { $p.tweaks -contains $_.id })
    $null = $sb.Append("| $($p.name) | $($m.Count) | $(@($m | Where-Object { $_.evidence.tier -eq 'A' }).Count) | $(@($m | Where-Object { $_.evidence.tier -eq 'B' }).Count) | $(@($m | Where-Object { $_.requires -eq 'reboot' }).Count) | $(@($m | Where-Object { $_.requires -eq 'logoff' }).Count) |$nl")
}
foreach ($p in $presets) {
    $null = $sb.Append("$nl## $($p.name): $($p.tagline)$nl$nl*$($p.hint)*$nl$nl$($p.description)$nl$nl")

    }

        'Allow-list only: a file is deleted only if its canonical path lies strictly inside one of the rule''s roots, and the roots are resolved again at clean time.',
        'Paths are canonicalized (`..`, 8.3 short names) before any check; relative, UNC and device paths are refused.',
        'A hard denylist in the deletion primitive protects drive roots, Windows (except Temp, the update download cache, CBS/DISM logs and crash dumps), Program Files (except the Steam shader cache, logs and dumps), ProgramData roots, Defender folders, profile roots, Documents, Desktop, Pictures, Music, Videos, Saved Games, OneDrive and the Downloads folder (opt-in rule only).',

        'Junctions, symbolic links and mount points are never followed or deleted; each file''s parent chain is re-checked for reparse points right before deletion.',
```

`tools/Convert-IgwtV1Data.ps1`:

```ps1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Migrates iG Windows Tuner 1.x data to schema v2.
.DESCRIPTION
    Converts the catalog files under a data folder (tweaks\*.json, presets\*.json, cleaner\*.json)
    to schema v2 in place: adds level, antiCheat, reversible, sideEffects, source and hardware,
    moves appliesTo.hardware conditions to appliesTo.conditions, and turns v1 presets into intent
    presets (include, exclude, levelCeiling, antiCheatPolicy). Action definitions are never changed,
    so every existing snapshot still matches the catalog. Running it twice changes nothing.

    With -SnapshotFolder it also writes schema 2 copies of snapshot files to -SnapshotDestination.
    Originals are never modified (iG Windows Tuner reads v1 snapshots directly and upgrades them in memory),
    and the destination must be a different folder.

    This only edits files; it changes no Windows setting.
.PARAMETER DataFolder
    Data folder to convert (default: the project's data folder).
.PARAMETER SnapshotFolder
    Optional folder with snapshot-*.json files to copy as schema 2.
.PARAMETER SnapshotDestination
    Folder for the schema 2 snapshot copies (required with -SnapshotFolder).
.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\Convert-IgwtV1Data.ps1 -WhatIf
.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\Convert-IgwtV1Data.ps1 -DataFolder D:\old\AegisTune\data
#>
[CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
param([string]$DataFolder, [string]$SnapshotFolder, [string]$SnapshotDestination)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
Import-Module (Join-Path $root 'src\iGWindowsTuner.psd1') -Force
if (-not $DataFolder) { $DataFolder = Join-Path $root 'data' }
$DataFolder = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $DataFolder).ProviderPath
if ($SnapshotFolder -and -not $SnapshotDestination) { throw '-SnapshotFolder needs -SnapshotDestination (snapshots are copied, never converted in place).' }

Set-IgwtEnvironment -DataFolder $DataFolder -WhatIf:$false
try {
    $report = @(Convert-IgwtDataToV2 -DataFolder $DataFolder)
    $report | Format-Table -AutoSize File, Kind, Items, FromSchema, Changed | Out-String -Width 160 | Write-Output
    Write-Output ("{0} file(s) checked, {1} converted{2}." -f $report.Count, @($report | Where-Object { $_.Changed }).Count, $(if ($WhatIfPreference) { ' (WhatIf: nothing written)' } else { '' }))
    if ($SnapshotFolder) {
        foreach ($f in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $SnapshotFolder -Filter 'snapshot-*.json' -File)) {
            $out = Convert-IgwtSnapshotToV2 -Path $f.FullName -Destination $SnapshotDestination
            if ($out) { Write-Output "Snapshot copy: $out" }
        }
    }
    if (-not $WhatIfPreference) {
        $errors = @(Test-IgwtCatalog)
        if ($errors.Count -gt 0) { Write-Warning ("Catalog validation after migration found {0} problem(s):`n{1}" -f $errors.Count, ($errors -join "`n")) }
        else { Write-Output 'Catalog validation after migration: OK.' }
    }
} finally {
    Set-IgwtEnvironment -DataFolder '' -WhatIf:$false
}

```

`tools/Invoke-QualityChecks.ps1`:

```ps1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Runs every build-time check: catalog validation, Pester 5, PSScriptAnalyzer and a Microsoft
    Defender custom scan of the project folder. Read-only for the system.
.DESCRIPTION
    Pester 5 and PSScriptAnalyzer are development dependencies (install them for the current user:
    Install-Module Pester -RequiredVersion 5.7.1 -Scope CurrentUser -SkipPublisherCheck;
    Install-Module PSScriptAnalyzer -Scope CurrentUser). iG Windows Tuner itself has no dependencies.
    Run from a NON-elevated PowerShell: the tests refuse to run elevated on a real machine.
    Results are written to artifacts\ (Pester NUnit XML, analyzer and Defender output).
.PARAMETER SkipDefenderScan
    Skip the MpCmdRun custom scan.
.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\Invoke-QualityChecks.ps1
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$SkipDefenderScan)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$artifacts = Join-Path $root 'artifacts'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $artifacts)) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $artifacts -Force }
$failed = $false

Write-Output '== Catalog'
& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Test-Catalog.ps1')
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $failed = $true }

Write-Output '== Pester 5'
Import-Module Pester -MinimumVersion 5.0.0 -MaximumVersion 5.99.99 -ErrorAction Stop
$cfg = New-PesterConfiguration
$cfg.Run.Path = (Join-Path $root 'tests')
$cfg.Run.PassThru = $true
$cfg.Output.Verbosity = 'Normal'
$cfg.TestResult.Enabled = $true
$cfg.TestResult.OutputPath = (Join-Path $artifacts 'pester-results.xml')
$result = Invoke-Pester -Configuration $cfg
Write-Output ("Pester: {0} passed, {1} failed, {2} skipped" -f $result.PassedCount, $result.FailedCount, $result.SkippedCount)
if ($result.FailedCount -gt 0) { $failed = $true }

Write-Output '== PSScriptAnalyzer'
Import-Module PSScriptAnalyzer -ErrorAction Stop
$findings = @(Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path $root -Recurse)
$findings | Select-Object Severity, RuleName, ScriptName, Line, Message | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 250 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $artifacts 'scriptanalyzer.txt') -Encoding UTF8
Write-Output ("ScriptAnalyzer: {0} error(s), {1} warning(s), {2} information" -f @($findings | Where-Object Severity -EQ 'Error').Count, @($findings | Where-Object Severity -EQ 'Warning').Count, @($findings | Where-Object Severity -EQ 'Information').Count)
if (@($findings | Where-Object { $_.Severity -in 'Error', 'Warning' }).Count -gt 0) { $failed = $true }

if (-not $SkipDefenderScan) {
    Write-Output '== Microsoft Defender custom scan'
    $mp = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Windows Defender\MpCmdRun.exe'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $mp) {
        $out = & $mp -Scan -ScanType 3 -File $root 2>&1 | Out-String
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
        Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $artifacts 'defender-scan.txt') -Value ("Exit code: $code`r`n" + $out) -Encoding UTF8
        Write-Output $out.Trim()
        Write-Output "MpCmdRun exit code: $code (0 = no threats found)"
        if ($code -ne 0) { $failed = $true }
    } else { Write-Output 'MpCmdRun.exe not found; scan skipped.' }
}

if ($failed) { Write-Output 'RESULT: FAILED'; exit 1 }
Write-Output 'RESULT: all checks passed'
exit 0

```

`tools/Invoke-SandboxTest.ps1`:

```ps1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    End-to-end test INSIDE Windows Sandbox: apply all -> verify -> revert all -> verify.
.DESCRIPTION
    Started automatically by tools\iGWindowsTuner.wsb (project mapped read-only to C:\iGWindowsTuner, results
    folder mapped writable to C:\SandboxResults). It refuses to run anywhere except Windows Sandbox
    because it really applies every non-expert tweak to the (disposable) sandbox system.

    Steps:
      1. Health report (HTML) and the state of every tweak before.
      2. Raw capture of every registry value the catalog touches.
      3. Apply all non-expert tweaks (one of each conflicting pair), without a restore point
         (Sandbox has no System Protection; the JSON snapshot is still written).
      4. Verify: every applicable tweak should now be On (GPU/TPM/adapter items report NotApplicable).
      5. Revert from the snapshot written in step 3.
      6. Verify: every captured registry value is back exactly (type, data, absent).
    Results: summary.txt, results.json, report.html, transcript.txt and the iG Windows Tuner logs.
.PARAMETER ResultsPath
    Writable results folder (default C:\SandboxResults).
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param([string]$ResultsPath = 'C:\SandboxResults')
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ResultsPath)) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ResultsPath -Force }
Start-Transcript -Path (Join-Path $ResultsPath 'transcript.txt') -Force | Out-Null
try {
    if ($env:USERNAME -ne 'WDAGUtilityAccount') {
        throw 'Safety stop: this script applies every tweak for real and only runs inside Windows Sandbox (user WDAGUtilityAccount).'
    }
    $projectRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
    Import-Module (Join-Path $projectRoot 'src\iGWindowsTuner.psd1') -Force
    $module = Get-Module iGWindowsTuner

    Write-Output '== Report'
    $report = Get-IgwtHealthReport
    $null = Export-IgwtHealthReport -Report $report -Path (Join-Path $ResultsPath 'report.html') -Format Html

    $catalog = @(Get-IgwtCatalog)
    $skip = @('power.high-performance-plan', 'net.doh-cloudflare', 'sec.asr-office-audit')
    $ids = @($catalog | Where-Object { -not $_.expert -and $skip -notcontains $_.id } | ForEach-Object { $_.id })

    $captureRegistry = {
        param($Catalog)
        $rows = @()
        foreach ($t in $Catalog) {
            foreach ($a in @($t.actions)) {
                if ($a.type -notin 'registry', 'registryListMerge') { continue }
                $v = Get-IgwtRegistryValue -Path $a.path -Name $a.name
                $rows += [pscustomobject]@{ Key = "$($a.path)\$($a.name)"; Exists = $v.Exists; Kind = $v.Kind; Value = (ConvertTo-IgwtSerializableValue -Value $v.Value -Kind $v.Kind) }
            }
        }
        $rows | Sort-Object Key -Unique
    }

    Write-Output '== Before'
    $ctx = New-IgwtContext
    $before = @(Get-IgwtAllTweakStates -Context $ctx | Select-Object Id, State, Reason)
    $regBefore = & $module $captureRegistry $catalog

    Write-Output "== Apply $($ids.Count) tweaks"
    $apply = Invoke-IgwtApply -Id $ids -Operation 'Apply' -SkipRestorePoint
    $applyFailed = @($apply.Results | Where-Object Result -EQ 'Failed')
    $notVerified = @($apply.Results | Where-Object { $_.Result -eq 'Applied' -and $_.PSObject.Properties['Verified'] -and -not $_.Verified })

    Write-Output '== Verify after apply'
    $ctx = New-IgwtContext
    $after = @(Get-IgwtAllTweakStates -Id $ids -Context $ctx | Select-Object Id, State, Reason)
    $notOn = @($after | Where-Object { $_.State -notin 'On', 'NotApplicable', 'ManagedByPolicy' })

    Write-Output '== Revert'
    $revert = $null
    if ($apply.Snapshot) { $revert = Invoke-IgwtRevert -SnapshotPath $apply.Snapshot }
    $revertFailed = @()
    if ($revert) { $revertFailed = @($revert.Results | Where-Object Result -EQ 'Failed') }

    Write-Output '== Verify after revert'
    $regAfter = & $module $captureRegistry $catalog
    $mismatch = @()
    foreach ($b in $regBefore) {
        $a = $regAfter | Where-Object Key -EQ $b.Key | Select-Object -First 1
        if (-not $a -or $a.Exists -ne $b.Exists -or $a.Kind -ne $b.Kind -or (ConvertTo-Json $a.Value -Compress) -ne (ConvertTo-Json $b.Value -Compress)) {
            $mismatch += [pscustomobject]@{ Key = $b.Key; Before = "$($b.Exists) $($b.Kind) $(ConvertTo-Json $b.Value -Compress)"; After = $(if ($a) { "$($a.Exists) $($a.Kind) $(ConvertTo-Json $a.Value -Compress)" } else { 'missing' }) }
        }
    }
    $ctx = New-IgwtContext
    $final = @(Get-IgwtAllTweakStates -Context $ctx | Select-Object Id, State, Reason)
    $stateDiff = @(foreach ($b in $before) { $f = $final | Where-Object Id -EQ $b.Id; if ($f.State -ne $b.State) { [pscustomobject]@{ Id = $b.Id; Before = $b.State; After = $f.State } } })

    $pass = ($applyFailed.Count -eq 0 -and $revertFailed.Count -eq 0 -and $mismatch.Count -eq 0)
    $results = [ordered]@{
        Pass = $pass; Build = (Get-IgwtOsInfo).FullBuild; Applied = @($apply.Results | Where-Object Result -EQ 'Applied').Count
        ApplyFailed = $applyFailed; NotVerified = $notVerified; NotOnAfterApply = $notOn; RevertFailed = $revertFailed
        RegistryMismatchAfterRevert = $mismatch; StateDifferencesAfterRevert = $stateDiff; Before = $before; After = $after; Final = $final
        ApplySnapshot = $apply.Snapshot; RevertSnapshot = $(if ($revert) { $revert.Snapshot } else { $null })
    }
    $results | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ResultsPath 'results.json') -Encoding UTF8
    $summary = @(
        "iG Windows Tuner Windows Sandbox test - $(Get-Date -Format s)"
        "Result: $(if ($pass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' })"
        "Tweaks applied: $($results.Applied); apply failures: $($applyFailed.Count); not verified: $($notVerified.Count)"
        "Applicable tweaks not On after apply: $($notOn.Count)"
        "Revert failures: $($revertFailed.Count); registry values not restored exactly: $($mismatch.Count); state differences after revert: $($stateDiff.Count)"
        ''
        'Apply failures:'; ($applyFailed | ForEach-Object { "  $($_.Id): $($_.Message)" })
        'Not On after apply (expected for hardware-dependent items in Sandbox):'; ($notOn | ForEach-Object { "  $($_.Id): $($_.State) $($_.Reason)" })
        'Registry mismatches after revert:'; ($mismatch | ForEach-Object { "  $($_.Key): before $($_.Before) / after $($_.After)" })
        'State differences after revert:'; ($stateDiff | ForEach-Object { "  $($_.Id): $($_.Before) -> $($_.After)" })
    )
    $summary | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ResultsPath 'summary.txt') -Encoding UTF8
    $summary | Write-Output
    $logs = Get-IgwtDataPath -Kind Logs
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $logs) { Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $logs '*') -Destination $ResultsPath -Force }
} catch {
    Write-Output "Sandbox test aborted: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    "ABORTED: $($_.Exception.Message)" | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ResultsPath 'summary.txt') -Encoding UTF8
} finally {
    Stop-Transcript | Out-Null
}

```

`tools/New-Release.ps1`:

```ps1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Builds a release folder and zip in dist\ (catalog check, docs, optional tests, SHA256 manifest).
.DESCRIPTION
    Read-only for the system: it only reads the project and writes into dist\. Ships plain
    .ps1/.psm1/.psd1/.json/.xaml files plus the .cmd launcher; no EXE packaging.
.PARAMETER SkipTests
    Do not run Pester and PSScriptAnalyzer before packaging.
.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\New-Release.ps1
#>
[CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
param([switch]$SkipTests)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$version = (Import-PowerShellDataFile (Join-Path $root 'src\iGWindowsTuner.psd1')).ModuleVersion

& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Test-Catalog.ps1')
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Catalog validation failed.' }
& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Build-Docs.ps1')
if (-not $SkipTests) {
    & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Invoke-QualityChecks.ps1') -SkipDefenderScan
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Quality checks failed.' }
}

$dist = Join-Path $root 'dist'
$stage = Join-Path $dist "iGWindowsTuner-$version"
if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($stage, 'Create release folder')) { return }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $stage) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $stage -Recurse -Force }
$null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stage -Force
foreach ($item in 'iGWindowsTuner.ps1', 'Start-iGWindowsTuner.cmd', 'CLAUDE.md', 'README.md', 'PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1', 'src', 'data', 'docs', 'tools', 'tests') {
    $src = Join-Path $root $item
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $src) { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination $stage -Recurse -Force }
}
$lines = foreach ($f in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $stage -Recurse -File | Sort-Object FullName)) {
    '{0}  {1}' -f (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(), $f.FullName.Substring($stage.Length + 1).Replace('\', '/')
}
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines((Join-Path $stage 'SHA256SUMS.txt'), [string[]]@($lines), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
$zip = Join-Path $dist "iGWindowsTuner-$version.zip"
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $zip) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $zip -Force }
Compress-Archive -Path (Join-Path $stage '*') -DestinationPath $zip
$hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
Set-Content -LiteralPath "$zip.sha256" -Value "$hash  iGWindowsTuner-$version.zip" -Encoding ASCII
Write-Output "Release: $zip"
Write-Output "SHA256:  $hash"
Write-Output 'Note: files extracted from a downloaded zip carry Mark-of-the-Web; review them, then Unblock-File if you trust them.'

```

`tools/New-SandboxConfig.ps1`:

```ps1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Writes tools\iGWindowsTuner.wsb for the current project location and creates the results folder.
.DESCRIPTION
    Windows Sandbox needs absolute host paths. This script regenerates the .wsb with this
    project's folder (mapped read-only) and a sibling "iGWindowsTuner-SandboxResults" folder (writable).
    It does not start Windows Sandbox; double-click tools\iGWindowsTuner.wsb when you are ready.
    Windows Sandbox must be enabled (Windows features: "Windows Sandbox"); enabling it is your call.
.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\New-SandboxConfig.ps1
#>
[CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
param([string]$ResultsFolder)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
if (-not $ResultsFolder) { $ResultsFolder = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $root) 'iGWindowsTuner-SandboxResults' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ResultsFolder) -and $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($ResultsFolder, 'Create results folder')) {
    $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ResultsFolder -Force
}
$esc = { param($s) [System.Security.SecurityElement]::Escape($s) }
$xml = @"
<Configuration>
  <!-- iG Windows Tuner end-to-end test in Windows Sandbox (generated by tools\New-SandboxConfig.ps1). -->
  <VGpu>Disable</VGpu>
  <Networking>Enable</Networking>
  <MemoryInMB>4096</MemoryInMB>
  <MappedFolders>
    <MappedFolder>
      <HostFolder>$(& $esc $root)</HostFolder>
      <SandboxFolder>C:\iGWindowsTuner</SandboxFolder>
      <ReadOnly>true</ReadOnly>
    </MappedFolder>
    <MappedFolder>
      <HostFolder>$(& $esc $ResultsFolder)</HostFolder>
      <SandboxFolder>C:\SandboxResults</SandboxFolder>
      <ReadOnly>false</ReadOnly>
    </MappedFolder>
  </MappedFolders>
  <LogonCommand>
    <Command>powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\iGWindowsTuner\tools\Invoke-SandboxTest.ps1 -ResultsPath C:\SandboxResults</Command>
  </LogonCommand>
</Configuration>
"@
$wsb = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'iGWindowsTuner.wsb'
if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($wsb, 'Write sandbox configuration')) { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($wsb, $xml, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))) }
Write-Output "Wrote $wsb (results: $ResultsFolder). Double-click it to start the test; read summary.txt in the results folder afterwards."
```

`tools/Sign-Toolbox.ps1`:

```ps1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Optional: Authenticode-sign iG Windows Tuner's PowerShell files with YOUR certificate and write a
    SHA256 manifest of every shipped file.
.DESCRIPTION
    - Signs *.ps1, *.psm1 and *.psd1 with a code-signing certificate from Cert:\CurrentUser\My
      (selected by thumbprint, or the only code-signing certificate present).
    - -CreateSelfSignedCertificate creates "CN=iG Windows Tuner Local Code Signing" in
      Cert:\CurrentUser\My, but only after you confirm. It never adds the certificate to the
      Trusted Root or Trusted Publishers stores; the script prints how to do that yourself if
      you want signatures to show as Valid.
    - Always writes SHA256SUMS.txt (after signing, so the hashes match the signed files).
    - -Verify checks the current files against SHA256SUMS.txt and reports differences.
    .cmd, .json and .xaml files cannot carry Authenticode signatures; the manifest covers them.
.PARAMETER CertificateThumbprint
    Thumbprint of an existing code-signing certificate in Cert:\CurrentUser\My.
.PARAMETER CreateSelfSignedCertificate
    Create a self-signed code-signing certificate (asks for confirmation).
.PARAMETER TimestampServer
    Optional RFC 3161 timestamp URL (signing then needs network access).
.PARAMETER ManifestOnly
    Only (re)write SHA256SUMS.txt.
.PARAMETER Verify
    Verify files against SHA256SUMS.txt.
.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\Sign-Toolbox.ps1 -ManifestOnly
.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\Sign-Toolbox.ps1 -CreateSelfSignedCertificate
.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\Sign-Toolbox.ps1 -Verify
#>
[CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true)]
param(
    [string]$CertificateThumbprint,
    [switch]$CreateSelfSignedCertificate,
    [string]$TimestampServer,
    [switch]$ManifestOnly,
    [switch]$Verify
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$manifestPath = Join-Path $root 'SHA256SUMS.txt'

function Get-ShippedFile {
    $include = @('iGWindowsTuner.ps1', 'Start-iGWindowsTuner.cmd', 'CLAUDE.md', 'README.md', 'PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1')
    $files = foreach ($n in $include) { $p = Join-Path $root $n; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { Get-Item -LiteralPath $p } }
    $files = @($files) + @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'src'), (Join-Path $root 'data'), (Join-Path $root 'docs'), (Join-Path $root 'tools'), (Join-Path $root 'tests') -Recurse -File)
    return @($files | Sort-Object FullName)
}

function Get-RelativePath([string]$Full) { return $Full.Substring($root.Length + 1).Replace('\', '/') }

if ($Verify) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $manifestPath)) { throw "No manifest at $manifestPath." }
    $expected = @{}
    foreach ($line in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifestPath)) { if ($line -match '^([0-9a-f]{64})\s+(.+)$') { $expected[$Matches[2]] = $Matches[1] } }
    $bad = 0
    foreach ($f in (Get-ShippedFile)) {
        $rel = Get-RelativePath $f.FullName
        $h = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
        if (-not $expected.ContainsKey($rel)) { Write-Output "NEW      $rel"; $bad++ }
        elseif ($expected[$rel] -ne $h) { Write-Output "CHANGED  $rel"; $bad++ }
        $expected.Remove($rel)
    }
    foreach ($k in $expected.Keys) { Write-Output "MISSING  $k"; $bad++ }
    if ($bad -eq 0) { Write-Output 'All files match SHA256SUMS.txt.'; exit 0 }
    exit 1
}

if (-not $ManifestOnly) {
    $cert = $null
    if ($CreateSelfSignedCertificate) {
        $question = 'Create a self-signed code-signing certificate "CN=iG Windows Tuner Local Code Signing" in Cert:\CurrentUser\My? It is only trusted after you add it to Trusted Publishers yourself.'
        if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldContinue($question, 'iG Windows Tuner signing')) { Write-Output 'Cancelled; no certificate created.'; exit 2 }
        $cert = New-SelfSignedCertificate -Type CodeSigningCert -Subject 'CN=iG Windows Tuner Local Code Signing' -CertStoreLocation 'Cert:\CurrentUser\My' -KeyAlgorithm RSA -KeyLength 3072 -HashAlgorithm SHA256 -NotAfter (Get-Date).AddYears(3)
        Write-Output "Created certificate $($cert.Thumbprint) in Cert:\CurrentUser\My."
        Write-Output 'To make the signatures Valid on this PC, export the public certificate and import it into "Trusted Publishers"'
        Write-Output '(and "Trusted Root Certification Authorities" for a self-signed certificate) for the current user. iG Windows Tuner does not do this for you.'
    } elseif ($CertificateThumbprint) {
        $cert = Get-ChildItem -Path 'Cert:\CurrentUser\My' -CodeSigningCert | Where-Object { $_.Thumbprint -eq $CertificateThumbprint } | Select-Object -First 1
    } else {
        $all = @(Get-ChildItem -Path 'Cert:\CurrentUser\My' -CodeSigningCert)
        if ($all.Count -eq 1) { $cert = $all[0] }
        elseif ($all.Count -gt 1) { throw 'Several code-signing certificates found; pass -CertificateThumbprint.' }
    }
    if (-not $cert) { throw 'No code-signing certificate found. Pass -CertificateThumbprint, use -CreateSelfSignedCertificate, or run with -ManifestOnly.' }
    $toSign = @(Get-ShippedFile | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.ps1', '.psm1', '.psd1' })
    foreach ($f in $toSign) {
        if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($f.FullName, 'Authenticode sign')) { continue }
        $params = @{ FilePath = $f.FullName; Certificate = $cert; HashAlgorithm = 'SHA256' }
        if ($TimestampServer) { $params.TimestampServer = $TimestampServer }
        $sig = Set-AuthenticodeSignature @params
        Write-Output ("{0,-14} {1}" -f $sig.Status, (Get-RelativePath $f.FullName))
    }
}

if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($manifestPath, 'Write SHA256 manifest')) {
    $lines = foreach ($f in (Get-ShippedFile)) {
        if ($f.FullName -eq $manifestPath) { continue }
        '{0}  {1}' -f (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(), (Get-RelativePath $f.FullName)
    }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines($manifestPath, [string[]]@($lines), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    Write-Output "Wrote $manifestPath ($(@($lines).Count) files)."
}

```

`tools/Test-Catalog.ps1`:

```ps1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Validates data\tweaks\*.json, presets and the rejected list. Read-only.
.DESCRIPTION
    Checks required fields, hint length, sources for Tier A/B, unique ids, revert paths,
    preset references, conflicts, expert/anti-cheat rules and the rejected list.
    Exit code 0 = valid, 1 = errors found.
.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\Test-Catalog.ps1
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param()
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src\iGWindowsTuner.psd1') -Force
$errors = @(Test-IgwtCatalog)
$catalog = @(Get-IgwtCatalog)
if ($errors.Count -eq 0) {
    Write-Output ("Catalog OK: {0} tweaks ({1} Tier A, {2} Tier B), {3} presets, {4} rejected entries." -f $catalog.Count,
        @($catalog | Where-Object { $_.evidence.tier -eq 'A' }).Count, @($catalog | Where-Object { $_.evidence.tier -eq 'B' }).Count,
        @(Get-IgwtPreset).Count, @(Get-IgwtRejectedTweaks).Count)
    exit 0
}
Write-Output "Catalog has $($errors.Count) error(s):"
$errors | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "  - $_" }
exit 1
```
